descKeys: inkers. the merchant area stretches to the northwest as well as south from here.
r1.description:
This part of Nal Shaddar has been set aside for the merchant trade.  Various
booths and vendors are around, hawking their wares.  Directly west of here
you can see a tavern, full of rowdy drinkers.  The Merchant Area stretches to
the northwest as well as south from here.

descKeys: -sized structure to the west. unfortunately you cannot enter it from this point.
r2.description:
The Merchant Area of Nal Shaddar stretches on here.  The area is full of
stalls, vendors, and merchants hawking their wares and services.  You are
right behind a medium-sized structure to the west.  Unfortunately you cannot
enter it from this point.

descKeys: throughout all hours of the day with people looking to purchase items they need.
r3.description:
You are in the southeastern corner of the expansive Merchant Area of Nal
Shaddar.  Vendors and merchants aplenty are around here, begging you to
see what they have to offer.  The area is fairly crowded throughout all
hours of the day with people looking to purchase items they need.

descKeys: op of the city. back to the east it seems that the area turns towards the north.
r4.description:
This is the southern portion of the Nal Shaddar Merchant Area.  All around this
spot are merchants and vendors trying to sell people something.  Directly to
the northwest is the main shop of the city.  Back to the east it seems that
the area turns towards the north.

descKeys: as you see that a few of the stalls are mostly empty. a tavern is to the south.
r5.description:
You are in the Market Area of Nal Shaddar.  The cavern is not so high above
your head here, as it is close to the cavern walls to the east.  Several of
the vendors look as if they are about out of items to sell, as you see that
a few of the stalls are mostly empty.  A tavern is to the south.

descKeys: ns down into the floor, heading to the food- serving part of this establishment.
down into the floor, heading to the food- serving part of this establishment.
r7.description:
You are in a small tavern in Nal Shaddar.  Patrons sit around small wooden
tables and sip their drinks with a casual interest.  Here and there you can
see a red stain on the wall or floor, signifying that there are many brawls
and other altercations that occur here.  As most of the patrons of this place
are not from Nal Shaddar, but are visiting merchants, a varied drink list can
be found.  A set of stairs runs down into the floor, heading to the food-
serving part of this establishment.
r7.title: small tavern in Nal Shaddar

descKeys: d other goods. the market area continues to the east and also back to the south.
r8.description:
This area of Nal Shaddar is commonly known as the Market Area, as there are
several shops and things here.  You see several vendors with thier wares,
hawking trinkets and other goods.  The market area continues to the east and
also back to the south.

descKeys: tock. a small archway in southern wall of the shop leads to another small store.
r9.description:
You are in a small shop situated in the Drow city of Nal Shaddar.  Many
shelves line the walls, holding various types of equipment and other items.
Although Nal Shaddar is quite off the beaten path, it is possible to even find
human and possible minotaur or halfling goods in stock.  A small archway in
southern wall of the shop leads to another small store.

descKeys: bank is to the southeast. the market area also continues to the west and north.
so continues to the west and north.
notes: listen: Loud and raucous laughter is eminating from the east.
smell: You smell a faint aroma of meat cooking to the east.

senses.listen: Loud and raucous laughter is eminating from the east.
senses.smell: You smell a faint aroma of meat cooking to the east.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r10.description:
This is the market center of Nal Shaddar.  A few shops have been erected here
to entice the wandering shopper to enter and purchase a useless trinket.  A
small tavern is east of here, judging from the aromatic smells issuing out
of it.  A trading shop is to the south, and a bank is to the southeast.
The market area also continues to the west and north.

descKeys: of here there is a large building that is home to the merchants of nal shaddar.
r11.description:
You are in the market section of Nal Shaddar.  The area is very busy with
merchants of all kinds, and houses several shops, both exotic and mundane.
The market area extends a ways to the east from here.  A general shop is
located to the southeast.  Just south of here there is a large building
that is home to the merchants of Nal Shaddar.

descKeys: few spots behind it for a drow to sit. the exit to the building leads northwest.
notes: listen: Loud and raucous laughter is eminating from the east.
smell: You smell a faint aroma of meat cooking to the east.

senses.listen: Loud and raucous laughter is eminating from the east.
senses.smell: You smell a faint aroma of meat cooking to the east.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r12.description:
You are in a small building that functions as a bank of sorts.  The room you
are in is devoid of most furnishings, only having a few benches here and there.
There is a long counter on the southern wall, with a few spots behind it for
a Drow to sit.  The exit to the building leads northwest.

descKeys: bove you are smooth and unnatural, as if this cave was not a natural occurrence.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r13.description:
The paved road branches off here, leading northeast to the more crowded parts
of Nal Shaddar, west to the entrance of the city, and southeast towards the
market area.  The cavern walls far above you are smooth and unnatural, as
if this cave was not a natural occurrence.

descKeys: others. that house can only be bey-sandrax, the most powerful house in the city.
r14.description:
You are in the more crowded part of Nal Shaddar.  Many Drow houses have been
constructed here in the past four thousand years.  You can see a huge and well-
situated house off to the east, standing out from the others.  That house can
only be Bey-Sandrax, the most powerful house in the city.

descKeys: or at least four thousand years, and is in no current danger of being destroyed.
r15.description:
The gates in front of this Drow house, Bey-Sandrax, are as massive as the
gates guarding the entrance to Nal Shaddar.  Being the largest and most
powerful house in Nal Shaddar, Bey-Sandrax has little to fear from most of
the other houses. Bey-Sandrax has been around for at least four thousand years,
and is in no current danger of being destroyed.

descKeys: the east side of the road is a large gate, probably an opening to a drow house.

yellow potions of cure critical wounds.name: yellow potions of cure critical wounds

r16.description:
You are in the more crowded part of Nal Shaddar, with a lot of the Drow Houses
having been constructed around here.  The road is running north and south,
weaving its way through the city.  You notice that on the east side of the
road is a large gate, probably an opening to a Drow House.

descKeys: t lead to one of those numerous houses. the road goes both north and also south.
r17.description:
This large road is running through the crowded section of the city, passing
by several of the Drow Houses.  Directly to the east is a large gate, which
must lead to one of those numerous Houses.  The road goes both north and
also south.

descKeys: m. the road continues back to the south and passes by several other drow houses.
r18.description:
The road ends here, running itself right up to the cavern wall.  This part of
Nal Shaddar is where most of the Drow Houses are located.  There is a gate to
the east which must lead to one of them.  The road continues back to the south
and passes by several other Drow Houses.

descKeys: through a newer part of the city that looks to not have been here for very long.
r19.description:
The Drow city of Nal Shaddar has been around for a long time, and is constantly
being expanded, using the slave workers to carve out new areas for the Drow
to use.  This small road is travelling through a newer part of the city that
looks to not have been here for very long.

descKeys: sion. through a dark and unwelcoming doorway to the northeast lies a small shop.
r20.description:
The shadows around here are deep and well-abundant.  The few light sources
come from an occasional faerie fire that have been seemingly conjured up
at random, giving you a sense of confusion.  Through a dark and unwelcoming
doorway to the northeast lies a small shop.

descKeys: o have fallen in the streets. there is a small alley that heads north from here.
r21.description:
Nal Shaddar is quite large and has several winding roads making their way
around the huge cavern.  This part of Nal Shaddar seems kind of deserted,
with most of the buildings around this area of the city being abandoned.
An unnatural hush seems to have fallen in the streets.  There is a small
alley that heads north from here.

descKeys: many shelves upon them. the shelves in turn are filled with items of all types.
r22.description:
This small and curious magic shop was established some twenty years ago by
an aging adventurer named Belwar Dissente.  Belwar had acquired numerous
magical items over his travels, and now he wishes to settle down and live
off of the items he has attained.  The walls of the shop have many shelves
upon them.  The shelves in turn are filled with items of all types.

descKeys: the herd is kept. back towards the south lies the rest of the underground city.
r23.description:
You are nearing the northern section of Nal Shaddar, which is used mainly
to contain the city's meat supply: a herd of rothes.  Up ahead to the north
is Rothe Island, where the herd is kept.  Back towards the south lies the
rest of the underground city.

descKeys: here is a small shop, smelling of fish. the rest of nal shaddar is to the south.
r24.description:
You are standing on a small dock, situated on the southern end of a fairly
large subterranean lake.  In the middle of the lake is an island of perhaps
two hundred feet in diameter.  The surface of the lake is smooth and waveless.
Directly east of here is a small shop, smelling of fish.  The rest of Nal
Shaddar is to the south.

descKeys: the surface being scratched and tarnished. the dock continues to the northeast.
r25.description:
You are standing at the end of the Rothe Island dock.  The water below
you is very murky, and is surely colder than you could imagine.  The dock
is made out of gray stone, with the surface being scratched and tarnished.
The dock continues to the northeast.

descKeys: on graxxas to provide them with fresh fish from the lake that is north of here.
r26.description:
This small shop, seeming quite out of place here in Nal Shaddar, was opened
up by a not-so-intelligent Drow by the name of Graxxas.  The shop is very
small, but seems to do a decent business.  The Matrons of all the houses
normally call on Graxxas to provide them with fresh fish from the lake
that is north of here.

descKeys: , but nothing worth investigating. back to the south you can see that main road.
r27.description:
You are in a small alley just off a main road in the northern part of Nal
Shaddar.  Here and there you can spot a large rat, just squatting there, quite
unafraid.  A few piles of trash are about, but nothing worth investigating.
Back to the south you can see that main road.

descKeys: sword in each of its eight appendages. a large building is located to the west.

senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

Baka (Ghost) shouts : ah

There are lots and lots of stalactites hanging from the ceiling of the cavern,
far above you.  A large building to the north draws your attention.  It
looks as if the architect of that building wanted it to resemble a huge and
hideous spider holding a gleaming sword in each of its eight appendages.
A large building is located to the west.

descKeys: lee-magthere. you also see that a large hole in the cavern floor is to the west.
notes: listen: You hear metal clashing upon metal.

senses.listen: You hear metal clashing upon metal.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r29.description:
You are standing before the large spider-like building that houses Melee-
Magthere, the school of Drow Warriors.  Many such warriors can be seen as
they enter and exit the academy.  For Drow warriors, this academy is a way
of life as it is also a way of survival.  You see that a small opening is
leading down towards a dark area underneath Melee-Magthere.  You also see that
a large hole in the cavern floor is to the west.

descKeys: while a large opening leads into an area in front of melee-magthere, presumably.
notes: listen: A faint clanking of armor reaches your ears.
smell: A slightly musty scent is wafting though the area.

senses.listen: A faint clanking of armor reaches your ears.
senses.smell: A slightly musty scent is wafting though the area.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r30.description:
You are beneath the bowels of Melee-Magthere, the celebrated school of Fighters.
This area is the stables, where the mounts of that organization are kept.  You
can see several stalls where the individual mounts are kept.  A small staircase
leads up to the main part of Melee-Magthere, while a large opening leads into
an area in front of Melee-Magthere, presumably.

descKeys: rants and stories of the evil surface faeries. a small set of stairs leads down.
notes: listen: You hear oration from the north.

senses.listen: You hear oration from the north.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r31.description:
You are standing in the academy for Drow warriors, Melee-Magthere.  Young
Drow students come here at the age of (roughly) twenty-five to study the art
of warfare and also the skills of being city guards.  Towards the north is
Lore Room, where each of the students are subjected to the Loremaster's rants
and stories of the evil surface faeries.  A small set of stairs leads down.

descKeys: t to look at that sign. there is a adamantite door leading southwest ( opened ).
might want to look at that sign. there is a adamantite door leading southwest .

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r32.description:
the page open yet.  It will be called Protect the People
You are in the Lore Room of Melee-Magthere.  Here the Loremaster spins dark
and dizzying tales about the evil surface elves, the faeries.  No weapons are
allowed in this room, for fear of fights starting as the students get caught
up in the deceptive yarns about the 'supposed' evil elves.  There is a small
sign on the wall.  You might want to look at that sign.
There is a adamantite door leading southwest ( OPENED ).

descKeys: . a small set of stairs leads down. the main part of nal shaddar is to the east.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r33.description:
You are in a fairly large building, used by the citizens of Nal Shaddar to
keep current on any news that concerns the city.  The shape of the building
vaguely resembles a spider, hence the name of the structure.  A small set of
stairs leads down.  The main part of Nal Shaddar is to the east.

descKeys: chairs have been placed around the room in a haphazard and chaotic sort of way.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r34.description:
You are in a small chamber, located beneath the Hall of the Spider, which is
up from here if you use the set of stairs.  The room is sparsely decorated.
A few stone chairs have been placed around the room in a haphazard and chaotic
sort of way.

descKeys: ere and there you can see a few lone drow walking about, keeping to the shadows.
see a few lone drow walking about, keeping to the shadows.
r35.description:
Stretching out before you to the east is the Drow city of Nal Shaddar.
Although you can see no direct light sources, flickers of faerie fire can
be spotted glinting off of the shiny cavern walls.  Here and there you can
see a few lone Drow walking about, keeping to the shadows.

descKeys: obably scheming up some evil plan to raise themselves higher in loth's standing.
evil plan to raise themselves higher in loth's standing.
r36.description:
You are in the hub of the Drow city of Nal Shaddar.  Paved roads and smaller
packed dirt paths lead away from here, going throughout the city.  Small
groups of Drow can be found talking together here, probably scheming up some
evil plan to raise themselves higher in Loth's standing.

descKeys: ourself. glancing east and then west, you decide that either way is just as bad.
r37.description:
The paved road you are travelling on is totally devoid of any surface marks
of any kind.  It must be maintained using magic, you surmise with a sharp
clarity that surprises yourself.  Glancing east and then west, you decide that
either way is just as bad.

descKeys: n archway leads east, heading to the kitchen, and a set of stairs leads upwards.
notes: smell: The pleasant smell of baking bread reaches your nostrils.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.smell: The pleasant smell of baking bread reaches your nostrils.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r40.description:
You are in the eating establishment called the 'UnderDark Jewel'.  It is
located directly undernearth the 'Dragons Poison' tavern, and is owned by
the same individual.  Several tables are around the room, where patrons
can sit and eat in peace, or a relative facsimile thereof, considering that
you are in one of the more deadly cities in the world.  An archway leads
east, heading to the kitchen, and a set of stairs leads upwards.

descKeys: typical in nal shaddar. a large oven, used often, is in the corner of the room.
r41.description:
This small kitchen is here to provide the food that is ordered by patrons of
the 'UnderDark Jewel', which is directly west of here through an archway.
Several open fires are here, although they are low on flames as fire is not
something that is typical in Nal Shaddar.  A large oven, used often, is in the
corner of the room.

descKeys: udent who is standing is awarded the title of melee master until the next melee.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r43.description:
This large cavern is the spot where the annual Grand Melee is held.  The Grand
Melee is held once every year near the end of the student's studies.  All of
the warriors who are in the same class are let loose in here with padded
weapons and are graded on their stealth and weapon-use.  The last student who
is standing is awarded the title of Melee Master until the next Melee.

descKeys: und here someplace. a small archway leads to the north and into a general store.
r44.description:
This small store specializes in Gems of all sorts.  Several shelves are on
the walls of the shop, displaying rare gems from around the area.  The owner
of this shop should be around here someplace.  A small archway leads to the
north and into a general store.

descKeys: room are padded mats, in case a student gets knocked down during the exercises.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r46.description:
This is the academy's weaponry and practice room.  Along one wall there is a
huge glass case attached to it.  The case holds hundreds of weapons of war and
destruction.  In the middle of the room are padded mats, in case a student
gets knocked down during the exercises.

descKeys: he north where it meets the island, and to the southwest where it ends abruptly.
r47.description:
The Rothe Island dock stretches for approximately fifty or so feet, jutting
out over the murky water.  Looking over the side of the dock and into the
water, you can barely see any ripples or waves marring the surface.  The
dock continues to the north where it meets the island, and to the southwest
where it ends abruptly.

descKeys: island is to the north a few feet, stretching out to the north in a large oval.
r48.description:
This is the Rothe Island dock.  It stretches out over the dark waters a
small ways to the south.  The dock itself is made from a polished gray stone,
hand-chiseled.  The Island is to the north a few feet, stretching out to the
north in a large oval.

descKeys: northeast. a small trail, surprisingly free of any debris, starts to the north.
r49.description:
You are standing just north of the Rothe Island dock.  The dock continues
to the south, jutting out over the murky water.  The shore of the Island
continues to the west and northeast.  A small trail, surprisingly free of
any debris, starts to the north.

descKeys: northeast towards a large tower and also to the south towards the island's dock.
r50.description:
You are strolling along a small trail that is free of any debris.  The smooth
ground must have been purposely been kept clean.  The trail continues to
the north, where it turns to the northeast towards a large tower and also
to the south towards the Island's dock.

descKeys: r mud marring its surface. off in the distance you can hear the call of a rothe.
r51.description:
The trail turns here, heading to the south towards the Island's dock, and
also to the northeast towards a large gray tower.  The trail is completely
clean, with no trash or mud marring its surface.  Off in the distance you
can hear the call of a rothe.

descKeys: orthern shore of the island. there is a stone door leading northeast ( closed ).
orthern shore of the island. there is a stone door leading northeast ( opened ).
ards the northern shore of the island. there is a stone door leading northeast .

ne.note: stone door to the gray tower — open door first when CLOSED

r52.description:
You are standing just southwest from a large gray tower.  The tower stands
several stories high, and looks like it was constructed hastily.  Not to
say that the tower will fall down about your shoulders, but it certainly
could use some upkeep.  The trail continues to the southwest and also to
the north towards the northern shore of the Island.
There is a stone door leading northeast ( OPENED ).

descKeys: sticking straight up for several stories. the trail also continues to the south.
r53.description:
This small trail is free of debris, and looks like it is used quite often.
To the northwest is the northern side of Rothe Island, just a few paces
away.  You can also see a large gray tower to the east, sticking straight
up for several stories.  The trail also continues to the south.

descKeys: of weapons are on the walls. there is a stone door leading southwest ( opened ).
ral racks of weapons are on the walls. there is a stone door leading southwest .
r55.description:
You are standing on the ground floor of a large gray tower.  A small set of
stairs is in the southeastern corner, leading upwards.  In the middle of
the room is another staircase, running downwards.  This room looks like
a barracks or guard station of sorts.  Several racks of weapons are on the
walls.
There is a stone door leading southwest ( OPENED ).

descKeys: corner of the room there is a small set of stairs, running to the ground floor.
r56.description:
You are near the top of a large tower made out of grayish stone.  A large
bed is against the northern wall, with an enormous footlocker having been
placed at the foot of that bed.  In the southeastern corner of the room
there is a small set of stairs, running to the ground floor.

descKeys: herds. if you are indeed headed in that direction, proper footgear is essential.
r57.description:
You are walking along the shore of Rothe Island.  The water, deep and
oftentimes treacherous, lies to the south.  To the north lies one of the
grazing fields for the rothe herds.  If you are indeed headed in that
direction, proper footgear is essential.

descKeys: and is home to two smaller herds of rothes, usually the ones that are in season.
r58.description:
The interior of Rothe Island is divided into two large sections, separated
by a well-groomed path.  The western section is home to one large herd of
mostly-female rothes, while the eastern side of the Island is home to two
smaller herds of rothes, usually the ones that are in season.

descKeys: e the lake ends and the rock begins. the shore continues to the north and south.
r59.description:
The water of the lake is particularly cold, which is a rarity in the place
called the Underdark.  Looking to the west, you can barely make out the
cavern wall, where the lake ends and the rock begins.  The shore continues
to the north and south.

descKeys: rothe herds. the herds are the primary food source for the city of nal shaddar.
r60.description:
You are walking along the shore of the small Island, about ten feet from
the dark and murky water.  The interior of the Island, which is to the east,
is home to a couple of large rothe herds.  The herds are the primary food
source for the city of Nal Shaddar.

descKeys: bles, suggesting that there may be something just under the surface of the lake.
r61.description:
The Island's shore takes a turn here, heading generally northeast and also
leading south, where it eventually turns to the left.  The water around here
is full of air bubbles, suggesting that there may be something just under
the surface of the lake.

descKeys: row of the city would have to gather foodstuffs somewhere else in the underdark.
r62.description:
The Island is basically elliptical in shape, running from the southeast
to the northwest.  Home to a couple of large rothe herds, the Island is
a crucial part of Nal Shaddar's food supply.  Without the herds, the Drow
of the city would have to gather foodstuffs somewhere else in the Underdark.

descKeys: mall wall of dirt is to the southwest, blocking your progress in that direction.
r63.description:
The shoreline takes an abrupt turn here, heading south by southwest and also
east and then northeast.  The water, about ten feet away from your current
position, looks very dark and extremely cold.  A small wall of dirt is to
the southwest, blocking your progress in that direction.

descKeys: of the island, several rothe herds graze around in the moss, mooing contentedly.
r64.description:
You are standing on the shore of Rothe Island, towards the northern section
of the Island.  The water in front of you is dark, and looks treacherous.
back to the south, towards the interior of the Island, several rothe herds
graze around in the moss, mooing contentedly.

descKeys: . the trail also continues to the southeast, towards the interior of the island.
r65.description:
The shoreline of the Island is heading in a straight line, from the north-
east to the southwest.  There are a few large rocks right off shore, which
jut out of the water by about five feet.  The trail also continues to the
southeast, towards the interior of the Island.

descKeys: rothe herds. speaking of rothes, you hear one go 'mooooooooo!' in the distance.
r66.description:
The shoreline of the Island turns here, heading to the southwest and also
back to the east.  This area is free of the soft moss that is prevalent
throughout the rest of the Island, used as food by the rothe herds.  Speaking
of rothes, you hear one go 'MOOOOOOOOO!' in the distance.

descKeys: icult to see across the whole of it. the interior of the island is to the south.
r67.description:
You are standing on Rothe Island, near the northernmost tip of the Island.
To the north, across the water, is a cavern wall.  The lake is quite large,
so it is a bit difficult to see across the whole of it.  The interior of
the Island is to the south.

descKeys: movement, but it is gone quite quickly and you are not quite sure what that was.
r68.description:
The shore of the Island consists mainly of a dark sand.  Feeling the sand,
you marvel at the fineness of it.  Looking out over the water, you think
that you see a sudden movement, but it is gone quite quickly and you are
not quite sure what that was.

descKeys: looks to be very cold. you would hesitate before stepping foot into that stuff.
r69.description:
The shoreline of the Island takes a turn here, heading west and also turning
to the south, heading towards a large field of moss.  The water in front of
you is very dark, and looks to be very cold.  You would hesitate before
stepping foot into that stuff.

descKeys: he sand. it looks like there is a main watering spot for the rothe to the south.
r70.description:
The shore is running north and south here.  To the west you can see a large
field of moss, used by the rothe herds as food.  Looking down, you can see
many hoofprints in the sand.  It looks like there is a main watering spot
for the rothe to the south.

descKeys: er for weeks, they tend to come to this spot only when it is absolutely crucial.
r71.description:
This spot on the Island is used by the rothe as a watering 'hole.'  The herds
come here all the time for their water.  Since rothes have the capability to
to hold their water for weeks, they tend to come to this spot only when
it is absolutely crucial.

descKeys: its these waters, but you certainly do not want to be the first one to find out.
r72.description:
The shore takes a turn here, heading northeast towards a watering spot for
the rothe herds, and also south towards more shoreline.  The water to the
east looks deceptively calm.  No one really knows what inhabits these
waters, but you certainly do not want to be the first one to find out.

descKeys: e its purpose in providing the city of nal shaddar with a steady supply of food.
r73.description:
The shoreline seems fairly long, but in all actuality, it is not.  The Island
is quite small, considering the amount of rothe living here.  However, it
does tend to serve its purpose in providing the city of Nal Shaddar with a
steady supply of food.

descKeys: rground lake, called van'baryn by the drow of nal shaddar, meaning 'dark water'.
r76.description:
You are in one of the grazing fields on Rothe Island, probably on the east
side.  Directly to the east is the shoreline of the Island, and beyond that
is the murky waters of the underground Lake, called Van'Baryn by the Drow of
Nal Shaddar, meaning 'dark water'.

descKeys: moss is their source of food. you can also spot a large tower to the west a bit.
r77.description:
The interior of the Island is covered with large patches of brown moss.  The
moss is all around you, looking like some sort of sickness.  However, the
rothe herds seem to like them, as the moss is their source of food.  You can
also spot a large tower to the west a bit.

descKeys: with no problem. a small fire pit is in the ground here, and a fire is burning.
r78.description:
The interior of the Island is mostly flat, with a few rises here and there.
The place is ideal for a herd of rothes, as there are huge deposits of
the edible moss that the rothe so love to eat.  Although the Island is not
terribly large, the moss grows back fast enough to sustain all the rothe
with no problem.  A small fire pit is in the ground here, and a fire is
burning.

descKeys: . you have heard many things about this mage's school, and all of them were bad.
r79.description:
You are somewhat located in the middle of Nal Shaddar.  To the south lies
the Drow Mage school of Sorcere.  Off to the southwest somewhere a large
Drow house can be found.  You have heard many things about this Mage's school,
and all of them were bad.

descKeys: underneath them. towards the south you can spot the large gates of a drow house.
r80.description:
The path winds its way trough a small patch of mushrooms.  The mushrooms are
like no other fungi you have encountered.  They have to be at least eight feet
in height, allowing you to pass easily underneath them.  Towards the south
you can spot the large gates of a Drow house.

descKeys: e rothe herds off of the small path that is on the other side of the protrusion.
r81.description:
You are standing in the the western interior of the Island.  To the east
is a small embankment, approximately four feet high.  The small wall is
probably used to keep the rothe herds off of the small path that is on the
other side of the protrusion.

descKeys: rothe herds as sustenance. off to the northeast you can spot a large gray tower.
r82.description:
The ground underneath your feet is quite spongy, being covered with a large
patch of brown moss.  The moss is extremely prevalent throughout the Island,
and is used by the rothe herds as sustenance.  Off to the northeast you can
spot a large gray tower.

descKeys: row overseers, the moss tends to grow back at an alarming, almost magical, rate.
r83.description:
You are close to the shoreline of the Island, standing in a large field of
brown moss.  The moss is used by the rothe herds as food.  Lucky for the
rothe herds and drow overseers, the moss tends to grow back at an alarming,
almost magical, rate.

descKeys: hrough the entire center of the island, and meets up with a large grayish tower.
r84.description:
You are standing in a small cul-de-sac in the moss fields.  A small embankment
is to the east, preventing you from travelling upon a small and debris-free
path.  The small path leads through the entire center of the Island, and
meets up with a large grayish tower.

descKeys: ish tower, evidently the lodgings of all the slave workers and drow taskmasters.
r85.description:
You are standing knee-deep in a large patch of brown moss.  The moss itself
has a peculiar smell to it and tastes like, um, chicken.  Off to the east
is a large grayish tower, evidently the lodgings of all the slave workers
and drow taskmasters.

descKeys: land. looking down you can see many sets of prints running all around the place.
r86.description:
You are in the western interior of the Island.  All around you are large
patches of brown moss, evidently the food supply for the rothe herds that
inhabit the island.  Looking down you can see many sets of prints running all
around the place.

descKeys: theast, you can see a large gray tower jutting up from the center of the island.
r87.description:
The Island is divided into two parts, the western and the eastern sections.
You are currently standing in the western portion, amidst a patch of brown
moss.  Looking to the northeast, you can see a large gray tower jutting up
from the center of the Island.

descKeys: of huge aquatic beasts come to your memory, making you step away from the lake.
r88.description:
The shore of the island takes a turn here, heading to the northeast and
also to the west, where it turns sharply to the north.  The water is right
in front of you, looking dark and mysterious.  Tales of huge aquatic beasts
come to your memory, making you step away from the lake.

descKeys: out ten feet away from the shore, in the water. a rock, perhaps, or perhaps not.
r89.description:
You are standing on the shore of Rothe Island, near the dark lake.  The
shoreline continues to the north a ways before it heads off to the right.
A large rock is about ten feet away from the shore, in the water.  A rock,
perhaps, or perhaps not.

descKeys: hroughout the island. a small path is right past a small embankment to the west.
r90.description:
You are standing on the eastern side of Rothe Island.  The interior of the
island is used by the rothe herds for feeding, eating the large patches of
brown moss that is prevelant throughout the Island.  A small path is right
past a small embankment to the west.

descKeys: gray tower, probably used to house the workers who tend to the herds of rothes.
r91.description:
You are just west of the shoreline of the Island.  The ground beneath your
feet is covered with large patches of brown moss.  Off to the west you can
see a large gray tower, probably used to house the workers who tend to the
herds of rothes.

descKeys: to the large herd of females, which every once in a while travels to this side.
r92.description:
You are standing on the eastern side of Rothe Island.  This side of the
Island is home to two small herds of rothes, mostly of the male gender.  The
western side of the Island is home to the large herd of females, which every
once in a while travels to this side.

descKeys: . a small path leads up to the tower, but that path is not accessible from here.
r93.description:
You are standing on top of a large patch of brown moss.  The moss is quite
spongy, and has a peculiar smell to it.  Directly to the southwest is a
large grayish tower, rising quite high in the air.  A small path leads up
to the tower, but that path is not accessible from here.

descKeys: school was structured after loth's favorite pet, a huge and deadly black widow.
r94.description:
You stand before the grandest and most elaborate structure in Nal Shaddar.
Arach-Tillith was constructed in servitude to the Drow goddess of Chaos, Loth.
Be as it may that the goddess' symbol is a spider, the cleric's school was
structured after Loth's favorite pet, a huge and deadly Black Widow.

descKeys: own in there, never to return. other undesirables are thrown down there as well.
notes: d = one-way drop into the Zerif Pit (r476) — never-walk exit for bots (r95:d).
listen: You hear a faint clashing of metal upon metal.

senses.listen: You hear a faint clashing of metal upon metal.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r95.description:
You are standing right beside a large hole in the cavern floor.  Not many
Drow really know what is down in the hole, as it is not usually entered.
Known as the Zerif Pit, the hole leads down underneath the city.  It was so
named as the word 'Zerif' means 'unfaithful' in the Drow language.  Drow who
have been found guilty of forgoing Loth's teachings are thrown in there, never
to return.  Other undesirables are thrown down there as well.

descKeys: e, as enforced by the teachers, but an occasional stabbing occurs now and again.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r96.description:
You are in the barracks of the academy.  The students retire here after a
long and hard day's fighting and learning.  The bunks are spaced about three
feet apart, with a footlocker at each of the bed's, holding the student's
personal possessions.  Usually it is quiet in here, as enforced by the
teachers, but an occasional stabbing occurs now and again.

descKeys: tential, images of loth and her favorite creatures, spiders, are all around you.
notes: listen: You hear a faint chanting.
smell: The smell of incense is strong here.

senses.listen: You hear a faint chanting.
senses.smell: The smell of incense is strong here.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r98.description:
You are standing in the clerical school of Arach-Tillith.  Since this school
is dedicated to teaching those Drow how to serve Loth to their fullest and
utmost potential, images of Loth and her favorite creatures, spiders, are
all around you.

descKeys: ally living beings who have been trapped in stone for their crimes against loth.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r99.description:
This grandiose room has been set aside to show the full power and glory that
the servants of Loth attain.  Statues line the walls, taking up almost every
inch of space.  The statues are actually living beings who have been trapped
in stone for their crimes against Loth.

descKeys: ly spit out above the brazier, hailing all praises to loth and to her followers.
notes: listen: You can hear a priestess quietly chanting to her mistress.
smell: You smell the pungent odor of incense being burned.  It makes your mind

senses.listen: You can hear a priestess quietly chanting to her mistress.
senses.smell:
You smell the pungent odor of incense being burned.  It makes your mind
wander as the smell permeates your senses.  You ask yourself if these are
really incense?  Your mind finally comes back under your control.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r100.description:
You are standing before a massive and twisted black altar.  Large and small
images of spiders cover every inch of the thing, with a particularly huge one
situated right in the center, having not a spider's head, but a female drow's.
A metal brazier has been set up in the middle of the room.  A large green
flame is being continually spit out above the brazier, hailing all praises to
Loth and to her followers.

descKeys: ls that will eventually, if you do not perish first, lead you up to the surface.
r101.description:
You are standing before a huge and imposing metal gate.  Through the doors
of the gate lies the great Drow city of Nal Shaddar.  Whether or not you
would be insane enough to enter the gate is entirely up to you.  The Drow
of Nal Shaddar are not known for their generosity, nor their mercy.  Back
to the west lies the passageway through the UnderDark tunnels that will
eventually, if you do not perish first, lead you up to the surface.

descKeys: ely constructed. back to the southwest you will enter the treacherous underdark.
notes: listen: You hear a faint echoing of dripping water.
smell: You smell a faint acrid scent.

senses.listen: You hear a faint echoing of dripping water.
senses.smell:
You smell a faint acrid scent.
There is also a smell of death in the area.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r102.description:
You almost rocked Umber hulk's world with that quick double thrust attack!
You are near the Drow city of Nal Shaddar.  The gate to the city is about
fifty feet to the east.  Between you and the gate are two large statues of
spiders.  The statues are about fifteen feet high and have been intricately
constructed.  Back to the southwest you will enter the treacherous UnderDark.

descKeys: u think you can spot a large metal structure, but you are not so sure from here.
r103.description:
The tunnel you are in dips fairly low towards the ground, coming up short by
probably six or so feet.  The walls of the tunnel are smooth, and some patches
of the walls are giving off a green glow.  Towards the northeast you think you
can spot a large metal structure, but you are not so sure from here.

descKeys: with various pieces of equipment. there is a adamantite door leading northeast .

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r108.description:
You are standing in the supplies room of Melee-Magthere.  Implements of the
Drow Warrior's destructive force are in this room, carefully stored and
kept track of.  The walls of the storage room are filled with many shelves
filled with various pieces of equipment.
There is a adamantite door leading northeast ( OPENED ).

descKeys: e is the school for drow magic. young drow come here to train in the black arts.
r109.description:
The huge and unremarkable building in front of you has deceptive looks.  For
inside of those unremarkable walls lie some of the most deadly Drow on the
face, and under it, of this world.  Sorcere is the school for Drow magic.
Young Drow come here to train in the black arts.

descKeys: d, securing house bregan l'noth in part from its enemies: the other drow houses.
r110.description:
You are standing before two large metal gates, these gates leading into the
Drow house of Bregan L'noth.  The second largest house in Nal Shaddar, a
huge granite wall surrounds the compound, securing House Bregan L'noth in
part from its enemies: The other Drow houses.

descKeys: sive structure. the field of mushrooms head back to the east and south, as well.
r111.description:
You are still in the mushroom field, but a large gate is to the west, probably
leading to a Drow House.  The gate leads directly in the rock, so the Drow in
that particular House seem to have a nice defensive structure.  The field of
mushrooms head back to the east and south, as well.

descKeys: h the mushrooms, but ends up against the large wall of a drow house to the west.
r112.description:
This mushroom field is in the southwestern part of Nal Shaddar.  There are
many of the large mushrooms in this area, stretching on to the north as well.
A small path runs through the mushrooms, but ends up against the large wall
of a Drow House to the west.

descKeys: fault: being male. you see a small set of stairs in the corner, leading upwards.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r113.description:
These barracks were constructed to hold the students of the warrior's school,
Melee-Magthere.  During their last six weeks of their ten year studies, the
warriors are housed here as they are instructed on Loth's might.  During these
six weeks of tutelage, the Drow warriors are continually berated for their
largest fault:  being male.  You see a small set of stairs in the corner,
leading upwards.

descKeys: ly used by the priestess. a small set of stairs leads down to the main barracks.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r114.description:
You are in the barracks of Arach-Tillith. The Priestess of Loth come here when
they are in need of rest or quiet prayer to their dark Matron.  Several mats
and couches are around the room, evidently used by the Priestess.  A small set
of stairs leads down to the main barracks.

descKeys: main altar, is ornately decorated. a particularly evil sense permeates the air.
notes: listen: The constant and fervent prayers to Loth almost make you retch.
smell: The incense-smell is overpowering.

senses.listen: The constant and fervent prayers to Loth almost make you retch.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r115.description:
The students of Arach-Tillith come here daily to commune with their goddess.
In the middle of the room stands a large altar which, although not quite as
big and intimidating as the main altar, is ornately decorated.  A particularly
evil sense permeates the air.

descKeys: ked, the key must be around here somewhere. there is a iron door leading south .

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r116.description:
You are standing before a huge iron door fitted into the southern wall.  Faint
eminations of pleas for help reach your ears, coming from behind the door.  To
the northeast is the main Altar room in Arach-Tillith.  Although the door is
usually locked, the key must be around here somewhere.
There is a iron door leading south ( LOCKED ).

descKeys: . this part of the tunnel is leading to the east and also back to the southwest.
r117.description:
You are in the treacherous UnderDark.  There is no telling what is around in
these tunnels, so you had better watch your step.  People have been known to
venture around down here, and never return.  This part of the tunnel is leading
to the east and also back to the southwest.

descKeys: ight tremor in the rock causes you to sway for a moment, but it is over quickly.
r118.description:
The tunnel is running west and northeast here, curving slightly.  You see that
the ground of the tunnel is a rough rock, where you could easily trip over
one of the many holes.  A slight tremor in the rock causes you to sway for
a moment, but it is over quickly.

descKeys: o the east you see that this tunnel bends to the left, heading to the northwest.
r119.description:
You are just southeast of a large intersection of the tunnels.  You see that
this tunnel meets up with a larger one which continues both north and south.
Back to the east you see that this tunnel bends to the left, heading to the
northwest.

descKeys: almost mirror-like. a dull-gray fungus is growing on the ten foot tall ceiling.
r120.description:
The tunnel you are travelling in is clean and free of debris.  From the looks
of it, someone or something is keeping this tunnel in good order.  The walls
of the passageway are smooth and almost mirror-like.  A dull-gray fungus is
growing on the ten foot tall ceiling.

descKeys: l as a slightly glowing fungus. the tunnel widens out a little bit to the south.
r121.description:
The tunnel gets a little darker here, as well as getting a little smaller and
stuffy.  The height of the tunnel is now just under ten feet.  The walls and
ceiling are covered in bat guano as well as a slightly glowing fungus.  The
tunnel widens out a little bit to the south.

descKeys: he dark hole to move on or you could turn around and head back the way you came.
r122.description:
The tunnel almost ends here with a sharp and rocky outcropping of the tunnel
wall about chest height and up.  The small space left underneath the rock is
very cramped and stuffy.  You will have to crawl through the dark hole to move
on or you could turn around and head back the way you came.

descKeys: rn opens up to the east, with loud chittering sounds coming from that direction.
r123.description:
The small and cramped space you are crawling through is extremely tight.  You
can barely wiggle around enough to even turn around, let alone continue along
the cramped space.  It looks like the hole widens a bit to the southeast,
while it looks as if it ends to the north.  A small cavern opens up to the
east, with loud chittering sounds coming from that direction.

descKeys: he bats seem to be pointedly ignoring you, for which you are certainly grateful.
r124.description:
This part of the tunnels has been taken over by a few thousand bats.  The
bats literally cover every square inch of this cavern.  It is hard to move
without stepping on one here and there.  The bats seem to be pointedly
ignoring you, for which you are certainly grateful.

descKeys: loud. you see that the cavern heads back to the west and also to the northeast.
r125.description:
You are in a small cavern that is filled with bats.  You think there are
probably several hundred bats in this vicinity, but you cannot tell for
certain.  The chittering noise is quite loud.  You see that the cavern
heads back to the west and also to the northeast.

descKeys: re it turns again to the right. against the eastern wall is a slight depression.
r126.description:
This small cavern is almost completely filled with bats.  The little creatures
are crawling over each other on the walls, floor, and ceiling.  The noise in
here is very loud.  The bat's cavern ends here and only heads back to the
southwest, where it turns again to the right.  Against the eastern wall is a
slight depression.

descKeys: oises bounce around you and then continue onwards through the extensive tunnels.
notes: listen: You hear the faint dripping of water.
smell: You smell the musty smell of the Underdark.

senses.listen: You hear the faint dripping of water.
senses.smell: You smell the musty smell of the Underdark.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r127.description:
The tunnel is quite dirty here, with large clumps of sand and grit being all
over the place, blanketing the whole area.  Looking upwards, you see that
the ceiling is a dingy gray color, exuding no reflections.  Faint echos of
barely discernable noises bounce around you and then continue onwards through
the extensive tunnels.

descKeys: out of place. a few flourescent fungi are on the walls, giving off a small glow.
notes: listen: You hear the faint dripping of water.
smell: You smell the musty smell of the Underdark.

senses.listen: You hear the faint dripping of water.
senses.smell: You smell the musty smell of the Underdark.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r128.description:
The tunnel's sides are rough and choppy here, as if the tunnel has been
recently constructed.  A small niche in the wall draws your attention, looking
slightly out of place.  A few flourescent fungi are on the walls, giving off
a small glow.

descKeys: and is slowing dripping down to the tunnel's floor, gathering into a small pool.
notes: listen: You hear the faint dripping of water.
smell: You smell the musty smell of the Underdark.

senses.listen: You hear the faint dripping of water.
senses.smell: You smell the musty smell of the Underdark.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r129.description:
The tunnel slopes a bit downward here towards the south.  A few scattered
rocks the size of your head are laying around various parts of the tunnel.
Moisture has gathered on the tunnel's ceiling, and is slowing dripping down
to the tunnel's floor, gathering into a small pool.

descKeys: equilibrium. there must be a large colony of bats or some such creatures nearby.
notes: listen: You hear the faint dripping of water.
smell: You smell the musty smell of the Underdark.

senses.listen: You hear the faint dripping of water.
senses.smell: You smell the musty smell of the Underdark.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r130.description:
The tunnel is sloping down towards the southwest, heading deeper into the
Underdark.  Chittering noises assault you from all directions, slightly
distorting your equilibrium.  There must be a large colony of bats or some
such creatures nearby.

descKeys: king around, you see that the tunnel walls are scarred with fissures and cracks.
notes: listen: You hear the faint dripping of water.
smell: You smell the musty smell of the Underdark.

senses.listen: You hear the faint dripping of water.
senses.smell: You smell the musty smell of the Underdark.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r131.description:
The tunnel slopes upwards to the northeast, ever so slightly.  A sudden
scurrying sound occurs off to your right, indicating that a small creature has
taken offense to your presence.  Looking around, you see that the tunnel walls
are scarred with fissures and cracks.

descKeys: ry direction. a foul-smelling stench is emanating from this area of the tunnels.
notes: listen: You hear the faint dripping of water.
smell: It smells like there is a rotting corpse nearby.

senses.listen: You hear the faint dripping of water.
senses.smell: It smells like there is a rotting corpse nearby.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r132.description:
The tunnel's ceiling slopes down a bit, only reaching about three or four
feet above your head.  Echoes of scraping noises reach your ears, seemingly
coming from every direction.  A foul-smelling stench is emanating from this
area of the tunnels.

descKeys: k. the picture resembles a huge demon, and looks to having been carved recently.
notes: listen: You hear the faint dripping of water.
smell: The stench is almost overpowering your senses!

senses.listen: You hear the faint dripping of water.
senses.smell: The stench is almost overpowering your senses!
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r133.description:
A horrible stench is coming to your nostrils, clouding your mind and also
your sinuses.  On one of the nearby walls there is a small picture having
been carved into the rock.  The picture resembles a huge demon, and looks
to having been carved recently.

descKeys: nothing. a small indention in the rock on the western wall draws your attention.
notes: listen: The tunnels are almost too quiet.
smell: You smell the musty smell of the Underdark.

senses.listen: The tunnels are almost too quiet.
senses.smell: You smell the musty smell of the Underdark.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r134.description:
This part of the tunnels seems clear of any debris.  The walls are fairly
smooth, and there are no pebbles or rocks laying around.  Besides being
pitch dark, the tunnels in this area seem to be extremely quiet.  You can
strain your ears, but you hear nothing.  A small indention in the rock on the
western wall draws your attention.

descKeys: ere. a smaller tunnel runs south of here for a ways and then turns to the right.
notes: listen: You hear the faint dripping of water.
smell: You smell the musty smell of the Underdark.

senses.listen: You hear the faint dripping of water.
senses.smell: You smell the musty smell of the Underdark.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r135.description:
A pungent-smelling fungus is growing on the wall of the tunnel in this area.
Although the fungus is not glowing, you can see that it is very much alive.
The tunnel is running east and west, and you can see that it curves off
towards the north a few feet west of here.  A smaller tunnel runs south of
here for a ways and then turns to the right.

descKeys: ling making in thougher to walk through this tunnel without hitting one of them.
notes: smell: This place smells rotten.

senses.listen: It is fairly quiet here.
senses.search: There is nothing of interest here.

r136.description:
You are at the northern end of a long tunnel.  The tunnel seems to be
decreasing in height further to the south.  There are large stalagmites on
the ground, as well as stalactites in the ceiling making in thougher to walk
through this tunnel without hitting one of them.

descKeys: the stalactites in the ceiling, indicating that there is a water source nearby.
notes: smell: This place smells rotten.

senses.listen: It is fairly quiet here, except for the water dripping down from the ceiling.
senses.search: There is nothing of interest here.

r137.description:
The end of this tunnel is just north of here, just within your sight.
Although you can't see the other end yet, it is too far away.  Some water is
slowly dripping down from the stalactites in the ceiling, indicating that
there is a water source nearby.

descKeys: o be more of it here. it looks like someone have been picking it from the walls.
notes: listen: You can hear the water dripping down from the ceiling.
smell: This place smells rotten.

senses.listen: You can hear the water dripping down from the ceiling.
senses.search: There is nothing of interest here.

r138.description:
The rock walls are growing closer together more and more, leaving you very
little space to move.  The strange fungus that usually populates the
UnderDark seems to be nearly gone, but you can see some traces that there
used to be more of it here.  It looks like someone have been picking it from
the walls.

descKeys: ou think you hear some mumbling sounds, but you can't tell what it is from here.
notes: listen: You think you can hear some mumbling sounds coming from the west.
smell: This place smells rotten.

senses.listen: You think you can hear some mumbling sounds coming from the west.
senses.search: There is nothing of interest here.

r139.description:
Small indentions decorate the walls here, telling you that someone has been
mining the area.  There are also small rocks scattered around the floor.
Further to the west you think you hear some mumbling sounds, but you can't
tell what it is from here.

descKeys: arc shaped path leading around it, just large enough for you to squeese through.
notes: smell: This place smells rotten.

senses.listen: It is fairly silent here.
senses.search: There is nothing of interest here.

r140.description:
The rocky walls have been well worked on here, they all have small holes in
them.  You can also tell that someone has been here recently, as they have
left some broken mining tools lying on the ground.  A large boulder is
blocking the tunnel to the west, but there is a narrow arc shaped path
leading around it, just large enough for you to squeese through.

descKeys: king sounds coming from the southwest, apparenly someone is mining in that area.
notes: listen: You can hear some picking sounds coming from the southwest.
smell: This place smells rotten.

senses.listen: You can hear some picking sounds coming from the southwest.
senses.search: There is nothing of interest here.

r141.description:
You are standing directly north of a large boulder.  It's so large that you
have to squeese yourself through to get past it.  Some rocks have been pushed
under it, to keep the boulder from rolling away.  You can hear tiny picking
sounds coming from the southwest, apparenly someone is mining in that area.

descKeys: stern wall. they seem to be having a break, and are watching their friends work.
notes: listen: You can hear the faernies hammering on the walls.
smell: There is no particular smell in this area.

senses.listen: You can hear the faernies hammering on the walls.
senses.smell: There is no particular smell in this area.
senses.search: There is nothing of interest here.

r142.description:
There is a lot of motion in this part of the tunnel.  Several faernies are
flying around in the area, hacking into the rock walls with their tiny mining
picks.  Some of the faernies have gathered around a small table, which is
standing close to the eastern wall.  They seem to be having a break, and are
watching their friends work.

descKeys: ay with ore carts is leading along the north wall, going deeper into the tunnel.
notes: listen: You can hear the faernies hammering on the walls.
smell: Faerny says something in an unknown language.

senses.listen: You can hear the faernies hammering on the walls.
senses.smell:
Faerny says something in an unknown language.
There is no particular smell in this area.
senses.search: There is nothing of interest here.

r143.description:
There are mining faernies all over this place.  They are working very hard,
trying to find valuable minerals in the rock walls.  They all seem totally
unaware of your presence.  A tiny railway with ore carts is leading along the
north wall, going deeper into the tunnel.

descKeys: of them back into the city. you can hear a pourling sound coming from the west.
notes: listen: You can hear a creek flowing to the west.
smell: There is no particular smell in this area.

senses.listen: You can hear a creek flowing to the west.
senses.smell: There is no particular smell in this area.
senses.search: There is nothing of interest here.

r144.description:
There is less activity here compared to northeast of here.  There is probably
not as much minerals to mine in this area.  You can spot a small railway,
barely two feet wide.  It's designed to carry ore carts back into the faerny
city.  Some faernies are pushing one of them back into the city.  You can
hear a pourling sound coming from the west.

descKeys: r south into the cavern. there is also a small railway following with the creek.
notes: listen: You can hear the water pouring down from a hole in the north wall.
smell: There is no particular smell in this area.

senses.listen: You can hear the water pouring down from a hole in the north wall.
senses.smell: There is no particular smell in this area.
senses.search: There is nothing of interest here.

r145.description:
Just south of you, you see what appears to be a guard post, and behind it the
tunnel opens up into a large cavern.  There is an underground creek here,
starting from a hole high up in the north wall.  The creek is flowing slowly,
further south into the cavern.  There is also a small railway following with
the creek.

descKeys: und creek from the north is flowing into the cavern, along with a small railway.
notes: listen: You can hear the sound of hundreds of faernies coming from the large cavern.
smell: There is no particular smell in this area.

senses.listen: You can hear the sound of hundreds of faernies coming from the large cavern.
senses.smell: There is no particular smell in this area.
senses.search: There is nothing of interest here.

r146.description:
You are standing in front of a guard post.  The guard post is necessary to
keep unwelcome visitors away from the cave faerny colony.  Behind the guard
post the tunnel is opening up into a large cavern.  The cavern is full of
activity, and in the center of it you see a large pillar with what appears to
be small holes inside it.  The underground creek from the north is flowing
into the cavern, along with a small railway.

descKeys: op your progress, since it's only two feet wide, so you can easily step over it.
notes: listen: You can hear the sound of hundreds of faernies coming from all around the large cavern.
smell: There is no particular smell in this area.

senses.listen: You can hear the sound of hundreds of faernies coming from all around the large cavern.
senses.smell: There is no particular smell in this area.
senses.search: There is nothing of interest here.

r147.description:
You are in the northern part of the cave faerny cavern.  In the center of
this cavern is a large pillar with several two feet wide holes.  The walls
around the pillar are also filled with these holes.  You estimate that there
must be over twohundred of these holes here.  The holes appears to be the
homes of these faernies.  The creek from the north flows down to the pillar
and from there it splits into to forks which goes around the pillar.  Luckily
the creek doesn't stop your progress, since it's only two feet wide, so you
can easily step over it.

descKeys: alking on. there are also some faernies hanging out by the creek and having fun.
notes: listen: You can hear the sound of hundreds of faernies coming from all around the large cavern.
smell: There is no particular smell in this area.

senses.listen: You can hear the sound of hundreds of faernies coming from all around the large cavern.
senses.smell: There is no particular smell in this area.
senses.search: There is nothing of interest here.

r148.description:
You are close to the north part of the faerny cavern.  This section seems to
be quite peaceful with most of the faernies being in their homes, the small
holes in the walls and the pillar.  The small creek flows peacefully along
the path you're walking on.  There are also some faernies hanging out by the
creek and having fun.

descKeys: g on. it is only two feet wide, but they don't seem to need much more than that.
notes: listen: You can hear the sound of hundreds of faernies coming from all around the large cavern.
smell: There is no particular smell in this area.

senses.listen: You can hear the sound of hundreds of faernies coming from all around the large cavern.
senses.smell: There is no particular smell in this area.
senses.search: There is nothing of interest here.

r149.description:
You are now in the northeast section of the cave faerny cavern.  There seems
to be some repairs going on here.  Several of the homes have been destroyed,
most likely from a battle, as the neighboring drow and duergar are quite keen
on attacking this place.  The creek that is the cave faernies' main source of
water is flowing alongside with the path you're walking on.  It is only two
feet wide, but they don't seem to need much more than that.

descKeys: aernies are flying between the different holes, carrying on with their business.
notes: listen: You can hear the sound of hundreds of faernies coming from all around the large cavern.
smell: There is no particular smell in this area.

senses.listen: You can hear the sound of hundreds of faernies coming from all around the large cavern.
senses.smell: There is no particular smell in this area.
senses.search: There is nothing of interest here.

r150.description:
As you travel along the path that circles around the large center pillar you
can't help but notice the beautiful surroundings.  There are several hundred
holes in the walls of the cave, as well as in the center pillar.  Most of
these holes emit a strong light, coming from fires inside that are made to
keep the faernies who live there warm.  The activity here is pretty much the
same as the other sections of this cave.  Several faernies are flying between
the different holes, carrying on with their business.

descKeys: ere. even most of the holes on the eastern wall and the center pillar are empty.
notes: listen: You can hear the sound of hundreds of faernies coming from all around the large cavern.
smell: There is no particular smell in this area.

senses.listen: You can hear the sound of hundreds of faernies coming from all around the large cavern.
senses.smell: There is no particular smell in this area.
senses.search: There is nothing of interest here.

r151.description:
The path you are traveling on is sloping more and more downwards to the
southwest, but it seems to even out after it's passed the corner of the
center pillar.  This region of the cave seems quite empty, and most of the
faernies have gathered southwest of here.  Even most of the holes on the
eastern wall and the center pillar are empty.

descKeys: with anything from trading goods to hanging out by the creek with their friends.
notes: listen: You can hear the sound of hundreds of faernies coming from all around the large cavern.
smell: There is no particular smell in this area.

senses.listen: You can hear the sound of hundreds of faernies coming from all around the large cavern.
senses.smell: There is no particular smell in this area.
senses.search: There is nothing of interest here.

r152.description:
You are at the nexus of the faerny cavern.  There are three paths leading
away from here, the southern one leads to a gate.  The gate is larger than
what you'd expect, considering it's inside a faerny colony where things
usually are smaller.  It's reaching towards the ceiling with it's size of
seven feet and the edge lines of the gate are decorated with nine beautiful
gems, with all of them shifting from dark colors in the bottom to bright
colors on the top.  The gate has most likely been made in that size so that
larger visitors could pass through it.  The other two paths, which are
leading northeast and northwest, are sloping quite steeply upwards.  Two
creeks, coming from both north ends, travel around the edges of the center
pillar and join into one single creek which then runs down into a hole in the
center of the nexus.  There are more faernies here than any other part of the
cavern.  The faernies busy themselves with anything from trading goods to
hanging out by the creek with their friends.

descKeys: path, as well as the creek, is beginning slope downwards towards the southeast.
notes: listen: You can hear the sound of hundreds of faernies coming from all around the large cavern.
smell: There is no particular smell in this area.

senses.listen: You can hear the sound of hundreds of faernies coming from all around the large cavern.
senses.smell: There is no particular smell in this area.
senses.search: There is nothing of interest here.

r153.description:
A large amount of faernies are traveling downstreams, towards the southern
part of the cavern.  There seems to be some kind of gathering place down
there.  This part of the cavern, on the other hand, is just like most other
parts of this cave.  This path, as well as the creek, is beginning slope
downwards towards the southeast.

descKeys: tiny stands can also be seen near the small creek that's floating through here.
notes: listen: You can hear the sound of hundreds of faernies coming from all around the large cavern.
smell: You think you smell some food coming from one of the shops.

senses.listen: You can hear the sound of hundreds of faernies coming from all around the large cavern.
senses.smell: You think you smell some food coming from one of the shops.
senses.search: There is nothing of interest here.

r154.description:
This looks like the merchant area of the cavern.  On the eastern cave wall
and the center pillar are several holes.  These holes are larger than the
other ones in the cavern to give more space for the wares of each store.
Each hole has a sign above it, describing what kind of shop it is.
Unfortunately for you, the wares are all too small for you to have any use of
them.  A few tiny stands can also be seen near the small creek that's
floating through here.

descKeys: r presence as they are all too busy with their work, or whatever they are doing.
notes: listen: Autosave.
smell: There is no particular smell in this area.

senses.listen:
Autosave.
Your stomach rumbles.
You can hear the sound of hundreds of faernies coming from all around the large cavern.
senses.smell: There is no particular smell in this area.
senses.search: There is nothing of interest here.

r155.description:
As you travel along the path that is circling around the center pillar of the
cavern you sometimes have to stop to avoid colliding with one of the many
faernies flying around the area.  They seem to be ignoring your presence as
they are all too busy with their work, or whatever they are doing.

descKeys: ole is larger than the others and apparently is some sort of mineral depository.
notes: listen: You can hear the sound of hundreds of faernies coming from all around the large cavern.
smell: There is no particular smell in this area.

senses.listen: You can hear the sound of hundreds of faernies coming from all around the large cavern.
senses.smell: There is no particular smell in this area.
senses.search: There is nothing of interest here.

r156.description:
You are traveling along a path that goes around the large pillar in the
center of this cavern.  Along the path flows a small creek, providing the
colony with their needed water.  There is an end station of a railway track
here.  There are several ore carts lined up on the track.  Some faernies can
be seen loading off ore and other minerals from the carts and into one of the
many holes on the walls.  This particular hole is larger than the others and
apparently is some sort of mineral depository.

descKeys: see a guard post. presumably something important lies beyond that southern gate.
notes: listen: You can hear the sound of many faernies coming from outside the north gate.
smell: There is no particular smell in this area.

senses.listen: You can hear the sound of many faernies coming from outside the north gate.
senses.smell: There is no particular smell in this area.
senses.search: There is nothing of interest here.

r157.description:
You are standing in a short hallway with two gates, one to the north and the
other to the south.  The ceiling, being only about seven feet above the
floor, as well as the walls are all painted in a goldish-yellow color.  A
long red-brown carpet is stretching from the north gate towards the southern
one, and just as it stops there you can see a guard post.  Presumably
something important lies beyond that southern gate.

descKeys: formations. the formations have been eroded with time, and are slightly rounded.
r158.description:
The tunnel is curving to the southeast here, bending slightly.  The ceiling
of the tunnel is about five to ten feet above you, filled with over-hanging
rock formations.  The formations have been eroded with time, and are
slightly rounded.

descKeys: ut you cannot be totally sure. there is also one small tunnel leading northeast.
r159.description:
The tunnel curves here, going both northwest and south.  A slight stench
is permeating the air of the tunnel, causing you to almost gag reflexively.
A large crack in one of the tunnel's walls looks natural, but you cannot
be totally sure.  There is also one small tunnel leading northeast.

descKeys: path, causing you to make a small detour around it to go either north or south.
r160.description:
The tunnel is running north and south here, and curves to the northwest a
little ways towards the north.  A large rock is right in front of your path,
causing you to make a small detour around it to go either north or south.

descKeys: this part of the tunnels their home, hence the piles of guano being quite small.
r161.description:
Many small piles of bat guano are lying around in this area of the tunnels.
It seems that bats have recently made this part of the tunnels their home,
hence the piles of guano being quite small.

descKeys: scratched up, as if some large pointy thing was used to chip away at the stone.
r162.description:
The tunnel starts to slope down to the south here.  Looking down the slope,
you see that the tunnel bends towards the east a small ways away from your
vantage point.  One of the walls of the tunnel is extremely scratched up,
as if some large pointy thing was used to chip away at the stone.

descKeys: tion. a faint sound comes to your ears, causing you to whirl around in surprise.
r163.description:
The tunnel is sloping downwards to the south, with it also inclining to the
north.  Although it is not a particularly steep slope, you find yourself
tiring out from the exertion.  A faint sound comes to your ears, causing
you to whirl around in surprise.

descKeys: is grey in color, and seems to have a few scratches and crevices on its surface.
r164.description:
The tunnel is running north and south here, with a slight incline being
detected while walking north.  The tunnel's ceiling is grey in color, and
seems to have a few scratches and crevices on its surface.

descKeys: el. looking to the southeast you see that the tunnel opens up to a large cavern.
r165.description:
The tunnel curves here, heading north and also to the west.  The distance
between the two walls is slight, almost forcing you to walk sideways to get
through this portion of the tunnel.  Looking to the southeast you see that the
tunnel opens up to a large cavern.

descKeys: el's floor, indicating that the traffic in these parts is slight, if not at all.
r166.description:
The tunnel hits a sharp corner here, heading both towards the east and towards
the south, where it slopes downward, ever so slightly.  A thin layer of dust
is covering the tunnel's floor, indicating that the traffic in these parts is
slight, if not at all.

descKeys: nel leads in that direction. also you can see a tunnel leading to the southwest.
r167.description:
The tunnel is sloping down a little bit towards the south, where it turns a
tight corner and heads to the east.  Small bits of guano are on the tunnel's
floor, indicating the presence of bats.  Stepping lightly between the patches
of the nasty stuff, you decide to head away from this area.  Looking to the
west, you see that a small tunnel leads in that direction.  Also you can see
a tunnel leading to the southwest.

descKeys: ne side of the tunnel's walls. off to the east you can see two very large gates.
r168.description:
The tunnel starts to slope upwards to the north.  The slope is almost barely
discernable, but there nonetheless.  A small crop of fungi is on the western
wall, looking like some sort of Underdark salad.  Small footprints line one
side of the tunnel's walls.  Off to the east you can see two very large gates.

descKeys: ons, their screams lost in the underground maze of tunnels called the underdark.
r169.description:
You are standing in a tunnel a little ways to the west of the Duergar city of
Dunkrist.  You can just barely spy the gigantic gates of the city.  To the
west lies the dangerous and treacherous warrens of the UnderDark.  Travellers
have been known to never reach their destinations, their screams lost in the
underground maze of tunnels called the UnderDark.

descKeys: ers and the city' defenders. to the west lies the dark and foreboding underdark.
r170.description:
You are standing just west of the Duergar city of Dunkrist.  The tall gates
of the city reach almost to the ceiling of the cavern, effectively setting a
barrier between the invaders and the city' defenders.  To the west lies the
dark and foreboding Underdark.

descKeys: to the west lies the dangerous underdark, seething with malice and malevolence.
r171.description:
You are standing within the metal gates of Dunkrist, the Duergar city.  The
gates stand over forty feet high, reaching to a low point of the cavern's
ceiling.  Stretching to the east, the Duergar city has been literally carved
from stalactites and stalagmites.  In the middle of the city is the merchant's
