senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r333.description:
The tunnel stops here, but continues on to the west.  A large hole is in the
ground here, gaping open like a whale's mouth.  Several handholds have been
set inside of the hole, allowing you to descend down into it.  Although you
are curious to see what is down in the hole, you do not relish the thought of
running into anything hostile.
r333.title: Hole in the ground

descKeys: tunnel walls. strangely enough, the moss is giving off a faint and bluish aura.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r334.description:
The mine tunnel slopes a bit here, going downwards to the east.  Looking
around at the tunnel walls, you see that a small moss-like plant is growing
upon the tunnel walls.  Strangely enough, the moss is giving off a faint and
bluish aura.
r334.title: Mine Tunnel

descKeys: he west, you see that hardly any dust has been disturbed upon the cavern ground.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r335.description:
The mine tunnel gets a little cramped here, shrinking in size until you
almost have to bend over to prevent from hitting your head on the ceiling.
Looking to the west, you see that hardly any dust has been disturbed upon
the cavern ground.
r335.title: Mine Tunnel

descKeys: a large fissure is in the ceiling, telling you that this shaft may be unstable.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r336.description:
The mine tunnel branches off into three separate directions here.  A strong
odor reminding you of dead rats eminates from the southeast.  Darkness is
the only discernable property about the other two directions.  A large fissure
is in the ceiling, telling you that this shaft may be unstable.
r336.title: Mine Tunnel

descKeys: e driving them. you can faintly see the entrance to the mines to the west a bit.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r337.description:
There have been several torches set about the tunnel walls, contained within
a few rusted and warped metal pegs, slammed into the wall with some incredible
force driving them.  You can faintly see the entrance to the mines to the
west a bit.
r337.title: Mine Tunnel

descKeys: to the west. the mine's dirt floor is almost smooth, with hardly any footprints.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r338.description:
The mine tunnel follows a set of metal tracks which run through the middle
of the tunnel.  The walls are smoke-stained and reek of bat guano.  You can
see a faint and inviting sliver of light to the west.  The mine's dirt floor
is almost smooth, with hardly any footprints.
r338.title: Mine Tunnel

descKeys: travelling east will take you farther and farther into these treacherous mines.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r339.description:
The entrance to the Kulajo Mines has been boarded up, albeit a poor job of
doing so.  The boards have been almost totally ripped away by eager treasure
seekers and flung halfway down the mountainside.  The mines open up into
daylight to the west, while travelling east will take you farther and farther
into these treacherous mines.
r339.title: Mine Tunnel

descKeys: silver were gone, the miners packed up and left, moving on to the next mountain.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r340.description:
You are just outside of the entrance to Kulajo Mines.  The mines burrow way
back into Mt. Kulajo.  They were built many years ago by prospectors looking
for mostly silver, although some gold was also found entrenched within the
mountain.  After all of the gold and silver were gone, the miners packed up
and left, moving on to the next mountain.
r340.title: Path to Mine

descKeys: itself with a few twists and turns. the mines are to the northeast a few steps.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r341.description:
The path to the mines winds a bit here, wrapping itself around a large
boulder that has rolled itself into the middle of the trail.  Lichens and
moss are growing on the huge rock, giving evidence to support the fact that
the boulder for been here for some time.  A lesser-used path winds off to the
north, losing itself with a few twists and turns.  The mines are to the
northeast a few steps.
r341.title: Path to Mine

descKeys: ver your shoulder, you can see threshold sitting near the base of this mountain.

senses.listen:
The Rothe-leather boots is damaged by the sunlight!
You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r342.description:
The rocky path is getting to be very inclined, making you work for every
foot you gain.  Off to the northeast a ways you can barely spot the entrance
of Kulajo Mines.  Gazing back over your shoulder, you can see Threshold
sitting near the base of this mountain.
r342.title: Path to Mine

descKeys: andscape here and there, looking ill and starved for some life-giving nutrients.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r343.description:
The small mountain path goes through a switchback here, making you put out
a little more exertion just to climb the route.  Small and scraggly trees dot
the landscape here and there, looking ill and starved for some life-giving
nutrients.
r343.title: Path to Mine

descKeys: urmise that you be the first person to have come around this area for some time.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r344.description:
You are travelling along a small path that is clinging precariously to the
rocky side of Mt. Kulajo.  The small dirt path is not very well-used, as if
nobody bothers coming up to this part of the mountain anymore.  Judging from
the thick foliage on and around the path, you surmise that you be the first
person to have come around this area for some time.
r344.title: Path to Mine

descKeys: t be seen from here, with its opening jutting out from the side of the mountain.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r345.description:
The small path is winding along the side of Mt. Kulajo.  Although you are high
off of the ground, you seem to feel at least marginally safe for the moment.
The mine can almost be seen from here, with its opening jutting out from
the side of the mountain.
r345.title: Path to Mine

descKeys: mine shaft. mt. kulajo looms over you like some sort of benefactorial presence.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r346.description:
This small path leads to either Kulajo Mines or gateway Road, depending on
which way you were headed.  The path runs along side Mt. Kulajo, winding its
way towards the old and mostly unused mine shaft.  Mt. Kulajo looms over you
like some sort of benefactorial presence.
r346.title: Path to Mine

descKeys: range, with the largest of the giants, mt. kulajo, being right in front of you.
notes: listen: You can hear several human voices to the south.

senses.listen: You can hear several human voices to the south.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r349.description:
This road is leading its way along a northeast-southwest route.  Off to the
east you can see a large body of water, which is probably the Kendrite Sea.
To the north lies the Absinthe Mountain Range, with the largest of the giants,
Mt. Kulajo, being right in front of you.
r349.title: Absinthe Mountain Range - Caravan Route

descKeys: mountain. a tumble off the path from this height would certainly be a bad thing.
r413.description:
The small mountain path is quite sturdy, if not unnerving to traverse.
Looking over the side of the path, you stare at least two hundred feet down
into the valley next to the mountain.  A tumble off the path from this height
would certainly be a bad thing.

descKeys: dy and solid a few steps down from here to the southwest. some flowers are here.
r414.description:
You are travelling along a small mountain path.  It seems as if the path
was hastily constructed, without regard to safety or any other regulations.
However, the path looks a little more sturdy and solid a few steps down from
here to the southwest.  Some flowers are here.

descKeys: ty of the surrounding snow drifts and snow-covered trees takes your breath away.
r419.description:
The small mountain path is almost indiscernable underneath the large piles
of snow that has accumulated over the years.  It is getting very difficult
to walk around in this area.  Although it is extremely cold and you feel as
if your nose would fall off if you tweaked it, the natural beauty of the
surrounding snow drifts and snow-covered trees takes your breath away.

descKeys: ighwaymen. the second reason is the number of yeti sightings in the recent past.
r420.description:
Cutland's Pass has become infamous over the years for a few different reasons.
The first reason is the number of ambushes that have occurred here by some
rebel highwaymen.  The second reason is the number of Yeti sightings in the
recent past.

descKeys: h looks out of the ordinary. the ceiling and floor of the tunnel is also smooth.
r431.description:
The tunnel is running east and west, hitting a sharp turn in either
direction about forty feet away.  The walls of the tunnel are smooth with
the exception of the northern wall, which looks out of the ordinary.  The
ceiling and floor of the tunnel is also smooth.

descKeys: the tunnel are quite smooth. that fact in itself sets off your internal alarms.
r432.description:
The tunnel takes a sharp turn here, heading to the west and also to the
south towards a small intersection.  The floor, walls, and ceiling of this
part of the tunnel are quite smooth.  That fact in itself sets off your
internal alarms.

descKeys: to the left. the walls and ceiling of this part of the tunnel are quite smooth.
r433.description:
The tunnel splits off into three separate directions.  To the east is a
large alcove, to the southwest the tunnel seems to dead-end, and to the
north the tunnel goes into a sharp turn to the left.  The walls and ceiling
of this part of the tunnel are quite smooth.

descKeys: ng the ceiling. a small hole, about three feet in width, is in the western wall.
r434.description:
The tunnel suddenly stops here, only heading back to the northeast towards
a small intersection.  The walls of the tunnel are very smooth and free of
any blemishes, including the ceiling.  A small hole, about three feet in
width, is in the western wall.

descKeys: e chasm in the wall is a large crack that looks like it may lead somewhere else.
r436.description:
You are standing in a three-way intersection of the tunnels.  A small chasm
is against the eastern wall.  The chasm is only a few feet across, but there
is no way to tell how deep it is.  Across the chasm in the wall is a large
crack that looks like it may lead somewhere else.

descKeys: tunnel continues west and even looks like it widens out a bit in that direction.
r438.description:
The tunnel descends sharply downward here, going almost straight down into
the darkness.  You could easily lose your footing if you are not cautious.
A small opening in the wall to your north looks a bit out of the ordinary.
The dark tunnel continues west and even looks like it widens out a bit in
that direction.

descKeys: be seen to the north, and a large cavern is through the tunnel to the southeast.
r441.description:
The small tunnel has not been used much, judging by the many rocky spires that
are jutting about along the tunnel floor.  If you do not watch your step, you
just might injure yourself.  A large mushroom grove can be seen to the north,
and a large cavern is through the tunnel to the southeast.

descKeys: a large cavern to the south. the mushroom grove also continues to the northwest.
r442.description:
You are standing in a small mushroom grove.  The mushrooms here are small ones,
only standing about eight feet in height on average.  The mushrooms provide
a continual diet for many of the Underdark's denizens.  A small tunnel leads
back to a large cavern to the south.  The mushroom grove also continues to the
northwest.

descKeys: oint. the route back to the southeast looks to eventually lead out of the grove.
r443.description:
The mushrooms in this large grove oftentimes grow to over fifteen feet high,
but most of them are around eight feet in height.  The grove travels off into
three general directions at this point.  The route back to the southeast looks
to eventually lead out of the grove.

descKeys: he region northwest of here. something must make this mushroom grove their home.
r444.description:
This area of the grove looks like it has been tampered with.  Some of the
mushrooms look to have been cleared away to the north, allowing travel in that
direction.  The same goes for the region northwest of here.  Something must
make this mushroom grove their home.

descKeys: around, maybe used for bedding. back to the south the grove looks more natural.
r445.description:
This looks like some sort of living area for something.  Several mushroom
stumps are around, evidently used for sitting, or perhaps tables.  There are
also a few piles of mushroom shavings around, maybe used for bedding.  Back
to the south the grove looks more natural.

descKeys: e mushrooms have been cleared from here, allowing more room for the inhabitants.
r446.description:
This part of the mushroom grove is obviously used for living quarters.  All
around this area are piles of what looks like mushroom shavings, evidently
used for bedding.  Most of the mushrooms have been cleared from here, allowing
more room for the inhabitants.

descKeys: sides. the walls of the cavern, strangely enough, are very smooth to the touch.
r447.description:
This area of the grove looks to be a living quarter.  Along the two walls of
the cavern are several long benches, made from large mushrooms that are laying
on their sides.  The walls of the cavern, strangely enough, are very smooth
to the touch.

descKeys: a mushroom is set directly in the center of this area, perhaps used as a table.
r448.description:
You are in the northwest part of the living quarters of the mushroom grove.
Several piles of mushroom shavings are on the floor of the cavern, probably
used for bedding.  A large stump of a mushroom is set directly in the center
of this area, perhaps used as a table.

descKeys: u can see that a wall of mushrooms goes across the way, almost blocking passage.
r449.description:
The mushrooms in this area are a different color than the rest of the grove.
They appear to have been 'smoked', as they are darker in color and also much
smaller, as if they shriveled up.  Up ahead to the north you can see that a
wall of mushrooms goes across the way, almost blocking passage.

descKeys: in neat rows, as if someone planted them in a certain order, like a small farm.
r450.description:
The mushroom grove is continuing here along the western side of the cavern.
It looks like the mushrooms in this part of the grove are smaller than normal.
They are also running in neat rows, as if someone planted them in a certain
order, like a small farm.

descKeys: passage to the north. south of here is the rows of mushrooms, resembling a farm.
r451.description:
You are near a large wall of mushrooms that almost prevent movement to the
north.  The densely-packed mushrooms run in a straight line and only have a
five foot wide opening near the center, allowing passage to the north.  South
of here is the rows of mushrooms, resembling a farm.

descKeys: looks to only be a few months old. amind the mushrooms is growing a small plant.
r452.description:
It looks like you are on the western side of the large mushroom grove, right
beside the cavern wall.  This route only heads to the north and back to the
southeast, as the mushrooms prevent you from heading any other direction.
To your left is a small mushroom, and it looks to only be a few months old.
Amind the mushrooms is growing a small plant.

descKeys: larger one. a small carving of some sort has been etched into one of the walls.
r453.description:
The small tunnel you are in is very damp and moldy.  There must be a source
of water nearby that is causing all of this wetness.  To the north you can
see that the tunnel intersects with another larger one.  A small carving of
some sort has been etched into one of the walls.

descKeys: water. you may be able to wade out to it, if you care to brave the murky water.
r454.description:
You are on the shore of an underground lake.  The lake stretches out to the
south as far as you can see, with the cavern walls reaching far upwards into
the darkness.  Along the shores of the lake lie several bones and a few
complete skeletons.  About ten feet from the shore is a large clam, just
barely sticking its shell out of the water.  You may be able to wade out to
it, if you care to brave the murky water.

descKeys: ind the door is evidently a jail of sorts. there is a wooden door leading east .
r455.description:
You are standing in a small room carved out of a grayish rock.  A small set
of stairs is in the middle of the room, heading upwards.  A small desk
is against one wall, facing a large door that is probably locked.  The room
behind the door is evidently a jail of sorts.
There is a wooden door leading east ( LOCKED ).

descKeys: to their surface, as if something big has passed through here in recent history.
r456.description:
The tunnel walls close in slightly here, giving you a sense of feeling like
you have been stuffed in a coffin, and unable to move.  The walls have many
scratches marked into their surface, as if something big has passed through
here in recent history.

descKeys: e recently, you can tell. back to the south, the tunnel seems to get a bit damp.
r457.description:
The tunnel suddenly stops here, leaving you to only head back to the south
if you are wanting to go anywhere.  The walls of the tunnel are smooth, but
something has been here recently, you can tell.  Back to the south, the
tunnel seems to get a bit damp.

descKeys: unique color. the shore continues on to the northeast and also back to the west.
r466.description:
You are on the shoreline of Rothe Island, right beside the water.  The sand
beneath your feet is very fine, and also very dark.  The mineral content
of the water must make the sand its unique color.  The shore continues on
to the northeast and also back to the west.

descKeys: s here, evidently having been missed by the rothe herds on their daily feedings.
r467.description:
The shore continues here to the east and also towards the southwest, where
it hits a landing, right in front of the dock.  There are several large
patches of moss here, evidently having been missed by the rothe herds on
their daily feedings.

descKeys: serving part of this establishment.
northwest. back to the south you can see many mushrooms that are dark in color.
r474.description:
There is a large wall of tightly-packed mushrooms that spreads almost all the
way across your path.  There is only a four foot wide opening that allows any-
thing to go northwest.  Back to the south you can see many mushrooms that are
dark in color.

descKeys: ning from the pit, or so it is rumored. the pit continues to the east and north.
notes: Zerif Pit: one-way drop from r95 d. Only exit is 'climb up' (rate-limited, often fails). Bots never walk r95:d (merchant param neverWalkExits/allowPitDescent); tagged no-explore for map-expand. Remove tag to explore on purpose.
r476.description:
You are in the mysterious Zerif Pit.  The dark hole runs beneath Nal Shaddar
and contains denizens of the UnderDark that are best left unseen.  The walls
of the Pit are covered in slime, so it is very hard to get out of it.  Right
above you is a large opening, the only opening from the Pit, or so it is
rumored.  The Pit continues to the east and north.

descKeys: of arach-tillith. you see that the pit continues south and east from this point.
r477.description:
You are in the Zerif Pit, below the Drow city of Nal Shaddar.  The Unfaithful
are thrown down here, to never come back.  It is rumored there is only one way
out of this Pit.  However, even if an Unfaithful escaped, they would be hunted
down and slaughtered by the members of Arach-Tillith.  You see that the Pit
continues south and east from this point.

descKeys: is causing that is something that you do not want to get in close quarters with.
r478.description:
The Pit continues in several directions here.  The walls of the Pit are all
covered with a dense slime.  Every now and then you can see that the slime
shivers a bit.  Whatever is causing that is something that you do not want
to get in close quarters with.

descKeys: for a lifetime. the pit continues to the north, east, and also back to the west.
r479.description:
You are in the Zerif Pit.  The Pit is more like a series of caverns that run
underneath Nal Shaddar.  It is rumored that they go on forever, and that any-
one who is sent down here wanders those caverns for a lifetime.  The Pit
continues to the north, east, and also back to the west.

descKeys: no telling what diseases and other nasty things that are inhabiting that slime.
r480.description:
The Pit looks like it dead-ends to the south.  Perhaps it does, but you
cannot tell from this vantage point.  The walls of the Pit are covered with
a nasty-looking slime.  There is no telling what diseases and other nasty
things that are inhabiting that slime.

descKeys: but you cannot tell for sure. however, leaving this area would probably be wise.
r481.description:
It looks like the Pit dead-ends at this point.  On three sides of you are
slime-covered walls, with the only exit being north.  On the ground are
several red spots.  Perhaps the spots are blood, but you cannot tell for
sure.  However, leaving this area would probably be wise.

descKeys: rm. the lair continues to the south, although you hesitate to go that direction.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r486.title: Dragon's Lair
r486.description:
You are standing in (presumably) a dragon's lair.  Large skeletons and many
pieces of discarded armament have been strewn about, a testament to those
foolish enough to have entered the treacherous home of a giant wyrm.  The
lair continues to the south, although you hesitate to go that direction.

descKeys: source of the glow. a small tunnel breaks off from the cavern to the northwest.
r506.title: Large Cavern
r506.description:
The cavern grows in size to the south, and gently diminishes to the east.  The
point of the cavern you are now in glows faintly with a greenish hue.  Looking
at the walls, you notice a strange type of fungus attached to it.  The fungus
must be the source of the glow.  A small tunnel breaks off from the cavern
to the northwest.

descKeys: esembles a normal tunnel. a small cavern juts off through a tunnel to the north.
r507.title: Sloping Cavern
r507.description:
The large cavern to the west has slowly dimished to about half of its height
and reached a steadying height of about forty-five feet at this juncture.
Off to the east, the cavern slopes down until it resembles a normal tunnel.
A small cavern juts off through a tunnel to the north.

descKeys: lowly growing in height and majesty. the tunnel continues unabated to the north.
r508.title: The tunnel ends
r508.description:
You are standing at the beginning of a tunnel, or maybe it is the end of the
tunnel you are witnessing.  A large cavern starts here and extends to the
west, slowly growing in height and majesty.  The tunnel continues unabated
to the north.

descKeys: tunnel continues west and even looks like it widens out a bit in that direction.
r510.title: The tunnel descends
r510.description:
The tunnel descends sharply downward here, going almost straight down into
the darkness.  You could easily lose your footing if you are not cautious.
A small opening in the wall to your north looks a bit out of the ordinary.
The dark tunnel continues west and even looks like it widens out a bit in
that direction.

descKeys: ded from years of exposure to determine to which race the rock's visage belongs.
r529.title: Dark Tunnel
r529.description:
The tunnel starts to widen out here, gaining in size to the south.  Directly
in the middle of the tunnel lies a peculiar rock.  The rock is shaped like
a head, although the facial features have been rounded from years of exposure
to determine to which race the rock's visage belongs.

descKeys: near the bottom of the wall is a space that could probably be travelled through.
r532.description:
This dark cavern is unstable at best.  Looking around, you see that there is a
lot of dust swirling around, almost choking you.  The walls shake visibly e
every once in a while, and the ceiling of the cavern looks like it could fall
at any moment.  The cavern seems to dead-end here, but near the bottom of
the wall is a space that could probably be travelled through.

descKeys: at lead away from here, with the southern route ending in some sort of dead-end.
r533.description:
The cavern has opened up a little at this point.  The ceiling of the cavern
is approximately twenty feet in height.  The dust is quite thick here, there
must be a lot of seismic activity in this region.  You see several routes
that lead away from here, with the southern route ending in some sort of
dead-end.

descKeys: head in several directions, with the cavern to the south opening up quite a bit.
r534.description:
This part of the cavern is very damp, as if there is a water source nearby.
The walls and ceiling are coated with moisture, with some of that moisture
dripping down and hitting the ground, stirring up some dust.  It looks like
you can head in several directions, with the cavern to the south opening up
quite a bit.

descKeys: rocks are around, some looking like they just got there during a recent cave-in.
r535.description:
The cavern grows much smaller to the north of here, forming a tunnel that is
about ten feet in height.  However, the cavern increases in size to the south
and southeast.  Large piles of rocks are around, some looking like they just
got there during a recent cave-in.

descKeys: el, almost blocking your progress to the east. there is a plant in front of you.
r536.description:
You are in a tunnel that is about ten feet in height.  To the south, the
tunnel opens up into a cavern, which is about twenty feet from ground to
ceiling.  Several piles of rocks are in the tunnel, almost blocking your
progress to the east.  There is a plant in front of you.

descKeys: . there are many piles of rocks around here, some of them looking newly-settled.
r537.description:
You are in a small tunnel that is leading west, where it turns again to the
south, and also south where it seems to dead-end.  The tunnel walls tend to
shake now and then.  This area must have a lot of cave-ins.  There are many
piles of rocks around here, some of them looking newly-settled.

descKeys: has a strange look about it. perhaps a closer inspection will turn something up.
r538.description:
The tunnel evidently dead-ends here, only heading back to the north.  There
are several piles of rocks here, one of them being about five feet in height.
When you are facing the dead-end, the wall to your left has a strange look
about it.  Perhaps a closer inspection will turn something up.

descKeys: the cavern have large chunks 'torn' from them, evidently from periodic cave-ins.
r539.description:
You are standing in a large cavern that seems to be quite unstable.  Dust
is swirling around haphazardly, getting into your nostrils and your garments
as well.  The walls of the cavern have large chunks 'torn' from them,
evidently from periodic cave-ins.

descKeys: en fungus is growing on the cavern's floor, giving off a faintly greenish light.
r541.description:
This small cavern reminds you of a box canyon on the surface.  Three sides of
the cavern end in walls, while a small tunnel leads south into a large cavern.
A lush carpet of green fungus is growing on the cavern's floor, giving off a
faintly greenish light.

descKeys: piders who occupy this vicinity. an intersection in the tunnels is to the south.
r542.description:
The tunnels are running through a gauntlet of large webs.  The webs stretch
from the floor of the tunnel to the ceiling.  It seems that there must be
one or more large spiders who occupy this vicinity.  An intersection in the
tunnels is to the south.

descKeys: nels are covered with similiar webs. a few bones litter the floor of the tunnel.
r543.description:
The tunnels branch off in a few different directions, with each of those
routes going through large webs that have been torn to shreds.  The walls
of the tunnels are covered with similiar webs.  A few bones litter the
floor of the tunnel.

descKeys: e wispy and look quite old. this tunnel must not be travelled through very much.
r544.description:
The tunnel gets very narrow here, almost making you walk sideways to fit
through.  The walls of the tunnel are covered with webs, although the webs
are wispy and look quite old.  This tunnel must not be travelled through
very much.

descKeys: ng the entire surface of the walls. this looks like it could be a lair of sorts.
r545.description:
A large scattering of bones and old bits of armor are strewn about this
part of the tunnels.  The walls of the area are covered with large webs,
just about covering the entire surface of the walls.  This looks like it
could be a lair of sorts.

descKeys: f the arachnid type. the tunnel heads back to the north towards an intersection.
r546.description:
The tunnel ends here against a stone wall to the south.  A plethera of silky
webs are around this part of the tunnel.  It seems that this area of the
Underdark is occupied by many monsters of the arachnid type.  The tunnel
heads back to the north towards an intersection.

descKeys: ls here, however it is not as thick around here as it was back to the southeast.
r547.description:
The cave tunnel takes a slight turn here, heading north.  Back to the
southeast, you see a small intersection of three tunnels, one of them heading
to the place where you are standing.  You see a thin layer of webbing covering
the walls here, however it is not as thick around here as it was back to the
southeast.

descKeys: his far into it. a tunnel seems to break lose heading west, northwest from here.
r548.description:
As you head deeper into the cave tunnel you notice that the webbing that where
so thick back to the south are almost gone here.  One can start wondering why
the spider does not want to head this far into it.  A tunnel seems to break
lose heading west, northwest from here.

descKeys: t. the bridge seems to have been there for many years as it is some holes in it.
r549.description:
It seems like some fighting once took place here but that must have been a
while ago, because on the ground you see some skeletons and some old rusty
weapons lying around.  A smaller tunnel breaks off heading west from here and to
the north, you see a bridge with a small underground lake beneath it.  The
bridge seems to have been there for many years as it is some holes in it.

descKeys: ld move yourself to the south, you would have some solid ground under your feet.
r550.description:
You are standing on a bridge, which runs over a small underground lake.  The
lake does not seem to be so deep but it is hard to tell when the water is
murky.  The bridge itself seems to be very old and have some holes in it; there
is a big one a bit to the north.  If you would move yourself to the south, you
would have some solid ground under your feet.

descKeys: ter is coming from. the water is dirty and you cannot tell how deep the lake is.
r551.description:
There is a big hole, north from here that might hinder your way if you are
planning to cross the bridge in that direction.  The hole seems to be too big to
jump across, so flying over it might prove to be a smart thing to do.  Under
the bridge is a small underground lake, the strange part is that you cannot see
where the water is coming from.  The water is dirty and you cannot tell how
deep the lake is.

descKeys: h ending up on each side at two big tunnels. there is a small shore to the east.
r552.description:
The filthy water in which you are swimming seems to have been poisoned;
however, you do not know from what.  Right above you, a bridge is hanging about
six feet above your head.  The bridge heads north and south ending up on each
side at two big tunnels.  There is a small shore to the east.

descKeys: gh that. a bit down in the water you notice a rock seemingly covering something.
r553.description:
There is a bridge hanging about six feet above the water, leading north and
west.  The bridge seems to have been hanging there for quite a while without
being maintained, because there are many holes in the bridge.  One of the holes
draws your attention as it seems to be very big, it would not be fun falling
through that.  A bit down in the water you notice a rock seemingly covering
something.

descKeys: y dirty, and the thought that this water is somewhat poisoned crosses your mind.
r554.description:
You are swimming under a bridge.  It seems as if the bridge have not been used
or taken care of for some centuries because there are several holes in it.  The
water in this small underground lake seems to be very dirty, and the thought
that this water is somewhat poisoned crosses your mind.

descKeys: would swim east, you would be right under a bridge that crosses this small lake.
r555.description:
The water in which you are swimming has a very bad smell that stings your
nostrils.  You start wondering if this water is poisoned or in some other way
been made unhealthy.  There seems to be a shore a bit south of here with a
tunnel leading somewhere else.  If you would swim east, you would be right
under a bridge that crosses this small lake.

descKeys: is a cave tunnel southeast from where you are standing, heading from the shore.
r556.description:
There is a small lake in front of you; it seems as if you could enter it from
here.  A strong poisoned smell stings your nostrils and you cannot tell where
it comes from.  However the water in the lake seems to be very filthy, a guess
would be that the smell is coming from there.  Entering the lake would mean a
high risk.  There is a cave tunnel southeast from where you are standing,
heading from the shore.

descKeys: son in some way. there seems to be an intersection of three tunnels to the east.
r557.description:
You are standing in a small tunnel, which seems to turn northwest from here,
heading to a small underground shore.  The air here is very damp and a strange
smell stings your nostrils.  What is comes from you cannot tell, however you
get the feeling that it is poison in some way.  There seems to be an
intersection of three tunnels to the east.

descKeys: you can see a tunnel to the west that presumably runs throughout the underdark.
r558.description:
You are in a rather large alcove in the tunnels.  Piles of bones (stripped
clean) are on the ground.  This looks like some sort of lair.  The lair of
who or what, you are not certain.  There is a strange smell around these
parts, and it totally unnerves you.  The ceiling of the alcove also looks
quite strange.  You can see a tunnel to the west that presumably runs
throughout the Underdark.

descKeys: g towards the merchant area. a small space leads east, between two large houses.
r560.description:
You are on the east side of the Northern Warrens, in the north part of Dunkrist.
This section of the city looks to be newer than most, and the road has been
recently paved.  The Warrens continue in any direction you choose to take,
with the south route leading towards the merchant area.  A small space leads
east, between two large houses.

descKeys: a for wastes and such. the air in this portion of dunkrist is none too pleasant.
r562.description:
You are standing on a small trail that has been carved directly into the rock.
The trail leads west towards the main plaza and also east towards what looks
like to be a dumping area for wastes and such.  The air in this portion of
Dunkrist is none too pleasant.

descKeys: many invaders could get past here and into the main hub of dunkrist to the east.
r565.description:
This tunnel is heavily fortified with rows of trenches, with the walls having
niches cut into them.  Stone foundations have been erected in the middle of
the tunnel, with platforms for arches to sit upon lining the sides of the
small towers.  Not many invaders could get past here and into the main hub
of Dunkrist to the east.

descKeys: de. it is obvious to you that this part of the city holds the wealthier duergar.
r566.description:
You are near the north side of the Northern Warrens, the residential district
of the Duergar city of Dunkrist.  The houses and living quarters around here
are usually large and well-made.  It is obvious to you that this part of the
city holds the wealthier Duergar.

descKeys: jected to many gases, and should not be breathed for prolonged portions of time.
r570.description:
There is a large hole in the ceiling here, with several handholds along the
wall leading up into it.  The air down in the bottom part of the mines has
most likely been subjected to many gases, and should not be breathed for
prolonged portions of time.

descKeys: ide the path, trying to exist in this harsh mountain air. some flowers are here.
r571.description:
You are walking along a narrow path that is resting in the shadow of Mt.
Kulajo, which is just east of here.  Way off to the west you can see the
beginnings of the Plains of Nereka.  Small foliage is growing beside the
path, trying to exist in this harsh mountain air.  Some flowers are here.

descKeys: s been kept in good shape for those few travelers who choose to use the roadway.
r572.description:
The small path you are walking upon is winding its way around Mt. Kulajo's
west side, running between Kal-Thax and Threshold.  Although this small road is
not used very much, it has been kept in good shape for those few travelers
who choose to use the roadway.

descKeys: arge birds circle overhead, almost trailing you in your movements down the path.
r573.description:
The mountain path, although quite sturdy, is not well-used, and you get the
distinct impression that you are the only being who has been on the road for
some time.  A few large birds circle overhead, almost trailing you in your
movements down the path.

descKeys: of being caught in one. a small path leads off from the main one, heading east.
r574.description:
The side of Mt. Kulajo is very steep, with this path you are standing upon
being about a third of the way up its west side.  The peak has been known to
to have many rock slides coming down from its heights, causing you to be
more than a little alarmed at the prospect of being caught in one.  A small
path leads off from the main one, heading east.

descKeys: lds have been carved into it. it looks like this is used by many a rock climber.
notes: Johans the Climber (surface): practice climbing costs 35 coins; same start/finish/refuse texts as Drakkay
r575.description:
You are standing just east of Mt. Kulajo.  The huge mountain towers above
you, dwarfing you in its majesty.  Look at the mountain's side, you can
see that several handholds have been carved into it.  It looks like this
is used by many a rock climber.

descKeys: not known as a very hospitable race, but neither are they know as being hostile.
r576.description:
The mountainous region in which you are traipsing about has been settled by
the dwarves of Kal-Thax for centuries.  The Kal-Thax region starts about here
and runs north for many miles.  The dwarves of Kal-Thax are not known as a
very hospitable race, but neither are they know as being hostile.

descKeys: ded from years of exposure to determine to which race the rock's visage belongs.
r584.description:
The tunnel starts to widen out here, gaining in size to the south.  Directly
in the middle of the tunnel lies a peculiar rock.  The rock is shaped like
a head, although the facial features have been rounded from years of exposure
to determine to which race the rock's visage belongs.

descKeys: tunnel continues west and even looks like it widens out a bit in that direction.
r585.description:
The tunnel descends sharply downward here, going almost straight down into
the darkness.  You could easily lose your footing if you are not cautious.
A small opening in the wall to your north looks a bit out of the ordinary.
The dark tunnel continues west and even looks like it widens out a bit in
that direction.

descKeys: rom the gate towards the throne. the gate to the south leads out into a hallway.
r610.description:
This room is totally magnificient.  The walls are dressed in a goldish-yellow
wall paper.  In the center of the room you see a three feet high throne, most
likely belonging to the resident of this room; The Grand faerny.  A thin
white carpet with gold-red engravings leads from the gate towards the throne.
 The gate to the south leads out into a hallway.

descKeys: leads into a small town. to the west is a trail that meanders through the trees.
r639.description:
You are at an intersection in roads.  The road travelling north and south
is about twenty feet wide, and is known as the Caravan Route.  This Route
runs from Kalinport in the south all the way up to the northern towns and
villages.  To the southeast is a small road that leads into a small town.  To
the west is a trail that meanders through the trees.

descKeys: s from threshold to kalinport. the moon is somewhere between breath and arrival.
used by the caravans running the north-south routes from threshold to kalinport.
r640.description:
The Great Forest totally envelopes you, almost cutting you off from any sort
of view out of the trees.  The area gives you a sense of awe, gazing at the
surrounding greenery.  You are on a large road, about twenty feet in width,
that is used by the caravans running the north-south routes from Threshold
to Kalinport.

descKeys: s from threshold to kalinport. the moon is somewhere between breath and arrival.
used by the caravans running the north-south routes from threshold to kalinport.

r731.description:
You have just entered a trail that seems to run deep into the forest.  You
cannot see off in the distance, because there are many trees in this part of
the forest.  To the south, you can see some mountains standing high against
the trees.

descKeys: nto the forest. you vaguely remeber hearing stories about bandits in the forest.
r732.description:
You are moving deeper into the forest on this trail.  You can only see the
trees surrounding you, and to the south the tall mountains from the Viluten
mountain range.  This trail seems to head deeper into the forest.  You
vaguely remeber hearing stories about bandits in the forest.

descKeys: an see some of the mountains standing high against the background of the forest.
r733.description:
You are on a well traveled trail that goes through the Great Forest.  In all
directions the only thing you can see are trees, and an occasional wildlife
animal.  To the south you can see some of the mountains standing high
against the background of the forest.

descKeys: ny footprints in the mud. this trail is very muddy, probably from a recent rain.
r734.description:
You are standing in the middle of the Great Forest.  In all directions, you
can only see trees.  The trail you are on looks to have been used a lot,
because you can see many footprints in the mud.  This trail is very muddy,
probably from a recent rain.

descKeys: when you started, giving you an idea of how far you have traveled on this trail.
r735.description:
This trail you are on seems to continue to the west through the forest.  The
forest is populated with many trees, and you can see many types of wildlife
in the forest as well.  To the south, you can see a mountain range that is
farther off than when you started, giving you an idea of how far you have
traveled on this trail.

descKeys: ou can see a mountain range. the forest seems to surround you in all directions.
r736.description:
You are standing on a trail deep in the forest.  This part of the forest is
covered with many trees.  To the northwest, it seems as if the number of
trees decreases.  To the south you can see a mountain range.  The forest
seems to surround you in all directions.

descKeys: a mountain range. the forest becomes more populated with trees to the southeast.
r737.description:
You are on a trail in the forest.  This part of the forest seems to have
less trees than the part you just came from.  The trail seems to continue
to the northwest.  To the south and west you can see a mountain range.  The
forest becomes more populated with trees to the southeast.

descKeys: you see a mountain range. this part of the trail seems to have been used a lot.
r738.description:
You are standing on a trail in the forest.  The trees here seems to be less
in number than earlier on the trail.  To the north you can see some
smoke, and to the south you see a mountain range.  This part of the
trail seems to have been used a lot.

descKeys: source of the glow. a small tunnel breaks off from the cavern to the northwest.
r951.description:
The cavern grows in size to the south, and gently diminishes to the east.  The
point of the cavern you are now in glows faintly with a greenish hue.  Looking
at the walls, you notice a strange type of fungus attached to it.  The fungus
must be the source of the glow.  A small tunnel breaks off from the cavern
to the northwest.

descKeys: caravan route between kalinport to the south and the settled lands to the north.
the south and the settled lands to the north. there is a plant in front of you.
r1238.description:
You are standing somewhere in the Kalamshite Desert.  Huge sand dunes are
all around you, blocking your view somewhat.  Looking around, you do not
see a speck of vegetation, only the rolling sands as far as you can see.
You are on the main caravan route between Kalinport to the south and the
settled lands to the north.

descKeys: ine, used by the caravans from the north and south to pass through the vilutens.
r1241.description:
The Viluten Mountains separate the harsh Kalamshite desert to the south and
the lush green forests to the north.  Judging from the rounded peaks and
mountain sides, the Vilutens are extremely ancient, having been around long
before any civilized race existed on the continent.  You are presently in a
deep ravine, used by the caravans from the north and south to pass through
the Vilutens.

descKeys: used by the caravans running the north-south routes from threshold to kalinport.

r1244.description:
You are travelling upon Gateway Road, which runs north and south through the
town of Threshold.  Several people bump into you as they make their way to
the town square, which lies south of your current position.  The road on which
you travel is well-worn.  A smithy, looking like it is closed, is to the west.

descKeys: your path, pausing briefly to stare at you. there is a small house to the east.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r1245.description:
Gateway Road runs north and south through Threshold.  This part of town is
used mainly for housing, judging by the closely-packed smaller buildings that
line either side of the road.  A small feline crosses your path, pausing
briefly to stare at you.  There is a small house to the east.

You are travelling upon Gateway Road, which runs north towards the mountains,
and south towards the town square.  A large and gleaming church is to the west

around this area seem well-made.

r1247.description:
You cannot You are now standing in Threshold's main square.  Several different types of
shops line the sides of the square.  The townsfolk can be seen hurrying around
the square with bundles under their arms, stopping occasionally to gaze into a
shop's window.  Looking around, you can see that the town's two main roads
meet at this point.  Gateway Road leads north and south, heading towards
the mountains and swamp area, respectively.  Frontiers Street goes east and
west from here.  The docks of the city are to the east, with the western
route of Frontiers Street leading out of town into the forests.

r1248.description:
Frontiers Street leads east and west, with the main town square situated a
few steps to the west.  A shop to the north of here has several customers
perusing its fine wares.  You also see a few official types enter the building
to the south.  Gazing around, you see an older man staggering out of the
establishment to the northeast, which you assume to be some sort of a bar.
npcs: Knight of the Circle that is astride Warhorse

r1249.description:
You are standing on Gateway Road in the town of Threshold.  Buildings line
the road, packed together snugly.  The town square is a ways to the south,
with several groups of people heading towards that direction.  Off on the side
of the road is a small vendor's stand.  Looking to the east, you see that a
small library has been built there recently.
npcs: Knight of the Circle that is astride Warhorse

descKeys: ople are mostly human, there is a large group of demi-humans residing here also.

r1250.description:
You are travelling upon Gateway Road.  The town of Threshold lies towards the
the south, while Mt. Kulajo is north of here.  Small buildings line the sides
of the road, housing Threshold's citizens.  Although the local people are
mostly human, there is a large group of demi-humans residing here also.

a tall grey tower of pale stone rises beside the road a short way to the north.

r1251.description:
You are near the town of Threshold, which is a little ways to the south.  All
along the road you are travelling upon, Gateway Road, there are small bushes
lining either side of it.  The funny thing is that they are all in great
shape, as if the town paid someone to take care of them.
npcs: Knight of the Circle that is astride Warhorse

descKeys: visit the outlying towns and villages. a smaller road also starts to the south.
notes: listen: You can hear several human voices to the south.

senses.listen: You can hear several human voices to the south.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r1252.description:
The Route continues north and west, heading towards the base of some large
mountain to the north, and heading through the foothills to the west.  The road
looks to be in good repair.  A lot of travellers use this road to visit the
outlying towns and villages.  A smaller road also starts to the south.

descKeys: mt. kulajo, which is rising high above the small town of threshold to the south.
notes: listen: You can hear several human voices to the south.
search: Your eyes sting from the bright light, and you are blinded for a moment!

senses.listen: You can hear several human voices to the south.
senses.search: Your eyes sting from the bright light, and you are blinded for a moment!

r1253.description:
This large road is used often, judging from the many footprints and cart wheel-
tracks.  Small bushes line the road, hedged into a perfect square shape.  Off
to the north you can see Mt. Kulajo, which is rising high above the small
town of Threshold to the south.

descKeys: the walls, most of the being half-full with books. gateway road is to the west.
r1254.description:
This library was funded by a local Threshold group, intent on putting a bit
more culture in Threshold.  Although it is only one small room in a tiny
building, they are set to expand it at anytime.  Several bookshelves line the
walls, most of the being half-full with books.  Gateway Road is to the west.

descKeys: of the alley, making you wonder why this roadway is not in fact called as such.
r1255.description:
You are at the beginning of Snake Alley, which is in the northern section of the
human city of Threshold.  The alley runs east and looks to curve to the south
in that direction.  Small buildings line the sides of the alley, making you
wonder why this roadway is not in fact called as such.

descKeys: as any main road. small and cheery buildings line either side of the throughway.
r1256.description:
Looking around, you note that Snake Alley does not really deserve its name.
This alley is not dark and foreboding like Kraken Alley, and it is open to the
sunlight as much as any main road.  Small and cheery buildings line either side
of the throughway.

descKeys: from their personal business. a small house to the west looks vaguely familiar.
r1257.description:
Snake Alley runs north and south here, running parallel to Gateway Road to the
west.  The buildings lining either side of the large alley seem to be in good
repair.  Many citizens of Threshold live around here, with some even living
right across from their personal business.  A small house to the west looks
vaguely familiar.

descKeys: uilding. a few piles of rubbish have been piled up here, left to rot in the sun.
r1258.description:
You have reached the end of Snake Alley.  The alley runs right into a large
brick building to the south.  Looking upwards, you can see a window on the
second floor of that building.  A few piles of rubbish have been piled up here,
left to rot in the sun.

descKeys: be, and where the cooling trench was as well. back to the east is gateway road.
r1259.description:
This shop used to be owned by an armorer who specialized in unique armors and
weapons.  However, recently he moved his shop to Kalinport.  You can see where
the large anvil used to be, and where the cooling trench was as well.  Back
to the east is Gateway Road.

descKeys: a sign on the wall which can be read, but it appears to be a list of some kind.
r1260.description:
This is an old house.  You can see by the antiques around the room that
someone with a lot of years resides here.  You can see the treasures of many
an adventure on tables around the room.  There is a sign on the wall which
can be read, but it appears to be a list of some kind.

descKeys: rch leads both downwards and upwards. to the right of the altar is a small door.
r1261.description:
You are standing inside of a huge and ornate church.  Having been erected
many years earlier, the main Church of Kertaine has grown in popularity, with
new converts in many other parts of the region.  A large and exquisitely-
crafted altar is against one wall, covering the entire length of one end.
Several rows of pews are in front of the altar, able to seat over a hundred
church-goers.  A large staircase in the northeast corner of the church leads
both downwards and upwards.  To the right of the altar is a small door.

descKeys: ng from before. a large staircase is in one corner of the room, leading upwards.
r1262.description:
In the early days of the Church there was not a readily-available supply of
construction materials.  Working around this shortage, the builders of the
Church constructed passageways and rooms underneath the main building.  At
first these passageways were rough rock, but over the years with the Church
garnering more wealth, floors made from marble were put in, replacing the
dirt and rock flooring from before.  A large staircase is in one corner of
the room, leading upwards.

descKeys: ath your feet, getting between you and the hard marble floor underneath the rug.
r1263.description:
The corridor is leading in the four principal directions.  Against one wall
is a small statue of Kertaine.  Having been carved in the early days of the
Church, the statue is not very impressive, but it is considered a holy relic
by the members of the Church.  A thick carpet of cloth is beneath your feet,
getting between you and the hard marble floor underneath the rug.

descKeys: aking up about ten feet of space. a wooden footlocker is at the foot of the bed.
r1264.description:
This medium-sized room belongs to an Acolyte of the Church.  The Acolyte works
as an aid to the Patriarch, helping him with the daily runnings of the Church
and other trivial matters that the Patriarch need not concern himself with.
A small bed is in one corner of the room, taking up about ten feet of space.
A wooden footlocker is at the foot of the bed.

descKeys: he room, with a small wooden footlocker having been set at the foot of that bed.
r1265.description:
The room you are standing in belongs to a low-ranking Acolyte of the Church.
This Acolyte's main job is keeping the Church free of debris.  In short, she is
a 'glorified' janitor.  A small bed is in one corner of the room, with a small
wooden footlocker having been set at the foot of that bed.

descKeys: . a nice rug is underneath your feet, running the entire length of the corridor.
r1266.description:
You are standing in an underground corridor, situated beneath the Church of
Kertaine's main parsonage.  The corridor runs east and west, with two rooms
branching off to the north and south.  A nice rug is underneath your feet,
running the entire length of the corridor.

descKeys: the room, with the only other item of furnishing being a small chest of drawers.
r1267.description:
You are in a large, yet sparsely furnished, room that has been reserved for
the Pastor of the Church.  The Pastor is in charge of the congregation, and
knows almost all of them by their first name.  He is the one who runs the
Church services, before and after the Patriarch speaks to the assembly.  A
medium-sized bed is against one wall of the room, with the only other item
of furnishing being a small chest of drawers.

descKeys: e desk, used by visitors of the pastor. to the north is an underground corridor.
r1268.description:
This large and spacious room is used by the Pastor as his personal study.
A large wooden desk is in the middle of the room, with a large and comfortable
chair being behind that desk.  A few wooden chairs are in front of the desk,
used by visitors of the Pastor.  To the north is an underground corridor.

descKeys: room is spacious, and most of that space is not being used for anything at all.

Church of Kertaine Guild Board [ 57 mess.name: Church of Kertaine Guild Board [ 57 messages, 57 new]

r1269.description:
This room was once used as living quarters, but now it is used for storage
only.  Several crates are in here, unopened and probably impposible to do
so.  The room is spacious, and most of that space is not being used for
anything at all.

descKeys: ceiling leads to the church's bell tower. the clerestory continues to the west.
r1270.description:
The upper clerestory of the church looks down at the altar below.  Everything
is calm and serene up here as light pours in from the great stained glass
windows.  A spiral staircase leads down, and a trapdoor in the ceiling leads
to the church's bell tower.  The clerestory continues to the west.

descKeys: west is an immense window heralding the glory of the original fifteen founders.
r1271.description:
You are directly overhead the altar.  Looking down, you see that there
is a small room hidden behind the altar, perhaps used to store items used
for services.  To the west is an immense window heralding the glory of the
original fifteen founders.

descKeys: it looks like there is some sort of a swamp to the south, outside of threshold.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r1272.description:
You are on Gateway Road, which travels north and south through the town of
Threshold.  The town square, with all of its shops and curiosities, lies a
few steps to the north.  It looks like there is some sort of a swamp to the
south, outside of Threshold.

descKeys: o the southwest. there is also a new building that has been erected to the east.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r1273.description:
You are on Gateway Road.  This part of Threshold looks to be a small business
emporium.  Small buildings line both sides of the street.  A few people walk
past you, heading north to the main shopping area of Threshold.  A large and
empty building stands off to the southwest.  There is also a new building that
has been erected to the east.

descKeys: town council has deemed the swamp off-limits. a small shop is open to the east.

s.note: Town guard blocks southbound (town edict, 2026-11-03). Swamp way in: r1273 sw r1279 `pry floorboard` (mstoblack). Northbound r1538 n is fine.

senses.smell:
A damp and soggy scent is eminating from the south.
There is also a smell of death in the area.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r1274.description:
You are standing on Gateway Road, which leads north into Threshold.  A vast
swamp is to the south, ominous and dark.  For years the swamp has been
dormant, but now it seems to be growing, with Threshold in danger of being
swallowed up by its land-eating marshes.  Since many people have mysteriously
vanished while exploring the swamp, the Threshold town council has deemed
the swamp off-limits.  A small shop is open to the east.

descKeys: ded to move elsewhere. a small storeroom is to the southeast, through a doorway.
r1275.description:
This shop used to be home to an alchemist's shop, judging from all the many
different types of bottles and beakers left behind.  It seems that the
shop's recent owners decided to move elsewhere.  A small storeroom is to the
southeast, through a doorway.

descKeys: ned shop is to the northwest, through a small archway that has seen better days.
r1276.description:
You are standing in the back room of the alchemist's shop.  Mostly empty, the
room has a few shelves on the walls and a few small boxes spread about.  The
main part of this abandoned shop is to the northwest, through a small archway
that has seen better days.

descKeys: wood stacked on them. a small staircase in the southwest corner leads downwards.
r1277.description:
The owner of this shop, Murphye Stormwood, has recently moved into town and
has convinced the town council to allow him to open this small shop.  Murphye
has a passion for woodworking, so he saved up until he could afford to open
this establishment.  Shelves are around the area with various types of wood
stacked on them.  A small staircase in the southwest corner leads downwards.

descKeys: shop. three small windows near the ceiling of the room are used for ventilation.
r1278.description:
You are in a small woodworking shop, located beneath Murphye's Woodshop, in
the town of Threshold.  Various knives and cutting tools are laying around
on the wooden tables, all of the instruments being in good shape.  A few
pedal-driven saws are around the room as well.  A layer of wood chips covers
the entire floor.  A small staircase is in the southwest corner, running up
to the shop.  Three small windows near the ceiling of the room are used for
ventilation.

descKeys: the table seem a different shade of color from the rest of the building's floor.
r1279.description:
This building has been abandoned for some years, judging by the amout of
cobwebs that are hanging around.  There is a small table and a few termite-
eaten chairs splayed about.  The floorboards under the table seem a different
shade of color from the rest of the building's floor.

descKeys: ranquil atmosphere of threshold. the notorious kraken alley starts to the south.
r1280.description:
Frontiers Street runs east and west from here.  A little ways to the east
lies the town square, where you may find a plethora of shops.  A small and
weather-beaten house is right in front of you, marring the tranquil atmosphere
of Threshold.  The notorious Kraken Alley starts to the south.

descKeys: and more stagnant than the rest of threshold. frontiers street is north of here.
r1281.description:
You are standing in the infamous Kraken Alley.  Small shapes flitter in and
out of the shadows, prompting you to move on or be accosted.  Steam is also
rising from the ground, as if this part of the town is hotter and more
stagnant than the rest of Threshold.  Frontiers Street is north of here.

descKeys: zens get their water from other and newer wells, this one is not used very much.
r1282.description:
This part of Kraken Alley is somewhat more 'lit' than the other parts of the
alley.  This must be because of the presence of a town well.  For some odd
reason, the Threshold town government decided to put the well in this dark
alley.  Since most citizens get their water from other and newer wells, this
one is not used very much.

descKeys: ses of people moving in and out of the many shadows, looking for an easy target.
r1283.description:
Kraken Alley comes to an abrupt halt here, running into a wall of rubbish
that has been heaped up beside the wall of some building.  Occasionally you
catch glimpses of people moving in and out of the many shadows, looking for
an easy target.

descKeys: scattered about the place. there is only one exit, and that is to the southeast.
r1284.description:
You are in a small establishment in a rough part of town.  From the looks of
things, this building is now not used.  Empty boxes line the floor, and litter
is scattered about the place.  There is only one exit, and that is to the
southeast.

descKeys: ular dog, smallish and feral, wags his tail when he notices you glancing at him.
r1285.description:
Frontiers Street passes trough a small business district here.  It looks
like these buildings are in need of repair however.  A few people push past
you, heading for the town square to the east.  A singular dog, smallish and
feral, wags his tail when he notices you glancing at him.

descKeys: right up to the gates of threshold. a small shop catches your eye to the north.

Knight of the Circle that is astride War.name: Knight of the Circle that is astride Warhorse

r1286.description:
You are standing on Frontiers Street, which runs east and west.  Judging by the
flow of people to the east, you surmise that east is where the main shops are.
A lush green forest full of huge and imposing trees can be seen to the west.
The forest seems to reach right up to the gates of Threshold.  A small shop
catches your eye to the north.
npcs: Knight of the Circle that is astride Warhorse

descKeys: ots and lots of shelves line the walls, holding various items for you to peruse.
r1287.description:
This small shop has been here for many years, founded by a respected member
of the community, a man named Willen Noggler.  Willen was a sell-sword as
a young man, but he eventually settled down in Threshold and made a good
name for himself.  Lots and lots of shelves line the walls, holding various
items for you to peruse.

descKeys: ather boots. a small shop is to the north, but it looks like it has closed down.

Knight of the Circle that is astride War.name: Knight of the Circle that is astride Warhorse

r1288.description:
The buildings here which line Frontiers Street are of newer design.  People
bustle by you, generally heading east.  The road on which you stand is made
of rough, packed dirt.  Looking down at the grubby roadway, you suddenly wish
you had chosen to wear your hard leather boots.  A small shop is to the
north, but it looks like it has closed down.
npcs: Knight of the Circle that is astride Warhorse

descKeys: feet into the air. the edge of the forest reaches right up to the city's gates.

Knight of the Circle that is astride War.name: Knight of the Circle that is astride Warhorse

r1289.description:
Frontiers Street begins here and runs east, towards the main part of Threshold.
A large and deep forest is to the west of here, with huge trees rising
hundreds of feet into the air.  The edge of the forest reaches right up to the
city's gates.
npcs: Knight of the Circle that is astride Warhorse

descKeys: arge path that leads southwest, away from threshold. a large berry bush is here.

Knight of the Circle that is astride War.name: Knight of the Circle that is astride Warhorse

r1290.description:
A large and green forest full of huge trees begins to the west.  The small
town of Threshold is to the east, waiting to be perused.  The trees of the
forest look unnaturally large, as if someone had fed them some secret diet
of tree food.  There is a large path that leads southwest, away from Threshold.
A large berry bush is here.
npcs: Knight of the Circle that is astride Warhorse

descKeys: ry tall heights, towering far above your head. a large road is to the northwest.

Knight of the Circle that is astride War.name: Knight of the Circle that is astride Warhorse

r1291.description:
This small path is leading northeast and northwest from here.  It seems that
a small town is to the east a ways, probably Threshold.  The forest is all
around you, with the trees growing to very tall heights, towering far above
your head.  A large road is to the northwest.
npcs: Knight of the Circle that is astride Warhorse

descKeys: leads into a small town. to the west is a trail that meanders through the trees.

Knight of the Circle that is astride War.name: Knight of the Circle that is astride Warhorse

r1292.description:
You are at an intersection in roads.  The road travelling north and south
is about twenty feet wide, and is known as the Caravan Route.  This Route
runs from Kalinport in the south all the way up to the northern towns and
villages.  To the southeast is a small road that leads into a small town.  To
the west is a trail that meanders through the trees.
npcs: Knight of the Circle that is astride Warhorse

descKeys: can see a large mountain range, and to the north of here are some rolling hills.

Knight of the Circle that is astride War.name: Knight of the Circle that is astride Warhorse

r1293.description:
You are on the main Caravan Route that runs throughout the eastern portion
of the Kalin continent.  At this time, the Route is running through a large
forest known as the Great Forest.  Up towards the northeast you can see a
large mountain range, and to the north of here are some rolling hills.
npcs: Knight of the Circle that is astride Warhorse

descKeys: d repair, considering the large amount of traffic that passes over it every day.

Knight of the Circle that is astride War.name: Knight of the Circle that is astride Warhorse

r1294.description:
The Caravan Route is running through many trees, twisting around them in an
orderly fashion.  The road itself is made from packed dirt, and looks to be
in good repair, considering the large amount of traffic that passes over it
every day.
npcs: Knight of the Circle that is astride Warhorse

descKeys: ike it is used quite often by travellers heading to and from towns and villages.

Knight of the Circle that is astride War.name: Knight of the Circle that is astride Warhorse

r1295.description:
You are on the Caravan Route, heading in an area that is between the Great
Forest to the south and the Absinthe Mountain Range to the north and north-
east.  The road is about twenty feet wide, and looks like it is used quite
often by travellers heading to and from towns and villages.
npcs: Knight of the Circle that is astride Warhorse

descKeys: you sense that by heading to the north, the elevation would rise significantly.
r1296.description:
The Route is passing through the buffer area between the Great Forest and
the large mountain range to the north.  A few trees are around, but they are
generally smaller than the ones to the south.  You sense that by heading to
the north, the elevation would rise significantly.

descKeys: bris. the surface of the road is smooth and looks relatively free from potholes.
r1297.description:
The Caravan Route curves here, heading both south towards a large forest, and
northeast towards a huge mountain range.  The sides of the roads are free of
brush and any other debris.  The surface of the road is smooth and looks
relatively free from potholes.

descKeys: eading to the northeast towards the mountains, and southwest towards the forest.
r1298.description:
You are just south of the Absinthe Mountain Range, travelling on the large and
expansive Caravan Route.  To the south, in the distance, you can see the start
of a large forest.  The road is heading to the northeast towards the mountains,
and southwest towards the forest.

descKeys: of 'highlands' area. past them to the northeast is the absinthe mountain range.
r1299.description:
The Route is heading east and west here, travelling remarkably straight.  To
the north you can spot some of the rolling hills, and near them looks to be
a sort of 'highlands' area.  Past them to the northeast is the Absinthe
Mountain Range.

descKeys: f you look closely through the trees to the southeast, you can see a small town.
r1300.description:
You are on the Caravan Route, travelling either east or west through a large
and expansive forest.  The trees in this area are very large, and have been
known to fall across the road now and again.  If you look closely through
the trees to the southeast, you can see a small town.

descKeys: the east you can see the route travelling through the trees of the great forest.
r1301.description:
The Route is running east and west here, but you can see that it curves to the
right if you were to head west.  That direction looks like it leads towards
a large and open plains area.  Back to the east you can see the Route
travelling through the trees of the Great Forest.

descKeys: t direction must head towards some sort of plains, perhaps the plains of nereka.
r1302.description:
This part of the Caravan Route is running through a large forest.  Towards the
east the trees get a lot thicker, but to the northwest they seem to fade out
until there are none about.  That direction must head towards some sort of
plains, perhaps the Plains of Nereka.

descKeys: outheast, but seems to also head towards an open area to the west and northwest.
r1303.description:
You are on the Caravan Route.  This part of the Route is nestled between
several small trees of the Great Forest.  The Route heads back into the
Forest to the southeast, but seems to also head towards an open area to the
west and northwest.

descKeys: and smells of nature. this wouldnt be a bad place to settle down at some point.
r1304.description:
You are standing in what appears to be a small clearing jsut outside of the
town of Threshold.  There is a small cottage here, and what appears to be a
garden off to the east.  All around you are the sounds and smells of nature.
This wouldnt be a bad place to settle down at some point.

descKeys: d potato plant. the smells coming from this garden are pleasant to your nostrils
r1305.description:
You are standing in what appears to be a small garden.  This garden looks to
have many different types of plants in it, some of which might be useful for
cooking some food.  You notice in particular the following plants: tomato
plant, carrot plant, celery plant, bean plant, and potato plant.  The smells
coming from this garden are pleasant to your nostrils

descKeys: used by the caravans running the north-south routes from threshold to kalinport.
r1306.description:
The Great Forest totally envelopes you, almost cutting you off from any sort
of view out of the trees.  The area gives you a sense of awe, gazing at the
surrounding greenery.  You are on a large road, about twenty feet in width,
that is used by the caravans running the north-south routes from Threshold
to Kalinport.
