r2682.description:
The road is meandering through the Plains of Nereka, twisting a few times
here and there, but straight for the most part.  Looking far to the south
you can spot a large forest, a huge green expanse that you find mind-boggling.
You think you can also see a large castle to the southeast a long ways.

descKeys: sed quite so frequently any more. the main part of the cathedral is to the west.
r2685.description:
You are in the Church of Kertaine.  This large cathedral was constructed only
a few short years ago.  The elders of the Church decided to move the main
worship center to a larger city.  Moving from Threshold to here was not easy,
but they made it through it.  Speaking of Threshold, the house of worship
is still there, although it is not used quite so frequently any more.  The
main part of the cathedral is to the west.

descKeys: le continues to the south. one of the main streets of deepwater is to the north.
r2686.description:
This large stable is used when travellers come to Deepwater and are in need
of lodging for their mounts.  People can also rent mounts here, as long as
the Stablehand is nearby.  The stable continues to the south.  One of the main
streets of Deepwater is to the north.

descKeys: you can see the famous dulaj road. there is a small sign here that you can read.
r2687.description:
You are standing in a covered area just south of the stables.  This area is
used by Deepwater merchants to prepare their Caravans for the long journey
to the other regions.  A large tent-like material has been stretched
overhead, keeping any rain out of the area.  To the south you can see the
famous Dulaj Road.  There is a small sign here that you can read.

descKeys: re in this area, penned in large stalls. the rest of the stable is to the north.
r2688.description:
You are in the southern end of the Deepwater Stables.  These stables have
been around for some time, as they are popular with travellers.  A few of
the larger horses are in this area, penned in large stalls.  The rest of the
stable is to the north.

descKeys: y having two or three guards stationed within. a smithy is now open to the east.
r2689.description:
You are standing on Commerce Way, which runs north and south throughout the
merchant section of Deepwater.  The road is usally well-traveled, with people
heading to and from the merchants' area.  To the south is a small guardhouse,
usually having two or three guards stationed within.  A smithy is now open
to the east.

descKeys: hat leads to the east is hanging open. commerce way is out the door to the west.
r2690.description:
You are in a newly-built blacksmith's shop.  A large anvil is in one corner
of the room, and an even larger forge is right in the middle.  A cooling
trench is near the forge as well.  A small door that leads to the east is
hanging open.  Commerce Way is out the door to the west.

descKeys: thing to buy. a well-used shop is to east, while a new bank is open to the west.
r2691.description:
You are currently in the merchant section of Deepwater, located near the south-
eastern portion of town.  Shops and other establishments line the road on
either side.  Several small groups of people are gathered in and around these
shops, looking for something to buy.  A well-used shop is to east, while a
new bank is open to the west.

descKeys: . an exit to the west leads to other parts of the merchant section of deepwater.
r2692.description:
You are standing in the main general store of Deepwater.  The owner of this
establishment buys and sells all sorts of items, from the mundane to the
exotic.  Many shelves cover the walls filled with all sorts of different items.
An exit to the west leads to other parts of the merchant section of Deepwater.

descKeys: ins of nereka. off to the north you can see part of the absinthe mountain range.

descKeys: ine, used by the caravans from the north and south to pass through the vilutens.
r2723.description:
The Viluten Mountains separate the harsh Kalamshite desert to the south and
the lush green forests to the north.  Judging from the rounded peaks and
mountain sides, the Vilutens are extremely ancient, having been around long
before any civilized race existed on the continent.  You are presently in a
deep ravine, used by the caravans from the north and south to pass through
the Vilutens.

descKeys: caravan route between kalinport to the south and the settled lands to the north.
r2724.description:
You are standing somewhere in the Kalamshite Desert.  Huge sand dunes are
all around you, blocking your view somewhat.  Looking around, you do not
see a speck of vegetation, only the rolling sands as far as you can see.
You are on the main caravan route between Kalinport to the south and the
settled lands to the north.

descKeys: tled lands to the north. you can see a large hole in the ground off to the east.
r2725.description:
You are standing somewhere in the Kalamshite Desert.  Huge sand dunes are
all around you, blocking your view somewhat.  Looking around, you do not
see a speck of vegetation, only the rolling sands as far as you can see.
You are on the main caravan route between Kalinport to the south and the
settled lands to the north.  You can see a large hole in the ground off to
the east.

descKeys: ing to the northeast, but its not that distinctive because of the jutting rocks.
r2752.description:
Walking up this path you almost trip over the roots and rocks sticking up out
of the eroded pathway.  This pathway seems to have been a result of mountain
water runoff.  The water that has come billowing down the mountain has eroded
the path so badly that it is very rocky and treacherous.  You can tell there
is a path leading to the northeast, but its not that distinctive because of
the jutting rocks.

descKeys: ing to the top. you can keep following northeast, or turn back to the southwest.
r2753.description:
Stepping from rock to rock, the water trickles down the mountain at your
feet.  The path you walk upon could become quite fatal with one slip.  The
rocks and roots make for stable steps up to the top, but it is unclear if the
path keeps on going to the top.  You can keep following northeast, or turn
back to the southwest.

descKeys: h is still leading to the northeast, and you can still go back to the southwest.
r2754.description:
The path is still very rocky.  The rocks and roots are good places for your
feet because the ground below is mucky. The runoff is getting more voluminous
as the altitude increases, and it looks like a small river.  The path is
still leading to the northeast, and you can still go back to the southwest.

descKeys: ical distance. there are still paths leading to the northeast and the southwest.
r2755.description:
Coming up the path you notice that there seems to be a small landing further
up.  It wasn't visible before, but you can tell that the topography is not as
constant as you thought it was.  The large mountain looms in the vertical
distance.  There are still paths leading to the northeast and the southwest.

descKeys: an easily travel back to where you came from, or you can step up onto the ledge.
r2756.description:
You have come up to the ledge of the landing.  You can easily climb up onto
it, and you can hear a strange noise, and smell and interesting stench.   It
smells something like manure.  You can easily travel back to where you came
from, or you can step up onto the ledge.

descKeys: landing. you can step back off of the landing, or you can travel on and explore.
r2757.description:
As you step up onto the landing you are greeted with a beautiful scene.
Through a break in the scene you can see the large Dwarven city of Stronghold
off to the north and west.  You can also see the largest herd of mountain
goats you have ever seen.  They have quite the home upon this large landing.
You can step back off of the landing, or you can travel on and explore.

descKeys: hills, its very beautiful up here. from here you can move west, north, and east.
r2758.description:
You are walking along the southern edge of the landing.  It seems as though
you can see far off from here, but nothing is too distinctive.  You can see
some deep valleys and small hills, its very beautiful up here.  From here you
can move west, north, and east.

descKeys: nd it makes for a beautiful sight. from here you can move west, north, and east.
r2759.description:
Walking about the southern edge of the landing, you can see far off to the
south.  Nothing too spectacular stands out, as it is so far away.  You can
see all sorts of topography from here, and it makes for a beautiful sight.
From here you can move west, north, and east.

descKeys: our north from here, and if you go further north and east you run into the cave.
r2760.description:
The southern edge of the landing is close to being cut off by the large wall.
 You can still see far off into the distance back to the south and southwest.
 You can move to your north from here, and if you go further north and east
you run into the cave.

descKeys: enced of climbers to get up this wall. you can go back west, or north from here.
r2761.description:
Coming up to the large wall, you strain your neck trying to scale its size.
It is so large that mist gathers at what you guess to be half way.  It would
take the most experienced of climbers to get up this wall.  You can go back
west, or north from here.

descKeys: and land other than the land your standing on. you can enter the cave from here.
r2762.description:
You are right next to the entrance of the cave.  You can see the flames of
the fire making the walls light up.  Looking back you can see where the
landing drops off, from here you cant see any of the towns or and land other
than the land your standing on.  You can enter the cave from here.

descKeys: weather. a small fire is built, and it looks to kave something roasting over it.
notes: Simien the Goat Herder (Herder's Crook, Frayed cloak) — consider: 'lose in a breakneck speed' for Zurker L? — skip
r2763.description:
Upon entering the cave you can immediately tell that it is someone's home.
You can see a small bed off in the corner, and a small chest right next to
it.  In front of you there is a pen, it is full of baby mountain goats and
their mothers.  It must be for keeping them out of the harsher weather.  A
small fire is built, and it looks to kave something roasting over it.

descKeys: the pen or head back to where you came from. there is a wood door leading east .
r2764.description:
You are now standing right in front of the pen.  It looks like it is being
held by a rope that can easily be lifted.  The little goats look very tired
and most of them are lying down and catching some rest on their mother's
stomachs.  You can either enter the pen or head back to where you came from.
There is a wood door leading east ( OPENED ).

descKeys: to your southeast, and you can see the little goats feeding from their mothers.
r2765.description:
You are standing near the inhabitants bed.  It is neatly made and folded
perfectly.  The chest is a dark cherry chest.  It is locked tightly, and you
guess it is not openable without the proper key.  The pen is to your
southeast, and you can see the little goats feeding from their mothers.

descKeys: made every time a droplet hits the pool. you can travel west or north from here.
r2766.description:
As you come to this corner of the cave you are standing next to what seems to
be a rain catch.  It must be used to keep the goats in the pen hydrated, and
also the inhabitant for that matter.  There is a little dripping sound that
is made every time a droplet hits the pool.  You can travel west or north
from here.

descKeys: easily leave back out of the pen from here. there is a wood door leading west .

decayed remains of Baby mountain goat.name: decayed remains of Baby mountain goat

decaying remains of Baby mountain goat.name: decaying remains of Baby mountain goat

r2767.description:
Upon entering the pen you step in a large pile of manure.  You can see the
little goat babies eyes quivering in fear, as they are not used to you.  The
mothers begin to stand in a defensive position with their little ones behind
them.  You can easily leave back out of the pen from here.
There is a wood door leading west ( OPENED ).

descKeys: s very small, but it seems as though not many of the goats had babies this year.
r2768.description:
As you shift to the other side of the pen, the goats shift too.  You are
still trudging in the muck of goat manure.  You have come to the end of the
little pen, and you can go back to the west from here.  This pen is very
small, but it seems as though not many of the goats had babies this year.

descKeys: re, and the cave is very close, you can see a fire inside, and maybe even a pen.
r2769.description:
As you come to the end of the ledge, the huge wall towers over you.  There is
no going on from here, its either a fall to your death or staying put.  The
landing stretches to the south and west from here, and the cave is very
close, you can see a fire inside, and maybe even a pen.

descKeys: er now, a little to the south and east. the landing leads to the south and east.
r2770.description:
The edge is getting closer to the wall, and there is no passage after that,
nor is there any way to see around the wall.  Off to the north and west
Stronghold is still visible and its fires burn bright.  The cave is closer
now, a little to the south and east.  The landing leads to the south and
east.

descKeys: s of goats coming from it. you can travel further east and further to the south.
r2771.description:
You are walking along the outer edge of the landing to the north and east.
There is goat manure everywhere, but the grass is green and lush.  The cave
is even closer now and you can hear the sounds of goats coming from it.  You
can travel further east and further to the south.

descKeys: arge crack in the wall. the landing stretches more to the east and to the south.
r2772.description:
You are now moving east on the northern edge of the landing, still trudging
in goat manure.  You can see the cave better now, and it is definately a cave
that has been made by a large crack in the wall.  The landing stretches more
to the east and to the south.

descKeys: light leaping from wall to wall. you can head to the east or back to the south.
r2773.description:
You are still on the edge of the landing, and still emersed in goat manure.
Stronghold is off in the distance, the lights of the large city make it very
visible.  You think there is a small cave over in the wall that ends the
landing.  You can see light leaping from wall to wall.  You can head to the
east or back to the south.

descKeys: ng. from here though it looks as though there is a small cave in the large wall.
r2774.description:
The grass here is kind of mucky as there is a lot of manure on the ground but
this land is very fertile, and the grass is plenty.  You can see Stronghold
still as you are still close to the edge of the landing.  The air has quite a
stench to it, and you can head pretty far to the east up until a large wall
that is the end of the landing.  From here though it looks as though there is
a small cave in the large wall.

descKeys: w. you are close to the middle of the landing, so you can go anywhere from here.
r2775.description:
Trampling through the manure you can see a cave off in the near distance.
The lush green grass brushes across your footwear.  You cant see the edge
from here, but even so there is a good view of the land below.  You are close
to the middle of the landing, so you can go anywhere from here.

descKeys: that has light leaping off the cave walls. you can move safely all around here.
r2776.description:
The manure is really stinking to high heaven here.  This is the middle of the
landing so none of the edges are visible, it just looks like the earth drops
off at the end of the landing.  The cave is omitting a soft glow that has
light leaping off the cave walls.  You can move safely all around here.

descKeys: all with your eyes. it is so tall, that it looks absolutely impossible to climb.
r2777.description:
You are coming closer to the cave and you can see a fire inside.  You can
also see some sort of pen.  It looks and sounds like there are goats in the
pen.  From here you can scale the large wall with your eyes.  It is so tall,
that it looks absolutely impossible to climb.

descKeys: off to the east. alongside the boulder there is a small path leading downwards.
r2778.description:
A large rock is off to the side of the path, having obviously rolled to that
point early in this century no doubt.  Besides the rock, the path has some
sparse vegetation growing alongside of it.  Squinting your eyes a bit, you can
see the Kendrite Sea off to the east.  Alongside the boulder there is a small
path leading downwards.

descKeys: s is to the northeast, choked with snow drifts. to the west lies kulajo plateau.
r2779.description:
The small mountain path branches off here into three separate and distinct
directions.  Toward the south, you can faintly see the town of Threshold
at the base of Mt. Kulajo.  The mountain pass is to the northeast, choked
with snow drifts.  To the west lies Kulajo Plateau.

descKeys: is a small distance southwest of here. a lesser-travelled path leads northwest.
r2780.description:
A little ways to the east, you can see that the mountain path splits off
into three separate directions, each leading to a different part of this
immense mountain.  The path continues here to Kulajo Plateau, which is a
small distance southwest of here.  A lesser-travelled path leads northwest.

descKeys: and the surrounding absinthe mountain range. a larger path is southeast of here.
r2781.description:
You are on a small mountain path that is leading down into the valley south
of this vantage point.  The valley is not very large, but it is deep, lying
between Mt. Kulajo and the surrounding Absinthe Mountain Range.  A larger
path is southeast of here.

descKeys: alley. lowering itself to the northwest, the path is heading for a small valley.
r2782.description:
The small path inclines or declines here, depending on the direction of your
travel itinerary.   Rising to the south, the path heads for the lip of the
surrounding mountainous shelf lining the valley.   Lowering itself to the
northwest, the path is heading for a small valley.

descKeys: ing eddies. the path rises to the southeast, climbing up the side of a mountain.
r2783.description:
You are standing on a small path that runs thrugh a diminutive valley.  A
prairie full of tall grass stretches out to the north, resembling an ocean
on land, complete with rippling waves swirling eddies.  The path rises to the
southeast, climbing up the side of a mountain.

descKeys: f that, proved by their use of small fires which can be seen from this distance.
r2784.description:
Looking at all the tall and brittle grass, you cannot help but think how easy
it would be to start a huge fire, which would easily consume most of the
valley's inhabitants.  The small village is evidently not afraid of that,
proved by their use of small fires which can be seen from this distance.

descKeys: ng from small fires. a seldom-used path branches off here and heads to the east.
r2785.description:
The path almost fades to obscurity here, dwindling down to a mere three feet
in width.  It seems that the path is not used very much, hence the need for
its upkeep.  Off in the distance to the north you can spot a few smoke trails
that are evidently coming from small fires.  A seldom-used path branches off
here and heads to the east.

descKeys: mall path continues, winding its way through the prairie's tall and brown grass.
r2786.description:
You are on a small path that is leading east and also west.  Towards the west,
this path meets up with a larger one, with this path ending.  Back to the
east, the small path continues, winding its way through the prairie's tall
and brown grass.

descKeys: t much is here, just a lot of tall grass and an endless, but beautiful, prairie.
r2787.description:
The small path you are on is about three feet in width.  It looks like it
is not used often, but of course why would anyone want to come out here?
Not much is here, just a lot of tall grass and an endless, but beautiful,
prairie.

descKeys: ng your eyes, you can faintly see a small village to the north of your position.
r2788.description:
The path turns here, heading southwest and also to the east, where it turns
again to the south.  The grass here is a couple of feet high, and is a nice
brown color.  Straining your eyes, you can faintly see a small village to
the north of your position.

descKeys: . not much is out here, just an endless supply of tall brown grass and open air.
r2789.description:
The path turns sharply here, heading to the west and also to the south.  A
large rock is right off of the path, having been overgrown with tall grass
and such.  Not much is out here, just an endless supply of tall brown grass
and open air.

descKeys: passed through here recently. the prairie goes on and on, with no end in sight.
r2790.description:
The small path splits here, where it leads to the north, the south, and also
to the southeast.  The grass around here is a bit trampled down, as if a
large number of individuals passed through here recently.  The prairie
goes on and on, with no end in sight.

descKeys: t it meets up with another path. the grass in this area is almost all flattened.
r2791.description:
It seems that the path splits off here, heading in three directions.  Off to
the west, the path turns again to the north.  The path also turns to the south
if you head east.  Off to the northwest it meets up with another path.  The
grass in this area is almost all flattened.

descKeys: flattened, as if several individuals took a nap here, laying down on the grass.
r2792.description:
The small path turns here, heading west towards an intersection of paths, and
also south where it looks like it turns again, this time to the east.  The grass
in this area is flattened, as if several individuals took a nap here, laying
down on the grass.

descKeys: a small village far to the north. also, there is a large mountain west of here.
r2793.description:
You are on a small path that is leading through an expansive prairie.  The
grass around you is a brown color and is approximately two feet tall.  If
you strain your eyes, you can see a small village far to the north.  Also,
there is a large mountain west of here.

descKeys: he several huts you can see. luckily, the path leads west away from the village.
r2794.description:
You are on a small path in a large prairie, just north of a small and dirty
kobold village.  The village looks like it has been here for a while, judging
by the shape of the several huts you can see.  Luckily, the path leads west
away from the village.

descKeys: rely traversable. a much cleaner path leads to the north, away from the village.
r2795.description:
You are on the outskirts of a tiny kobold village.  There are about five huts
around here, with all of them in need of repair.  The path that leads through
the dirty village is muddy and barely traversable.  A much cleaner path leads
to the north, away from the village.

descKeys: the smell, it seems that the hut to the south is their kitchen and 'dining' hut.
r2796.description:
It seems that this is the center of the small kobold village.  One path leads
north, evidently heading out of the village.  Another path leads east towards
a medium-sized hut, and the path heading west leads to two large huts, probably
used by the kobolds for sleeping purposes.  There is also a hut directly
south of here.  From the smell, it seems that the hut to the south is their
kitchen and 'dining' hut.

descKeys: er hut. the path leads back to the west where it hits some sort of intersection.
notes: 3 Large kobolds (guards: 'fairly close, but you should lose'); 'A guard is right in your way!' blocks e and s
r2797.description:
The kobold village is quite dirty.  Garbage and other sorts of waste line the
path, haphazardly deposited there by the kobolds.  Directly south of you is
a fairly large hut, while to the east is a smaller hut.  The path leads back
to the west where it hits some sort of intersection.

descKeys: down for the night. all along the path is garbage, thrown about by the kobolds.
r2798.description:
You are in a kobold village, on a path that is leading west towards two large
huts and also east towards an intersection in the paths.  The huts to the
west are probably used by the kobolds when they bed down for the night.  All
along the path is garbage, thrown about by the kobolds.

descKeys: the roof might need looked at. the small and muddy path leads back to the east.
r2799.description:
You are right in front of two large huts.  The one to the west is in a bad
shape, and is in need of repair.  The hut to the southwest is in a little
better shape, although that hole in the roof might need looked at.  The small
and muddy path leads back to the east.

descKeys: . the walls of the hut are made from thatched straw and do not look very sturdy.
r2800.description:
You are in a large hut, evidently used by the kobolds to sleep in.  There
are several piles of fur on the ground, probably used as bedding.  The floor
of the hut is just dirt, as the kobolds are not that picky.  The walls of the
hut are made from thatched straw and do not look very sturdy.

descKeys: hen it rains. there are several piles of bedding around on the floor of the hut.
r2801.description:
This large hut is used by several kobold familes, usually as a sleeping place.
Looking up to the roof, you see that there is a large hole.  Unfortunately
for the kobolds who stay in here, the place tends to get quite wet when it
rains.  There are several piles of bedding around on the floor of the hut.

descKeys: n part of the hut, probably used by the kobolds when they are eating, to sit on.
r2802.description:
This medium-sized hut is evidently used for cooking and eating events.  There
is a large fire pit near the southern portion of the hut.  A large spit has
been set up over the fire.  It looks like kobolds only eat meat.  What type
of meat they like, well, you would be better off not knowing.  A few filthy
mats have been placed near the eastern part of the hut, probably used by the
kobolds when they are eating, to sit on.

descKeys: lem. the tunnel continues to the north, where it looks like it may end abruptly.
r2826.description:
You are in a small tunnel, right below a manhole.  The manhole is about five
feet above your head, but there are cuts in the wall that should allow you to
go up with no problem.  The tunnel continues to the north, where it looks
like it may end abruptly.

descKeys: nport, which is to the south, to the northern lands, past the viluten mountains.
r2835.description:
You are standing on a sand dune, just west of a large hole in the ground.
The hole looks to be very deep, and you hesitate to enter.  Off to the west
you can see the main caravan route that runs from Kalinport, which is to
the south, to the northern lands, past the Viluten Mountains.

descKeys: n made by some large beast. off to the west a ways you can spot a caravan route.
r2836.description:
You are right in front of a large hole in the rocky ground, surrounded by
large sand dunes.  The hole is at least fifty feet in diameter, which large
gouges in the rock that may have been made by some large beast.  Off to the
west a ways you can spot a caravan route.

descKeys: caravan route between kalinport to the south and the settled lands to the north.
r2837.description:
You are standing somewhere in the Kalamshite Desert.  Huge sand dunes are
all around you, blocking your view somewhat.  Looking around, you do not
see a speck of vegetation, only the rolling sands as far as you can see.
You are on the main caravan route between Kalinport to the south and the
settled lands to the north.

descKeys: the smell, it seems that the hut to the south is their kitchen and 'dining' hut.
r2949.description:
It seems that this is the center of the small kobold village.  One path leads
north, evidently heading out of the village.  Another path leads east towards
a medium-sized hut, and the path heading west leads to two large huts, probably
used by the kobolds for sleeping purposes.  There is also a hut directly
south of here.  From the smell, it seems that the hut to the south is their
kitchen and 'dining' hut.

descKeys: laque beside the door that states 'cothax'. there is a wood door leading north .
r2951.description:
You are just south of a huge mansion.  The huge mansion appears as though it
maybe several stories tall and looks to be extreamly new.  The huge mansion
itself is made out of some strange stone that hardly has any blemishes.
There is a large door on the front of the abode, with a small plaque beside
the door that states 'Cothax'.
There is a wood door leading north ( OPENED ).

descKeys: to concentrate or even get mildly annoyed. there is a wood door leading south .
r2952.description:
Cothax's mansion starts off with a lavishly designed living room.  The stone
here seems to reflect the light just right to where  everything is
illuminated, even in moonlight. There are no dark  spaces in the room. Fancy
furniture sits in the room, waiting for  the duty of furniture to be
fulfilled. There is no dust around,  for the staff of the mansion works hard
to please their master.  Sounds of music comes from all around, but not loud
enough to not  be able to concentrate or even get mildly annoyed.
There is a wood door leading south ( OPENED ).

descKeys: r proper places. chairs surround the table, more than enough for a dozen guests.
r2953.description:
The living room of the mansion is dustless. Many objects lay within  this
room. A table sits in the middle of the room, waiting for meal  time to be
used. Plates, goblets, silverware, all of golden color,  lay upon the table,
sitting in their proper places. Chairs surround  the table, more than enough
for a dozen guests.

descKeys: medal. a wood oven sits in the middle of the room, heating the rest of the room.
r2954.description:
The kitchen has pans, spatulas, and all the other kitchen utensils hanging
up. The hooks are made of a brass-like medal. A wood oven sits in the middle
of the room, heating the rest of the room.

descKeys: one corner marked 'just in.' there is a small trapdoor in a corner of the room.
r2955.description:
The pantry is a spacious room with shelves and cabinets of items preserved to
be  used later in cooking. Items like pickeled pig feet, and so on lay on
shelves,  in the cabinets, and even in boxes on the floor. Baked potatoe
'chips' are also  in small bags. There is enough food to last an army months.
There is a box in  one corner marked 'Just in.' There is a small trapdoor in
a corner of the room.

descKeys: in the room. the sound of the music from the living room is also dampened here.
r2956.description:
The room is lavishly designed for pets to have fun in, rest, and eat.  Hair
from each pet can be seen entangled with each other in the room.  The sound
of the music from the living room is also dampened here.

descKeys: ing just clang together. many don't come into this room when they are out-of-it.
r2957.description:
The library is huge! Book shelves line the walls. Many books of  recreational
type sits on these shelves. The floor is of a granite  stone, that adds to
the elegance of the room. The colors of the books  binding just clang
together. Many don't come into this room when they  are out-of-it.

r2975.description:
Namssas takes a drag off a Namssas Cigar.
This large room is directly underneath the Viper's Nest, in the town of
Threshold.  The owner of the Viper's Nest decided to have a room that could
hold a large number of individuals in a restful environment.  Large couches
have been set around the room, with several chairs having been placed in
spots around the room as well.  A small staircase in the corner leads up
to the main bar of the Viper's Nest.

descKeys: ables in a drunken stupor. a small set of stairs runs down to the main bar room.
r2976.description:
I getsh for my effortchs??  Not a damn thing!
You are standing on a small landing above the bar.  Three rooms have been put
up here to accomodate patrons of the pub who wish to spend the night.  Looking
down over the bar, you can see several people slumped over their tables in a
drunken stupor.  A small set of stairs runs down to the main bar room.

descKeys: ation. the main bar is to the south. a small staircase runs down to the kitchen.
r2977.description:
You are in a small section in the back of the Viper's Nest.  This room was
built after the owner of the Nest was repeatedly bombarded with requests
for food service.  Not wanting to contaminate a good drinking spot, the
owner of the tavern decided to house the food in a separate location.  The
main bar is to the south.  A small staircase runs down to the kitchen.

descKeys: seems like an old graveyard. a hush has descended over this part of the forest.
r2979.description:
You are standing on a small path that has been overgrown with tall grass
and vicious weeds.  The path, made out of packed dirt, leads east towards
a large road and also leads west to what seems like an old graveyard.  A
hush has descended over this part of the forest.

descKeys: orest consist here of mostly pines and a few sprigs of bilberry and lingonberry.
r2980.description:
You are standing on a small path that continues in two directions, east, on to
the Caravan Route, and northwest, further away from it.  There are trees all
around you, preventing you from getting any view.  The forest consist here of
mostly pines and a few sprigs of bilberry and lingonberry.

descKeys: ll around you and some sprigs of bilberry and lingonberry growing on the ground.
r2981.description:
You are inside the Great Forest, with trees surrounding you.  There is a path
leading in two directions, southeast, towards the Caravan Route, and west,
deeper into the forest.  There are pines growing all around you and some sprigs
of bilberry and lingonberry growing on the ground.

descKeys: you are spruces and a few birches, and on the ground, there are bilberry sprigs.
r2982.description:
All the trees in the area look the same, making it hard to find anything to
orientate yourself after.  There is however a path leading in two directions,
southwest and east.  Growing around you are spruces and a few birches, and on
the ground, there are bilberry sprigs.

descKeys: orest, or northeast, where the birches seems to have been replaced with spruces.
r2983.description:
You are deep in the Great Forest with trees surrounding you in every direction.
The forest consists of mostly birch here and there does not seem to be much
growing on the ground.  It is possible to continue on a path in two direction,
west, deeper into the forest, or northeast, where the birches seems to have
been replaced with spruces.

descKeys: o be a rather narrow lake, but you cannot from this distance see how long it is.
r2984.description:
There is something strange with the forest around you, it seems more alive than
a normal forest.  It feels like the tress around you are following every step
you take and listening to every breath you take.  Looking through the trees
west there seems to be a rather narrow lake, but you cannot from this distance
see how long it is.

descKeys: round the lake. it is also possible to continue east out of this strange forest.
r2985.description:
You are standing at the shore of a small lake.  The trees around you go all the
way down to the water, standing so close together that it makes it impossible
to reach it.  Something that could be called a path continues south and
northwest around the lake.  It is also possible to continue east out of this
strange forest.

descKeys: is possible to continue north and southwest by walking on the shore of the lake.
r2986.description:
The forest opens up to give way for a small beach.  The lake is very shallow
here making it possible to wade out in it.  Far out in the water there seems to
be a large rock shaped like what appears to be a human.  It is possible to
continue north and southwest by walking on the shore of the lake.

descKeys: ch by heading east, or you can continue out in the water southwest or northwest.
r2987.description:
You are standing in a lake with water all around you.  Right in front of you is
a large rock.  It has the shape of a strange creature, a small human with fins
growing out of its legs.  All the surfaces of the rock are smooth, with no
trace on it that would suggest that anyone has used any tools to fashion it.
You can head back to a beach by heading east, or you can continue out in
the water southwest or northwest.

descKeys: middle of the lake, east, to more shallow water, or southeast, towards a beach.
r2988.description:
You are wading in a lake with water reaching you up to the waist.  North of
here there seems to be some really wet ground, with aspens growing all the way
down to the shore, and west, beyond some wet ground, there seems to be an oak
forest.  You can from here move safely, in the water, in three directions:
south, towards the middle of the lake, east, to more shallow water, or
southeast, towards a beach.

descKeys: here is no possibility to get there though, as the water gets a little too deep.
r2989.description:
You are in the middle of a lake standing in the water.  Even though this is one
of the deepest parts of the lake, the water only comes up to your waist.
Looking west you can see that there is a small green hill and on it there are
oaks growing.  There is no possibility to get there though, as the water gets a
little too deep.

descKeys: sible to go southwest, to a cliff face, or northeast, to the middle of the lake.
r2990.description:
You are wading in a lake and the floor of it consists of mostly clay.  There
are small waves curling the surface of the water and southeast of here there is
a rocky beach, that can be reached by heading east.  It is also possible to go
southwest, to a cliff face, or northeast, to the middle of the lake.

descKeys: beach. although the water is not moving much here, it is still fresh and clear.
r2991.description:
You are wading in a lake with rocks and water all around you.  There are many
stones on the floor of the lake and growing on the stones are algae.  You can
continue south where there is a rocky beach, with a cliff west of it.  You can
also continue west further out in the lake or you can head northeast towards a
dirt beach.  Although the water is not moving much here, it is still fresh
and clear.

descKeys: ollow the waterside of the lake west up on a cliff or head into the forest east.
r2992.description:
The trees have opened up here to give way for a rocky beach, with slippery
rocks scattered around you.  Although it is risky the rocks could possible be
used to get north out into the water.  You can also follow the waterside of the
lake west up on a cliff or head into the forest east.

descKeys: there are two openings in the clearing, one leading west and one leading north.
r2993.description:
the middle there is a tree stump.  The grass around the tree stump is trampled
so it gives the impression that someone has danced around it many times.
There are two openings in the clearing, one leading west and one leading north.

descKeys: on around you consists of mostly aspen and covering the ground are aspen leaves.
r2994.description:
The trees grow all the way down to the lake and form an unbreakable line, thus
making it impossible to reach the water.  There are bushes preventing you from
following the lake southwest, you can however follow it northeast or you could
head south into the forest.  The vegetation around you consists of mostly aspen
and covering the ground are aspen leaves.

descKeys: seems to turn west. looking east there is a track leading down to a rocky beach.
r2995.description:
You are standing on a high cliff that looks out on a lake.  Far on the other
side of the lake, there seems to be a hill, with green grass and spread across
it are a few giant oaks.  The cliff that you are standing on continues south
where it seems to turn west.  Looking east there is a track leading down to
a rocky beach.

descKeys: scarce, only a few bushes here and there growing out of the cracks of the cliff.
r2996.description:
You are high up on a cliff, looking out over a small lake.  Growing just at the
edge of the cliff is a tree and on the middle of its base, there is a hole.
The vegetation around you is scarce, only a few bushes here and there growing
out of the cracks of the cliff.

descKeys: is to head northwest down the slope. to get back to the top, you can head east.
r2997.description:
You are moving on a slope, which leads up to a cliff.  Not much is growing on
the slope just a few bushes here and there and occasionally a flower.  The only
possible way to reach the base of the cliff is to head northwest down the
slope.  To get back to the top, you can head east.

descKeys: il continues southeast up on a cliff and northeast out to a more open landscape.
r2998.description:
You are following a trail that passes right next to a lake.  The forest around
you is full of trees and it gives away a strange feeling.  It seems to observe
everything somehow, like if it was alive.  The forest is composed here of
mostly aspens but there are also one or two oaks growing on small hills where
the sun has the possibility to reach them.  The trail continues southeast up on
a cliff and northeast out to a more open landscape.

descKeys: northeast or southwest. it is also possible to head west deeper into the forest.
r2999.description:
The forest has started to open up a bit here, it is no longer filled with
aspens as before.  They have been replaced with oaks, but a few of the aspens
can still be spotted though.  Grass in growing all the way down to the
waterside, which makes it possible to follow the shore, northeast or southwest.
It is also possible to head west deeper into the forest.

descKeys: hey have seen a leprechaun running around in the area but no one knows for sure.
r3000.description:
You are standing on a small animal track that leads west deeper into an oak
forest and east towards a lake.  This forest along with the lake has been
rumored to be home of some strange creatures, magic ones, like dryads, sprites
and pixies.  There have also been people claiming that they have seen a
leprechaun running around in the area but no one knows for sure.

descKeys: them have a strong and healthy color and their smell dominates the nearby area.
r3001.description:
If you venture any further into the forest you would surely get lost, since the
trees around all seems to look the same to you.  Every part of this forest
looks, from the tiniest plant to the largest tree, to be filled with life and
magic.  All of them have a strong and healthy color and their smell dominates
the nearby area.

descKeys: they must stretch back to the time of the reytu empire, two thousand years ago.
r3002.description:
You are so deep in the forest that if you would venture any further, you would
surely get lost.  Looking around you, you see that the forest is composed of
huge green oaks.  Their age is just too hard to imagine, as they must stretch
back to the time of the Reytu Empire, two thousand years ago.

descKeys: shine through. growing on the ground, in the scarce light are a few pale plants.
r3003.description:
You are in the deepest part of this strange forest now, with oaks growing all
around you.  The path that you are traveling on continues in two directions,
northeast and south.  The oaks in the area are so big that their branches
blocks out any light that might shine through.  Growing on the ground, in the
scarce light are a few pale plants.

descKeys: mething looking like a small child, but as you try to look closer it disappears.
r3004.description:
It is possible to continue in two directions from here:  east, out of this
forest, or southwest, deeper into it.  Sitting on a branch in one of the oaks
there seems to be a squirrel, eating an acorn.  In another oak, you catch a
glimpse of something looking like a small child, but as you try to look closer
it disappears.

descKeys: ling that you are not welcome here, as the oaks creak in a very threatening way.
r3005.description:
Large oaks are everywhere around you, growing out of the soil, with roots that
make the ground somewhat bumpy.  You don't see any other vegetation around
you, not even sprigs, and looking up on the oaks you get the feeling that you
are not welcome here, as the oaks creak in a very threatening way.

descKeys: hicker, east, towards a small lake, or west, deeper into the forest. all acorns.
r3006.description:
It is possible to continue in four different directions from here, north, to
the outer parts of the oak forest, south, where the forest seems to get
thicker, east, towards a small lake, or west, deeper into the forest.  All
acorns.

descKeys: green. on the base of it there seems to be holes that could be used to climb it.
r3007.description:
There are oaks all around you, preventing you from continuing any further
south.  Looking around you there is one tree in particular that draws your
attention, it is at least twice as big as any other tree in the area.  Although
the tree must be incredibly old, its branches are still strong and green.  On
the base of it there seems to be holes that could be used to climb it.

descKeys: hree directions, south or northeast around the lake, or west into an oak forest.
r3008.description:
The ground here is very wet and walking on it feels like walking in a bog.
Growing on the ground is heather and on some places even cranberry can be
found.  It is possible to move safely in three directions, south or northeast
around the lake, or west into an oak forest.

descKeys: it is possible however to follow the waterside of the lake north and southwest.
r3009.description:
You are standing on a small hill.  It is covered with green grass and spread
across the landscape are oaks.  The water in the lake, which is east of here,
seems to be quite deep, making it impossible to wade out.  It is possible
however to follow the waterside of the lake north and southwest.

descKeys: outhwest. there is also a track west which will take you deeper into the forest.
r3010.description:
You are standing beside a large oak.  The oak must have been hit by lightning
at some time, it is totally dead and looks like the base has twisted itself, a
clear sign of lightning hitting it.  There are a few more oaks in the area,
none of them as large as this one though.  There is also a lake southeast of
here and it is possible to follow the shore of it by heading east or southwest.
There is also a track west which will take you deeper into the forest.

descKeys: of the cliff is a small tree, you cannot from this distance see what kind it is.
r3011.description:
You are at the northern part of a lake.  The ground here is very wet and the
vegetation around is composed of aspens.  It is only possible to move by the
shore of the lake, west or southeast, as the ground is too wet on the other
places.  Looking out over the lake there seems to be a cliff on the other side.
On top of the cliff is a small tree, you cannot from this distance see what
kind it is.

descKeys: sible ways to continue, east, back to the lake, or west, deeper into the forest.
r3012.description:
You are standing inside a forest, with oaks surrounding you in every direction.
These oaks seem for some reason to be more alive than other trees you have
seen, nowhere in sight is there a dying tree, only living ones with nice green
leaves.  There are two possible ways to continue, east, back to the lake, or
west, deeper into the forest.

descKeys: w the trees is filled with acorns and leaves and growing on it are a few sprigs.
r3013.description:
There are only two possible ways to continue, south or east.  In both
directions there seem to be oaks growing.  The only trees you can see in the
area are old and large oaks, with great green branches reaching for the sky.
The ground below the trees is filled with acorns and leaves and growing on it
are a few sprigs.

descKeys: mostly small and young oaks, and on the ground there are a few flowers growing.
r3014.description:
Right east of here there seems to be a large oak growing, with a size that is
twice that of the surrounding ones.  It is not possible to get there from here
though, as the track that you are traveling on only continues north and
southwest.  The vegetation around you is composed of mostly small and young
oaks, and on the ground there are a few flowers growing.

descKeys: ere. the only way out of here is to head west towards a deeper part of the lake.
r3015.description:
You are standing in a shallow part of a lake, the water only reaches you to the
ankles.  The area is filled with a strange and unnatural fog that seems to be
everywhere.  This whole part of the lake gives away a strange feeling, as if
you are not welcome here.  The only way out of here is to head west towards a
deeper part of the lake.

descKeys: in and out. the lake is not deep at all here, it only reaches you to the ankles.
r3016.description:
You are standing in a lake at the base of a cliff.  Looking up towards the
cliff face, you notice that there are many small holes in it.  There are nests
built in some of them, with birds flying in and out.  The lake is not deep at
all here, it only reaches you to the ankles.

descKeys: orest consist here of mostly pines and a few sprigs of bilberry and lingonberry.
r3183.description:
You are standing on a small path that continues in two directions, east, on to
the Caravan Route, and northwest, further away from it.  There are trees all
around you, preventing you from getting any view.  The forest consist here of
mostly pines and a few sprigs of bilberry and lingonberry.

descKeys: used by the caravans running the north-south routes from threshold to kalinport.
r3214.description:
The Great Forest totally envelopes you, almost cutting you off from any sort
of view out of the trees.  The area gives you a sense of awe, gazing at the
surrounding greenery.  You are on a large road, about twenty feet in width,
that is used by the caravans running the north-south routes from Threshold
to Kalinport.

descKeys: e smoke, and hear some faint voices. to the south, you can see a mountain range.
r3703.description:
You are on a trail that goes through the forest.  You are able to notice a
very small trail heading to the north.  The main trail goes northwest.
Looking to the north, you can see some smoke, and hear some faint voices.
To the south, you can see a mountain range.

descKeys: over by the edge of trees, and in the center of there camp there is a fireplace.
r3711.description:
You seem to be in some sort of a makeshift camp.  This looks to be used
for only short periods of time.  The area is completely surrounded by
trees.  You notice a small tent over by the edge of trees, and in the
center of there camp there is a fireplace.

descKeys: e what looks like some smoke. you also notice some footprints here on the trail.
r3713.description:
You are standing on a small path.  To the south you can see a mountain
range, and to the north you see a forest.  This part of the trail seems to
be nice and peaceful.  To the east you see what looks like some smoke.  You
also notice some footprints here on the trail.

descKeys: gainst the background of the deep forest. far to the north, the forest thickens.
r3719.description:
You are in a small opening in the forest.  To the north, you can see that
the opening continues for only a short distance.  To the south you can see
a mountain range against the background of the deep forest.  Far to the
north, the forest thickens.

descKeys: n that direction, it appears that a few huts, low to the ground, come into view.
r3760.description:
The path turns here, heading north to an intersection of another path, as
well as heading east to another intersection of paths.  A slight movement
to the south catches your eye.  When you look in that direction, it appears
that a few huts, low to the ground, come into view.

descKeys: uld be wise to watch your step, for you do not know what they do to trespassers.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r3761.description:
The Drow academy of magic, Sorcere, is well-known and feared throughout the
Underdark, as well as the surface.  Dark magics and evil conjurings occur
here on an everyday basis.  It would be wise to watch your step, for you do
not know what they do to trespassers.

descKeys: while climbing them. the exit/entrance to the academy of magic is to the north.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r3762.description:
You are standing at the base of a huge set of stairs, reaching up into the
darkness like some snake out of a nightmare.  The ornate stairs are so
large that fifteen Drow could stand shoulder to shoulder while climbing them.
The exit/entrance to the academy of magic is to the north.

descKeys: find the hidden doors. a staircase leads up and down, vanishing in the darkness.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r3763.description:
You are on the landing for the second floor of the academy.  Looking around,
you do not see any doors of any kind.  It seems that this floor is off limits
to everyone but the students, who would know where to find the hidden doors.
A staircase leads up and down, vanishing in the darkness.

descKeys: l light spells within them. (very dim light spells for scroll-reading purposes.)

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r3764.description:
You are standing atop the third floor landing.  A large and ornate staircase
leads down into the darkness, while an unassuming hallway leads north.  To the
south you can see many candles burning, which seems strange to you being that
all the other light sources around are globes that contain Continual Light
spells within them.  (Very dim light spells for scroll-reading purposes.)

descKeys: as deemed necessary after one student accidentally let loose a fireball in here.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r3765.description:
This room, although still a bit dark and gloomy, has several candles placed
conveniently around the room, providing the rooms only light sources.  This is
the Practice Room, where young students come to practice their spellcasting
skills without actually casting the spells.  There is a continual Dispel
Magic spell in here, causing all magics to fail.  This precaution was deemed
necessary after one student accidentally let loose a fireball in here.

descKeys: ds presumably to the archmage's quarters. a small and plain room is to the east.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r3766.description:
You are traveling down a wide hallway that leads through the upper floor of
the academy of magic, Sorcere.  Up ahead to the north you can spot a large
and imposing door that leads presumably to the Archmage's quarters.  A small
and plain room is to the east.

descKeys: very few drow have travelled. an extension to the small library is to the south.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r3767.description:
You are standing in a small library, located in an obscure corner of Sorcere.
Only the elder Magii are allowed in this room, for the books contained within
are very valuable, a lot of them coming from the surface, from places very
few Drow have travelled.  An extension to the small library is to the south.

descKeys: om is also stacked high with books, some of them very rare and some commonplace.

senses.listen: You listen and hear nothing unusual.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r3768.description:
You are in an extension of the small library that is to the north of here.
After a while the number of books in the regular library grew until the need
for an extension came into being.  This room is also stacked high with books,
some of them very rare and some commonplace.

descKeys: es very dense with trees. this part of the trail does not have many trees on it.
r3833.description:
You are in an opening in the forest, standing on a small path.  This path
seems as if it has not been used lately.  You can see the forest to the
north, it looks as if it becomes very dense with trees.  This part of the
trail does not have many trees on it.

descKeys: ere are not as many trees in this part of the foreset as there are to the north.
r3834.description:
You are on a path that seems to be heading deep into the heart of the
forest.  This part of the trail seems to have been neglected for some time
because you see no signs of recent use.  There are not as many trees in
this part of the foreset as there are to the north.

descKeys: best place for you to need help. the forest seems to thicken towards the north.
r3835.description:
You are walking on a barely discernable path.  This particular area has not
been used much, as the weeds are quite high.  You seem to be alone
in this part of the forest, this would not be the best place for you to
need help.  The forest seems to thicken towards the north.

descKeys: untain range, and to the north all you can see is the forest covered with trees.
r3836.description:
You are walking on an overgrown path.  In this part of the forest, it seems
that you are completely alone.  You can hear the sounds of nature filling
your body with joy.  To the south you can still see a mountain range, and to
the north all you can see is the forest covered with trees.

descKeys: ch sunlight can reach the ground. far to the south you can see a mountain range.
r3837.description:
You are walking on an overgrown path.  It seems that the path has not
been used very much, as there are tall weeds everywhere.  To the north the
forest becomes very dense, and not much sunlight can reach the ground.  Far
to the south you can see a mountain range.

descKeys: animal. to the north you can see that the forest becomes very dense with trees.
r3838.description:
You are on an overgrown path.  It seems that this part of the path is used
more frequently that the first half.  You see many footprints in the mud
which indicates that this path was not made by an animal.  To the north you
can see that the forest becomes very dense with trees.

descKeys: usly quite drunk. looking around, you notice some trees, and a small dirt mound.
r3839.description:
You are on the outskirts of some sort of camp.  Ahead you are able to hear
what sounds like many people singing and fighting.  It must be from some
sort of a camp, and the inhabitants are obviously quite drunk.  Looking
around, you notice some trees, and a small dirt mound.

descKeys: ner is almost ready, because the bandits are gathering in this part of the camp.
r3840.description:
You are now at what appears to be the center of the camp.  You notice a
large campfire here, which is obviously the source of the smell.  It seems
that dinner is almost ready, because the bandits are gathering in this part
of the camp.

descKeys: r does all his work. from the way things look, he is not one who likes visitors.
r3841.description:
Now you are just south of the camp leader's tent.  As you glance into the
tent you can catch a glimpse of a table, cluttered with objects.  This
must be where the leader does all his work.  From the way things look, he
is not one who likes visitors.

descKeys: his work. in the corner of the room you see a bed that looks suspicious to you.
r3842.description:
This is the camp leader's tent.  There are many things scattered around the
the floor.  You see a table full of maps, and papers.  This is obviously
where the leader does his work.  In the corner of the room you see a bed
that looks suspicious to you.

descKeys: . to the north you can see a small room, and to the south you hear faint voices.
r3843.description:
You are in an underground passage.  It seems that this is where the bandits
keep all of their stolen goods, in a hidden spot so that no one will try to
take them back.  To the north you can see a small room, and to the south you
hear faint voices.

descKeys: gold, and other valuable treasures. you notice a lot of gold lying around also.
r3844.description:
You are now in the treasure room of the bandit camp.  This is where they
keep all of the things they steal.  You notice many shelves in the room,
and also piles of gold, and other valuable treasures.  You notice a lot of
gold lying around also.

descKeys: do not seem to be welcome down here, this is obviously not a place for visitors.
r3845.description:
You are in a small room.  This is where the guards stay when they are not

most likely where the guard leader does his work.  You do not seem to be
welcome down here, this is obviously not a place for visitors.

r3980.description:
You are onboard a freighter that has been docked in the harbor for
quite some time.  It is easily the largest ship that you have ever set
foot upon.  To the east, you can see a rather large hole in the shape
of a square that must lead down into the hold of the freighter.

descKeys: s to lead off the freighter while the deck continues to the north and southeast.
r3981.description:
From here you can see easily into the cargo hold of the freighter.  It
appears as though several crates still need to be unloaded.  To the
northwest, you can see a plank that appears to lead off the freighter
while the deck continues to the north and southeast.

descKeys: a sailboat lies to the south of the yacht. a large crane lies to the northwest.
r3982.description:
From this part of the deck, you can get a good overall view of the
Dunagin Docks.  The receiving area lies to the immediate west.  An
expensive yacht lies to the southwest, and a sailboat lies to the south
of the yacht.  A large crane lies to the northwest.

descKeys: ngs of insignificance rush throughout your body, and you return back to reality.
r3983.description:
Here is the southernmost part of the freighter or otherwise known as
the stern of the freighter.  You can easily gaze at the magnificence of
the Bay of Frohon.  Sudden feelings of insignificance rush throughout
your body, and you return back to reality.

The small path is meandering through a deep forest, heading south and east.
A large tree, right in front of your position, looks a bit out of the
ordinary.  The tree is about fifty feet high, but from the looks of it, the
tree is dead.

This small path is leading towards a graveyard to the west and also through
forest to the north.  The path is quite overgrown and is a bit difficult to
traverse through.  A large tree to the north looks different from the rest,
as it appears dead.

their dead within its boundaries.  Weeds and tall grass grow all over the

r4236.description:
You are standing in a large crypt that has seen better days.  Most of the
stone structure is crumbling and in dire need of repair.  Looking to the
east, you can see the exit from this foul place.  The crypt leads farther
to the west, getting quite dark.

descKeys: f bones and rotten fabrics are all around, some in better condition than others.
r4237.description:
The crypt's hallway continues west towards an intersection and east towards
an exit.  There are coffins lining either wall, some open with their contents
spilled out in front of them.  Piles of bones and rotten fabrics are all
around, some in better condition than others.

descKeys: ite right about it. looking at it more closely, you can see several teeth marks.
r4238.description:
You are standing in a very dark intersection of a large crypt.  There are
four separate passageways leading from here, each being equally dark.  In
the middle of this intersection is a small statue.  The statue is made out
of marble, but something does not look quite right about it.  Looking at it
more closely, you can see several teeth marks.

descKeys: e crypt is still in shambles, however, and looks like it may fall at any moment.
r4239.description:
This part of the crypt seems a little more dry than the rest.  The walls of
the passageway seem to be in a slightly better state of repair.  Someone or
something must be fixing up the place.  The ceiling of the crypt is still in
shambles, however, and looks like it may fall at any moment.

descKeys: e. glancing to the north, you can see that the crypt's passageway ends abruptly.
r4240.description:
The crypt's passageway takes a turn here, heading north and also east.  A
small niche in the corner draws your attention, as something could be
easily hidden in there.  Glancing to the north, you can see that the crypt's
passageway ends abruptly.

descKeys: g been spread all around the area. the passageway leads to the south unhindered.
r4241.description:
You are standing near a dead end in the crypt's passageway.  The way to the
north is completely blocked by a pile of rubble.  The rubble extends all the
way to the ceiling.  A few coffins have spilled on the ground, with some
of the contents having been spread all around the area. The passageway leads
to the south unhindered.

descKeys: e new. it seems that this area houses the more well-off population of deepwater.
r4244.description:
You are standing on Waterside Road in the southern section of Deepwater.  The
road takes a turn here, heading east and also south towards the city hall.  The
buildings around you have been well-built and look quite new.  It seems that
this area houses the more well-off population of Deepwater.

descKeys: hall. the rest of deepwater sprawls over the area to the north, past aurel bay.
r4245.description:
You are at the southernmost part of Deepwater.  To the south lies the Plains
of Nereka and the shores of the Sea of Honshale.  To the east is a large and
newly-built structure, evidently the city hall.  The rest of Deepwater sprawls
over the area to the north, past Aurel Bay.

descKeys: icials must be in that direction. a large archway leads west, towards waterside.
r4246.description:
The Deepwater city hall was erected a scant few years ago to service the city's
growing populace.  A large hallway leads south where it hits an intersection
with another hallway.  The offices of the town clerks and other officials
must be in that direction.  A large archway leads west, towards Waterside.

descKeys: ting areas. an exit that heads north seems to hit some sort of guard checkpoint.
r4247.description:
The guard tells you to behave while in the City Hall, or he will hunt you down!
You are in an intersection of hallways, inside of the City Hall of Deepwater.
One hallway leads south where it passes by several offices, no doubt
belonging to a town clerk or bureaucrat.  Another hallway leads to the east,
heading to a few large meeting areas.  An exit that heads north seems to hit
some sort of guard checkpoint.

descKeys: lls of the hallway have been painted blue. there is a wooden door leading west .
r4248.description:
This hallway is leading north, where it looks like there is an intersection
with another hallway, and south towards more offices.  An office is to the
west, probably occupied by a clerk clerk.  The walls of the hallway have
been painted blue.
There is a wooden door leading west ( OPENED ).

descKeys: seems to be holding some personal effects. there is a wooden door leading east .
r4249.description:
This is a large office, occupied by a bureaucrat who is high up in the system.
A large desk is against the western wall, right under a window.  The window is
overlooking a small garden.  There is a wooden shelf near the top of the wall
that seems to be holding some personal effects.
There is a wooden door leading east ( OPENED ).

descKeys: tunnel walls are almost exclusively black with the worthless ore of fool's gold.
r4252.description:
You are in a seemingly maze-like tunnel system that tends to wind around and
mix you up considerably.  The dank air down here does nothing to help your
feelings of claustrophobia.  The tunnel walls are almost exclusively black
with the worthless ore of fool's gold.

descKeys: h shovels. the miners were trying to extend this mine farther into the mountain.
r4253.description:
You have stumbled across the miner's last dig.  The southern wall has been
hacked at with pickaxes and shoved at with shovels.  The miners were trying
to extend this mine farther into the mountain.

descKeys: ge left here by the old miners, but you cannot even begin to fathom its meaning.
r4254.description:
An overturned mine cart has nestled in between two good sized rocks which
have been placed in the center of the room.  The rock and cart group looks
like some kind of message left here by the old miners, but you cannot even
begin to fathom its meaning.

r4256.description:
You are standing just inside of the compound of the first House of Nal
Shaddar, Bey-Sandrax.  This house was one of the first constructed in Nal
Shaddar, a little more than a century ago.  The huge gates of the house,
located just behind you, are covered with magical sigils and glyphs, and
are made up of Adamantite, about a foot thick.  The rest of the House is to
the northeast.

You are standing almost directly below a large marble balcony.  Looking
around, you cannot see any steps leading up to the main part of the House.
It seems that the House Nobles like to distance themselves from the mere

The gates of the House are to the southwest.

commoners of Bey-Sandrax by a large closed balcony.

You are standing directly west of the large Temple of Loth.  The temple
is one of the larger structures located within the Bey-Sandrax compound.

is only accessible from an opening in the marble balcony to the west.  To

You are standing in a large chapel, dedicated to the glory of the Spider Queen,
Loth.  The ceiling is about thirty feet high, and their are benches around
the temple that would sit at least two hundred Drow.  Near one end of the
area is a large altar, covered in what looks like blood.

of the house is to the east, being elevated from your position by about
twenty feet.  It seems that the only way in the main house is to get up to
a marble balcony, which is open to the south.  Towards the north you can
see the main barracks for all of the commoners.

You are in the barracks of House Bey-Sandrax.  This room holds all of the
commoners of the House, as the Nobles stay in the main compound.  There are
many beds around the place, but most are empty, as there are always Drow out
and about in Nal Shaddar, spying and whatnot.

descKeys: nt for a minimal charge, assuming the requestor is actually a member this house.
r4265.description:
This part of the House complex houses an expert smith.  In the middle of the
smithy there is a forge, with a bellows standing on its side.  From the runes
carved into them it is accurate to assume that they are powered by magic.
Placed close to the forge there is an anvil with a sledgehammer leaning against
it.  On the walls of the building all kinds of smithing tools are hanging, all
nicely ordered.  The smith will fix or resize any equipment for a minimal
charge, assuming the requestor is actually a member this House.

You are on a broad balcony that is overlooking the main compound of House
Bey-Sandrax.  The balcony goes around the entire top portion of the structure.
You can enter the top part of the House here, by going 'in' it.  Looking to
the south, you see the beautiful city of Nal Shaddar.  At this point you can
climb down to the courtyard of the main compound, if you wish.

r4268.description:
You are in the main part of the House.  This sanctuary is used by the Nobles
of the House when they are plotting to destroy other Houses.  Several large
couches and chairs are here, with several tables having been placed against
one of the walls.  The main balcony is back to the east.
There is a adamatite door leading south ( LOCKED ).
There is a adamatite door leading west ( LOCKED ).
There is a adamatite door leading east ( LOCKED ).

r4269.description:
You are in hallway in the interior of the House.  The Nobles are just about the
only ones allowed in this area.  The walls of the hallway are a deep blue color,
something rarely seen in Nal Shaddar.  Decorations on the wall depict Loth in
all her glory.  Back to the south you can see a general gathering room.
There is a adamatite door leading north ( LOCKED ).
There is a adamantite door leading east ( LOCKED ).
