in this part of the mines causes you to gag slightly.  While gagging, you
notice that the walls have scratch marks upon them, as if some large and
fearsome creature regularly visits this area.

descKeys: a towering mountain. by chance you notice a crack in the side of the cliff face.
r4279.description:
You are on what looks to be a mountain path.  The path runs up to and ends at a
cliff face to the immediate southeast.  The path continues west on around the
north edge of a towering mountain.  By chance you notice a crack in the side of
the cliff face.

descKeys: ace to the east. looking to the west the path turns slightly left around a bend.
r4280.description:
You are on what appears to be a mountain path.  The path runs east and west
around the northern edge of a towering mountain.  The path looks like it ends
abruptly at a cliff face to the east.  Looking to the west the path turns
slightly left around a bend.

descKeys: his vantage point you can see a valley tucked in the mountains to the southwest.
r4281.description:
You are on what seems to be a mountain path.  The path runs east from here
around the northern edge of a towering mountain.  The path also turns slightly
southwest down a gradually sloping decline leading off the mountain.  From this
vantage point you can see a valley tucked in the mountains to the southwest.

descKeys: sight. back the other direction the path continues southwest to a small plateau.
r4282.description:
You tread near the top portion of an incline that runs up and down the side of a
mountain.  To the northeast the path curves up and around the mountain bending
east out of sight.  Back the other direction the path continues southwest to a
small plateau.

descKeys: st. there is also a slight incline up the side of the mountain to the northeast.
r4283.description:
You are on the east side of a small plateau which rests against a towering
mountain.  The plateau continues on to the west a bit and then drops off in a
sharp decline around the mountain to the southwest.  There is also a slight
incline up the side of the mountain to the northeast.

descKeys: short distance to the east where it turns and begins its gradual ascent upward.
r4284.description:
At the western edge of a plateau you stand overlooking a small valley to the
southwest.  The valley is not large but looks to be covered in dense green
trees.  Behind you the plateau continues a short distance to the east where it
turns and begins its gradual ascent upward.

descKeys: west. there is also a sharp incline that heads up the mountain to the northeast.
r4285.description:
You are at the eastern edge of a valley where it meets a mountain that towers
over you to the east.  This small valley is packed with green foliage that
grows denser as the valley continues along to the west.  There is also a sharp
incline that heads up the mountain to the northeast.

descKeys: emerald arboretum-like environs which encompass every route and every direction.
r4286.description:
You are surrounded by luscious plantlife.  Nearly everything around you is
leafy green or jaded in some shade of deep yet brilliant chartreuse.  There are
but a few scant scattered exceptions to the emerald arboretum-like environs
which encompass every route and every direction.

descKeys: for a short ways. however the westerly passage has been blocked by a landslide.
r4287.description:
You stand at an intersection.  A path leads off away from the valley to the
northwest where the trees collect densely.  The valley continues both to the
east and to the west for a short ways.  However the westerly passage has been
blocked by a landslide.

descKeys: rmth and look with a hint of humidity not normally found in mountainous regions.
r4288.description:
The forest and plantlife is thick in this region.  Much thicker than to the
southeast.  Yet it promises from all appearances to become even thicker still
to the northwest and northeast.  The plants and climate also have taken on an
unusual warmth and look with a hint of humidity not normally found in
mountainous regions.

descKeys: ggy dark tropical feel as if the forest was hinting at a jungle-like atmosphere.
r4289.description:
The temperature and humidity seem rather high here.  The flora and
concomitantly of corresponding fauna have also taken on a hefty thickness.
There is nearly a muggy dark tropical feel as if the forest was hinting at a
jungle-like atmosphere.

descKeys: absolute jungle. to the south everything opens up to a cooler and lighter area.
r4290.description:
The forest has become a blanketing thicket of vines and vegetation from the
south up to this point.  As the humidity and temperature also rise in the
northerly direction the light diminishes enveloped by the density of trees.  Up
to the north the forest becomes an absolute jungle.  To the south everything
opens up to a cooler and lighter area.

descKeys: eir way out. it would take a very brave individual to venture forward from here.
r4291.description:
You are at the entrance to a dark jungle.  There is very little you can see
through this ominous opening in the vine covered trees.  The jungle is filled
with many a danger.  One could easily get lost in such a place and never find
their way out.  It would take a very brave individual to venture forward from
here.

descKeys: in circles?' with the dangers, this jungle is not the place in which to be lost.
r4292.description:
As you look around you realize everything in this area of the dark jungle looks
the same as the last.  There is a small tree here that looks strangely familar.
Could it be that you have passed by this tree before?  This begs the question
'Are you walking in circles?'  With the dangers, this jungle is not the place
in which to be lost.

descKeys: orth. one should be very cautious around this hive and make no sudden movements.
r4293.description:
As you look around you realize everything in this area of the dark jungle looks
the same as the last.  There is a giant hive there that is buzzing with noise.
There are a few insects flying back and forth.  One should be very cautious
around this hive and make no sudden movements.

descKeys: ue, with several patches of white here and there, evidently representing clouds.
r4294.description:
This small hallway is heading west towards the entrance to City Hall, and also
south towards a meeting place.  Directly east of here is another large room
that has been set aside for town meetings.  The walls of the hallway have
been painted a light blue, with several patches of white here and there,
evidently representing clouds.

descKeys: rth end of the room. an exit leads back to the hallway, which is west from here.
r4295.description:
You are standing in a large meeting room, evidently set aside for gatherings
of the Deepwater populace to discuss city matters.  Several rows of small
wooden chairs face a large table that is at the north end of the room.  An
exit leads back to the hallway, which is west from here.

descKeys: ing. there is a wooden door leading west . there is a wooden door leading east .
r4296.description:
The hallway ends here, only heading to the north.  There are two offices at
this end of the city hall, and both look like they are used often.  The ceiling
in this part of the building is in need of slight repair.  The paint on the
walls is blue, but it is chipping.
There is a wooden door leading west ( CLOSED ).
There is a wooden door leading east ( CLOSED ).

descKeys: to sit down. the archway to the north leads back to the main part of city hall.
r4297.description:
You are in a small room located in Deepwater's City Hall.  The room is sparsely
decorated, as there is not a lot of people who come here.  A small bench is in
one corner of the room, offering the only place to sit down.  The archway to
the north leads back to the main part of City Hall.

descKeys: e driving them. you can faintly see the entrance to the mines to the west a bit.
r4301.description:
There have been several torches set about the tunnel walls, contained within
a few rusted and warped metal pegs, slammed into the wall with some incredible
force driving them.  You can faintly see the entrance to the mines to the
west a bit.

descKeys: e driving them. you can faintly see the entrance to the mines to the west a bit.
r4302.description:
There have been several torches set about the tunnel walls, contained within
a few rusted and warped metal pegs, slammed into the wall with some incredible
force driving them.  You can faintly see the entrance to the mines to the
west a bit.

descKeys: he freighter by the plank that lies to the west. the deck looks very clean here.
r4365.description:
To the northeast, you see the freighter's main cabin from where captain
commands the freighter.  The deck of the freighter continues to the
north and the south, while you can exit the freighter by the plank that
lies to the west.  The deck looks very clean here.

descKeys: sail that has been folded to conserve space and several tarps are lying around.
r4366.description:
The main cabin of the freighter is sitting to your north.  The outside
wall of the freighter appears as though it has recently been painted.
Beside you sits a large sail that has been folded to conserve space and
several tarps are lying around.

descKeys: ads down into the cargo hold. much traffic comes through this point as a result.
r4367.description:
You are standing at a major intersection on the freighter.  The door
to the north leads to the main cabin on the freighter.  To the south,
you can see the main mast and a ladder that leads down into the cargo
hold.  Much traffic comes through this point as a result.

descKeys: rowboat sitting to your south. there is a large hole in the hull of the rowboat.
r4368.description:
You notice a window on the cabin sitting to your north.  Glancing
through it, you can see a desk along with other fishing items on the
walls.  You also notice a rowboat sitting to your south.  There is a
large hole in the hull of the rowboat.

descKeys: the north, south, and west. the entrance to the cabin appears to be to the west.
r4369.description:
You are now standing southeast of the cabin on the freighter.  You can
easily look over the edge of the freighter from here and jumping off
at this height would hurt.  The deck continues to the north, south, and
west.  The entrance to the cabin appears to be to the west.

descKeys: ers watches far ahead of the ship for anything that might be in the ship's path.
r4370.description:
A small distance to the west, you spot a large mast that looks almost
20 feet in height.  Near the top you see the crow's nest where one or
more crew members watches far ahead of the ship for anything that might
be in the ship's path.

descKeys: w is still working on unloading the rest of the cargo from inside the freighter.
r4371.description:
Directly to your west, you notice a hole in the deck of the freighter
that is huge and rectangular in shape.  It is uncovered at the moment,
and you guess that the crew is still working on unloading the rest of
the cargo from inside the freighter.

descKeys: led out of the hull by the crane. the deck continues to the north and southwest.
r4372.description:
From this angle, you have a better view of the inside of the freighter
by gazing through the hole in the deck of the freighter.  You see
several crates that still need to be pulled out of the hull by the
crane. The deck continues to the north and southwest.

descKeys: main mast. unlike the other mast, there is no crow's nest mounted near the top.
r4373.description:
You are standing directly west of a mast that is smaller than the mast
toward the front of the freighter.  Sailors call this mast a mizzen, because
it is smaller than the main mast.  Unlike the other mast, there is no
crow's nest mounted near the top.

descKeys: enough, there are no oars nearby. the deck continues to the south and northwest.
r4374.description:
Some kind of stand has been mounted on the edge of the freighter, which
lies toward the east.  On the stand is a small life boat, which looks
like it could hold about 20 men.  Strangely enough, there are no oars
nearby.  The deck continues to the south and northwest.

descKeys: he anchor of the freighter and keep the freighter from floating out of the dock.
r4375.description:
When you look over the rail at this point, you can a large chain that
leads from the side of the freighter and breaks the surface of the
water.  The chain must hold the anchor of the freighter and keep the
freighter from floating out of the dock.

descKeys: ave never seen before. the creature is surrounded by a brown and red background.
r4376.description:
You are standing at the northernmost point of the freighter, which also
happens to be on the bow.  There is a small flagpole mounted on the
rail.  There is a large creature on the flag that you have never seen
before.  The creature is surrounded by a brown and red background.

descKeys: why the wall needs repainted. the deck continues to the northeast and southwest.
r4377.description:
The outside wall here of the captain's cabin looks like somebody just
painted it.  As you glance closer at the wall, you notice that there is
some graffiti, which must be the reason why the wall needs repainted.
The deck continues to the northeast and southwest.

descKeys: they probably do not have much to do on the freighter when they are out to sea.
r4378.description:
You notice that the deck is incredibly clean all around you.  The
sailors must spend much of their time cleaning the entire freighter.
That seems feasible since they probably do not have much to do on the
freighter when they are out to sea.

descKeys: at all times of the day. to the northeast, you spot the freighter's main cabin.
r4379.description:
You are standing between two planks that allows people to board and
disembark from the freighter.  One lies to the north, and the other lies
to the south.  They are heavily used by sailors at all times of the day.
To the northeast, you spot the freighter's main cabin.

descKeys: r dangerous situations in which you have been, but they quickly leave your mind.
r4380.description:
This particular spot in the docks seems to be more unstable than anywhere else.
As you walk, you hesitate for fear that the boards will give way, and you will
fall through, possibly to your death.  The boards are noticeably rotting away
and have many holes.  You begin to reminisce of the other dangerous situations
in which you have been, but they quickly leave your mind.

descKeys: mmon on ships, and rats have been rumored to be responsible to for many plagues.
r4381.description:
As you pass by a bow of a yacht, you nearly trip on a rat passing in
front of your feet.  As the rat scurries underneath a loose board, you feel
glad that it did not decide to take a piece of your flesh with it.  Disease
is very common on ships, and rats have been rumored to be responsible to for
many plagues.

descKeys: t. you wonder if the owner will have trouble steering the yacht out of the dock.
r4382.description:
You are now directly west of an expensive yacht.  For some unknown reason,
there is a small do-rag tied to the railing of the yacht.  You do not quite
understand why wearing fros is a major fad nowadays.  A large amount of
algae and plankton have collected near the rudder of the yacht.  You wonder
if the owner will have trouble steering the yacht out of the dock.

descKeys: ediate southeast is a small sailboat, and to the immediate northeast is a yacht.
r4383.description:
As you walk along the docks, you become aware most of the boats for personal
use are docked here instead of to the northeast.  As you glance to the east,
you notice that you are standing between the bows of two boats.  To the
immediate southeast is a small sailboat, and to the immediate northeast is a
yacht.

descKeys: success, other jealous merchants had officials cut future funding for building.
r4384.description:
The docks end abruptly at this point, and you suspect that the builders
planned to build further.  Rumor has it that the funding was severed
because of greedy merchants.  It seems that a rich merchant moved his
business out of the main part of Dunagin to preserve his commercial secrets.
Because of his surprising success, other jealous merchants had officials
cut future funding for building.

descKeys: air its many holes. despite its poor condition, it does look somewhat seaworthy.
r4385.description:
You now have a better view of a sailboat off to the south.  As you get a
closer view of the sailboat, you frown at its seemingly awful condition.
This sailboat has definitely seen better days.  Out of pity, you consider
tossing a coin into the sailboat in hopes that the owner will repair its
many holes.  Despite its poor condition, it does look somewhat seaworthy.

descKeys: ecorations inside the yacht. investigating might be worth your while monetarily.
r4386.description:
As you look to your left, you notice a well-kept, expensive yacht.  It has been
painted almost a pearly white, and you notice a small indentation and stain
on the side of the yacht almost to your level.  Next to you, there are some
small shards of glass.  You glance through a circular window and see lavish
decorations inside the yacht.  Investigating might be worth your while
monetarily.

descKeys: l 'swim to the dinghy.' the competition was halted when one of swimmers drowned.
r4387.description:
You have reached the end of this branch of the docks.  As you gaze out over
the breadth of the Frohon Bay, in the distance you can vaguely see the small
dinghy bobbing up and down in the waves.  Years ago, to increase his
popularity, the mayor of Dunagin sponsored an annual 'Swim to the Dinghy.'
The competition was halted when one of swimmers drowned.

descKeys: of sand. above the walls lie many spectator stands, filled with cheering masses.
r4389.description:
You are standing inside of a walled arena.  The ground is comprised of sand.
Above the walls lie many spectator stands, filled with cheering masses.

descKeys: lled with cheering masses. the walls of the arena are too high for you to climb.

You are standing inside of a walled arena.  The ground is comprised of sand.

descKeys: mice. the adventure guild of elinost is to the east, and a bank is to the west.
ast, and a bank is to the west. the moon is somewhere between journey and sleep.
r4397.description:
This part of the city is well-used and in good repair.  The buildings that
line either side of Spruce Avenue are in good shape.  Looking to the north,
you can see the main industrial hub of Elinost.  A lone feline is stalking
around one of the houses, possibly searching for mice.  The adventure guild
of Elinost is to the east, and a bank is to the west.

descKeys: d this intersection, you see that a few small businesses have been erected here.
r4398.description:
You are in the center of Elinost, the majestic elven city.  A wide-laned
road runs east and west, called Wind Way, while Spruce Avenue runs north
and south through here.  Elves walk past you, intent on some unknown task
that you are not privvy to.  Looking around this intersection, you see that
a few small businesses have been erected here.

descKeys: large gates adorned with elven sigla are to the south, leading out of the city.
south, leading out of the city. the moon is somewhere between journey and sleep.
r4399.description:
You are standing in Elinost, the majestic Elven city.  Although Elinost is
located in the midst of an immense forest, its beauty stands out and makes
it seem as if the city was here before the forest.  Spruce Avenue runs north
from here and the Elven Mori runs west and east.  Two large gates adorned
with elven sigla are to the south, leading out of the city.

descKeys: ches far to the south, an endless sea of trees. a small building is to the west.
r4400.description:
You are on a small path that is directly south of two large gates.  The gates
lead into the elven city of Elinost.  Guards are on a constant watch to stop
any Drow from entering their fair city.  However, the left gate is left open a
bit to allow others to safely pass through.  Looking to the south, the Great
forest stretches far to the south, an endless sea of trees.  A small building
is to the west.

descKeys: hich would be to the west. an open-air building is only a few steps to the east.
r4401.description:
The small path you are treading upon is about five feet wide and seems to
not be used that often.  The path continues to the north where it runs into
two large gates, which evidently lead into the city of Elinost.  The path
continues to the south, but it is taken over more by the thick underbrush.
While looking at the forest to the south, you notice a small opening in the
trees to the right, which would be to the west.  An open-air building is
only a few steps to the east.

descKeys: oks impassable. the few footprints in the dirt suggest this path is rarely used.
ggest this path is rarely used. the moon is somewhere between journey and sleep.
r4402.description:
This simple dirt path continues south from the city of Elinost.  Lush and
green, the forest surrounds you to both the east and west.  The plants form
form a thick wall that looks impassable.  The few footprints in the dirt
suggest this path is rarely used.

descKeys: r. you wonder if this energy is what keeps the elves alive for centuries on end.
ves alive for centuries on end. the moon is somewhere between journey and sleep.
r4403.description:
The path here is bathed in dark green shadows due to the immense trees lining
both sides of the north-south trail.  You feel the heaviness of nature's own
life force on the air.  You wonder if this energy is what keeps the elves
alive for centuries on end.

descKeys: years. over time, the log has probably been home to many of nature's creatures.
to many of nature's creatures. the moon is somewhere between journey and sleep.
r4404.description:
A log has fallen across the path here, though it should be no trouble to step
over it.  The rotten wood suggests the tree fell on its own, and you suspect
it has lain here for many years.  Over time, the log has probably been home
to many of nature's creatures.

descKeys: r carved this path originally would have endured a great challenge in making it.
r4405.description:
The dirt path bends here.  To the north lies the elven city of Elinost,
the path to the southwest leads deeper into the forest.  The trees continue
to be thick on both sides of the path.  Whoever carved this path originally
would have endured a great challenge in making it.

descKeys: here are no prints in the dirt, you think this was not the work of beast or man.
r4406.description:
The dirt path turns a little rocky here and you nearly lose your footing.
It looks like the ground was recently twisted and torn apart.  A few trees
also appear to be growing at strange angles.  Given that there are no prints
in the dirt, you think this was not the work of beast or man.

descKeys: ous feeling that evil lies to the west. it might be safer to go back to elinost.
r4407.description:
Several trees have been uprooted alongside the trail.  As you look to the
west, the swath of destruction appears to get worse.  The trail continues to
the southwest and east, though you get the ominous feeling that evil lies to
the west.  It might be safer to go back to Elinost.

descKeys: locked in a deep trance. a holy green energy appears to be emanating from them.
r4408.description:
The ground appears to have been severely upheaved here.  In fact, the land to
the west has sunk into a giant crack in the earth.  Two strange trees guard
the entrance to the crack, but upon closer inspection, they are elven priests!
Leaves and branches have covered these two elves who appear locked in a deep
trance.  A holy green energy appears to be emanating from them.

descKeys: rest. the elves have managed for now to contain the imps in this burning grotto.
r4409.description:
The giant crack's walls extend ten feet tall here.  You recall hearing about
a giant earthquake that tore through the area south of Elinost.  While most
most natural disasters are ignored by the nature-conscious elves, this quake
put them at arms.  After the quake, a legion of fire imps appeared,
threatening to burn down the great forest.  The elves have managed for now
to contain the imps in this burning grotto.

descKeys: he walls. back to the west is the small trail that leads north towards the city.
r4410.description:
This open-air building is used to house the Griffins that are used by the
Elinost Elite.  Many stables are here, with some of them being currently
occupied.  A small sign is on one of the walls.  Back to the west is the
small trail that leads north towards the city.

descKeys: charred corpse of a moose. given the horror on its face, it did not die quickly.
r4411.description:
Numerous small fires burn here, consuming the few remaining logs.  The pain
nature has felt here echoes in your bones.  On the ground, you see a strange
black mass.  Looking closer, you see it is the deeply charred corpse of a
moose.  Given the horror on its face, it did not die quickly.

descKeys: with no second thoughts whatsoever. you wonder what sort of evil these imps are.
r4412.description:
Several pools of molten rock lie before you.  With careful skipping among the
more solid parts, you can probably get through this area.  The imps, however,
probably plod right through the lava with no second thoughts whatsoever.
You wonder what sort of evil these imps are.

descKeys: only contain the imps. this environment saps them of their very source of power.
r4413.description:
A fire geyser shoots its flames skyward here at regular intervals.  The
intense blast of heat saps the air, and you nearly suffocate.  You understand
now why the elves only contain the imps.  This environment saps them of their
very source of power.

descKeys: ems like a vacation spot right now. you begin planning your next vacation there.
r4414.description:
The grotto appears to be sinking deeper into the earth the further west you
go.  The severe heat rises as well.  You wonder if you and your equipment can
survive this unholy place.  Even the Abyss seems like a vacation spot right
now.  You begin planning your next vacation there.

descKeys: ve dealt to the land, you sort of wish you were standing here blind in the dark.
r4415.description:
Every rock hear has been burnt a dark charcoal black.  Without the fires
coming from all directions, you would not be able to see anything here.
Seeing the emptiness the imps' flames have dealt to the land, you sort of
wish you were standing here blind in the dark.

descKeys: the imps are definitely contained for now. you wonder if eli will win this one.
r4416.description:
The grotto ends in a sheer wall to the north.  The extreme heat has melted
the wall to the point it is too slick to climb.  You now see that the only
exit out of here is through those elven priests.  The imps are definitely
contained for now.  You wonder if Eli will win this one.

descKeys: but now its waters empty into this cauldron of heat, instantly turning to steam.
r4417.description:
A large cloud of steam scalds you as you stand here.  You know a few Kalinport
citizens who would enjoy a sauna like this, but doubt they would enjoy the
company.  You suspect a natural spring used to exist here, but now its waters
empty into this cauldron of heat, instantly turning to steam.

descKeys: their shadows. the grass on the side of the trail is thick and nearly knee-high.
r4418.description:
You are standing on one of the many dirt trails that lead to and from the
great Elven city of Elinost.  The city's colossal quartz walls are very
near, covering most of the trail with their shadows.  The grass on the
side of the trail is thick and nearly knee-high.

descKeys: y stunted by the shadow of the giant quartz wall that surrounds the entire city.
r4419.description:
The trail here is smooth and even, evidence that the people of nearby
Elinost take care of the roads here.  A few small trees stand on the side
of the trail, likely stunted by the shadow of the giant quartz wall that
surrounds the entire city.

descKeys: inst the wall, you see a small pile of rocks that has collected there over time.
r4420.description:
Between the city walls of Elinost and the trail lies a small patch of
trimmed grass.  Elven citizens often use this small meadow for leisurely
picnics.  Up against the wall, you see a small pile of rocks that has
collected there over time.

descKeys: tting hillier. the grass on all sides of the trails is noticeably quite healthy.
r4421.description:
You are at a crossroads.  To the north and west, the dirt trail continues
alongside the city walls of Elinost.  To the east, you begin to see the
the countryside getting hillier.  The grass on all sides of the trails is
noticeably quite healthy.

descKeys: ills the elves of elinost call the grey hills. the grass here is lush and green.
r4422.description:
The dirt trail continues to the east and west throughout the rolling
countryside.  To the west appears to be a crossroads.  Off in the east
a bit, you can see the rolling hills the elves of Elinost call the Grey
Hills.  The grass here is lush and green.

descKeys: tryside. a bit of wind blows in from the east, sending a damp chill through you.
r4423.description:
Off in the east, you can see the rolling hills the elves of Elinost call
the Grey Hills.  The trail here is smooth and even as the elves take good
care of the roads and surrounding countryside.  A bit of wind blows in
from the east, sending a damp chill through you.

descKeys: sence here is quite noticeable due to the great health of all the plants nearby.
r4424.description:
The Grey Hills loom to the east, and the air here has taken on the well
known and despised damp chill of the Hills.  Along the trail to the west
lies the great Elven city of Elinost.  The elves' presence here is quite
noticeable due to the great health of all the plants nearby.

descKeys: of the trail. the grass on the side of the trail is thick and nearly knee-high.
r4425.description:
This dirt trail travels around the perimeter of the great Elven city of
Elinost.  The city's colossal quartz walls are quite tall and cast shadows
that cover most of the trail.  The grass on the side of the trail is thick
and nearly knee-high.

descKeys: is a small price to pay considering the protection the wall has given the elves.
r4426.description:
Due to the great care of the elves of Elinost, the trail here is smooth and
and even.  On the side of the trail, several small trees are growing, though
the shadow of the giant quartz wall has apparently stunted their growth.
Still, you feel it is a small price to pay considering the protection the
wall has given the Elves.

descKeys: a due to the wind tunnel effect of the giant quartz walls that protect the city.
r4427.description:
A massive gate leads west into the city of Elinost.  There is a bustle of
activity here as elves enter and leave the city on various errands.  A
strong wind blows throughout the area due to the wind tunnel effect of the
giant quartz walls that protect the city.

descKeys: rocks that have come loose over the years and collected at the base of the wall.
r4428.description:
Despite the elements and the many years, the city walls of Elinost still
stand as tall and strong as they did centuries ago.  The only sign of wear
is a small pile of rocks that have come loose over the years and collected
at the base of the wall.

descKeys: s and to the south by hills. in the dirt of the trail, you see a few footprints.
r4429.description:
This crossroads is just east of the Elven city of Elinost.  To the north
and south, the trail continues along the city walls. The trail to the east
appears flanked to the north by farmlands and to the south by hills.  In
the dirt of the trail, you see a few footprints.

descKeys: growth. a crossroads to the south is very close to the eastern gate of elinost.
r4430.description:
Due to the great care of the elves of Elinost, the trail here is smooth and
and even.  On the side of the trail, several small trees are growing, though
the shadow of the giant quartz wall has apparently stunted their growth.
A crossroads to the south is very close to the eastern gate of Elinost.

descKeys: inst the wall, you see a small pile of rocks that have been set aside over time.
r4431.description:
Nestled between the city wall and the trail, a small meadow lies here.  Many
people use this meadow for picnics and the occassional game as it is close to
a city gate.  Against the wall, you see a small pile of rocks that have been
set aside over time.

descKeys: ick, green carpet. you wonder if the elves actually water it each and every day.
r4432.description:
The trail here is smooth and even, evidence that the people of nearby
Elinost take care of the roads here.  The grass on either side of the trail
forms a thick, green carpet.  You wonder if the elves actually water it
each and every day.

descKeys: at the grass next to the wall, you see several rocks strewn throughout the area.
r4433.description:
The grass on both sides of the trail show signs of great care.  A few trees
also grow here, though the shadow of the city wall has limited their growth
significantly.  Looking at the grass next to the wall, you see several rocks
strewn throughout the area.

descKeys: of flax shining like gold under the sun. the grass here is a lush, hearty green.
r4434.description:
The trail here is smooth and even, evidence that the people of nearby
Elinost take care of the roads here.  A small trail to the southeast leads
towards the large, flowing fields of flax shining like gold under the sun.
The grass here is a lush, hearty green.

descKeys: is likely the season of harvest. to the west, you can see the walls of elinost.
r4435.description:
A small wagon path leads east into the flax fields.  Looking at the trail,
you guess that wagons filled with flax use this trail quite a bit.  As the
flax is quite high and golden in color, it is likely the season of harvest.
To the west, you can see the walls of Elinost.

descKeys: ce is used very often, leaving the muddy ground filled with rut and wheel marks.
r4436.description:
You are standing just within the western entrance of the flax fields.  A
thick row runs east between two tall walls of flax.  Due to the proximity
to the dirt trail and Elinost, this entrance is used very often, leaving
the muddy ground filled with rut and wheel marks.

descKeys: ck in deep rut and wheel marks in the ground. be careful, you might lose a shoe.
r4437.description:
The east-west row of flax has a cut leading to the south to shockingly more
flax.  Looking a ways to the east, you think you see an exit from the flax
fields.  You find trouble walking as your feet continually get stuck in deep
rut and wheel marks in the ground.  Be careful, you might lose a shoe.

descKeys: , but seeing how much the flax sways just by your breath, you decide not to try.
r4438.description:
Looking between the stalks of the flax, you see an elven farmer walking among
the crop.  His steps seem to not affect the plants at all.  You yourself wonder
if you can step through the flax like that, but seeing how much the flax sways
just by your breath, you decide not to try.

descKeys: re. gauging your position, you think you are near the southern end of the field.
r4439.description:
A rickety wooden barn is the north.  You see no doors in the rusty brown
wooden wall, so you presume the entrance is to the east or west from here.
The rows in the flax field extends to the east, west and south from here.
Gauging your position, you think you are near the southern end of the field.

descKeys: ou are not claustrophic. the narrow row here makes the air a bit stuffy and hot.
r4440.description:
The barn's eastern end is to the north, but you only guess this as the
flax has grown to an extreme height, obscuring your view.  It's a good
thing you are not claustrophic.  The narrow row here makes the air a bit
stuffy and hot.

descKeys: ythes must have. you tempt to break a stalk with your hands, but fail miserably.
r4441.description:
The flax makes a sharp bend here, giving you the options of heading only
north or east.  The thickness of the stalks makes you fear the keen, sharp
edge the centaurs' sickles and scythes must have.  You tempt to break a stalk
with your hands, but fail miserably.

descKeys: by some poor elf a long time ago. you decide to leave it there to amuse others.
r4442.description:
This row in the flax is a complete dead-end.  A large puddle has collected
here, turning the ground into a slimy muck.  Looking in the water, you find
an old leather boot left by some poor elf a long time ago.  You decide to
leave it there to amuse others.

descKeys: and valor. from time to time, old-timers gather here to relate their glory days.
r4443.description:
This building has long been the home for adventurers in Elinost.  Though
few come by here as they used to, the walls here are filled with the
essence of tales of adventure and valor.  From time to time, old-timers
gather here to relate their glory days.

descKeys: lven scribes then write this news and place it on the bulletin board found here.
r4444.description:
A large window opens out to the east that overlooks the street below.
It is from here that most news of the outside world is collected via
pigeons who carry messages from far off cities.  A few elven scribes then
write this news and place it on the bulletin board found here.

descKeys: u look up to see a small building floating in mid-air, blocking the sun's light.
r4445.description:
You are travelling along Spruce Avenue, which runs north and south.  The hub
of Elinost can be seen to the south, while a large and imposing palace
heralds its appearance to the far north.  Small buildings line either side of
the road, indicating a business district.  Noticing a shadow forming behind
you, you look up to see a small building floating in mid-air, blocking the
sun's light.

descKeys: all booths have been set up here to accommodate the wayfarers with refreshments.
r4446.description:
The two roadways, Spruce Avenue and Mori, meet here, making a large and very
busy intersection.  Elven citizens of Elinost can be seen walking along the
roads or riding in horse-drawn carriages.  Small booths have been set up here
to accommodate the wayfarers with refreshments.

descKeys: stands up, as it is the only one in good shape. smoke billows from its chimney.
r4447.description:
Spruce Avenue runs through another business district to the north.  Large
and unkempt buildings line this portion of the road, looking as if the owners
do not really care if the buildings fall into ruin.  One building stands up,
as it is the only one in good shape.  Smoke billows from its chimney.

descKeys: arrows displayed in the window. other businesses line each side of the roadway.
r4448.description:
You are standing in yet another business district of Elinost.  Looking around,
you cannot really distinct this part of the city from any other.  Off to the
west is a small shop where you may get rid of some of your excess baggage.  To
the east is a shop with arrows displayed in the window.  Other businesses line
each side of the roadway.

descKeys: g to the north you can see a large and elaborate palace jutting up into the sky.
r4449.description:
Travelling along this part of Spruce Avenue, you notice that the buildings
seem to be getter more and more elegant and grandiose.  This must be the
more wealthy section of Elinost.  Glancing to the north you can see a large
and elaborate palace jutting up into the sky.

descKeys: s quartered and each body part is fed to a different dragon that roams the land.
r4450.description:
You are at a crossroads for Spruce Avenue and Mori.  To the north lies a huge
and securely-guarded palace.  The palace is home to the Speaker of the Moon
and his family, and stands at the center of the elven lands.  Entrance into
the palace is offered to few, with many thieves being caught over the years.
Whenever this happenes, the thief is quartered and each body part is fed to
a different dragon that roams the land.

descKeys: t south of here, leading all the way to the center of the great city of elinost.
r4451.description:
You are standing right outside of the Palace of the Moon.  Twin hedges of
the finest-manicured green spruce trees line your path.  A tall iron gate
is directly north of you, with the palace being just beyond the elven-made
gate.  Spruce Street is just south of here, leading all the way to the center
of the great city of Elinost.

descKeys: al quarters. a tall gate is to the south, leading towards the center of elinost.
r4452.description:
The Palace of the Moon has been here for eons, having been one of the first
structures to be erected back when the elves first settled this part of the
forest.  The southern part of the palace houses the court-appointed scribes,
with the northern section of the palace housing the Hall of the Moon and
the royal quarters.  A tall gate is to the south, leading towards the center
of Elinost.

descKeys: tted plants are all around you, since the elves revere forest-life and its like.
r4453.description:
You are in the Western Hallway of the palace of the Moon.  Several scribes
hurry past, bustling towards the throne room to the north.  Exotic flowers
and potted plants are all around you, since the elves revere forest-life
and its like.

descKeys: ramble by you, making their way northward. there is a wooden door leading west .
r4454.description:
You are standing in the Western Hallway of the Palace of the Moon.  The
hallway runs north and south, and there is a wooden door to the west,
leading into some room of some sort.  Elven courtierss scramble by you,
making their way northward.
There is a wooden door leading west ( OPENED ).

descKeys: ntire length of the hallway. a few paintings of forest scenes are on both walls.
r4455.description:
The Western Hallway runs south and also north, where it then curves to the
northeast towards the Hall of the Moon.  A fine rug is underneath your feet,
and runs the entire length of the hallway.  A few paintings of forest scenes
are on both walls.

descKeys: s to the speaker. the hallway continues for quite a ways to the south from here.
r4456.description:
You are standing in the northern section of the Western Hallway.  To the
northeast lies a guard checkpoint where a contigent of Elite Guards check out
any petitioners to the Speaker.  The hallway continues for quite a ways to
the south from here.

descKeys: the palace are south from this point, with the throne room being north of here.
r4457.description:
You have reached a guard checkpoint.  Members of the Elite Guard are always
stationed here to check out all petitioners to the Speaker.  If any of the
beings are suspicious in any way, they are taken away for some intense and
arduous 'questioning.'  The two great hallways of the palace are south from
this point, with the throne room being north of here.

descKeys: to the east has a few scuff marks on it. there is a wooden door leading north .
r4458.description:
You are standing before a large and imposing wooden door.  Beyond the door
to the north is the Hall of the Moon, which serves as the throne room for
the Speaker of the Moon, the leader of the elven people.  Many guards have
been put here to insure that no one of evil persuasion gets past.  Any one
of non-elven heritage is usually turned away as well.  The wall to the east
has a few scuff marks on it.
There is a wooden door leading north ( OPENED ).

descKeys: g been constructed of the same materials. there is a wooden door leading south .
r4459.description:
You are standing in the southernmost part of the Hall of the Moon.  This
famed Hall serves as the throne room for the Speaker of Elinost, the leader
of the elven people.  The walls of the Hall are made of the purest marble,
with the floor of the Hall having been constructed of the same materials.
There is a wooden door leading south ( OPENED ).

descKeys: orty feet, then halt abruptly. the speaker's elaborate throne lies to the north.
r4460.description:
The Hall of the Moon reaches its center point here.  Looking up, you can see
that there is indeed no ceiling.  The walls of the oval-shaped room reach
up into the air for about forty feet, then halt abruptly.  The Speaker's
elaborate throne lies to the north.

descKeys: or. it is said that only members of the royal family are able to open that door.
r4461.description:
The Elite Guard goes berserk after spotting you, the attacker of the Speaker!
The Elite Warrior does a quick feint and then smacks you across the face.
The Elite Warrior does a quick feint and then smacks you across the face.
The Elite Guard goes berserk after spotting you, the attacker of the Speaker!
The Elite Warrior does a quick feint and then smacks you across the face.
The Elite Guard goes berserk after spotting you, the attacker of the Speaker!
The Elite Warrior does a quick feint and then smacks you across the face.
The Elite Warrior does a quick feint and then smacks you across the face.
The Elite Guard goes berserk after spotting you, the attacker of the Speaker!
The Elite Guard goes berserk after spotting you, the attacker of the Speaker!
The Elite Warrior does a quick feint and then smacks you across the face.
You are standing before the Speaker's throne inside of the Hall of the Moon.
The throne, which is to the north, is about six feet in height, allowing
for the Speaker's un-Elven like height.  Beyond the throne to the north
lies an ornate door.  It is said that only members of the royal family are
able to open that door.

descKeys: ruction and reinforced with elven magic. a very small door is on the north wall.
r4462.description:
The Speaker is gazing at you thoughtfully.
The Hall of the Moon is one of the few wonders of the known world.  Seeing
that the Hall is open to the forest air, you would think that it rains in
here on occasion.  Such is not the case.  The Hall was constructed using
the modern Dwarven mode of construction and reinforced with Elven magic.
A very small door is on the north wall.

descKeys: slight spring to your step. up ahead to the northwest you can spot a guard post.
r4463.description:
The Eastern Hallway turns towards the northwest here, while also running
south for quite a long distance.  An exquisitely-crafted rug lies beneath
your feet, adding a slight spring to your step.  Up ahead to the northwest
you can spot a guard post.

descKeys: ng many nature scenes. up ahead to the north the hallway turns towards the west.
r4464.description:
You are travelling through the Eastern Hallway.  A fine rug is underneath
your feet, running the entire length of the hallway.  Paintings of forest
animals line the wall, displaying many nature scenes.  Up ahead to the north
the hallway turns towards the west.

descKeys: als, especially the animals of the forest. there is a wooden door leading east .
r4465.description:
The hallway runs north and south, with a wooden doorway on the eastern side
of the hall.  Small paintings of birds, squirrels, and other forest animals
have been placed on either wall of the hallway.  It seems that elves have an
affinity for animals, especially the animals of the forest.
There is a wooden door leading east ( OPENED ).

descKeys: on each table. the well-woven rug underneath your feet is of the finest quality.
r4466.description:
The Eastern Hallway runs north towards the Hall of the Moon and also south-
west towards the palace's entrance.  Several small tables line both walls,
with an ornate vase containing a single flower being on each table.  The
well-woven rug underneath your feet is of the finest quality.

descKeys: so hot and so wet? judging by the imps' fighting prowess, they relish this hell.
r4467.description:
The air here is filled with such thick smoke that your vision is limited to
only a few feet from your face.  Your sweat just pools on your skin, unable
to evaporate into the thick, humid air.  How can the air be both so hot and
so wet?  Judging by the imps' fighting prowess, they relish this hell.

descKeys: a deep pit of some kind. the heat from there is the fiercest you have ever felt.
r4468.description:
You estimate that you are now fifty feet below the surface of the surrounding
forest.  If it is night or day above you, you have no real means of learning
which is true.  The grotto descends sharply here, leading down to a deep pit
of some kind.  The heat from there is the fiercest you have ever felt.

descKeys: t be too late if any impish leaders have escaped from their subterranean prison.
r4469.description:
The very walls of this room appear to be flowing molten rock.  A deep gash
in the ground burns with a demonic fire.  This is where the imps broke
through to the surface world.  It will take an amazing effort on the part of
elves to close that opening.  It might be too late if any impish leaders have
escaped from their subterranean prison.

descKeys: cide to leave the sword there to remind others what these horrors are all about.
r4470.description:
You see a single sword lying on the ground here, carbon scorching covering
both the hilt and blade.  Some pour soul must have fallen while defending
the surface from these fire imps.  You decide to leave the sword there to
remind others what these horrors are all about.

descKeys: y. looking closer at it, you see that the tree also has teeth marks all over it.
r4471.description:
A large blackened stump is all that remains of a once gigantic tree.  Its
rings are now glowing charcoal.  You wonder how many years that tree took to
grow, and how many seconds it took to burn away.  Looking closer at it, you
see that the tree also has teeth marks all over it.

descKeys: evere their forests, no tree is cut down without one being planted in its place.
r4472.description:
You are in a small building just south of Elinost.  There are woodchips all
over the place.  This place must be used as a woodshop.  Various instruments
are on the floor, evidently used for the shaping of wood.  Since Elves revere
their forests, no tree is cut down without one being planted in its place.

descKeys: the houses around this part of elinost are the poorest and most ill-constructed.
r4473.description:
The Mori meets Spruce Avenue a little ways to the east from here.  You can
see a group of guards converging at the crossroads, as if they are in fact
watching for outsiders.  The houses around this part of Elinost are the
poorest and most ill-constructed.

descKeys: g within elinost. the northern part of the city is reserved for those of wealth.
r4474.description:
Going all the way around the city of Elinost, the Mori holds the many housing
districts of Elinost.  The southern part of the city, in which you now stand
is home to the many laborers and unskilled artisans living within Elinost.
The northern part of the city is reserved for those of wealth.

descKeys: get around to these parts, being as they usually get lost in the immense forest.
r4475.description:
You are standing just inside the gates of Elinost.  The famed elven city has
been erected smack dab in the middle of a huge and dark forest.  Not many
non-elves get around to these parts, being as they usually get lost in the
immense forest.

descKeys: who have jobs as servants or laborers. some stairs lead down into a restaurant.
r4476.description:
The Mori winds its way through the many housing districts of Elinost, going
around the entire city.  The houses in this part of Elinost are not very
spectactular in the least and must belong to those Elves who have jobs as
servants or laborers.  Some stairs lead down into a restaurant.

descKeys: outh of elinost, to the more grandiose mansions of the northern part of elinost.
r4477.description:
You are walking along the Mori, which means 'way' in old Elvish.  The Mori
encircles the city and holds most of the housing districts in it, ranging
from the less wealthy houses in the south of Elinost, to the more grandiose
mansions of the northern part of Elinost.

descKeys: s themselves. to the north is a large white building, holding the temple of eli.
r4478.description:
This part of Wind Way is very busy.  Besides having many businesses about, the
center of Elinost is but a few paces away.  Elinost is famed for its exotic
wares, with this part of the city being mainly responsible for that fame.
Contrary to many a belief, the elves make most of their wares themselves.
To the north is a large white building, holding the Temple of Eli.

descKeys: y customer counts. a small line of petite trees line either side of the roadway.
r4479.description:
Looking on the side of the roadway, you spot a couple of vendors almost
getting into a fist fight.  It seems times are kind of hard in Elinost right
now, and every customer counts.  A small line of petite trees line either
side of the roadway.

descKeys: nely-tailored gowns and impeccable uniforms. commands are: 'buy item' and 'list'
r4480.description:
This is a small business near the center of Elinost.  Judging from the many
types of cloth being displayed, you surmise that this is a tailor's shop.
The wealthy of Elinost come to this shop, owned by a certain Joruth, to
purchase finely-tailored gowns and impeccable uniforms.
Commands are: 'buy item' and 'list'

descKeys: ng and other activities. a small storeroom can be seen in the back of the store.
r4481.description:
When you walk into this building, strange smells and exotic scents assault
your nose, causing you to become a little light-headed.  It seems that this
small shop is a place of spice.  You can purchase thousands of different
spices here, used in cooking and other activities.  A small storeroom can be
seen in the back of the store.

descKeys: curious wooden box. you can see the front of the store through a small doorway.
r4482.description:
This dusty little room has thousands upon thousands of small glass vials
filled with spices set upon rows of wooden shelves.  You could not even begin
to count the number of different types of pepper alone!  In one corner of the
room is a curious wooden box.  You can see the front of the store through
a small doorway.

descKeys: cted there by the local residents. the stone wall is perhaps two feet in height.
r4483.description:
The Mori runs straight through a large residential neighborhood, twisting its
way through the estates.  Lining either side of the street is a small stone
wall, having been erected there by the local residents.  The stone wall is
perhaps two feet in height.

descKeys: lies off of the roadway to the west, with pleasant smells emanating from within.
r4484.description:
You are travelling upon the Mori, which means 'way' in old elvish.  The houses
around in this area are very spacious and well-made.  The populace in this
area is made up mostly of middle-class elves.  A quaint little tavern lies off
of the roadway to the west, with pleasant smells emanating from within.

descKeys: s and acorns. the townsfolk of this area erected in the spirit of elven harmony.
r4485.description:
The Mori runs through a large residential neighborhood here.  Along either
side of the roadway lies a green hedge perhaps three feet in height.  The
hedge has been artfully pruned and decorated with pine cones and acorns.
The townsfolk of this area erected in the spirit of elven harmony.

descKeys: all elves being able to find their way back to elinost via this very same route.
r4486.description:
You are travelling along the Mori, which means 'way' in old elvish.  This
roadway was the first street in Elinost, and was named the 'way' in hopes
of all elves being able to find their way back to Elinost via this very same
route.

descKeys: ntion to the west. it seems that this particular estate belongs to a high baron.
r4487.description:
The roadway winds through a neighborhood filled with large mansions and grand
estates.  Along either side of the road lie large houses with well-manicured
lawns and lush foliage.  One large house draws you attention to the west.  It
seems that this particular estate belongs to a High Baron.

descKeys: well maintained, suggesting the baron employs a large, healthy maintenance crew.
r4488.description:
You are standing on a path that leads to the mansion of the High Baron.
The Mori is back to the east.  Flowering hedges line both sides of the
cobblestone path.  Everything here is well maintained, suggesting the
Baron employs a large, healthy maintenance crew.

descKeys: sing. an apple tree to the east has dropped a few pieces of fruit onto the path.
r4489.description:
The cobblestone path continues both to the east and northwest with the
hedges continuing to bank both sides of the way.  A puddle in the path
marks where a cobblestone is missing.  An apple tree to the east has
dropped a few pieces of fruit onto the path.

descKeys: owery scent. a small dirt path to the northeast leads into the estate's gardens.
r4490.description:
The cobblestone path appears to stop to the northwest at the entrance to the
Baron's mansion.  The hedges lining the path are filled with pink and blue
blossoms, filling the air with a light, flowery scent.  A small dirt path
to the northeast leads into the estate's gardens.

descKeys: . a small path leads east into the gardens. there is a wood door leading north .
r4491.description:
You are standing just outside the mansion of the High Baron.  The wooden
building is beautifully constructed, though smaller than you expected.
Fancy wood carvings of ivy line the frame of the sturdy door.  A small path
leads east into the gardens.
There is a wood door leading north ( OPENED ).

descKeys: ending somewhere in the hall to the north. there is a wood door leading south .
r4492.description:
This small room just within the mansion is a place for visitors to relieve
themselves of coats and cloaks before entering the rest of the house.  On
one wall, there are several pegs and shelves for storing said articles.
A thick rug begins here, ending somewhere in the hall to the north.
There is a wood door leading south ( OPENED ).

descKeys: of the hall, suggesting that this room is used for entertaining guests at times.
r4493.description:
The main hall of the mansion has several exits branching off to different
parts of the house.  Through the elaborately painted doorway to the west,
you see a staircase.  Several velvet chairs are on both sides of the hall,
suggesting that this room is used for entertaining guests at times.

descKeys: table set before it. a doorway leads back east to the main hall of the mansion.
r4494.description:
You at the bottom landing of a flight of stairs.  Two griffin heads have
been carved into the ends of the bannisters.  A mirror hangs on a wall
nearby, with a small table set before it.  A doorway leads back east to
the main hall of the mansion.

descKeys: e years. you notice that his older daughter is missing from the newer paintings.
r4495.description:
You are standing at the top of a flight of stairs.  A hallway leads to the
east.  The polished wood of the stairs gleam brightly.  Along the wall, you
see portaits of the Baron and his family over the years.  You notice that
his older daughter is missing from the newer paintings.

descKeys: at night. the high ceiling opens to a skylight that allows the sun to shine in.
r4496.description:
This hallway connects the two upstairs rooms with the stairwell to the west.
A finely woven carpet is laid out on the wood floor.  Two torchholders are
set in the wall, presumably to light the place at night.  The high ceiling
opens to a skylight that allows the sun to shine in.

descKeys: er is on the wall behind the bed. to the west is another room, perhaps the bath.
r4497.description:
The master bedroom of the house has a giant oak bed that sits easily three
feet off the floor.  A small pair of stairs on each side of the bed must
help the baron and his wife in and out of it.  On every wall are tapestries
portraying various nature scenes.  A stunning one of the moon over water is
on the wall behind the bed.  To the west is another room, perhaps the bath.

descKeys: small furnace is nearby to heat the water. a large cabinet stands in the corner.
r4498.description:
A giant porcelain tub is the main attraction of this bathroom.  Pipes from
the ceiling run down to the spigot, so you presume the source of water
might be rain water collected on the roof.  A small furnace is nearby to
heat the water. A large cabinet stands in the corner.

descKeys: e that the ceiling in this room is a little lower than in the rest of the house.
r4499.description:
This bedroom is covered in lace and ruffles, meaning it probably belongs to
High Baron's youngest daughter, Lilia.  A small canopy bed is against one
wall, and several stuffed animals are on top of the mattress.  A small
closet is set in one wall.  You notice that the ceiling in this room is a
little lower than in the rest of the house.

descKeys: piece stands in the middle of the table. presumably, the kitchen is to the west.
r4500.description:
The High Baron's dining hall is meant only for small parties, usually only
the baron's family.  A round oak table sits in the center of the room
capable of seating maybe eight elves at once.  A lovely rose centerpiece
stands in the middle of the table.  Presumably, the kitchen is to the west.

descKeys: the oven. by the smell, you think a cherry cake is currently being baked in it.
r4501.description:
The Baron's kitchen is in some ways a garden as well.  Herb plants in pots
are on nearly every surface.  A cherry tree appears to be growing over in
the corner.  A stone hearth on one wall is presumably the oven.  By the
smell, you think a cherry cake is currently being baked in it.

descKeys: t at the estate's gardens, giving you a strong view of a unicorn-shaped topiary.
r4502.description:
The walls of this room are lined with bookshelves, except for one wall with
a large map of Elinost and the surrounding countryside.  To the north is
the High Baron's office.  A large bay window looks out at the estate's
gardens, giving you a strong view of a unicorn-shaped topiary.

descKeys: of the desk next to a small mug of java. an elaborate rug covers the wood floor.
r4503.description:
In this office, from behind the pine desk, the High Baron makes decisions
regarding the health and welfare of Elinost and the surrounding lands.  A
tall pile of papers sits on one corner of the desk next to a small mug of
java.  An elaborate rug covers the wood floor.

descKeys: constructed in the city. the buildings around this area are large and uncramped.
r4504.description:
Swedemcgee punches Elite boldly, causing a lot of damage.
You are walking along the Mori, which is running through a residential district
in the northern part of Elinost.  The Mori runs around the entire city, and
was the first principal road to be constructed in the city.  The buildings
around this area are large and uncramped.

descKeys: u have ever seen. upon closer inspection, you see the roses also have no thorns.
r4505.description:
The garden is alive with bushes and flowers with many the likes you have
never seen before.  You see no weeds or dead leaves anywhere.  Of
particular interest is a rose bush with the fullest blossoms you have ever
seen.  Upon closer inspection, you see the roses also have no thorns.

descKeys: d in front of a large bay window on the mansion is a tremendous rearing unicorn.
r4506.description:
This corner of the garden is filled with miraculous topiaries.  The
sculptured bushes have been carefully trimmed over the years to resemble
various animals.  A beautiful lion is to your right, and in front of a
large bay window on the mansion is a tremendous rearing unicorn.

descKeys: s and well-to-do familes of elinost. large estates line either side of the road.
r4507.description:
The Elite Warrior does a quick feint and then smacks you across the face.
The Elite Warrior does a quick feint and then smacks you across the face.
The Elite Warrior does a quick feint and then smacks you across the face.
The Mori runs around the entire city, save the palace, in a hourglass-shaped
route, with the middle of the hourglass being the center of Elinost.  This
area of the city holds the large mansions and well-to-do familes of Elinost.
Large estates line either side of the road.

descKeys: eads to the west, towards a large hallway. there is a wooden door leading west .
r4508.description:
This small cubicle is used by the palace scribes, who are at the moment
busily writing down speeches and such.  Five small desks are here, spread
out evenly around the room, with a chair set behind each one.  A wooden
door leads to the west, towards a large hallway.
There is a wooden door leading west ( OPENED ).

descKeys: way is to the east, through a wooden door. there is a wooden door leading east .
r4509.description:
You are standing in a scribe's cubicle.  Several small desks are here,
having been set up for the scribes' use.  A small window is in the western
wall, allowing a small amount of sunlightt to filter in.  The Western Hall-
way is to the east, through a wooden door.
There is a wooden door leading east ( OPENED ).

descKeys: imals are abundant, with depictions of elven living having been inserted within.
r4510.description:
Gazing at the near wall, you can see that many elaborate and intricate
carvings and stencils have been etched into the surface.  Pictures and
murals of forest animals are abundant, with depictions of Elven living
having been inserted within.

descKeys: h, you see the magnificent palace of the moon rising high behind the city walls.
r4511.description:
A vein of gold quartz in the city wall gives everything nearby a warm glow.
Protecting the elves within for centuries, you marvel at the workmanship of
the city walls.  To the north, you see the magnificent Palace of the Moon
rising high behind the city walls.

descKeys: ack looking years older than when they began. the dirt trail leads to the south.
r4512.description:
The trail rises sharply here as the Grey Hills begin immediately to the
east.  Bitter wet cold begins to soak through every pore of your being.
The elves who travel through these hills often come back looking years
older than when they began.  The dirt trail leads to the south.

descKeys: this hill, but what direction? you notice the wind never blows in from the west.
you know, an exit might just be down the slope of this hill, but what direction?
r4513.description:
Standing atop a hill, you see only the pervasive fog to your right, left
above, and below.  If you are not careful, your next step will be onto fog
and not solid ground.  A cold shiver runs down your spine as you slowly
realize that you see no end to the Grey Hills.  For all you know, an exit
might just be down the slope of this hill, but what direction?

descKeys: you know, an exit might just be down the slope of this hill, but what direction?
r4514.description:
Standing atop a hill, you see only the pervasive fog to your right, left
above, and below.  If you are not careful, your next step will be onto fog

descKeys: our nerves turn cold at the thought of the horrible battle that took place here.
r4515.description:
A strange indention in the earth is the sign of a recent struggle.  Looking
at the many marks in the mud, you judge that a large, lumbering beast was
brought down by several smaller, faster creatures.  All hints of blood have
been washed away by the fog.  Your nerves turn cold at the thought of the
horrible battle that took place here.

descKeys: e and back again. you rub your neck, half expecting to find gills growing there.
r4516.description:
The maze-like paths of the Grey Hills never seem to end.  Only by the
shrewdest sense of direction do manage to determine what direction is
north.  You shiver as you step in a large puddle, splashing yourself from
head to toe and back again.  You rub your neck, half expecting to find
gills growing there.

descKeys: nly the hardiest of flora and fauna can possibly survive here in the grey hills.
r4517.description:
The ground is very damp and muddy.  A cold breeze rushes between the
hills; the brisk air waking you up.  A few trees cling to life here in
the mud, despite the apparent lack of sun.  Only the hardiest of flora
and fauna can possibly survive here in the Grey Hills.

descKeys: nly the hardiest of flora and fauna can possibly survive here in the grey hills.

descKeys: trees look worse than those that grow near human, or even worse, dwarven cities.
r4519.description:
A large clump of trees is nestled in this valley between two tall hills.
With careful steps, you can get through here, though you expect to get stuck
once or twice.  Looking at the dark wood, it seems untouched by the light of
the elves.  In fact, these trees look worse than those that grow near human,
or even worse, dwarven cities.

descKeys: d only bends in your hands. your footsteps are clearly evident in the slimy mud.
r4524.description:
The fog never seems to vary in its thickness, regardless of whether or
not you are at the top or bottom of a hill.  The few trees droop as if
they have soaked in too much water over the millenia.  Grasping a thin
branch, you find it impossible to break.  The limp wood only bends in
your hands.  Your footsteps are clearly evident in the slimy mud.

descKeys: egular basis. if not for the perpetual moisture, this land would be a wasteland.
r4529.description:
Thick patches of earth appear to have been stripped dry (if that is even
possible here in the hills) of all living life.  You do see the neighboring
moss and underbrush slowly filling in these gaps before your eyes.  The large
thallid herds that roam these hills must clear out the hills on a regular
basis.  If not for the perpetual moisture, this land would be a wasteland.

descKeys: your being. you begin to really question whether or not this trip was worth it.
r4530.description:
The Grey Hills begin immediately to the southeast.  The muddy trail and
sudden inclines make walking difficult.  Bitter wet cold begins to soak
through every pore of your being.  You begin to really question whether or
not this trip was worth it.

descKeys: duces this mud. you notice that no grass is growing on either side of the trail.
r4531.description:
You find that your left foot is stuck ankle deep in a mud puddle.  The trail
heading southeast to the Grey Hills looks to just get worse.  You suppose
that the near constant fog that covers the hills also produces this mud.
You notice that no grass is growing on either side of the trail.

descKeys: gin to understand why as the trail gets muddier and more difficult to the south.
r4532.description:
A cold damp wind blows from out of the south, freezing your marrow.  Few
elves travel to the Grey Hills, unless the Speaker or High Baron commands
them to.  You truly begin to understand why as the trail gets muddier and
more difficult to the south.

descKeys: the north appears strong and lush, but the grass to the south is quite scraggly.
r4533.description:
The dirt trail branches off here in several directions.  The trail to the
south appears a bit rockier and less used, but leads to the Grey Hills.
The main path runs east-west and looks well kept.  The grass to the north
appears strong and lush, but the grass to the south is quite scraggly.

descKeys: resence of elves is noticeable due to the great health of all the plants nearby.
r4534.description:
The Grey Hills loom to the south, and the air here has a subtle chill to
it, likely coming from the winds from the Hills.  The trail continues between
the elven farmlands and the Grey Hills.  The presence of elves is noticeable
due to the great health of all the plants nearby.

descKeys: ooking at the trail, you see that more footprints lead to the west or northeast.
r4535.description:
Standing at a crossroads, you have the choice of three directions.  West
stands the great city of Elinost.  Farmlands appear to be to the northeast.
Looming from the southeast are the Grey Hills.  Looking at the trail, you
see that more footprints lead to the west or northeast.

descKeys: ng kept fallow till the next growing season. elinost is a fair walk to the west.
r4536.description:
A large puddle stands in the middle of the dirt trail, reflecting the sky
in its still waters.  Lush grass grows to the north and south, but there
are no trees.  You suspect these fields are being kept fallow till the
next growing season.  Elinost is a fair walk to the west.

descKeys: south a ways are somber grey hills. lush grass grows on both sides of the trail.
r4537.description:
The dirt trail continues to the east and west throughout the rolling
countryside.  To the west appears to be a crossroads.  Off in the east
a bit, you can see some farmlands to the north.  To the south a ways are
somber Grey Hills.  Lush grass grows on both sides of the trail.

descKeys: t like treetops. to the east lie the lands the elves farm for food and clothing.
r4538.description:
You are standing just inside the majestic elven city of Elinost.  Situated
in the middle of an immense forest, Elinost was constructed with nature in
mind.  The buildings have been shaped into tree-like buildings, with the
roofs being sporadic, just like treetops.  To the east lie the lands the
elves farm for food and clothing.

descKeys: like small trees. a small dog lies on the edge of the road, watching you warily.
r4539.description:
You are travelling upon Wind Way, which runs east and west.  A little ways
to the east lies a huge forest, while the center of Elinost is to the west.
Lining each side of the roadway are small buildings, shaped like small trees.
A small dog lies on the edge of the road, watching you warily.

descKeys: ub of elinost. off to the side of the road a vendor is trying to hawk his wares.
r4540.description:
Wind Way is dotted with small potholes here, as if some large cart rambled
through this area, tearing up the roadway.  Looking to the west, you can see
the main hub of Elinost.  Off to the side of the road a vendor is trying to
hawk his wares.

descKeys: is the elven city of elinost, nestled among the huge trees of an endless forest.
es of an endless forest. to the immediate north, you see a small yard below you.
r4541.description:
You are standing on the roof of the Royal Palace.  Towards the north you can
see a large circular tower rising up through the palace.  To the south is
the elven city of Elinost, nestled among the huge trees of an endless forest.
