r4560.description:
The Elite Warrior's facial expression never changes.
You touch the scuff mark and the wall revolves, taking you with it.
You are standing in the headquarters for the secretive Elinost Elite.  The
room is sparse with furnishings, but the members of the Elite do not care
for comfort.  They have a job to do, and they do it with absolute and utter
devotion.  The only furnishing in the room is a small desk, with a small
yet sturdy wooden chair behind that desk.

descKeys: n painted several centuries before. sleeping barracks are seen to the northeast.

Elinost Elite Guild Board [ 68 messages,.name: Elinost Elite Guild Board [ 68 messages, 68 new]

r4561.description:
You are in a small meeting room where the older and more experienced members
of the Elinost Elite meet to discuss matters pertaining to their duties.  A
large table has been set in the middle of the room, with high-backed wooden
chairs set around it.  A painting of Elinost is on the northern wall, a bit
faded, having been painted several centuries before.  Sleeping barracks
are seen to the northeast.

descKeys: nder how restful such sleep could be on the wooden planks that make up the beds.
r4562.description:
Though the Elinost Elite Guard has several hundered members, these barracks
contain only ten beds.  Through their discipline and ever-vigilance, an
elite only rests for one night every month.  Even then, you wonder how
restful such sleep could be on the wooden planks that make up the beds.

descKeys: ies of trials and quests. runes are carved into the wall, glimmering peculiarly.
r4563.description:
Along the eastern wall stands a weapon rack filled with both ancient and
new elite weaponry.  Honed solely for their use, an elite must earn the
honor of using them by completing a series of trials and quests.  Runes
are carved into the wall, glimmering peculiarly.

descKeys: ents are here, focusing their gaze and spirit on the path of eli in the heavens.
r4564.description:
The roof here is open to reveal the passage of the moon throughout the
sky.  Upon completing the cadet stage of being an elite, the warrior trains
focus and vigilance.  Several elite students are here, focusing their gaze
and spirit on the path of Eli in the heavens.

descKeys: l be needed again. their honor and duty is a driving force for all elites today.
r4565.description:
This enclosed garden has an eerie stillness to it.  About fifty ivy-covered
statues are standing in formation here, but upon closer inspection, you
see they are really elves in a deep trance.  Having not fallen in battle
or to disease and too old to fight, these elves entered this garden to
await the day they will be needed again.  Their honor and duty is a
driving force for all Elites today.

descKeys: through a small opening to the east or an even smaller opening to the southwest.
r4566.description:
You are standing in an area that is full of large foliage.  Trees both great
and small are surrounding you, just about cutting off any sunlight.  The trees
are closely packed together.  It seems you can only go one of two ways, either
through a small opening to the east or an even smaller opening to the southwest.

descKeys: ight be able to slip through. the trees in this area are green and full of life.
r4567.description:
This area is full of trees, surrounding you on every side.  The 'path' you are
on leads one direction, to the south.  However you also spot a small opening
in the trees to the northeast that you might be able to slip through.  The
trees in this area are green and full of life.

descKeys: roup of trees to the south, you spot a small opening near the base of the trees.
r4568.description:
The small path you are on only heads to the north.  Any other direction you
would hit a row of trees!  The trees are packed so closely together that you
have a hard time seeing any sunlight.  Peering closely at a group of trees to
the south, you spot a small opening near the base of the trees.

descKeys: s. there is also a small opening to the north which could possibly be traversed.
r4569.description:
You are in the middle of a huge forest, full of large green trees and home to
many a woodland creature.  You can easily head south through a large opening
in the rows and rows of trees.  There is also a small opening to the north
which could possibly be traversed.

descKeys: north where the trees are very thick, or to the west towards one huge oak tree.
r4570.description:
The forest totally envelops you in its greenery.  It seems that this part of
the woodlands is relatively untouched by anyone other than the forest's own
creatures.  You hesitate to impeed upon that purity, so you tread lightly.  It
look likes you can head either north where the trees are very thick, or to the
west towards one huge oak tree.

descKeys: res. for some reason the trunk of the tree in front of you draws your attention.
r4571.description:
You are standing before a huge oak tree.  The tree looks ancient and towers
over the rest of its nearby brothers and sisters.  Looking around the base of
the tree you can see many prints that evidently originated from various wood-
land creatures.  For some reason the trunk of the tree in front of you draws
your attention.

descKeys: trunk is to the east, and to the north is another open area inside of the tree.
r4572.description:
You are standing in what appears to be a huge oak tree.  The tree is almost
entirely hollow, but still seems quite alive.  There must be something divine
at work here.  Looking upwards, you can see that the top of the tree is open
to the sky.  It is a wonder that this place is not victim to the elements.
Not a wind stirs in here, and rain or snow does not enter this sacred place.
An exit in the trunk is to the east, and to the north is another open area
inside of the tree.

descKeys: this wonderful place, and one to the west towards another open area in the tree.
r4573.description:
This room is literally covered with prints from various woodland creatures.
It seems that the animals come in here to just bask in the glow of Eli, the
God of Nature.  The surface of the tree's walls is of course wood, but it
looks like it has almost petrified itself over the years.  Near one of those
walls is a small altar.  The Priests of Eli do not have much use for large
and obnoxious monuments to their Patron, as he only cares what is in their
hearts.  Looking around you notice that there are two exits, one to the south
which heads towards the exit from this wonderful place, and one to the west
towards another open area in the tree.

descKeys: om the outside. you also notice a small ladder on the western wall of the trunk.
r4574.description:
This part of the tree is sparsely occupied.  A few stones are around the
area, evidently used for sitting.  The floor of the area is littered with
leaves and other small forest objects, such as pine cones and bits of root.
The trunk curves in a strange way here, twisting from the west about ten
feet east and then abruptly heading south for many more feet.  It must look
almost 'square'-like from the outside.  You also notice a small ladder on
the western wall of the trunk.

descKeys: nly the hardiest of flora and fauna can possibly survive here in the grey hills.
r4575.description:
The ground is very damp and muddy.  A cold breeze rushes between the
hills; the brisk air waking you up.  A few trees cling to life here in
the mud, despite the apparent lack of sun.  Only the hardiest of flora
and fauna can possibly survive here in the Grey Hills.

descKeys: good time to sit down and think, but the mud would just soak through your pants.
r4576.description:
In the fleeting shadows of the fog, you think you see someone beckoning to
you.  You run towards them, but find only more fog.  Mirages only occur in
deserts, so you wonder how much the moisture has soaked into your mind,
clouding your sanity.  This would be a good time to sit down and think, but
the mud would just soak through your pants.

descKeys: cking your path through the hills. strangely, the air seems warmer to the north.
r4577.description:
A recent mudslide has occurred on this hill.  You surmise that the topology
of the Grey Hills is in constant flux.  Hills grow and recede over the
seasons.  Looking behind you, you see that your footsteps have already begun
to fade, giving you little hope of backtracking your path through the Hills.
Strangely, the air seems warmer to the north.

descKeys: eat of the sun evaporates it away. to the north, grape vines grow under the sun.
r4578.description:
To the south, the Grey Hills rise out of the ground.  As long as the elves
have lived in this area, these hills have never been covered by the forest.
The fog from the hills wafts over the trail, but the heat of the sun
evaporates it away.  To the north, grape vines grow under the sun.

descKeys: every pore of your being. the wind howling between the hills reaches your ears.
r4579.description:
To the south begin the Grey Hills.  Your feet begin to slip as the muddy
trail takes on a steady incline.  The cold, wet wind soaks through your
clothes and every pore of your being.  The wind howling between the hills
reaches your ears.

descKeys: he farmlands. looking south, you see how close the elves farm to the grey hills.
r4580.description:
Directly to your north, you see a large row of tomato plants.  The large
plants cast a few playful shadows on the trail.  Alongside the trail is a
ditch, presumably used for irrigating the farmlands.  Looking south, you
see how close the elves farm to the Grey Hills.

descKeys: gins to rise, you hear more and more the sharp howling of the wind in the hills.
r4581.description:
Your feet slip around a lot because the trail is quite close to the Grey
Hills at this point.  Cold, wet winds pelt moisture into every pore of your
being.  As the trail begins to rise, you hear more and more the sharp howling
of the wind in the hills.

descKeys: gh the grey hills are a bit to the south, you do not feel their harsh, wet cold.
r4582.description:
Directly to your north is an orchard.  The trees are packed so dense that
you first mistook them for being part of the forest you see to the east in
the distance.  The trail here is quite firm and even here.  Though the Grey
Hills are a bit to the south, you do not feel their harsh, wet cold.

descKeys: he air. the trail goes straight east here, staying ever close to the grey hills.
r4583.description:
The trail breaks off here to the north, leading into the orchard.  The trees
are among the healthiest trees you have ever seen.  Each one rises easily
forty feet into the air.  The trail goes straight east here, staying ever
close to the Grey Hills.

descKeys: rd and a forest. the forest to the east looks to be thick and heavy with plants.
r4584.description:
There is a marked difference between the lands north and south of the trail.
The Grey Hills loom to the south under a heavy fog, while to the north, rich
soil feeds both an orchard and a forest.  The forest to the east looks to be
thick and heavy with plants.

descKeys: in the forest suggests that elves have been cultivating the plants around here.
r4585.description:
The Grey Hills loom to the south, and the air here has a subtle chill to
it, likely coming from the winds from the Hills.  The trail continues between
the forest and the hills.  The thick plant life in the forest suggests that
elves have been cultivating the plants around here.

descKeys: ture here a bit chilly. to the west, the trail leads eventually back to elinost.
r4586.description:
The trail breaks off to the south, leading to the Grey Hills.  The forest to
the east is beginning to shadow eveything around you.  The shade plus the wet
winds from the hills makes the temperature here a bit chilly.  To the west,
the trail leads eventually back to Elinost.

descKeys: that little sunlight manages to penetrate the thick canopy created by the trees.
r4587.description:
Immediately to the east, a large forest begins.  The trail appears to go on
through the forest, though you have a hard time calling that mess of roots
and rocks a trail.  You notice that little sunlight manages to penetrate the
thick canopy created by the trees.

descKeys: e trail itself is made from loose dirt, and looks like it is not used very much.
r4588.description:
The trail is running east and west, looking the same in both directions.  The
sides of the trail are lined with trees, so thick that you can barely even
see between them, let alone head off from the path through them.  The trail
itself is made from loose dirt, and looks like it is not used very much.

descKeys: the trail is not used very much, leading you to wonder what exactly is out here.
r4589.description:
The trail takes a turn here, heading both west and southeast.  Some of the
tops of the trees that line the trail are hanging over the trail.  A few of
them even touch the ground in a few places.  Looking down, you notice that the
trail is not used very much, leading you to wonder what exactly is out here.

descKeys: the trees lining the trail are thick, preventing you from heading off into them.
r4590.description:
The trail is about five feet wide at this point, barely enough room for two
people to stand shoulder to shoulder and walk down it.  Whatever this trail
leads to must be remote, and not well-visited.  The trees lining the trail
are thick, preventing you from heading off into them.

descKeys: ee a small opening in the trees to the east, barely discernable from this angle.
r4591.description:
The trail suddenly stops at this point, only heading back to the west.  It
seems as if the people who made the trail made it to this point and just
stopped.  Thinking that, you do see a small opening in the trees to the east,
barely discernable from this angle.

descKeys: utheast. before you leave, you do notice a small space in the trees to the west.
r4592.description:
The trail seems to end here, however, it does travel back to the southeast.
The trail is approximately six feet wide, just enough space for a small wagon
or such to travel upon it.  Seeing as there is no other way to go, you decide
to head back to the southeast.  Before you leave, you do notice a small space
in the trees to the west.

descKeys: ive feet from your current position, looping around them at an incredible speed.
r4593.description:
The trail is running in two directions, east where it finds its way to a small
stream, and to the northwest where it seems to suddenly stop.  A small bird
flies around a collection of blue flowers, about five feet from your current
position, looping around them at an incredible speed.

descKeys: o cross it fairly easily, assuming you do not inadvertently fall into the water.
r4594.description:
To your north and east, a small stream flows by through the forest.  To the east,
a large tree trunk is laying over the stream, bank to bank, covering the entire
span of the stream.  It looks like you could be able to cross it fairly
easily, assuming you do not inadvertently fall into the water.

descKeys: ow, and the water is not running very fast, so there seems to be no danger here.
r4595.description:
You are on a large tree trunk that is perhaps six feet wide and suprisingly
sturdy, considering that it reaches from one side of a stream to the other.
The stream below you is fairly shallow, and the water is not running very
fast, so there seems to be no danger here.

descKeys: ing the entire width of the stream. otherwise, the trail heads back to the east.
r4596.description:
The trail runs into a small stream at this point, which is to the west.  The
stream is traversable, as someone or something has put a large tree trunk
across it, spanning the entire width of the stream.  Otherwise, the trail
heads back to the east.

descKeys: unk that spans the stream, so it would not be too hard to get to the other side.
r4597.description:
You are on a small trail that is running through a large forest.  The trail
is running east and west.  Directly to the west is a small stream that cuts
the trail in two.  Luckily, there is a tree trunk that spans the stream, so it
would not be too hard to get to the other side.

descKeys: a planned effort by someone. off the trail is a small tree that has red leaves.
r4598.description:
This trail is heading straigh east and west at this point, suprisingly heading
neither to the north or to the south at all.  Noticing this, it is possible
that this trail was no random occurrence, but a planned effort by someone.
Off the trail is a small tree that has red leaves.

descKeys: there is not much here. nevertheless, the only way you see to go is to the west.
r4599.description:
The trail ends here, only heading back to the west.  The trail runs right up
to a large tree and just stops.  Odd that this occurs, as why would someone
make a trail to this point?  There is not much here.  Nevertheless, the only
way you see to go is to the west.

descKeys: he trees that is about four feet off the ground. you may be able to go that way.
r4600.description:
The trail suddenly stops here, only going back to the east.  The trees on
either side of the trail prevent you from heading off the trail, so you cannot
go that way.  However, you do see a small opening in the trees that is about
four feet off the ground.  You may be able to go that way.

descKeys: growing off the side of the path, swaying to and fro gently in the warm breeze.
r4601.description:
The trail turns here, heading both east and northwest.  The trail is about
five feet wide at this point and is easily traversable.  A collection of
tall reeds are growing off the side of the path, swaying to and fro gently
in the warm breeze.

descKeys: in them. this must be one of the preferred spots for birds to raise their young.
r4602.description:
The trees of this huge forest are unsually tall, sometimes reaching heights of
over five hundred feet.  Looking up towards the treetops, you can see many
bird nests in them.  This must be one of the preferred spots for birds to
raise their young.

descKeys: y other direction. a small bush near one side of the trail calls your attention.
r4603.description:
The trail narrows here to about three and a half feet in width, which makes it
a bit tougher to travel upon.  To the sides of the trail are large trees,
blocking you from going in any other direction.  A small bush near one side
of the trail calls your attention.

descKeys: ust be used by forest animals, trying to make their way through the dense trees.
r4604.description:
You are on a dirt trail that leads through the middle of a large and very
expansive forest.  The trail is perhaps five feet wide, and looks like it is
not used that often.  This trail must be used by forest animals, trying to
make their way through the dense trees.

descKeys: at the tops of the trees sometimes reach over one hundred feet, and much higher.
r4605.description:
At this point, the trail is going east and west.  On each side of the trail,
lines of trees prevent you from going any direction besides on the trail.
Looking up you can see that the tops of the trees sometimes reach over one
hundred feet, and much higher.

descKeys: art of the trail, following the trail almost in a straight and also narrow line.
r4606.description:
The trail is meandering its way through the forest.  At this point it is
running west and northeast.  A line of yellow flowers is running along the
southern part of the trail, following the trail almost in a straight and also
narrow line.

descKeys: that the path turns to the left slightly, and then heads back to the west again.
r4607.description:
The trail is about six feet wide at this point.  To the east you can see a
large mound of dirt that is directly to the left of the trail.  Back to the
west you see that the path turns to the left slightly, and then heads back to
the west again.

descKeys: if you head west on the trail, it heads a bit to the left, which is also south.
r4608.description:
You are on a dirt trail that is heading east and west.  Directly to the north
of the trail is a large mound of dirt.  What it is for, or why it is here is
simply beyond you.  If you head east on the trail, it turns a bit to the right.
Likewise, if you head west on the trail, it heads a bit to the left, which is
also south.

descKeys: also see that if you go southeast, the trail will take another turn to the left.
r4609.description:
The trail turns here, heading both west and also southeast.  Towards the
west you see that the trail runs by a large mound of dirt, passing within a
few feet of it.  You also see that if you go southeast, the trail will take
another turn to the left.

descKeys: a bunch of bees and other insects, as their color seems to be quite attractive.
r4610.description:
The trail narrows a bit here, getting down to about four feet in width.  Along
one side of the trail there is a collection of red flowers.  The flowers are
being attended to by a bunch of bees and other insects, as their color seems
to be quite attractive.

descKeys: me reason. the air in this area is still, and a gentle breeze brushes your face.
r4611.description:
The trail widens a bit here, getting to be about eight feet in width.  Looking
at the dirt, you only see a few scattered footprints, and they are mostly
pointed to the east, for some reason.  The air in this area is still, and a
gentle breeze brushes your face.

descKeys: some of these trees somehow get to the amazing height of over one thousand feet.
r4612.description:
The trail is running straight here, going both east and west.  Several large
trees line the north side of the path, towering over you to great heights.
It is said that some of these trees somehow get to the amazing height of
over one thousand feet.

descKeys: and prevent you from heading in any other direction besides following the trail.
r4613.description:
You are on a dirt trail that is leading west and also back to the northeast.
The trail is only about six feet wide and it looks like it is not used very
often.  The trees line the trail and prevent you from heading in any other
direction besides following the trail.

descKeys: y large road. you should be able to head that way if you are not too encumbered.
r4614.description:
You are on a small trail that is perhaps six feet wide.  The route to the
southwest is easily discernable, but the way to the east is a bit tricky.
The trail basically stops about ten feet to the east, but after that it is
only a small tree blocking your way to a very large road.  You should be able
to head that way if you are not too encumbered.

descKeys: uth routes from threshold to kalinport. one small tree stands out in particular.
used by the caravans running the north-south routes from threshold to kalinport.
r4615.description:
The Great Forest totally envelopes you, almost cutting you off from any sort
of view out of the trees.  The area gives you a sense of awe, gazing at the
surrounding greenery.  You are on a large road, about twenty feet in width,
that is used by the caravans running the north-south routes from Threshold
to Kalinport.

descKeys: used by the caravans running the north-south routes from threshold to kalinport.

of view out of the trees.  The area gives you a sense of awe, gazing at the
surrounding greenery.  You are on a large road, about twenty feet in width,
that is used by the caravans running the north-south routes from Threshold
to Kalinport.

descKeys: used by the caravans running the north-south routes from threshold to kalinport.
