descKeys: e and are very green. the trail is made out of packed dirt, and looks well-used.
r4694.description:
You are on a small trail that is leading north, where it hits a larger trail,
and west where it continues on through the forest.  The trees that line the
trail are fairly large and are very green.  The trail is made out of packed
dirt, and looks well-used.

descKeys: rge mammal. small clawprints are upon the dirt path, scattered around your feet.
r4695.description:
The trees are all around you, reaching to heights that astound you.  Small
creatures can be heard chittering among the trees, with the occassional sound
coming from some large mammal.  Small clawprints are upon the dirt path,
scattered around your feet.

descKeys: e reason, there are not very many sounds emanating from this part of the forest.
r4696.description:
The forest thins out just a little bit here.  You can actually see some clouds
which are hanging in the blue sky.  There must not be a good water supply in
this area for the trees to live off of.  For some reason, there are not very
many sounds emanating from this part of the forest.

descKeys: ise, you see a small squirrel scolding you from about four feet above your head.
r4697.description:
The forest continues on and on, although you can spot some sort of structure
off to the west, looking like a tower or something similar.  Looking up in
surprise, you see a small squirrel scolding you from about four feet above
your head.

descKeys: nches. a large stump sits right in the middle of the path, looking weather-worn.
r4698.description:
The forest is alive with sights and smells that assault your senses as you
wander around.  The trees rise so high in the air that they nearly cut off
the sunlight, which streams vainly through the uppermost branches.  A large
stump sits right in the middle of the path, looking weather-worn.

descKeys: unnaturally large. a green moss is growing upon the trees on their north sides.
r4699.description:
A large tree has fallen across the forest path, forcing you to climb over its
large bulk.  Looking around, you cannot even spot where the tree begins or
ends.  The trees in this part of the forest seem unnaturally large.  A green
moss is growing upon the trees on their north sides.

descKeys: th. the dirt path narrows a bit here, dwindling down to about three feet across.
r4700.description:
The trees are thickly numbered in this portion of the deep forest.  They
are so close together it seems like walking down a hallway while you are
travelling upon the dirt path.  The dirt path narrows a bit here, dwindling
down to about three feet across.

descKeys: nd gnarly. a little-used path leads to the southeast, looking quite unappealing.
r4701.description:
A sudden hush in the forest's sounds occurs, giving you an odd sense of
foreboding.  Something is about to happen, your senses scream!  Knowing
this and trusting your intuition, you decide to move on.  The trees off to
your left side are strangely warped and gnarly.  A little-used path leads
to the southeast, looking quite unappealing.

descKeys: moment before heading in that direction, as who knows what could be back there.
r4702.description:
This path is fairly small, being only about eight feet at its widest.  It seems
that an air of gloominess is travelling about the air, and is coming from the
southeast.  You would surely hesitate a moment before heading in that direction,
as who knows what could be back there.

descKeys: on in about seven feet wide and is heading to the northwest and also southeast.
r4703.description:
The trees here have almost been flattened down to their stumps.  Something
that is large and very bulky regularly passes through this region, heading to
who knows where.  The path you are on in about seven feet wide and is heading
to the northwest and also southeast.

descKeys: re travelling in that direction. the path you are on continues to the northwest.
r4704.description:
The path is narrow here, only about five feet in width.  The trees here have
been flattened by something very large.  Towards the south, the forest seems
to get very gloomy, and you hesitate before travelling in that direction.  The
path you are on continues to the northwest.

descKeys: larger and more open area. however, it is quite dark. a path runs to the north.
r4705.description:
This part of the forest is much darker than the rest.  It is as if a
dark cloud of misery has descended upon the area, blotting out anything
that is in any way light-having.  To the south is a larger and more open
area.  However, it is quite dark.  A path runs to the north.

descKeys: aled the sky almost completely. a small hole is in one of a nearby tree's trunk.
r4706.description:
The path gets a little less used here.  It looks like no one comes here any
more, preferring the more lighted parts of the forest.  Here it is as if the
trees have concealed the sky almost completely.  A small hole is in one of
a nearby tree's trunk.

descKeys: ound in the underbrush and surrounding trees, making you a bit nervous and edgy.
r4707.description:
You are in the deep forest situated somewhat southwest of Threshold.  The
huge trees which are surrounding you reach high into the heavens.  Small
animals run around in the underbrush and surrounding trees, making you a bit
nervous and edgy.

descKeys: ldlife. they come here to quench their thirst, as well as to find game to stalk.
r4708.description:
You have stumbled upon a small glade, situated snugly among the tightly packed
trees.  The glade is small, only being perhaps fifteen feet across at its
widest, but very important to the forest wildlife.  They come here to quench
their thirst, as well as to find game to stalk.

descKeys: t all. a large stump lies in front of you, blackened by a lightning bolt strike.
r4709.description:
The trees are tightly packed together here in this part of the deep forest.
High above you, the trees' branches intertwine so much that you could
probably walk through the whole forest without touching the ground at all.
A large stump lies in front of you, blackened by a lightning bolt strike.

descKeys: thwest. even when looking between the trees you cannot see anything but foliage.
r4710.description:
The small path running trough the forest ends here, running up to a group
of tightly packed trees.  The thickly meshed trees would make it impossible
to move any other direction than southwest.  Even when looking between the
trees you cannot see anything but foliage.

descKeys: e saplings. the leaves of most of the trees are starting to turn brown in color.
r4711.description:
You are standing in the deep forest, gazing about in wonder over the huge
trees.  They are so tall that it boggles the mind on how ancient they must
be, and who was even around when they were mere saplings.  The leaves of most
of the trees are starting to turn brown in color.

descKeys: close-knit trees. speaking of trees, the ones around here are greener than most.
r4712.description:
A large elk with a huge rack upon his majestic head stares at you through
cautious eyes.  Never moving his eyes from your face, he carefully trots
away, dodging through the close-knit trees.  Speaking of trees, the ones
around here are greener than most.

descKeys: nrecyclable uses. on one of the trees a large 'x' has been carved into the bark.
r4713.description:
The trees seem endless.  Luckily the human loggers have not reached this
serene section of the forest yet.  It would be a shame to have all of these
trees cut down and used for various unrecyclable uses.  On one of the trees
a large 'X' has been carved into the bark.

descKeys: on the forest floor. on a nearby tree's branch you can spot a small bird's nest.
r4714.description:
The trees here seem about the same as the more northern part of the forest.
They are close together, and very tall, reaching far into the sky.  Strangely,
you do not see any dead trees lying upon the forest floor.  On a nearby tree's
branch you can spot a small bird's nest.

descKeys: have been smaller at one time, due to the chisel marks on the lip of the cavern.
r4716.description:
You are standing in a clearing that has been made in the forest.  Many sets
of footprints litter the ground, giving you a sense of foreboding.  A small
cave is to the west, looking quite dark.  The cave looks to have been smaller
at one time, due to the chisel marks on the lip of the cavern.

descKeys: e walls of the cave, you can spot a few crude drawings scratched into the stone.
r4717.description:
This cave is quite dank and humid.  An awful smell emanates from the deeper
parts of the cave, giving you a clue on to whom this cave belongs.  A small
clearing in the forest outside of the cave lies to the east.  Looking at the
walls of the cave, you can spot a few crude drawings scratched into the stone.

descKeys: have burn marks, as if the denizens of this region enjoy setting things on fire.
r4718.description:
You are standing in a clearing that has been made in the forest.  Many sets
of footprints are on the ground, scattered about.  At the edge of the large
clearing, some of the trees have burn marks, as if the denizens of this
region enjoy setting things on fire.

descKeys: rints you can spot a small hole, as if someone has unearthed something recently.
r4719.description:
You are standing in a clearing that has been made in the forest.  Many sets
of footprints are on the ground, scattered about.  At the edge of the large
clearing, the trees have been hacked on with crude axes it looks like,
making large and jagged cuts in the bark.  The clearing continues to the
east and northeast.  Near one of the groups of footprints you can spot a small
hole, as if someone has unearthed something recently.

descKeys: looking towards the north you can see that the trees end, and the plains start.
r4720.description:
This path is running through the forest, heading both northwest and southeast.
The roadway is used for travel between the east coast of Kalin and the Plains
of Nereka.  The trees here line the road, and generally are quite large.
Looking towards the north you can see that the trees end, and the plains start.

descKeys: green and brown colors abounding. it looks like the path is used often, as well.
r4721.description:
The path is still running through trees here.  Up to the north you can see
that the trees end and the plains start.  The path is lined with large and
lush trees, green and brown colors abounding.  It looks like the path is
used often, as well.

descKeys: es. it seems that this part of the path is used regularly, judging by the width.
r4722.description:
You are standing at the forest's edge.  To the northwest lies the Plains of
Nereka, stretching out as far as you can see.  Back to the southeast the
deep and lush forest continues.  It seems that this part of the path is used
regularly, judging by the width.

descKeys: bush, startling you. the bunny then bounds away at top speed, running in terror.
r4723.description:
The Plains are running in every direction, going for miles and miles.  A
huge bush is right in front of you, looking quite out of place.  A small
rabbit bounds out from under the bush, startling you.  The bunny then bounds
away at top speed, running in terror.

descKeys: existence. keeping that in mind, you look around for some clues, but find none.
r4726.description:
Among the vast forest lies this ominous black tower.  Although the door is
readily accessible, you understandibly hesitate before entering.  There
seems to be no logical explanation for this tower's existence.  Keeping
that in mind, you look around for some clues, but find none.

descKeys: e long lost to moths. a small flight of stairs lead up into the gloomy darkness.
r4727.description:
It looks like whomever created this tower has been long dead.  Cobwebs and
dust lay over everything like a thick blanket.  A large tapestry covers the
northern side of the room, depecting a scene long lost to moths.  A small
flight of stairs lead up into the gloomy darkness.

descKeys: all is easily discernable. someone or something must have cleaned this place up.
r4728.description:
You are on the top floor of the strange black tower.  This floor of the tower
is distinctly different from the ground floor.  No dust can be seen, and the
immense tapestry covering this northern wall is easily discernable.  Someone
or something must have cleaned this place up.

descKeys: walls, enclosed in the art they served during their mortal years on this plane.
r4729.description:
You jump through the mirror, landing on a hard stone floor on the 'other' side.
You are standing in the Bastion of High Sorcery.  For several centuries the
Bastion has existed, having been constructed by a few dozen of the most
powerful magic-users in existence at the time.  A retreat for the often-
scorned mages, the Bastion is a center for learning and sometimes even a
final resting place for old mages who come here to be emtombed within the
magic tower's walls, enclosed in the Art they served during their mortal
years on this plane.

descKeys: p throughout the room, allowing any conference of mages to sit down comfortably.
r4730.description:
You are in the immense meeting hall of the Bastion of High Sorcery.  The
room seems to stretch for several hundred yards, but this must be some sort
of magical illusion, for the tower looks to be only a hundred feet across
from the outside!  Rows of tables are lined up throughout the room, allowing
any conference of mages to sit down comfortably.

descKeys: d rug covers the entire floor of the meeting hall, stretching for endless yards.

Bastion of High Sorcery Guild Board [142.name: Bastion of High Sorcery Guild Board [142 messages,142 new]

r4731.description:
The meeting hall continues throughout the Bastion.  The large wooden tables
around you have comfortable wooden chairs set around them, allowing for the
ultimate in easeful meetings.  A finely-crafted rug covers the entire floor
of the meeting hall, stretching for endless yards.

descKeys: ues seem to move now and then, but it must be a trick of the light or something.
r4732.description:
The meeting hall stretches far before you, about three hundred yards in its
length.  Ornate statues line the walls, staring back at you with an amused
disinterest.  The statues seem to move now and then, but it must be a trick
of the light or something.

descKeys: of the tower's private chambers. off to the west is the bastion's meeting hall.
r4733.description:
You are standing on the first floor of the huge staircase in the Bastion of
High Sorcery.  The fifteen foot wide staircase winds its way to the top of
the tall tower, ending near the Master of the Tower's private chambers.  Off
to the west is the bastion's meeting hall.

descKeys: ircase, made out of black marble, has no cracks or imperfections on its surface.
r4734.description:
The large and ornate staircase winds its way up and down the full length of
the Bastion.  You are currently standing on the second floor landing, and
can continue up or down, or go west towards the Bastion's immense library.
The staircase, made out of black marble, has no cracks or imperfections on
its surface.

descKeys: around the room for those mages who like to just grab a book and start reading.
r4735.description:
You have entered the huge and extensive library of the Bastion.  Thousands
of books, scrolls, and parchments fill the many shelves around the library,
adding to the Bastion's knowledge an immense amount. A few small chairs have
been set around the room for those mages who like to just grab a book and
start reading.

descKeys: tables have been put here, one of which has a world map painted on its surface.
r4736.description:
You are in the section of the library which holds the huge books detailing
the histories of the various cultures and civilizations that have existed
at one time on this world.  A few small tables have been put here, one of
which has a world map painted on its surface.

descKeys: t over an immense and green forest. a small table is here, covered with scrolls.
r4737.description:
The library is quite large, filled with thousands of compendiums and other
sources of a mage's obsession : knowledge.  A small window, one of the few
that you have seen in the Bastion, is set against one wall, looking out over
an immense and green forest.  A small table is here, covered with scrolls.

descKeys: iding a place for a weary mage to sit down after hours of studying or searching.
r4738.description:
The Bastion's library is one of the largest in the world.  Mages come from
all over the world to peruse the books, looking for some bit of obscure
information that is vital to their private studies.  A few chairs have been
set up around the area, providing a place for a weary mage to sit down after
hours of studying or searching.

descKeys: n-mage visitors. the staircase is made out of black marble, and shines brightly.
r4739.description:
You are standing on the third floor landing of the Bastion.  To the west is
the living quarters of visiting mages, apprentices to the Master of the
Bastion, and (rarely) non-mage visitors.  The staircase is made out of black
marble, and shines brightly.

descKeys: bit as it goes up from here, tuning down to a mere four feet across at the top.
r4740.description:
The fourth floor landing is quite large, being about forty feet across.  It
seems that a lot of traffic moves in and around this floor.  To the west is
the huge research room of the Bastion, efficiently dubbed the 'Hotzone'.
The staircase shrinks a bit as it goes up from here, tuning down to a mere
four feet across at the top.

descKeys: out from four feet to about ten feet across. there is a iron door leading west .
r4741.description:
You are standing on the landing of the top floor of the Bastion.  Home to
the Master of the Bastion, the top floor is rarely visited by any person or
thing other than the Master himself.  A large iron door, one of the few in
this tower, is set against the western wall and is said to be unopenable by
anyone other than the Master.  The staircase heads downwards, widening out
from four feet to about ten feet across.
There is a iron door leading west ( LOCKED ).

descKeys: nding to the fact that volatile spells are unleashed in this very research room.
r4742.description:
You had best be wary, for you are now in the 'Hotzone.'  This immense research
area has been used for centuries for all sorts of spell testing and other
such miscellaneous researching activities.  Huge tables made out of some
sort of hard material are about the room, each of them having scorch marks
prevalent on their surfaces.  The walls are also scarred with many scorch
marks too, lending to the fact that volatile spells are unleashed in this
very research room.

descKeys: have surrounded the graveyard look like they have been systematically poisoned.
r4743.description:
You are in an old graveyard, once used by the town of Threshold to bury
their dead within its boundaries.  Weeds and tall grass grow all over the
place, almost covering the graves and headstones.  The trees that have
surrounded the graveyard look like they have been systematically poisoned.

descKeys: have surrounded the graveyard look like they have been systematically poisoned.
r4744.description:
You are in an old graveyard, once used by the town of Threshold to bury
their dead within its boundaries.  Weeds and tall grass grow all over the
place, almost covering the graves and headstones.  The trees that have
surrounded the graveyard look like they have been systematically poisoned.

descKeys: have surrounded the graveyard look like they have been systematically poisoned.
r4745.description:
You are in an old graveyard, once used by the town of Threshold to bury
their dead within its boundaries.  Weeds and tall grass grow all over the
place, almost covering the graves and headstones.  The trees that have
surrounded the graveyard look like they have been systematically poisoned.

descKeys: one and mortar. a small metal plate is underneath the water, barely discernable.
r4746.description:
You are standing ankle deep in some brackish water, as far as you can see.
Looking upwards, you see a faint touch of light at the top of the well, no
doubt leading to Kraken Alley.  The sides of the well are made out of
packed stone and mortar.  A small metal plate is underneath the water, barely
discernable.

descKeys: re tightly. a small metal plate is against the southern wall, looking quite odd.
r4747.description:
As you step on the plate a wall moves in a 180 degree circle, dumping you
in about five inches of water in the other side.
You are standing in about five inches of water.  Looking around, you see that
the walls of these catacombs are made from packed dirt, and is liable to
cave in at any time.  A slight chill is permeating the area, causing you to
clutch at your clothing a bit more tightly.  A small metal plate is against
the southern wall, looking quite odd.

descKeys: ary of your actions. here and there a rat scurries past on some rat-like errand.
r4748.description:
The catacombs branch off here in three different directions, equally dark
and dank.  The walls are almost in a crumbling state, causing you to be a
bit more wary of your actions.  Here and there a rat scurries past on some
rat-like errand.

descKeys: not look very stable, as if it could come crashing down upon you at any moment.
r4749.description:
You are standing in yet another intersection of the catacombs.  Trekking
around in these catacombs, it is easy to get our directions mixed up and to
wander around aimlessly.  The ceiling at this intersection does not look
very stable, as if it could come crashing down upon you at any moment.

descKeys: le of straw is floating in the water, looking like some sort of decrepit dinghy.
r4750.description:
You have reached an intersection in the catacombs.  Three passageways of
equal darkness lead from here, continuing deeper into the catacombs.  A pile
of straw is floating in the water, looking like some sort of decrepit dinghy.

descKeys: of dirt are missing, making you sense that the tunnels are not entirely stable.
r4751.description:
The catacombs turn here, heading west and towards the south.  The ceiling
above you is made from the same material as the walls: packed dirt.  As you
are looking at the ceiling, you notice that a few mounds of dirt are missing,
making you sense that the tunnels are not entirely stable.

descKeys: l the way to your skin. the wall to the west looks slightly out of the ordinary.
r4752.description:
You are underneath Threshold, deep within the catacombs.  Many have travelled
its depths, but few have returned, at least returned alive.  A five inch
tepid pool of water surrounds your ankles, soaking your footwear all the way
to your skin.  The wall to the west looks slightly out of the ordinary.

descKeys: causing you to cringe. a small pit in the side of the wall draws your attention.
r4753.description:
The catacombs run underneath Threshold for what seems like miles.  It could
be quite easy for you to get lost down here.  A faint scratching noise
reaches your ears, causing you to cringe.  A small pit in the side of the
wall draws your attention.

descKeys: your ankles, is also exuding a foul stench, as if the water was indeed polluted.
r4754.description:
The smell of a musty decay permeates your nostrils, almost giving you an
immense headache.  The water, which reaches up almost to your ankles, is
also exuding a foul stench, as if the water was indeed polluted.

descKeys: d. the ground looks like hewn stone, and does not resemble the walls or ceiling.
r4755.description:
The catacombs are running east and west at this point.  The water that has
been a constant companion, swishing around your ankles, suddenly vanishes,
leaving you standing on dry ground.  The ground looks like hewn stone, and
does not resemble the walls or ceiling.

descKeys: six inches deep and is probably home to a family of rats or another such rodent.
r4756.description:
The intersection you at situated at leads three directions, with each of
the tunnels being exceedingly dark and dank.  A small hole near the bottom
of the northern wall is about six inches deep and is probably home to a
family of rats or another such rodent.

descKeys: attempts to dig out the cave-in, but the attempts seem to have been to no avail.
r4757.description:
You are at the sight of a cave-in.  It seems that a huge amount of rock and
dirt just got too heavy to be supported without any beams and then crashed
to the dirt ground.  It also looks like there has been some attempts to
dig out the cave-in, but the attempts seem to have been to no avail.

descKeys: point is made out of, strangely enough, mortar. you must be beneath a building.
r4759.description:
You have reached yet another intersection in the catacombs beneath Threshold.
Each direction seems darker than the last, with strange sounds assaulting
you from each way.  The ceiling at this point is made out of, strangely
enough, mortar.  You must be beneath a building.

descKeys: izing salad. a small metal plate is on the ground, just under the water's level.
r4760.description:
The catacombs curve slightly here, heading west and to the northeast.  A
few drops of water are dripping down from the celing, hitting the five inch
deep pool of water with a slight 'plop.'  A light-green fungus is growing
on one of the walls, looking like an unappetizing salad.  A small metal plate
is on the ground, just under the water's level.

descKeys: s. a scurrying sound behind you causes you to whirl around, but you see nothing.
r4761.description:
The catacombs run along a straight path here, heading to the west and also
to the east.  The water surrounding your ankles subsides to only about two
inches in depth, but still stinks nonetheless.  A scurrying sound behind
you causes you to whirl around, but you see nothing.

descKeys: ainst one wall. there must be a huge population of rats down in these catacombs.
r4762.description:
The passageway curves here, heading both to the north and to the east.  A
large rat scurries by your feet and then disappears into a dark hole near
the water line against one wall.  There must be a huge population of rats
down in these catacombs.

descKeys: the passageway for some reason. the catacombs do continue to the west, however.
r4764.description:
You have reached a dead-end in the catacombs.  The tunnel runs right up to a
dirt wall to the east.  It looks like that this wall has been erected to
cut off the passageway for some reason.  The catacombs do continue to the
west, however.

descKeys: the entire length of the corridor, which does end to the west a few more steps.
r4765.description:
This small hallway runs between several rooms, used by various visitors to
the Bastion and by the Master's several apprentices.  A finely-crafted rug
is running the entire length of the corridor, which does end to the west a
few more steps.

descKeys: inst the northeastern wall and a small chest of drawers is against another wall.
r4766.description:
This small room is used by one of the Master's apprentices.  The young mage
spends his off-hours in here, quietly going over spells or just studying up
on the world's history.  A bed is against the northeastern wall and a small
chest of drawers is against another wall.

descKeys: hem, imp is right in front of you, staring up at you with huge and cunning eyes.
r4767.description:
The corridor ends to the west, but also leads north and south into two small
rooms.  A rug runs throughout the hallway, adding a small spring to your
step.  An impish statue of an, ahem, imp is right in front of you, staring
up at you with huge and cunning eyes.

descKeys: me. a large bed is against one wall which could sleep up to six or seven people.
r4768.description:
The large room has been richly furnished with finely-crafted rugs and many
large cushions strewn about the room.  Since there are not many visitors of
the non-magic-using sort to the Bastion, the Mages here like to impress
the few who do come.  A large bed is against one wall which could sleep up
to six or seven people.

descKeys: rea is far from being squallid, as the clean road being a proven factor of this.
r189.description:
The Southern Warrens is home to many of the lower-caste members of the
Dunkrist citizenry.  The houses around this area are small and crowded
together for the most part.  However, this area is far from being squallid,
as the clean road being a proven factor of this.

descKeys: the cavern. off to the east is the entrance to the largest building in dunkrist.
r190.description:
You are in the Southern Warrens of Dunkrist, home to the everyday citizens of
the city.  You see several medium-sized houses that have been carved out of
the stone wall of the cavern.  Off to the east is the entrance to the largest
building in Dunkrist.

descKeys: place. it looks as if the city's builders are planning upon expanding dunkrist.
r191.description:
You are just north of the Southern Warrens, which houses about two-thirds of
the city's populace.  Looking to the east, you see that a recent delving into
the cavern's walls has taken place.  It looks as if the city's builders are
planning upon expanding Dunkrist.

descKeys: ards the waste warrens. there is an archway to the north that leads to a smithy.
r192.description:
The road bends sharply to the northwest here, leading towards the merchant's
plaza, while also continuing west through the Southern Warrens.  One of the
houses catches your eye, as it seems to be leaning quite a bit, looking like
it may fall over at any minute.  A small trail that is cut in the rock leads
east, towards the Waste Warrens.  There is an archway to the north that leads
to a smithy.

descKeys: l door is hanging open, and another archway leads south to the southern warrens.
r193.description:
You are in a small shop that is used as a Blacksmithy.  A large anvil, close
to the ground, is in one corner of the shop.  A forge is right in the middle
of the area, and is where the smith does most of his work.  A small door is
hanging open, and another archway leads south to the Southern Warrens.

descKeys: . a small door is hanging open that leads back to the regular blacksmith's shop.
r194.description:
This small shop is used by an Smith, who specializes in sharpening weapons
of various shapes and sizes.  An anvil is near the center of the room, and is
the Weaponsmith's main working area.  A small door is hanging open that leads
back to the regular Blacksmith's shop.

descKeys: down the middle of the walkway is a stream of fetid water that smells terrible.
r563.description:
You are in the Southern Warrens of Dunkrist.  The houses and buildings here
are not in the best of shape.  Evidently the lower class citizens of the
city live here.  Running down the middle of the walkway is a stream of fetid
water that smells terrible.

descKeys: ear the road, going about their daily activities. a large temple is to the west.
r564.description:
One of the poorer sections of the Southern Warrens is located here.  The houses
are extremely dilapidated and one can be left to wonder how they are even
standing.  Various duergar stroll near the road, going about their daily
activities.  A large temple is to the west.

descKeys: t. to the east is a small shop that looks like they specialize in precious gems.
r4770.description:
Commerce Way is running south and north here, passing through the merchant
section of Deepwater.  The road is lined with shops that are milling with
customers, shopping around for this and that.  To the east is a small shop
that looks like they specialize in precious gems.

descKeys: locked and can only be opened by the owner of this shop, a small gnomish fellow.
r4771.description:
You are in a small shop located in the merchant district of Deepwater.  Large
glass cases are around the room, showcasing a large collection of precious
gems.  The cases are magically locked and can only be opened by the owner of
this shop, a small gnomish fellow.

descKeys: inst one wall, with a heavy piece of glass that is right in front of the teller.
r4772.description:
You are in the one and only bank that is within the city limits of Deepwater.
This bank has only been around for five or six years, but in that time it
has done a brisk business.  A large counter is against one wall, with a
heavy piece of glass that is right in front of the teller.

descKeys: is flapping loudly from a slight breeze that is coming off of the bay of aurel.
r4773.description:
You are in the merchant section of Deepwater, walking along Commerce Way, a
well-used road heading north and south.  Several shops are in this area and
offer a large selection of goods, both foreign and local.  A small alley is
to the west and a large shop is to the northeast.  East of here, there is a
large building that is made out of brick.  Hanging off the building there
is a large flag that is flapping loudly from a slight breeze that is coming
off of the bay of Aurel.

descKeys: , as it used to be located closer to the docks. the exit to the shop leads east.
r4774.description:
This small shop reeks of fish.  The owner of the shop buys and sells fish
from here, whenever he is not out fishing himself.  The shop has not been
in town for very long, as it used to be located closer to the docks.  The
exit to the shop leads east.

descKeys: buildings around this area are mostly small and in need of some kind of repair.
r4776.description:
You are travelling upon Fenster Road.  The roadway leads north where it ends
in front of a small and grubby building and southeast where it hits some
sort of check point.  The buildings around this area are mostly small and in
need of some kind of repair.

descKeys: uth you can see the bay of aurel. it looks as if fenster road ends to the north.
r4777.description:
Fenster Road is the road you are on, travelling south, you would hit the
city docks.  To the west is a small building that has an unpleasant smell
eminating from within.  No telling what is in that building.  Off to the south
you can see the Bay of Aurel.  It looks as if Fenster Road ends to the north.

descKeys: e staircase looks rickety, but it would probably be able to hold up your weight.
r4778.description:
This is Fenster Road.  At this point the road starts and then leads to the
south.  At the end of the road is a small staircase that leads down to the
sands of the beach.  The staircase looks rickety, but it would probably be
able to hold up your weight.

descKeys: food supply. off to the west is the main dock which then leads north and south.
r4779.description:
Fish trainer peers intently at his fishing line.
You are travelling upon a smaller dock reserved for the watercrafts that are
smaller in size.  The boats are mainly used by the local fishermen to go out
on the Bay and catch their food supply.  Off to the west is the main dock which
then leads north and south.

descKeys: mostly smaller boats, used mainly for fishing, the main dock is off to the west.
r4780.description:
You are at the end of a small dock.  To the east is a long stretch of water
until it hits the shore.  Beyond that shore is the Plains of Nereka.  Around
this area are mostly smaller boats, used mainly for fishing,  The main dock
is off to the west.

descKeys: in dock continues on to the east. ships that are heading to deepwater dock here.

transit.label: Kendrite Passages ship
transit.howTo: buy a pass at the company office (`routes`, `purchase N`), then at this berth `board ship`, `ready`

board ship.note: Kendrite Passages ship to Deepwater: buy a pass at the company office (`routes`, `purchase N`), then at this berth `board ship`, `ready`

r4781.description:
The ships of the Kendrite Passages shipping company are berthed here.  The
three-masted schooners are very seaworthy and capable of attaining high
speeds in the open sea.  The rest of the company's main dock continues on to
the east.  Ships that are heading to Deepwater dock here.

descKeys: er, as well as their shadows. there is an enclosed building to the north of you.
r4782.description:
As you carefully reach the end of the pier, the wind really kicks up, and you
are almost knocked off the pier.  The view is worth it though.  You have
never seen anything like it.  The sun's beams radiate off the Sea of
Honshale, and the ships look like diamonds in the dark blue abyss.  You can
even see the reflection of the few clouds in the sky on the water, as well as
their shadows.  There is an enclosed building to the north of you.

descKeys: is not as high up as the western pier, so you are basically looking down on it.
r4783.description:
As you pass the sailors, you feel the wind pick up.  You then realize why the
sailors stayed at the base of the pier.  The wind chills you to the bone, and
you feel as though sitting with the sailors would not be a bad idea.  You can
see the eastern pier, though it is not as high up as the western pier, so you
are basically looking down on it.

descKeys: ut towards the end of the pier is because the cool winds will blow out the fire.
r4784.description:
When you get to the western pier you begin to hear some of the wild tales of
the sailors.  They all sound quite bogus, but it is a good way to entertain
themselves.  They all are sitting on rocks in a circle, with a nice warm fire
in the middle.  You think the reason that they aren't out towards the end of
the pier is because the cool winds will blow out the fire.

descKeys: docked all around it. not to mention the ships leaving and entering the harbor.
r4785.description:
As you look to the west you see the western pier more clear.  It seems to be
a sailor's hangout.  You see them there congregating and talking about their
last voyages.  To the north you see the dock.  It seems to be a long strip.
Large vessels are docked all around it.  Not to mention the ships leaving and
entering the harbor.

descKeys: s into the sea in hopes of catching dinner. there is a wood door leading north .
r4786.description:
As you enter this clearing, you smell the bittersweet smell of salt coming
off the ocean.  There are two piers, one to the east of you, and one to the
west.  This looks like a nice little harbor.  There doesn't seem to be much
action through this part of the harbor, only a couple of sailors and
fishermen moping about.  Most of the fishermen are on the eastern pier
casting their lines into the sea in hopes of catching dinner.
There is a wood door leading north ( CLOSED ).

descKeys: e piers. there are many boats, and some you can see way off the in the distance.
r4787.description:
You seem to be at the base of the eastern pier.  You see lots of fishermen,
some having luck and others not doing so well.  From this pier you can see
the dock, it is between the piers.  There are many boats, and some you can
see way off the in the distance.

descKeys: e a lot easier to see in this area. you can also see farther out into the ocean.
r4788.description:
You are more than half way up the pier.  From here you can see some of the
fishermen's catches.  They look quite large, but not a meal of course.  You
notice a slight slope in this pier, and you can see a lot more now.  The
ships are a lot easier to see in this area.  You can also see farther out
into the ocean.

descKeys: ntrigues you. you are pretty close to the sea, but a fall would not be pleasant.
r4789.description:
As you carefully reach the end of the pier, you seem to barely have your
balance.  You can really see the Sea of Honshale now, and the view of the
ships that are farther away is great.  They look so small, which intrigues
you.  You are pretty close to the sea, but a fall would not be pleasant.

descKeys: ng. you can also see the tips of a castle protruding from the top of the forest.
r4790.description:
As you arrive here you realize that there is a small harbor to the north.
When you stop to take the time to look around you realize that this is one of
the most serene places you have ever set your eyes on.  There is a small path
leading down south towards an opening.  You can also see the tips of a castle
protruding from the top of the forest.

descKeys: ear throughout the area, but there is nothing that looks like it could cause it.
r4791.description:
As you walk into the opening, the woods around you are all extremely light
and beautiful.  There are four paths leading to different directions.  The
path to the south will take you towards a castle in the distance.  Another
two paths just lead further into the woods. Then there is a path leading back
towards the ocean. There is still a sense of fear throughout the area, but
there is nothing that looks like it could cause it.

descKeys: an opening to the north, or you can go towards the castle on the southern path.
r4792.description:
As you continue to walk on the path, you look around and see that the woods
are becoming increasingly thick.  You can still see the tips of a castle up
above the trees, and it is slowly getting closer to you.  The path leads back
into an opening to the north, or you can go towards the castle on the
southern path.

descKeys: castle, but at this point the trees have blocked most of the view of the castle.
r4793.description:
The woods around you take away most of the light.  You couldn't make it very
far off the path if you attempted to walk off of it.  Off to the east you can
see the small dwarven town of Kelton.  The main path leads to the south
towards a large castle, but at this point the trees have blocked most of the
view of the castle.

descKeys: n head south to reach the drawbridge of the castle or back north into the woods.
r4794.description:
When you arrive and look around a large castle towards the south immediately
draws your attention.  As you look up at the castle it looks as if it is
extremely old.  The castle is made of all stone, and there is a small
drawbridge that leads you over the moat.  You can head south to reach the
drawbridge of the castle or back north into the woods.

descKeys: ee a guard station. to the north of you is a path that leads back to the forest.
r4795.description:
You are standing at the drawbridge that leads south to the Castle Lorasin.
The castle has four towers, one at each corner of the castle, and there is a
large moat surrounding it.  Further ahead south you see a guard station.  To
the north of you is a path that leads back to the forest.

descKeys: astle. to the north of you is the drawbridge that leads back to the island path.
r4796.description:
You are standing at the drawbridge in front of the huge iron gates of Castle
Lorasin, that lead south into the hall.  There are two guard checkpoints here
to stop troublemakers from entering the castle.  To the north of you is the
drawbridge that leads back to the island path.

descKeys: , and there is also a stairway leading down to the basement areas of the castle.
r4797.description:
You are standing in a large hall inside Castle Lorasin.  The entire castle
appears to be built with stone bricks.  There is a large window at the
northern wall that provides light for the entire room.  In each corner there
is a statue resembling the owner if this castle, Lord Lorasin.  Ahead south
there is a corridor leading further into the castle, and there is also a
stairway leading down to the basement areas of the castle.

descKeys: the castle staff's living quarters. to the west is the kitchen and dining room.

decaying remains of Lorasin castle guard.name: decaying remains of Lorasin castle guard

r4798.description:
You are south from the main hall of the castle, in an intersection that leads
off to the south, east, and west.  This place is inhabited by elves, but it
doesn't look very elven-like to you.  Its a bit darker here, but most of the
light still comes from the hall north of here.  You see a garden to the
south.  To the east is the castle staff's living quarters.  To the west is
the kitchen and dining room.

descKeys: , but also for ornamental purposes. to the north you see the castle's main hall.
r4799.description:
You are in a corridor heading further south into the castle.  You can see the
castle garden south from here.  There are lit candles on the walls to make up
for the low lumination in the area, but also for ornamental purposes.  To the
north you see the castle's main hall.

descKeys: west and find the entrance to the large castle, or you can continue on the path.
r4800.description:
There is a small path here that leads you through the trees and past the
castle.  The castle is is to the south of you, and the path continues towards
the east.  You can head back towards the west and find the entrance to the
large castle, or you can continue on the path.

descKeys: ast taking you further away from the ocean and towards the middle of the island.
r4801.description:
There is a small path here that leads you through the trees and past the
castle.  The castle is is to the southwest of you and it is getting harder to
see due to the trees in the way.  You can head back towards the west to get
to the front of the castle.  The path continues on towards the east taking
you further away from the ocean and towards the middle of the island.

descKeys: and also heads back to the west towards the castle and the rest of civilization.
r4802.description:
There are trees all around you now, and it seems as if you have become a
loner once again.  There is no sign of civilization anywhere around you, all
that is around you is trees, and the small path you are walking on.  The path
heads to the south going around the outside of the castle, and also heads
back to the west towards the castle and the rest of civilization.

descKeys: are in some sort of utopia. the path continues towards the south and the north.
r4803.description:
You arrive here, and the serene nature of the island is shown to you.  If
this path weren't here you would think that you are the first person to ever
venture to this part of the island.  It is nice to get away from civilization
and have some time alone in nature.  The trees are sensational, and the warm
weather make it seem as if you are in some sort of utopia.  The path
continues towards the south and the north.

descKeys: lowing you to get off of it. the path continues towards the south and the north.
r4804.description:
You continue on the path and are amazed with the beauty of this part of the
island.  You can hear the birds chirping all around you, and the flowers on
the floor are bright and colorful.  The trees are beautiful and still make
huge walls on either side of the path, not allowing you to get off of it.
The path continues towards the south and the north.

descKeys: oking down each way the path leads. it leads to the north, south, and southeast.
r4805.description:
The path leads you here, and there are still huge amounts of trees all around
you, lots of light underbrush, and there are a lot of flowers littering the
forest floor.  The small path leads off into three seperate directions here.
There doesn't seem to be any kind of a change in scenery looking down each
way the path leads.  It leads to the north, south, and southeast.

descKeys: ay on the path at all times. the path heads towards the northwest and the south.
r4806.description:
The path leads on this way, and there are lots of trees surrounding you.
There is also a pretty wide variety of small flowers on the forest floor.
The underbrush is extremely thick and is impassable on both sides of the
path, forcing you to stay on the path at all times.  The path heads towards
the northwest and the south.

descKeys: east that is coming up through the trees. the path heads to the north and south.
r4807.description:
You path takes you here, and as you look around you notice that the path has
widened a small amount, and the trees seem to be less dense.  As you look
around you notice some smoke towards the east that is coming up through the
trees.  The path heads to the north and south.

descKeys: way down towards the south you might see a small brook, you're not sure though.
r4808.description:
The path begins to widen a bit here, allowing you much more space to walk.
You can see some smoke coming from somewhere in the east, you're not quite
sure where though.  You can begin to hear something a bit strange here, and
the path heads towards the north and the south.  Way down towards the south
you might see a small brook, you're not sure though.

descKeys: something towards the northeast. the path leads towards the north and the south.
r4809.description:
This part of the path has opened up significantly, and it is the size of a
decent road.  The trees are still all around you, and the underbrush below
the trees has lightened up a bit.  You are almost positive that you can see
the brook from here to the south.  You can also begin to hear it.  You can
see a bit of smoke rising up from something towards the northeast.  The path
leads towards the north and the south.

descKeys: s to run along the bank towards the east, and it also goes up towards the north.
r4810.description:
You walk right up next to the brook, and the beauty of it is amazing.  You
can see the spring that is feeding it to the southeast.  The water runs past
you and towards the west.  The trees still stops you from heading anyway off
the path.  The path continues to run along the bank towards the east, and it
also goes up towards the north.

descKeys: or southeast. towards the southeast you would walk right past the small spring.
r4811.description:
There is a small spring here feeding the small brook through the woods.
There are lots of trees and other plants around here due to the large amount
of water here.  The trail looks like it has been walked on quite a bit here,
and it leads into three separate directions.  You can head towards the west,
east, or southeast.  Towards the southeast you would walk right past the
small spring.

descKeys: est and the east, and looks as if it has been travelled on quite a bit recently.
r4812.description:
The path continues on leading you through the forest.  You can hear the sound
of running water to the west.  The trees that are all around you are
extremely tall, large, and full of green leaves.  Way up towards your
northeast you can see some smoke rising up from somewhere in the forest.  The
path heads towards the west and the east, and looks as if it has been
travelled on quite a bit recently.

descKeys: coming up from north of you. the path continues towards the southeast and west.
r4813.description:
The path takes a turn to the southeast leading you further into the forest.
The only thing that is keeping you from getting lost is this small path.  The
trees all around you are thick and are providing the forest floor with shade
from the sun.  There is some light getting through the top of the forest and
it's beaming down on a small tree.  You can also see a thick stream of smoke
coming up from north of you.  The path continues towards the southeast and
west.

descKeys: n the forest is going to become. the path heads towards the north and the south.
r4814.description:
There are some small animals that run past you as you arrive here.  The path
is beginning to get overgrown by the forest, and the trees are starting to
become thicker.  It looks as if the further you head south, the more thick
and overgrown the forest is going to become.  The path heads towards the
north and the south.

descKeys: more of a safe way to walk more than a path and it leads to the north and south.
r4815.description:
The forest starts to become more dense here, and there is very little light.
The trees are very close together and the underbrush is extremely thick.  The
path becomes quite hard to distinguish from the rest of the forest floor, but
you can still see it.  It is now more of a safe way to walk more than a path
and it leads to the north and south.

descKeys: two ways it looks as if you could stand any chance at going is north and south.
r4816.description:
It is incredibly dense here, and very hard for you to walk at all.  The trees
and underbrush have completey overtaken the path, but it opens up more to the
south, where you think you may have caught a glimpse of the ocean.  There is
hardly any light here making it even more difficult to find your way.  The
only two ways it looks as if you could stand any chance at going is north and
south.

descKeys: ot, while the northern part doesn't look like people travel that way very often.
r4817.description:
Here there are three different ways to travel.  A couple other small trails
merge here taking you in different directions.  The trees are extremely thick
here, and it is getting quite dark.  The paths lead to the west, east, and
north.  Towards the east it looks like that has been travelled a lot, while
the northern part doesn't look like people travel that way very often.

descKeys: th. you can also head towards the east, where it is quite dark compared to here.
r4818.description:
The nature here has pretty much overgrown the path, and everything around
you.  You can see a faint way to walk through here, but your not too sure if
it will lead you anywhere.  Up towards the northwest you can see this 'path'
merge into another larger path.  You can also head towards the east, where it
is quite dark compared to here.

descKeys: perature here to drop extremely. the path heads towards the south, and the west.
r4819.description:
This part of the path doesn't look like it has been travelled very often.
The underbrush has taken over the path a little bit, which makes it rather
difficult to walk through.  The tree's continue to block out the light and
this causes the temperature here to drop extremely.  The path heads towards
the south, and the west.

descKeys: es in. this corridor continues to the north. a small office is also to the west.
r4820.description:
You are just north of the castle garden.  There are unlit candles on the wall
to match the rest of the corridor.  The garden looks like a huge plant house,
with flowers, trees and people inside.  The entire ceiling is made out of
glass so that the sun shines in.  This corridor continues to the north.  A
small office is also to the west.

descKeys: th, leading further into the castle. the garden continues to the south and west.
r4821.description:
You are in the castle garden.  There are flowers, trees, plants and people
everywhere.  This appears to be one of the more popular areas of the castle.
The entire ceiling is made out of glass, so that plants can get sun.  There
is a corridor to the north, leading further into the castle.  The garden
continues to the south and west.

descKeys: rom outside the large glass ceiling. the garden continues to the north and west.
r4822.description:
This is the southeastern part of the garden.  There is a large pond here with
people swiming in it.  There are park benches around the pond, as well as sun
bathing people.  You can feel the sun shining on you from outside the large
glass ceiling.  The garden continues to the north and west.

descKeys: e that this is not an ordinary tree. the garden continues to the north and east.
r4823.description:
This is the southwestern part of the garden.  There is a huge and ancient oak
tree standing here, apparently this garden is built around the oak.  As you
look at the tree you notice a mystical and beautiful glimmer coming from the
leaves, you realize that this is not an ordinary tree.  The garden continues
to the north and east.

descKeys: calmer then the rest of the garden. the garden continues to the south and east.
r4824.description:
This is the northwestern part of the garden.  There is a large bed of flowers
in the middle of the room, and several park benches standing around it.  This
place is much calmer then the rest of the garden.  The garden continues to
the south and east.

descKeys: e flowers on the desk. outside the office is a corridor leading north and south.
r4825.description:
You are in an office.  The room does not have much furnituring, as the
Elinost Elites don't care for comfort.  You notice a desk and a wooden chair
behind it.  There is a large painting of Elinost on the wall behind the desk
and some flowers on the desk.  Outside the office is a corridor leading north
and south.

descKeys: need to light it since there is enough light coming from the large hall window.
r4826.description:
You are east of an intersection of hallways.  This hallway leads to the
kitchen and dining room.  This place does not look very elven-like at all.
Although the elves in the castle has tried to compensate the grey stone brick
walls by hanging up some flower baskets on the walls.  There is an unlit
candle hanging on the brick wall to the north, there is no need to light it
since there is enough light coming from the large hall window.

descKeys: the kitchen which makes you hungry, its probably dinner time at the castle now.
r4827.description:
This corridor leads to the east and west.  A bit to the east you can see an
intersection of corridors leading to the north, south and east from here.
The corridor stops to the west of here and heads south to the kitchen.  You
can smell the food from the kitchen which makes you hungry, its probably
dinner time at the castle now.

descKeys: the sun shines through the window it emits a shadow of the basket on the floor.
r4828.description:
This part of the corridor leads south and east.  You can barely make out an
intersection to the east.  To the south is the kitchen and the dining room.
There is a large window on the western side of the room.  There is a flower
basket hanging in the window.  As the sun shines through the window it emits
a shadow of the basket on the floor.

descKeys: dor, or head north back to the intersection. there is a wood door leading east .
r4829.description:
You are west of the castle kitchen.  Pleasant smells of foods come from the
open door.  You feel a strong urge to enter the kitchen, and maybe taste some
of the food.  If not, you could visit the dining room further down the
corridor, or head north back to the intersection.
There is a wood door leading east ( OPENED ).

descKeys: up this part of the corridor. there is a chair standing against the south wall.
r4830.description:
You are east of the castle's dining room.  To the north you see the kitchen
door, and pleasant aromas from the kitchen blanket this part of the castle.
There is a window on the west wall, lighting up this part of the corridor.
There is a chair standing against the south wall.

descKeys: e north wall. the chairs are lined up symetrically around the long dining table.
r4831.description:
This is the castle dining room.  There is a large cabinet containing
expensive silverware.  In the middle of the room is a very long dining table
starting on close to the south wall and ending far away towards the north
wall.  The chairs are lined up symetrically around the long dining table.

descKeys: a table with vegetables ready to be chopped. there is a wood door leading west .
r4832.description:
You are in the castle kitchen.  Mmmm, the smells of food make you hungry.
There is a lot of work going on here, cooks run back and forth.  Against the
northern wall there is a stove with something cooking in a huge frying pan,
and again the southern wall you see a table with vegetables ready to be
chopped.
There is a wood door leading west ( OPENED ).

descKeys: he candles are unlit. this corridor leads to the castle staff's living quarters.
