decayed remains of Lorasin castle guard.name: decayed remains of Lorasin castle guard

r4833.description:
You are at the east side of Castle Lorasin.  There are some candles on the
northern wall to lighten this place up, although there is enough light coming
from the castle hall, so the candles are unlit.  This corridor leads to the
castle staff's living quarters.

descKeys: he north you realize that it is some kind of intersection with some other paths.
r4834.description:
The path leads on this way, and there are still huge amounts of trees all
around you, and there are a lot of flowers all over the forest floor.  The
path leads into a couple directions here, north and south.  As you look up
towards the north you realize that it is some kind of intersection with some
other paths.

descKeys: ion. the trees start to close in a bit though, confining the path a little more.
r4835.description:
The small path takes you here, and there are lots of trees all around you,
and there are a some small flowers on the forest floor.  The path leads into
a couple directions here, north and south.  There doesn't look to be any
difference in either direction.  The trees start to close in a bit though,
confining the path a little more.

descKeys: very easy to find your way. it goes in two directions, the south and the north.
r4836.description:
You continue to venture through the ongoing path, leading you towards the
center of the island.  The trees all around you are very full and green and
there are many butterflies around here that are flying around the flowers on
the forest floor.  The trees have overcome the path a bit, but it is still
very easy to find your way.  It goes in two directions, the south and the
north.

descKeys: than you have ever seen before. the path heads to both the south and the north.
r4837.description:
The trees around you start to decrease a little bit, and they seem less dense
throughout this part of the path.  There are lots of flowers here, more wild
flowers than you have ever seen before.  The path heads to both the south and
the north.

descKeys: ing around you, blocking out all sunlight, but it doesn't look to be very dense.
r4838.description:
You trek on following this never-ending path, and continue to enjoy the
astounding aspects of nature on this island.  The path takes a small turn
here towards the southwest, and also heads back towards the north.  The trees
are still towering around you, blocking out all sunlight, but it doesn't look
to be very dense.

descKeys: t. it looks to be some kind of small intersection of the paths to the southwest.
r4839.description:
The path here looks to be walked on quite a bit.  There isn't anything else
around here that looks too suspicious.  The trees continue to tower over you
blocking out all sunlight, causing it to be a bit cold.  The path heads
towards the southwest and the northeast.  It looks to be some kind of small
intersection of the paths to the southwest.

descKeys: ks to be some kind of major intersection between the paths, and looks very open.
r4840.description:
You arrive here, look around and see that the path splits off into three
different ways here.  The trees still make a quite formidable barrier around
you forcing you to continue to walk on the paths.  The paths lead towards the
northeast, southwest, and northwest.  Towards the northwest it looks to be a
bit darker than here, due to the huge amount of trees.  Towards the southwest
it looks to be some kind of major intersection between the paths, and looks
very open.

descKeys: d are in larger numbers. the paths can take you south, east, west, or northeast.
r4841.description:
There are four different paths that intervene here.  They all head in
separate directions, as there are no significant differences between any of
the different ways you can follow.  It looks a bit darker towards the west,
but that is probabley because the trees there are much thicker and are in
larger numbers.  The paths can take you south, east, west, or northeast.

descKeys: multiple paths intervene there. the path heads towards the southeast and north.
r4842.description:
The trees here have pretty much taken over everything around you.  The only
other thing you can see besides all the trees is the small path your walking
on.  It is quite dark, and you feel as if you are being watched.  Towards the
north it gets significantly lighter than here, and looks as if multiple paths
intervene there. The path heads towards the southeast and north.

descKeys: be 'consumed' by the forest. the path heads towards the southeast and northwest.
r4843.description:
You lose a bit of your security as you begin to walk through this part of the
forest.  It is quite dark, and feel as if you are being watched.  Towards the
southeast you can see the ocean.  The trees are still all around you, and the
path is your only way you can go.  The only ways you can go without getting
lost is northwest and southeast, otherwise you'll most likely be 'consumed'
by the forest.  The path heads towards the southeast and northwest.

descKeys: thwest you will lose sight of it. the path heads towards the east and northwest.
r4844.description:
The path is quite small here, and it is kind of rather hard to follow the
path.  The trees are still all around you, and the path is your only way you
can go.  The path takes a bit of a turn here, and starts to head up towards
the northwest.  You can still see the ocean, but you feel if you start
heading up towards the northwest you will lose sight of it.  The path heads
towards the east and northwest.

descKeys: ence, just a beautiful ocean path. the path heads towards the east and the west.
r4845.description:
The path begins to widen a bit here, and continues to lead to the east and
west.  The trees are still all around you, and the path is the only way you
can go.  As you look down the path towards the west and east, there doesn't
seem to be any difference, just a beautiful ocean path.  The path heads
towards the east and the west.

descKeys: view of the ocean. the paths continues on towards the east, north, and the west.
r4846.description:
It seems as if there has been more creatures walking around here.  The path
looks to be more worn here than anywhere else, and it's probably due to the
other path that leads into this one towards the north.  The path towards the
north looks very dark, and dense.  The trees are still very dense and allow
you to only walk on the paths.  The path towards the north looks as if it has
been walked on a bit more than this one.  Towards the south you still have
the beautiful view of the ocean.  The paths continues on towards the east,
north, and the west.

descKeys: ook down each of the paths. the path continues on towards the east and the west.
r4847.description:
There are lots of flowers here, and you see lots of small butterflies flying
to them getting the nectar from them.  The trees are still all around you,
and the path is your only way you can go.  Towards the west it seems as if
the path has been travelled a bit more.  Other than that there doesn't seem
to be any difference as you look down each of the paths.  The path continues
on towards the east and the west.

descKeys: u look down each of the paths. the path takes you towards the east and the west.
r4848.description:
The path here is quite wide, and a little bit of the underbrush is starting
to creap up on the path.  The trees are still all around you, and the path is
your only way you can go.  There are lots of flowers here, which seems a bit
strange, but they add to the beauty of this path.  There doesn't seem to be
any difference as you look down each of the paths.  The path takes you
towards the east and the west.

descKeys: l fish jumping in and out of the water. the path leads to the east and the west.
r4849.description:
You arrive here and look around, and realize the beauty of this island.  The
trees are still all around you, and the path is the only way you can go.  It
doesn't look much different either way.  Out in the ocean you can see some
small fish jumping in and out of the water.  The path leads to the east and
the west.

descKeys: ttle more movement to the eastern side. the path leads to the east and the west.
r4850.description:
The small ocean path continues along the coast.  The trees are still all
around you, and the path is the only way you can go.  It doesn't look much
different either way, although there seems to be a little more movement to
the eastern side.  The path leads to the east and the west.

descKeys: s you a perfect view over the ocean. it leads towards the west, north, and east.
r4851.description:
The ocean is right here to your south, and the size of it is amazing.  The
trees are still on every side of you except to the south.  The path looks as
if it has been travelled on a lot recently.  The path is in very good shape,
it is quite large here and gives you a perfect view over the ocean.  It leads
towards the west, north, and east.

descKeys: as if the woods are as thick as here. the shere beauty of the ocean amazes you.
r4852.description:
The fox jumps at a small butterfly.
The ocean is to the south of you, and the woods are up towards the north of
here.  There is a nicely carved path heading north, but it seems to be some
sort of tunnel that gets darker as you go farther in.  You can also head back
along the ocean shore towards the east or the west.  Towards the east the
small path opens up a bit and it doesn't look as if the woods are as thick as
here.  The shere beauty of the ocean amazes you.

descKeys: asslands of merevia begin. there looks to be much life striving throughout them.
r4853.description:
You are on a path that is leading through some light woods that will
eventually end if you keep heading east into the grasslands.  Far to the east
past the grasslands you can see the Sea of Honshale.  Towards the west the
woods thicken and the path gets smaller.  To the north, northeast, and
northwest the grasslands of Merevia begin.  There looks to be much life
striving throughout them.

descKeys: site is endless grass. towards your west is a path leading back into the woods.
r4854.description:
You are at the beginning of a huge grassland.  The grass around you is about
waist high and has no path leading through it.  Directly to your east is the
Sea of Honshale, it is beautiful.  Towards the north the only thing in site
is endless grass. Towards your west is a path leading back into the woods.

descKeys: ou can head in all directions from here to get to other parts of the grasslands.
r4855.description:
You are standing on the coast of the grasslands.  You have a wonderful view
of the Sea of Honshale.  There are a couple small turtles crawling around on
the beach just below you.  The beach looks far to rocky for you to walk on,
so you opt to stay off of it and up here just above it.  You can head in all
directions from here to get to other parts of the grasslands.

descKeys: impossible to explore through. there are lots of animal tracks through out here.
r4856.description:
A strong gust of wind rushes towards you off of the sea.
You are standing in the grasslands.  The grasslands run along the coast of
the Sea of Honshale.  There is lots of tall grass around here and it is
impossible to find any type of path.  Just east of here you can see the Sea
of Honshale.  The western side of the grasslands are bordered with a dark
forest that is impossible to explore through.  There are lots of animal
tracks through out here.

descKeys: ground here. off to your west you can see a forest that is very thick and dark.
r4857.description:
You are in the plains of Merevia.  The grass here is very high and all around
you.  Off in the distance towards the east you can see the Sea of Honshale.
Travel is slow because of the grass, it would be easy to get lost here
because everything looks the same and there is no path.  There are lots of
mushrooms that are covering the ground here.  Off to your west you can see a
forest that is very thick and dark.

descKeys: can head in all directions from here and remain in the heart of the grasslands.
r4858.description:
You are wandering through the huge grasslands of Merevia.  To the east of the
grasslands is the Sea of Honshale and to the west of the grasslands is the
dark forest.  The grass here is very high, and it is quite annoying trying to
walk through.  As you look up it is mostly clear except for a few fluffy
white clouds that are scattered through out the sky.  You can head in all
directions from here and remain in the heart of the grasslands.

descKeys: a forest begin. on the eastern side of the grasslands lies the sea of honshale.
r4859.description:
The only thing that seems to be around you is the high grass that the plains
have such an abundance of.  There are lots of small animals that live and
strive around here.  As you look around, there is high grass in all
directions.  Towards the west you can see the grass come to an end and a
forest begin.  On the eastern side of the grasslands lies the Sea of
Honshale.

descKeys: xcuses for trees here and there. there's a hole in the ground beneath your feet.
r4860.description:
The sea is beautiful here, although the sun reflecting off the water almost
blinds you.  These are the grasslands of Merevia, they run along the shore of
the Sea of Honshale on the eastern side of Merevia.  There are a few pathetic
excuses for trees here and there.  There's a hole in the ground beneath your
feet.

descKeys: e sea or you can walk back up the small incline to get back into the grasslands.
r4861.description:
You carefully step down from the grasslands onto the small stones that line
the coast of the sea.  The water is very beautiful and it stretches out as
far as the eye can see.  You slowly walk up to the waters edge on the sand
and wash your face in the refreshing water.  As you stand here and view your
surroundings a small wave comes up and just envelops your feet.  The water is
very warm and it sends a small chill through your spine.  You can remain on
the coast of the sea or you can walk back up the small incline to get back
into the grasslands.

descKeys: maybe about twenty feet wide. from here the view of the ocean is breath taking.
r4862.description:
You are now on the sandy beach to the west of the Sea of Honshale.  There are
still a few signs of grassland scattered around this area of the beach, a few
tall blades of grass here and there.  The waves are lapping up and down
against your ankles.  To the west it is complete grassland, no sand.  The
beach is not very wide its maybe about twenty feet wide.  From here the view
of the ocean is breath taking.

descKeys: the beach. you can also head west to get back into the heart of the grasslands.
r4863.description:
You let your feet sink into the soft warm sand and let your body relax for
once.  There aren't any immediate dangers around you, and the view you have
of the Sea of Honshale is breath taking.  Aromas are coming off of the sea
and they are the only thing that you can smell.  There are tons of small
hermit crabs crawling around the beach searching for food.  Above you are
some light clouds and birds that are swooping about the sea in attempt to
find a meal.  You can head to the northwest or southwest and remain on the
beach.  You can also head west to get back into the heart of the grasslands.

descKeys: he sea of honshale. the sea of honshale is just east of you, and looks splendid.
r4864.description:
The large beach runs north and south along the eastern side of the grasslands
is quite beautiful.  There are lots of crabs and turtles that live on the
beach.  They all scurry about minding their own business.  There are also
lots of small shells laying about the beach that have been carried in by the
Sea of Honshale.  The Sea of Honshale is just east of you, and looks
splendid.

descKeys: h or south along the beach or towards the west where the grasslands are located.
r4865.description:
A small bird swoops down towards the sea.
The large beach extends as far as you can see towards the north and south.
The Sea of Honshale is just east of you, and it is very large.  There are
some small waves rolling in towards the coast.  Above the sea you view some
birds flying around chirping at each other.  You can head north or south
along the beach or towards the west where the grasslands are located.

descKeys: e grasslands everywhere. way off to the west you can see the tips of some trees.
r4866.description:
You are standing here on the nice beach.  Every step you take you feel the
nice warm sand surround your foot and ankle.  As you look away from the sea
for a moment a large wave crashes in on the beach and the water sprays up on
you.  You look out over the sea and see a couple large fish jump up out of
the water.  Back towards the west you can see the grasslands everywhere.  Way
off to the west you can see the tips of some trees.

descKeys: rds the north and south. you can also head westward to get back onto the plains.
r4867.description:
You are standing on the beach over looking the beautiful Sea of Honshale.
There is a soft breeze coming off of the sea, that carries aromas of the
ocean with it.  The sand on the beach is quite soft on your feet and as you
look down there are some small sea creatures scurrying about.  The coast
continues to run towards the north and south.  You can also head westward to
get back onto the plains.

descKeys: n the westward direction to get back onto solid ground, and away from the coast.
r4868.description:
You are standing on the nice warm beach here on Merevia.  The warm waters of
the Sea of Honshale rush up the beach and onto your feet.  The aromas of the
ocean are all around you, and the small breeze runs through your hair.  You
look out over the sea and can see lots of small waves heading in towards the
coast.  You can head towards the north and south along the coast.  You can
also head in the westward direction to get back onto solid ground, and away
from the coast.

descKeys: outh along the coast, or back towards the west where the grasslands are located.
r4869.description:
You are standing on the warm beach that runs along the Sea of Honshale.  This
long beach runs all the way south as far as you can see.  There are lots of
small waves that are coming inland from the sea.  North of here, you can see
a small inlet that is allowing water to come in.  There must be some kind of
stream or creek that runs through the island that is fed by the sea.  You can
head south along the coast, or back towards the west where the grasslands are
located.

descKeys: e. you can also head towards the south into the vast majority of the grasslands.
r4870.description:
You are standing just south of a huge swamp.  There are lots of dead trees in
the swamp.  You can see lots of moss hanging off of the trees, meaning that
the trees have been dead for quite a long time.  There is also a small creek
that runs along the border of the forest, not allowing you to pass.  Just
east of here, is the Sea of Honshale.  You can also head towards the south
into the vast majority of the grasslands.

descKeys: along the outside of the forest, or towards the south where the grasslands are.
r4871.description:
A gloomy forest is just north of you.  There is lots of underbrush, so it's
quite hard to see into the forest.  There is also a thick haze that is on the
floor of the forest, which makes it impossible to see what is in there.  Most
of the trees in the forest look to be dead, and you have second thoughts
about entering it.  There is a small wooden bridge here, that takes you over
a small creek to get you into the forest.  You can head towards the east and
west along the outside of the forest, or towards the south where the
grasslands are.

descKeys: very safe. you can also head towards the south where the safe grasslands extend.
r4872.description:
You are standing just south of a very creepy looking forest.  You are not
sure if it is a forest or a swamp, but there are some very horrible noises
coming from it.  All of the trees are dead, and there is a lot of moss
hanging off of the dead limbs.  There is also some kind of haze that lingers
about the ground in there.  You can head east and west along the border of
the northern forest, but it does not seem very safe.  You can also head
towards the south where the safe grasslands extend.

descKeys: f you. you can head towards the east and south along the borders of the forests.
r4873.description:
You are in the most northwestern tip of the grasslands.  There is some kind
of swamp up towards the north.  West of here there is a very dense forest.
The grass in this part of the grasslands is not as high as it is in other
parts of the grasslands, since there isn't much sun that shines through the
huge trees that tower over the top of you.  You can head towards the east and
south along the borders of the forests.

descKeys: you can head in several directions to get to different parts of the grasslands.
r4874.description:
There is a dark forest that is just west of you.  It is very dense, and it's
quite hard to see anything in there.  There is a large shadow that is being
cast over this part of the grasslands from the tall trees that tower over
you.  North of here you can see another forest, it isn't as dark and dense as
the one towards the west, but it looks very creepy.  North of here, the
grasslands come to an end, and the northern forest begins.  You can head in
several directions to get to different parts of the grasslands.

descKeys: ee the sea of honshale. there are several paths leading in different directions.
r4875.description:
There are lots of small insects buzzing around here.  You are standing amidst
some very high grass, and it is quite difficult to make your way around this
part of the grasslands.  North of here, you can see the edge of a very creepy
forest.  On the western side of the grasslands there is a very dense forest
that is impassable.  Way off towards the east you can see the Sea of
Honshale.  There are several paths leading in different directions.

descKeys: small waves crashing up on the coast. the grassland area extends all around you.
r4876.description:
You manage to make your way through the high grass that is all around you.
You climb on top of a small knoll, and you have a good view of everything
around you.  The western side of the grasslands is bordered by a very dark
and dense forest.  The northern side of the grasslands is bordered by a very
creepy looking forest, it looks like it could be a swamp of some kind.  On
the eastern side of the grasslands lies the Sea of Honshale.  You can see
lots of small waves crashing up on the coast.  The grassland area extends all
around you.

descKeys: xing sound. you can head in all directions to different parts of the grasslands.
r4877.description:
You are standing west of the coast.  The elevation is rather high here
compared to what the elevation is at the coast, so you have a good view of
the Sea of Honshale.  It is a rather steep hill towards the east to get down
to the beach.  Just north of here, you can see a rather creepy swamp looking
forest.  The small waves are crashing in on the beach, and it is creating a
very relaxing sound.  You can head in all directions to different parts of
the grasslands.

descKeys: a is, or you can continue to venture through the grasslands in other directions.
r4878.description:
You are standing just west of the Sea of Honshale.  There are some rather
strong breezes coming off of the sea.  Some of the sand from the beach hits
your face, and it stings a bit.  The grass is rather low here, and it's
fairly easy for you to travel through this part of the grasslands.  North of
here you can see a forest that looks somewhat dense, but there appears to be
something magical about it.  You can head towards the east to where the sea
is, or you can continue to venture through the grasslands in other
directions.

descKeys: s. you look towards the west and you can see some small mushrooms on the ground.
r4879.description:
A small bird swoops down towards the sea.
You are on the most eastern side of the grasslands.  You stand here
overlooking the Sea of Honshale.  You are about six or seven feet above the
beach on the grasslands.  Being this high up off the ground you have a great
view of the ocean.  You have to look away after watching the ocean for a
while because the glare of the sun off the water is hurting your eyes.  You
look towards the west and you can see some small mushrooms on the ground.

descKeys: e north, but it may not be very smart due to the harsh conditions of this place.
r4880.description:
The trees around are incredibly thick, and there is hardly any space to walk
through here.  There are lots of flowers here, more wild flowers than you
have ever seen before.  Towards the south it brightens up quite a bit, and
you can just see the ocean.  There is also space to walk up towards the
north, but it may not be very smart due to the harsh conditions of this
place.

descKeys: se two places you feel you would get lost if you tried to venture anywhere else.
r4881.description:
It is extremely hard to find your way through here.  The trees around are
incredibly thick, which makes it very difficult to walk.  There are lots of
flowers here which makes you feel a bit secure through this part of the
forest.  There are small paths that you can follow that lead towards the west
and the south.  Other than those two places you feel you would get lost if
you tried to venture anywhere else.

descKeys: that is a bit strange here, it sounds as if there is some running water nearby.
r4882.description:
There is a small amount of light here, although towards the north you can see
that it opens up a lot, and a lot of light is getting through.  The trees
around are incredibly thick, which makes it very difficult to walk though.
The only two obvious places you could go are towards the east or towards the

descKeys: , west, and south. if you head east, you would be walking right aside the brook.

The path continues on and there is quite a large canopy over your head.  As
you continue to walk and look around you notice a small babbling brook to the
north of you.  You catch a glimpse of a sparkle off the water that
immediately makes you look over.  It is just another part of the beauty that
you have witnessed throughout the island.  You would think that this small
brook was fed by the ocean, but it may be spring-fed.  The path heads towards
the east, west, and south.  If you head east, you would be walking right
aside the brook.

descKeys: e path to the east or the west, both ways go right along the shore of the brook.
r4884.description:
The path keeps on heading to the east and the west.  Here you can get a very
clear view of the small brook to the north of you.  As you look around you
feel as if you never want to leave this place because of its incredible
beauty.  The trees, brook, sound, smell, and weather here is one of the
better things you have experienced in your life.  You can follow the path to
the east or the west, both ways go right along the shore of the brook.

descKeys: and through the trees of the forest. you can head towards the east or the west.
r4885.description:
The path continues to lead you right past the small brook.  It is about
thirty feet away from you, but you see no way to get to it due to the thick
underbrush and trees.  The path continues to lead you past the shore of the
brook, and through the trees of the forest.  You can head towards the east or
the west.

descKeys: have been travelled on quite a bit. it continues towards the east and the west.
r4886.description:
The brook comes incredibly close to you here, about ten feet away from you,
but unfortunately you can't get to it.  There are many trees around you as
well as the brook.  There isn't anything else around that really draws you're
attention except for the path your walking on.  This part of the path seems
to have been travelled on quite a bit.  It continues towards the east and the
west.

descKeys: owards the east where it looks like it has been travelled on significantly more.
r4887.description:
You come to see a quite large spring coming out of the ground feeding a small
forest brook that looks very beautiful.  All the trees around you don't allow
you to leave the path, but you can follow the brook to the west, or continue
towards the east where it looks like it has been travelled on significantly
more.

descKeys: nto nothing, and you start to have second thoughts about travelling any further.

As you walk deeper into the forest, the scene of beauty and stability is
slowly diminishing.  Back to the west you can see it open up again, and to
the east it looks as if the woods are getting thicker and darker.  The path
starts to decrease into nothing, and you start to have second thoughts about
travelling any further.

descKeys: west it looks a bit lighter, but there is no significant change in the scenery.
r4889.description:
The woods continue to get darker and the amount of light has significantly
decreased.  The path starts to fade off in some parts, but then comes back
the further you look down the trail.  It looks as if no one has has been here
for a very long time.  Back to the west it looks a bit lighter, but there is
no significant change in the scenery.

descKeys: then others which indicates that there more then one of whatever is down there.
r4890.description:
looking leaves.  They somehow intrigue you.  You hear many grunts coming from
somewhere below the earth.  They are probably to warn away any tresspassers.
There are other grunts, some fainter then others which indicates that there
more then one of whatever is down there.

descKeys: death and rotting, while the one to the north smells like the tunnel around you.
r4891.description:
This tunnel is made completely of dirt.  Looking ahead there is a main one
and one other that branches off.  Both are pitch black.  The one to the
northwest smells of death and rotting, while the one to the north smells like
the tunnel around you.

descKeys: ust animals, but men too! otherwise the walls and dirt of the tunnel are normal.
r4892.description:
This tunnel is much larger then the one you were just in, you can fit in it
quite convieniantly.  There are no spider webs or anything else that would
usually appear in a burrow.  On the floor you see foot prints of mixed
animals.  Upon closer inspection you actually see that these are the
footprints of not just animals, but men too!  Otherwise the walls and dirt of
the tunnel are normal.

descKeys: is tunnel has obviously had its fair share of kills. this is no ordinary burrow.
r4893.description:
The smell of death and rotting gets nearly unbearable as you travel down the
tunnel.  The floor is covered with bones and half eaten corpses.  The dirt
walls are smeared with blood and have deep scratches all over them.  Whatever
lurks in this tunnel has obviously had its fair share of kills.  This is no
ordinary burrow.

descKeys: e mentioned are hanging from the ceiling. this place is the definition of death.
r4894.description:
You almost faint from the sight and smell that beholds you.  There are
thousands of bones, littering the blood drenched dirt around you, they crunch
under the weight of you.  Corpses and other nasty particles of living things
too gruesome to be mentioned are hanging from the ceiling.  This place is the
definition of death.

descKeys: lit to lighten this place up. the staff's living quarters start south from here.

decaying remains of Lorasin castle guard.name: decaying remains of Lorasin castle guard

r4896.description:
You are at the northeast part of Castle Lorasin.  The light from the castle
hall does not quite reach through here, so the candles on the northern wall
are lit to lighten this place up.  The staff's living quarters start south
from here.

descKeys: e south. there is a wood door leading west . there is a wood door leading east .
r4897.description:
This is the castle staff's living quarters.  There is a sign saying 'Captains
Quarter's' on the door to the east, and one saying 'Castle Mage Quarter's' on
the west door.  There are flower baskets hanging above both doors, with
flowers from the castle garden.  The corridor continues to the south.
There is a wood door leading west ( OPENED ).
There is a wood door leading east ( OPENED ).

descKeys: rters. the corridor continues to the east, where the guard barracks are located.
r4898.description:
You are in a corridor that leads through the staff's living quarters.  To the
west is a staircase leading up to the upper level, and to the north is the
guard captain and castle mage's living quarters.  The corridor continues to
the east, where the guard barracks are located.

descKeys: bed, levitating close to the southern wall. there is a wood door leading east .
r4899.description:
This is the living quarters of the castle mage, Parabus.  Its full of strange
artifacts, devices, magical scrolls and strange objects floating in the air.
There is a flat wooden board, that apparently is used as a bed, levitating
close to the southern wall.
There is a wood door leading east ( OPENED ).

descKeys: s a large bed, and a table in the southeast. there is a wood door leading west .
r4900.description:
This is the living quarters of Captain Barbakas.  There are many trophies on
the walls from all the battles he has won.  There is a large window on the
east wall that lightens up the entire room.  In the northeast corner there is
a large bed, and a table in the southeast.
There is a wood door leading west ( OPENED ).

descKeys: ether, and the underbrush is so thick. the path heads towards the east and west.
r4901.description:
As you arrive, you notice the substantial change in light, because it has
gotten darker.  The trees have overtaken this part of the forest making it
very hard to see.  There are no other places that you have ever seen like
this where the trees are so close together, and the underbrush is so thick.
The path heads towards the east and west.

descKeys: t has grown up on the path. the path leads towards two directions east and west.
r4902.description:
The trees have formed a very thick canopy above here, making it difficult to
see anything around you due to the lack of light.  There are many different
kinds of trees around here, and there is also a very large amount of
underbrush that has grown up on the path.  The path leads towards two
directions east and west.

descKeys: s of strange plants around here. the path leads in two directions east and west.
r4903.description:
It has become increasingly darker through out this part of the forest.  The
trees form a very thick canopy above, and are all very close together making
it impossible to leave the path.  There are many different kinds of strange
plants around here.  The path leads in two directions east and west.

descKeys: controlled by some kind of being. the path leads towards the northwest and west.
r4904.description:
This part of the path has been walked on quite a bit, and this is evident
from the footprints that are all over the ground.  The trees here are still
very close together and form a canopy, but quite a bit of light is getting
through it.  The underbrush also looks as if it has been controlled by some
kind of being.  The path leads towards the northwest and west.

descKeys: healthy. you can head back through the small opening or south towards the ocean.
r4905.description:
It doesn't look as if anyone has ever been here before.  There is no trace of
life around here anywhere.  There is a small path that leads all the way to
the ocean, which you can barely see from here.  The trees around you are
still very large, and healthy.  You can head back through the small opening
or south towards the ocean.

descKeys: . you can head towards the north away from the ocean or south towards the ocean.
r4906.description:
You arrive here and quickly come to realize that you are getting closer to
the ocean.  There is still no trace of life around here though.  There is a
small path that leads all the way to the ocean, which you can barely see from
here.  The trees around you are still very large, and healthy.  You can head
towards the north away from the ocean or south towards the ocean.

descKeys: . you can head towards the north away from the ocean or south towards the ocean.
r4907.description:
The ocean starts to come in view from here.  There doesn't seem to be
anything living around here.  The small path continues towards the ocean, and
will take you right to the coast if you keep heading south.  The trees around
you are still very large, and healthy.  You can head towards the north away
from the ocean or south towards the ocean.

descKeys: head towards the north away from the ocean or east along the coast of the ocean.
r4908.description:
You are on the very edge of the island, where the water meets the land.
There still doesn't seem to be anything living around this part of the
island.  The path takes a big turn towards the east here, and runs right
along the ocean.  The trees are starting to decrease a little bit here.  You
can head towards the north away from the ocean or east along the coast of the
ocean.

descKeys: as far as you can see. the path runs along the coast towards the east and west.
r4909.description:
You are still right walking on the path right next to the shore.  You can't
see any sign of life around here.  The path continues on towards the east
along the coast of the island.  The amount of trees has grown some, and
provided some shade from the hot sun.  As you look out upon the ocean, the
water stretches as far as you can see.  The path runs along the coast towards
the east and west.

descKeys: rds the northeast. the path runs along the coast towards the northeast and west.
r4910.description:
The path continues to take you right along the ocean, giving you a great view
the entire time.  The amount of trees has grown some, providing some shade
from the hot sun.  The path takes a bit of turn towards the northeast, away
from the ocean, and back into the forest.  It also looks much darker up
towards the northeast.  The path runs along the coast towards the northeast
and west.

descKeys: get back out of here is towards the southwest back along the coast of the ocean.
r4911.description:
You arrive here and the ocean is to the south of you.  It is rather hard to
see it from here, due to the large amount of trees around.  There is
something a bit strange about this part of the forest though.  The ground
looks a bit strange as well as the trees.  The only way to get back out of
here is towards the southwest back along the coast of the ocean.

descKeys: iden road leads towards the northwest, and sai road leads towards the northeast.
r4912.description:
You are on Jitsu Lane, the busiest lane and part of this small village.
There are many lights lining this road, making it possible to see down here.
As you look ahead you can see that this lane is the main part of this small
and unseen village.  It is a wonder how such a large community of people can
survive down here, you ponder how it is possible.  You look up and see a
small ladder that you can climb to get back to the surface.  Jitsu Lane heads
towards the north, Gaiden Road leads towards the northwest, and Sai Road
leads towards the northeast.

descKeys: on jitsu lane or head back to the south where the main intersection is located.
r4913.description:
You are just north of the main intersection of the small village.  There are
people bustling on both sides of the lane.  The lights lining the road
provide the only light for this small community.  You can continue to walk
north on Jitsu Lane or head back to the south where the main intersection is
located.

descKeys: his part of the lane. jitsu lane continues on in two directions north and south.
r4914.description:
You are standing right in the heart of Jitsu Lane now.  There are small men
and women on both sides of you.  The small huts line both sides of Jitsu
Lane.  The people in the huts are constantly yelling at you to buy herbs,
plants, or different kinds of medicines.  The lights here are much brighter
and provide more light to this part of the lane.  Jitsu Lane continues on in
two directions north and south.

descKeys: the east is sai road or you can stay on jitsu lane which leads north and south.
r4915.description:
This is the middle of Jitsu Lane.  There are merchants, vendors, and children
all around this part of the village.  The huts still line both sides of the
road and there are people in them trying to sell their goods.  The lights are
bright here as well, the reason for this is because there is a lot of
activity around this part of the village.  Towards the east is Sai Road or
you can stay on Jitsu Lane which leads north and south.

descKeys: their goods to you and each other. jitsu lane heads towards the north and south.
r4916.description:
You are on Jitsu Lane which is the main road of the small village.  There are
lights that line either side of the road so the community has plenty of light
to see.  You also see the entrance to Gaiden Road up towards the northwest.
There doesn't seem to be much development on that road.  The vendors continue
to walk up and down Jitsu Lane trying to sell their goods to you and each
other.  Jitsu Lane heads towards the north and south.

descKeys: of the road as well. you can head towards the north or the south on jitsu lane.
r4917.description:
You are walking on Jitsu Lane.  Way up north you see the entrance to the
masters samurai's dojo.  There are some bright lights that are shining on the
dojo see it is quite easy to see from here.  This part of Jitsu Lane is still
inhabited with all of the merchants and vendors.  The huts are starting to
decrease in number on this part of the road as well.  You can head towards
the north or the south on Jitsu Lane.

descKeys: ojo of the master samurai, or you can head back south to get back to jitsu lane.
r4918.description:
This is the entrance to a large dojo.  The master samurai lives here.  The
dojo is very large and you don't understand why someone would need or want
such a large house.  All of the noise and commotion has stopped here but you
can see all of it to the south of you.  If you head north you will enter the
dojo of the master samurai, or you can head back south to get back to Jitsu
Lane.

descKeys: at brightens this place up are the two torches placed on the west and east wall.
r4922.description:
You are standing in front of a huge portal of some kind located in an
underground cave.  The portal is looking very omnious.  This place is quite
damp and cold, and the only thing that brightens this place up are the two
torches placed on the west and east wall.

descKeys: wall of this corridor there is a portal that will take you out of the dark seal.
r4923.description:
It appears that you are inside some sort of dungeon.  When you look around
you see that you are in a corridor leading east and west.  There are no
torches in here, but there is still light.  This place is apparently lit by
some sort of magic.  Against the northern wall of this corridor there is a
portal that will take you out of the dark seal.

descKeys: familiar to you. this small hallway runs in the eastern and western directions.
r4924.description:
Down the western hallway you can see a glowing blue portal that sheds a
minimal amount of light upon this part of the hallway.  The walls of the
hallway are constructed of some type of brown stone that doesn't look
familiar to you.  This small hallway runs in the eastern and western
directions.

descKeys: here you can see an intersecting hallway that has a small purple glow within it.
r4925.description:
This small hallway has run into a dead end.  There is a large wall north of
here, not allowing you to head any further.  The only obvious way to get out
of this hallway is to head south.  Way south of here you can see an
intersecting hallway that has a small purple glow within it.

descKeys: h this small hallway. north of here, it looks as if the hallway comes to an end.
r4926.description:
This small hallway runs north and south.  South of here, you can see another
corridor that has a faint glow of purple.  There aren't any good sources of
light through this small hallway.  North of here, it looks as if the hallway
comes to an end.

descKeys: you look around this part of the corridor, the southern wall looks very strange.
r4927.description:
There is a hallway that runs north from this spot.  You can also head towards
the west, where you can see a small torch mounted on the wall.  East of here
the corridor opens up and there is a rather large room that has a glowing
purple aura throughout it.  As you look around this part of the corridor, the
southern wall looks very strange.

descKeys: re the hallway gets smaller. east of here, you can hear some sounds of movement.
r4928.description:
Here, the hallway is quite wide and there is a bit of light being exuded from
a small torch mounted on the wall.  The corridor bends to the east here, and
you can also head back down towards the south where the hallway gets smaller.
East of here, you can hear some sounds of movement.

descKeys: ou look north of here it is rather dark, but the hallway seems to open up a bit.
r4929.description:
This dark hallway leads north and south.  Down to the south, the hallway
turns into another corridor.  You feel rather confined in this dark hallway.
There are cracks all over the brown walls.  As you look north of here it is
rather dark, but the hallway seems to open up a bit.

descKeys: on't see much of interest, except two faint torches glowing at the opposite end.
r4930.description:
The corridor heads to the north and west from here.  North of here it widens
a bit, and it looks as if there is a bit more light than in this dark
corridor.  Down the western corridor you don't see much of interest, except
two faint torches glowing at the opposite end.

descKeys: n wall. you can continue to head through the dark hallway by going east or west.
r4931.description:
The twisting corridors through this dark seal have taken you far away from
civilization.  The walls are very dark, the light is dim, and it is hard to
breathe.  There is a small alcove in the northern wall.  You can continue to
head through the dark hallway by going east or west.

descKeys: h mounted on a wall, providing just enough light for you to see the stairs here.
r4932.description:
You stand at the end of this dark corridor.  There are some stairs that will
take you further from the surface.  The stairs look very unstable, and you
have second thoughts before walking down them.  North of here, there is a
small torch mounted on a wall, providing just enough light for you to see the
stairs here.

descKeys: kind of brown material. you can head to the south here or back towards the west.
r4933.description:
There is a small torch here mounted on the wall.  This small hallway is very
dark, and there are lots of strange sounds throughout this part of the seal.
The ground is very uneven and the ceiling is made of some kind of brown
material.  You can head to the south here or back towards the west.

descKeys: the east. the walls here are a dark red color, and they look to be very sturdy.
r4934.description:
You are standing fairly deep within this dungeon of evil.  There is a rather
steep stairwell leading up to the first level of the dark seal.  This dark
corridor is luminated by two small torches at the base of the stairwell.
North of here, the corridor bends off towards the east.  The walls here are a
dark red color, and they look to be very sturdy.

descKeys: es lighting up some kind of stairwell. you can also follow the eastern corridor.
r4935.description:
A slight breeze runs through this hallway right when you walk in.  It is
rather hard to see in here, due to the flickering of the torches.  The two
small torches mounted on either side of this hallway are almost being blown
out by the small gusts of wind.  South of here, at the end of the hallway,
you can see two more small torches lighting up some kind of stairwell.  You
can also follow the eastern corridor.

descKeys: s to open up a bit. all of the walls around this place are a very strange color.
r4936.description:
You are standing amidst two intersecting corridors.  Down the western
corridor you can see a couple of small torches that are providing a fair
amount of light.  South of here, it is very dark, and you can't see anything
down there.  You can also head to the north where the corridor seems to open
up a bit.  All of the walls around this place are a very strange color.

descKeys: it looks as if the size of that hallway is very small compared to this hallway.
r4937.description:
There are small gusts of wind rushing through these confined corridors.
There doesn't seem to be any source of these winds.  South of here you can
see the flickering of torches on the walls.  This corridor bends towards the
west.  You have second thoughts before heading down the western corridor,
because it looks as if the size of that hallway is very small compared to
this hallway.

descKeys: . west of here, it is much darker, and the corridor continues to shrink in size.
r4938.description:
This corridor is very small, and you are beginning to feel rather
claustrophobic standing in here.  East of this point there seems to be a lot
more light, and the corridor expands quite a bit.  West of here, it is much
darker, and the corridor continues to shrink in size.

descKeys: east of here, the corridor expands a bit, and south of here it gets much bigger.
r4939.description:
This dark corridor heads in two directions, south and east.  The corridor is
very small here, and you move very cautiously so you don't touch the walls.
The walls are very hard to see, and there is no telling what might be lurking
on them.  East of here, the corridor expands a bit, and south of here it gets
much bigger.

descKeys: by torches. the southern part of this corridor continues to get bigger in size.
r4940.description:
There is a dark corridor that heads north and south from here.  There is
another crossing corridor that heads towards the west.  North of here, the
corridor diminishes greatly in size.  Down the western corridor, you see some
light being shed by torches.  The southern part of this corridor continues to
get bigger in size.

descKeys: than here. there is also a fair amount of light shining in here from the south.

Glyph of Fire, hindering you from going.name: Glyph of Fire, hindering you from going south

r4941.description:
This corridor is rather big, and it continues to the north and south as far
as you can see.  South of here, there looks to be a much bigger room.  The
northern part of the corridor looks to be much smaller than here.  There is
also a fair amount of light shining in here from the south.

descKeys: rection. there is a iron door leading west . there is a iron door leading east .
r4942.description:
This is more like a room than a corridor.  The ceiling is very high and the
walls are quite far apart.  On the eastern and western walls there are two
large iron doors.  South of here, you can sense much evil and hesitate to
travel any further in that direction.
There is a iron door leading west ( LOCKED ).
There is a iron door leading east ( LOCKED ).

descKeys: urking south of here, but you know whatever it is, is very strong and very evil.
r4943.description:
You are standing in the middle of a large room.  There is an intense amount
of evil energy surging through here.  North of here, you can see the corridor
that you walked down to get here.  It is very hard to see what is lurking
south of here, but you know whatever it is, is very strong and very evil.

descKeys: f the large room. you can also head to the west, where the large room continues.
r4944.description:
You are in the southeastern part of a large room.  There are myriads of
corpses laying around the room.  Whatever created this shrine of death and
destruction must be a fearsome fighter.  North of here is the northeastern
part of the large room.  You can also head to the west, where the large room
continues.

descKeys: ses echoing through the shrine. the shrine continues towards the north and east.
r4945.description:
You are in the most southwestern corner of the large shrine.  There is
usually a large demon of evil lurking around the shrine looking for another
foe to demolish.  You stop for a moment, and can hear strange noises echoing
through the shrine.  The shrine continues towards the north and east.

descKeys: ast, you can see light coming in from the corridor that leads out of the shrine.
r4946.description:
You are in the most northwestern corner of the shrine.  There are large
stains of blood all around the walls, it seems as if there has been some
gruesome fighting taking place in here.  Towards the east, you can see light
coming in from the corridor that leads out of the shrine.

descKeys: the east. the bright torches really show off how red the walls around here are.
r4947.description:
There are two rather large torches mounted on the western wall.  There
doesn't seem to be any obvious way to get out of this corridor, except for
heading back towards the east.  The bright torches really show off how red
the walls around here are.

descKeys: the hallway. it seems as if heading east is the only thing you can do from here.
r4948.description:
This small hallway runs towards the east.  The northern wall looks a bit out
of the ordinary.  As you look down towards the east, you can't see much
except for a small torch at the end of the hallway.  It seems as if heading
east is the only thing you can do from here.

descKeys: e wall luminating this part of the corridor. down this hallway towards the east,
r4950.description:
You are standing in a dark corridor that leads east and west.  In the
westward direction, you can see a bend in the corridor where it leads up
north again.  Far to the west you can see two small torches on the wall
luminating this part of the corridor.  Down this hallway towards the east,

descKeys: nt of light. you attempt to see around the bend in the corridor but to no avail.
r4951.description:
The corridor begins to bend towards the east.  It is a very sharp corner, and
you can't see around it.  There are two small torches mounted in the wall
here, which provide a satisfactory amount of light.  You attempt to see
around the bend in the corridor but to no avail.

descKeys: the north there is more light, and you can see an intersection of two hallways.
r4952.description:
This dark corridor begins to shrink a bit.  As you look down to the south,
there is just enough light for you to see a turn in the corridor.  As you
continue to head deeper into the dark seal the air is becoming much more
stale and hard to breathe.  Up to the north there is more light, and you can
see an intersection of two hallways.

descKeys: e down the southern corridor, it is very dark and you can't detect any movement.
r4953.description:
This is an intersection of two corridors.  The one leading east and west
appears to end abruptly after just a few steps to the west, making it look a
bit suspicious.  As you glance down the southern corridor, it is very dark
and you can't detect any movement.

descKeys: here. there are sounds throughout the corridors of this seal that are very loud.
r4954.description:
You are fairly deep inside the seal now.  You continue to walk around the
dark corridors very cautiously.  Your step on something that crunches beneath
your foot.  As you look down there is a skeleton of a halfling laying here.
There are sounds throughout the corridors of this seal that are very loud.

descKeys: some dried splattered blood. there has obviously been a fight here at some time.
r4955.description:
There are lots of strange sounds echoing around the small hallway.  As you
head further into the dark seal, you begin to regret ever entering it.  The
dim light that shines throughout the hallway lights up one of the walls.  On
the wall there is some dried splattered blood.  There has obviously been a
fight here at some time.

descKeys: f glowing light. there is a small hallway that heads south out of this corridor.
r4956.description:
You are in a a small dark corridor.  The walls are made out of some sort of
uknown brown stone.  There isn't anything around here that really grabs your
attention.  This place sheds a very ominous feeling.  Towards the east there
is some kind of glowing light.  There is a small hallway that heads south out
of this corridor.

descKeys: rn wall. you sense a small draft coming from both the eastern and southern wall.
r4958.description:
You are in a very small room, apparently some sort of secret area in the
castle.  The only thing that keeps the room from being dark is the torch
hanging on the western wall.  You sense a small draft coming from both the
eastern and southern wall.

descKeys: eel a small draft coming from the west wall. there is a iron door leading east .
r4959.description:
You are in the basement of Castle Lorasin.  The corridor appears to end here.
To the east is the castle's treasure chamber, the two guards that are posted
here will make sure no one without permission will pass.  You think you feel
a small draft coming from the west wall.
There is a iron door leading east ( OPENED ).

descKeys: ds posted out in front of it. the path to the east leads to the torture chamber.
r4960.description:
You are in the basement of Castle Lorasin.  You are standing before an
intersection that leads to the north, south and east.  The basement is not
cleaned as often as the other parts of the castle.  You draw this conclusion
because there are large deposits of dirt and dust throughout the walls and
floor.  To the south you you see a treasure chamber which usually has guards
posted out in front of it.  The path to the east leads to the
torture chamber.

descKeys: level. to the south you you see a treasure chamber with guard posted outside it.
r4961.description:
You are in the basement of Castle Lorasin.  This place is dark, cold and
damp.  The basement is built with stone, as the rest of the castle.  The
torches on the walls provides with the light.  North from here is a stairway
that leads up to the first level.  To the south you you see a treasure
chamber with guard posted outside it.

descKeys: leads up to the first level. to the south you think you see a treasure chamber.
r4962.description:
You are in the basement of Castle Lorasin,  it is probably the most unelven
part of the castle, as it is dark, cold and damp.  The basement is built with
stone bricks, as the rest of the castle.  The torches on the walls provides
with the light.  North from here is a stairway that leads up to the first
level.  To the south you think you see a treasure chamber.

descKeys: ement. there is also a stairway that leads up to the ground level of the castle.
r4963.description:
You are at an intersection of paths here in the basement of the castle.  The
basement is built of stone bricks, as is the rest of the castle.  A torch on
the northern wall provides with light.  You can see three paths, one to the
west that leads to the castle jail, and the other two are quite dark and lead
to other parts of the basement.  There is also a stairway that leads up to
the ground level of the castle.

descKeys: ur view. to the west is thick forest, and it seems so much darker back that way.
r4964.description:
As you move farther east, the trees begin to clear off a little, and the city
of Kelton look to be closer than ever.  From here you can't really tell much
about it, but it hopefully is a happening town.  You can sort of see the
buildings, but the thinning tree line still blocks your view. To the west is
thick forest, and it seems so much darker back that way.

descKeys: ght before. you can see a small village store through the clearing east of here.
r4965.description:
As you come to this part of the path, you can see exactly where the trees
open up more.  The city is still not very easy to see, but now you can see
some sort of people walking in and around the exit.  Though from here it is
hard to tell who they are.  The town as you can tell from here is looking a
little more promising than thought before.  You can see a small village store
through the clearing east of here.

descKeys: s. the entrance to city is off to the east. to the west you can see deep forest.
r4966.description:
When you step out into the clearing the town seems to erupt from the ground.
You wouldn't have guessed it was as big as it is.  From here you can tell
what type of people the inabitants are.  You can see dwarves in the city
going about their daily business.  The entrance to city is off to the east.
To the west you can see deep forest.

descKeys: e doing all sorts of things. kelton as you hoped seems to be one happening town.
r4967.description:
When you move farther east, the entire town comes into view.  The entrance to
the town is just to the east.  As you look back you can see the forest, it
looks almost impenetrable from here.  Through the entrance you can see people
doing all sorts of things.  Kelton as you hoped seems to be one happening
town.

descKeys: ches off into the other main street of kelton, which is heading north and south.
r4968.description:
You are on one of the main streets that lead through the city.  The name of
the street is Kelton Street.  Although it is not much of a street, its
starting to turn into more of a path.  Going west the path leads into thick
woodland, going east it leads into the more civilized part of Kelton.
Directly east of here Kelton Street branches off into the other main street
of Kelton, which is heading north and south.

descKeys: ho once stumbled upon this place after getting lost in the woodlands of merevia.
r4969.description:
You are in the intersection of Kelton Street and Griffith Street.  Directly
to the east is the city's square.  Looking towards the west you can see thick
woodland.  If you look either north or south you can see that Griffith Street
branches off in many directions.  Supposedly there is a parade that goes
through Kelton Street every year, honoring the founder of Kelton.  Gent
Griffith, a great dwarven explorer, was the one who once stumbled upon this
place after getting lost in the woodlands of Merevia.

descKeys: ee some thick woodlands. towards the east you can see the smithy and the church.
r4970.description:
You are in Kelton's main square.  Dwarves are hurrying about busily, going in
and out of the buildings lining the square.  In the center of the square
there are statues of Kelton's greatest warriors and its other heroes.  The
stonework of the street is perfect.  If you look towards the west you can
distantly see some thick woodlands.  Towards the east you can see the Smithy
and the Church.

descKeys: mine. each stone is carved to perfection and is fitting in snugly with the rest.
r4971.description:
You are just east of Kelton's main square.  To the north you can see a
fabulous looking Church and to the south you can see Kelton's legendary
Smith.  The street here is made of fantastic looking stone, probably mined by
the dwarves from some nearby mine.  Each stone is carved to perfection and is
fitting in snugly with the rest.

descKeys: of the other areas of the city because it is so close to the city's main square.
r4972.description:
This area of the city is filled with homes because it is the halfway point
between the Guard station and the city square. The square is to the west and
the station is to the east. The stonework here is breathtaking, it's better
than in most of the other areas of the city because it is so close to the
city's main square.

descKeys: ards the southwest, and you can see the mad cow, kelton's bar, to the northeast.
r4973.description:
You are walking on the streets in the dwarven city of Kelton.  The street has
been well-used but you can still see the beauty of the stone beneath all the
dirt and the dust.  The city's smith is towards the southwest, and you can
see the Mad CoW, Kelton's bar, to the northeast.

descKeys: from the lack of blood to their heads. there is a path leading to the northeast.
r4974.description:
This is a busy area of town, as the guard station is to the southeast and the
bank is a small distance south of here.  Guards are heading in and out of the
station reporting on the comings and goings.  Some of the dwarves walking out
of the bank have joyful smiles on their faces, while the others look as
though they might faint from the lack of blood to their heads.  There is a
path leading to the northeast.

descKeys: ornate, the design is somehow made up for by the simple geometry of the masonry.
r4975.description:
You notice quite a difference from Kelton Street to your southwest compared
to where you stand now.  Before you thought that the city of Kelton showed a
fine example of good architecture, but walking on the Path of Honor has
expanded your horizons.  There is not one imperfection on this hand-laid stone
pathway leading to the Honor Guard guild.  The proportions are flawlessly
precise, the stone walls on either side of you to the repeating sets of arcs
overhead.  Though not overly-ornate, the design is somehow made up for by the
simple geometry of the masonry.

descKeys: u can go to the north toward the guild or return back to kelton going southwest.
r4976.description:
You feel almost inferior as you walk along the Path of Honor, there is a
sense of history and age here beyond anything you have ever felt.  The stones
themselves seem to contain wisdom, having been there for such a long period
of time.  Coming out of your revery you once again notice the beauty of where
you stand, stone warriors begin to line the walls here, seemingly guarding
the path upon which you are standing.  You can go to the north toward the
guild or return back to Kelton going southwest.

descKeys: r or go south on the path of honor. there is a heavy wooden door leading north .
r4977.description:
The pathway comes to an end as it reaches the Honor Guard guild, which
consists of short stone walls with a thatched roof.  There are two stone
dwarven warriors standing guard at the door of the guild, each of them with
their hands on the hilt of their swords.  From where you stand now you can
enter the guild through the door or go south on the Path of Honor.
There is a heavy wooden door leading north ( OPENED ).

descKeys: ou stand in continues to the north. there is a heavy wooden door leading south .
r4978.description:
You are in awe as you stand in the entrance hall to the Merevia Honor Guard
guild.  The workmanship of the building is structurally perfect and has a
very stout dwarven feel to it.  The floor is of highly varnished dark wood,
the stone walls are hand-laid.  The atmosphere of the building is cheery but
solid and serious, reminiscent of the Dwarven race.  There are some wooden
stairs on the west side of the room that presumably lead to the basement,
while the hall you stand in continues to the north.
There is a heavy wooden door leading south ( OPENED ).

descKeys: s like an office, to the east is a bedroom, and the hall continues to the south.
r4979.description:
The quality and craftsmanship of the guild continues to astound you as you
walk through it.  You have never seen a building that is so impeccably
constructed, it is almost as if the hands of Reorx himself reached down from
the heavens and helped build these halls.  Weapons of legendary Honor Guard
members line the walls, each of them with their owners painting below them.
Reluctantly you pull your eyes from these weapons of awesome power and take
in your surroundings. To the north is what looks like an office, to the east
is a bedroom, and the hall continues to the south.

descKeys: ge wood-framed bed on the eastern side of the room, next to it stands a dresser.
r4980.description:
This room is home to one of the finest warriors ever trained by the Honor
Guard, Brenoak Grenith.  Rumor has it that after head-butting one too many
times, Brenoak went completely insane.  So high is the guild's respect for
this dwarf though, that they let him live here in permanent retirement.  His
quarters are extremely neat, even by military standards.  There is a large
wood-framed bed on the eastern side of the room, next to it stands a dresser.

descKeys: west and the east. you can here a bit of running water to the northeast of you.
r4981.description:
There are lots of trees that are on either side of you that are forming a
very large and thick canopy above.  You know it is quite warm right now, but
since all the trees are blocking all the sun light it is quite cold here.
The path leads to the west and the east.  You can here a bit of running water
to the northeast of you.

descKeys: a small amount of shade for the animals that live in and around the grasslands.
r4982.description:
You can feel a nice warm breeze coming off the Sea of Honshale here.  There
are a few puffy white clouds up in the sky that provide random spots of shade
through out the grasslands.  As you stare up at the clouds you forget about
everything that is around you.  The grasslands extend in all directions from
here allowing you to run, jump, or skip anywhere you wish without a worry on
your mind.  Off to the east you can see the Sea of Honshale.  There are a few
birds flying above the ocean chirping at each other.  Off to the west of the
grasslands you can see a dense forest that obstructs your vision from seeing
any further.  North of here you can see a decent sized tree that is providing
a small amount of shade for the animals that live in and around the
grasslands.

descKeys: u can see is grassland. this place is amazing, the pure nature clears your mind.
r4983.description:
The grassland starts sloping down as it gets closer to the Sea of Honshale,
you can hear the waves lapping up against the rocks from here.  There is a
tree just in front of you, there are many animal prints below it, they must
use it for shade.  The only thing you can see is grassland.  This place is
amazing, the pure nature clears your mind.

descKeys: uth the grasslands stretch on. towards the east you can see the sea of honshale.
r4984.description:
There grasslands are sloping a small bit down towards the east where the
coast is.  South of here you can see a rather small maple tree.  The grass is
rather thick here and it makes it quite difficult to walk.  You continue to
venture through this part of the grassland and as you're walking your foot
hits the body of a dead animal hidden in the grass.  Way off towards the west
you can see a dark forest and to the north and south the grasslands stretch
on.  Towards the east you can see the Sea of Honshale.

descKeys: rolling into the coast, and you wonder if there is any kind of life down there.
r4985.description:
The grasslands extend on in all directions from here.  It is quite difficult
to see since all of the grass around this part of the grasslands is so high
and thick.  Towards the east though, it begins to slope down towards the
coast, where the Sea of Honshale is located.  You can see some small waves
rolling into the coast, and you wonder if there is any kind of life down
there.

descKeys: of the grasslands. the grass is quite tall, and you can head in all directions.
r4986.description:
There is a rather strong breeze coming off of the Sea of Honshale.  All of
the grass bends a bit because of the wind, and you can hear it all swaying
back and forth.  The warm breeze quickly rushes past you, and it is silent
once again.  You can see a lot of tall trees west of here, they tower over
the grasslands and form the western boundary of the grasslands.  The grass is
quite tall, and you can head in all directions.

descKeys: ing into the beach, and you can hear the sounds of them crashing in on the land.
r4987.description:
The grass in this part of the grasslands is surprisingly low.  As you look
everywhere around you the grass looks a bit taller than here.  Off to the
west you can see the tips of some trees of the forest.  You can continue to
walk through the grasslands in all directions from here.  A small ways
towards the east you can see the Sea of Honshale.  There are some rather
large waves rolling into the beach, and you can hear the sounds of them
crashing in on the land.

descKeys: ere. you can head in all directions to get to different parts of the grasslands.
r4988.description:
You are walking through the rich and fertile plains of Merevia.  The thick
grass that surrounds you is all around the huge grassland area.  There are
small flowers, bushes, insects, and animals all around these grasslands.  You
are rather close to the Sea of Honshale which lies to the east of here, and
you can smell the aromas coming off of the ocean.  Just north of the
grasslands you can see the tips of some trees in a light forest.  There seems
to be something rather majestic about the forest north of here.  You can head
in all directions to get to different parts of the grasslands.

descKeys: ou from walking outside the forest path. the path leads both northeast and west.
r4989.description:
You have entered a forest full of mist and gloom.  South of you is a bridge
that crosses over a river.  The bridge is leading away from this horrid
place, into the grasslands of Merevia.  The trees around you are dense enough
to stop you from walking outside the forest path.  The path leads both
northeast and west.

descKeys: bushes are lining up on the sides of the forest path, looking quite unfriendly.
r4990.description:
As you venture forward into the forest you notice the eerie silence around
you.  There are no birds here, nor any winds blowing.  The thick layer of
mist is starting to lighten up towards the north.  Thorny leafless bushes are
lining up on the sides of the forest path, looking quite unfriendly.

descKeys: breaking up all around you, but you can see it getting denser to the southeast.
r4991.description:
You stop briefly to look around, as you get a panicked feeling that you
aren't alone in here.  You notice some gleaming eyes looking at you from deep
inside the forest.  The mist is breaking up all around you, but you can see
it getting denser to the southeast.

descKeys: tself right and left. you see that a mist is starting to form towards the south.
r4992.description:
This region of the forest is rather gloomy, giving you the impression that
there is a never-ending night here.  The trees grow very high, blocking any
sunlight that would try to enter this place.  The forest path isn't very
straight, as it keeps winding itself right and left.  You see that a mist is
starting to form towards the south.

descKeys: reating an impassable wall. you spot a large lake to the northeast of this spot.
r4993.description:
The darkness of the forest never seems to end.  All of the trees and plants
around you have died from the lack of sunlight.  The grey and rotting trees
are packed tight together, creating an impassable wall.  You spot a large
lake to the northeast of this spot.

descKeys: you can see a lake to the east of you. the lake is stretching far to the north.
r4994.description:
You suddenly get a feeling that the nature around you is looking at you,
almost as if it were alive.  There are a lot of vines crawling up on the
trees in this area.  You can see a lake to the east of you.  The lake is
stretching far to the north.

descKeys: ankle. to the north and east you can continue venturing through the grasslands.
r4996.description:
The bunny hops around with his ears flopping.
The bunny hops around with his ears flopping.
You are standing in the grasslands of Merevia.  To the west and south of here
lies dense forest which is unpassable.  The grass is very green here and is
about waist high.  There are lots of rabbit holes that are very hard to see
through the thick grass, you should be careful that you don't step in one and
break your ankle.  To the north and east you can continue venturing through
the grasslands.

descKeys: ou look to the east you can see a large amount of mushrooms covering the ground.
r4997.description:
Just west of you there is a large forest.  You can see some movement in the
thicket of the forest.  East of you the grasslands of Merevia extend as far
as you can see.  You can smell the pine trees that are just west of you.  You
look down at the ground and you can see some small animal tracks that look
quite conspicuous.  As you look to the east you can see a large amount of
mushrooms covering the ground.

descKeys: ou can walk in all directions from here to get to other parts of the grasslands.
r4998.description:
You are just west of the Sea of Honshale.  You can hear the water lapping up
on the shore, and it is one of the most harmonious sounds you've heard in
your lifetime.  There are many birds flying above the sea chirping at each
other and carrying on.  The grass here is a bit higher than the other parts
of the grasslands probably due to the location right next to the sea.  As you
look towards the east where the sea is, the grasslands begin to slope down a
bit and it seems as if you're going to walk right into the sea.  You can walk
in all directions from here to get to other parts of the grasslands.

descKeys: ea of honshale. you can head in all different directions through the grasslands.
r4999.description:
You continue to walk around the high grass.  It hurts your legs a bit, as
some of the small thorns and thistles poke you.  You can see a rather dense
forest west, and up to the north you can see some light woods.  All the way
east, you can see the beautiful waters of the Sea of Honshale.  You can head
in all different directions through the grasslands.

descKeys: ls through the grasslands you can see the grass swaying in the wind like a wave.
r5000.description:
There is a nice warm wind that is blowing through this part of the
grasslands.  You smell numerous strange aromas as the winds blow by.  West of
here you can see a large forest that determines the end of the grasslands.
East of here the grasslands stretch on and way off to the east you can see
the Sea of Honshale.  As a large gust of wind rolls through the grasslands
you can see the grass swaying in the wind like a wave.

descKeys: ead in several different directions to get to different parts of the grasslands.
r5001.description:
You are standing deep within the dense grasslands.  The grass is very high,
and seems rather dry.  The ground below you also feels a bit hard, and it
seems as if there hasn't been any rain here in a while.  Above the sky is
very clear except for a few clouds that are lounging in the sky.  You can
head in several different directions to get to different parts of the
grasslands.

descKeys: sea of honshale, otherwise there isn't anything else that grabs your attention.
r5002.description:
You step through the thick grass trying to avoid all of the briars that are
around this part of the grasslands.  There are thick patches of briars that
have been concealed by the high grass.  You carefully try to make your way
through without trying to get caught in any of the briar patches.  Way off
towards the east you can see the Sea of Honshale, otherwise there isn't
anything else that grabs your attention.

descKeys: . beyond the beach you can see the sea of honshale which looks pretty from here.
r5003.description:
The sun is beating down on you, there is not much shade anywhere except under
a couple trees.  There are large pretty flowers all across the ground, some
have been trampled by animals.  A little ways to your east is a small sandy
