beach, inhabated only by crabs and shells.  Beyond the beach you can see the
Sea of Honshale which looks pretty from here.

descKeys: many different directions from here to get to different parts of the grasslands.
r5004.description:
You continue to walk through the thick and high grass of the grasslands.
Above you the sky looks very clear, and the warm sun beats down upon you.
There is also a nice breeze coming off of the Sea of Honshale, so you don't
get too hot.  You can head in many different directions from here to get to
different parts of the grasslands.

descKeys: see the sea of honshale. you can head in several different directions from here.
r5005.description:
You are standing on a small hill in the middle of the grasslands.  Some of
the grass here is quite high, while in other spots the grass has been beat
down by something.  You have a pretty good view of all surroundings from the
top of this small hill.  North of the grasslands you can see some kind of
forest, and on the western side you can see a very large dark forest.  On the
eastern side you can see the Sea of Honshale.  You can head in several
different directions from here.

descKeys: grasslands you spot the tips of a couple trees, but you can't see anything else.
r5006.description:
As you continue to walk through the grasslands, a blade of grass slices the
side of your leg.  The soil here is very rich and dark, you now understand
how the plant life thrives.  The grass here is very tall, and it is quite
difficult for you to make your way around.  There is a huge forest off to the
west that looks very dark.  On the northern side of the grasslands you spot
the tips of a couple trees, but you can't see anything else.

descKeys: ds the west. all the way to the east you catch a glimpse of the sea of honshale.
r5007.description:
You are on the western side of the grasslands of Merevia.  Directly to your
west is a huge forest that looks very dense.  There is something strange
about the forest, and you get a feeling that something evil lurks in there.
The grasslands extend in all directions from here except towards the west.
All the way to the east you catch a glimpse of the Sea of Honshale.

descKeys: small bushes that look quite unfamiliar compared to the rest of the grasslands.
r5008.description:
The grass here climbs up to your chest.  As you continue to walk through the
grasslands a small bit of pollen enters your nose from a nearby flower and
you have to sneeze.  There are lots of yellow and pink flowers around here
that smell wonderful.  East of here the grasslands slope down and continue to
slope all the way to the sea.  From here you can see the sea fairly easily
and there are lots of white caps way out in the sea.  North of here you can
see some small bushes that look quite unfamiliar compared to the rest of the
grasslands.

descKeys: can walk along the forests outer edge to the southwest or towards the northeast.
r5009.description:
There is a huge dark forest that looms over you and the rest of the western
grasslands.  The forest are so thick you can't see more than ten feet into
the woods before it turns to darkness.  There is no possible way that you
could head through the woods without getting lost.  Off to the east the
grasslands extend as far as you can see with the scenic backdrop of the Sea
of Honshale.  You can walk along the forests outer edge to the southwest or
towards the northeast.

descKeys: ead in several directions from here to get to different parts of the grasslands.
r5010.description:
You can smell the blooming flowers that are scattered across the ground.
There is a dark forest that is directly to your west, it looks as if it has
been corrupted by some kind of evil.  You can hear many birds chirping and
the grass swaying in the wind.  The simplicity of the grasslands clears  your
mind, and allows you to be entirely at ease.  You can head in several
directions from here to get to different parts of the grasslands.

descKeys: ave been burnt, probably by the great fire that once swept through these plains.
r5011.description:
The fox wanders around the grasslands.
To your west is the dark forest which is too thick to go through.  There are
a few puny rasberry and blackberry bushes laying around this area of the
grasslands of Merevia. The grass is about five feet tall.  There are lots of
briars in the grass that keep getting stuck to you.  There are blackened
stumps everywhere that look to have been burnt, probably by the great fire
that once swept through these plains.

descKeys: prised if there are tons of small animals that live and burrow around this area.
r5012.description:
You are standing on the western most side of the grasslands.  Just west of
you, there is a thick dark forest.  As you try to walk through the forest you
quickly recognize that it is too thick and decide that you should stay in the
grasslands.  The grasslands expand in all other directions except towards the
west.  The grass here is quite high and you wouldn't be surprised if there
are tons of small animals that live and burrow around this area.

descKeys: ly runs into the beach. you can head in many other directions from here as well.
r5013.description:
The view of the Sea of Honshale is beautiful from here.  You are still
standing rather high above sea level, so you can see really far out into the
sea.  Off towards the east, the elevation drops a bit, then eventually runs
into the beach.  You can head in many other directions from here as well.

descKeys: heast, or east. if you head any other way, you'll be back out in the grasslands.
r5014.description:
This part of the grasslands continues to slope down towards the Sea of
Honshale.  You are just west of the coast now.  The sea looks very pretty and
there looks to be a lot of wildlife down near the water on the beach.  As you
stand here looking at the sea a small bit of sea spray just hits the side of
your face and rejuvenates you.  You can head towards the sea by going
northeast, southeast, or east.  If you head any other way, you'll be back out
in the grasslands.

descKeys: uthwest along the edge of the forest or continue to walk through the grasslands.
r5015.description:
There is a huge forest that towers over you west of here.  You glance into
the forest and see some large beings in there walking around.  You strain
your eyes in an attempt to see them, but they are just to far away.  The
grass here is quite dry and as you walk through it, it crackles a bit.  You
can head southwest along the edge of the forest or continue to walk through
the grasslands.

descKeys: were you look. way off towards the east you catch a view of the sea of honshale.
r5016.description:
There are lots of bushes and large trees west of you.  They make it
impossible to head any further west.  The tree line extends north and south
of here and as you look up and down it looks impossible to head west through
any part of it.  East of you are the grasslands of Merevia.  The grass is
really high almost everyhwere you look.  Way off towards the east you catch a
view of the Sea of Honshale.

descKeys: you can see the sea of honshale. there are many paths leading in all directions.
r5017.description:
Here you can see many bushes and trees to the west of you, to the east of you
are the Merevia grasslands.  They are long and a beautiful gold, the grass is
pretty high, and very thick.  Way off to the east, you can see the Sea of
Honshale. There are many paths leading in all directions.

descKeys: orthwest. the tunnel is at very steep slope leading down deeper into the ground.
r5018.description:
You have are standing just below the surface, and there is a small ladder
here in the middle of the tunnel that leads up.  There is a small hole in the
ground above that will allow you to leave the tunnel and get out onto the
surface.  All around the walls of the tunnel you can see rocks, boards, and
other objects placed within the walls to make sure there isn't any type of
cave-in.  The dark tunnel also leads back down towards the northwest.  The
tunnel is at very steep slope leading down deeper into the ground.

descKeys: lso head towards the northwest down the tunnel towards the bottom of the tunnel.
r5019.description:
You are standing in a tunnel that is just below the surface of the ground.
Southeast of here, you can see a lot of light shining into the tunnel from
the surface above.  There is a slight incline to the southeast and you can
head up the tunnel to reach the surface.  You can also head towards the
northwest down the tunnel towards the bottom of the tunnel.

descKeys: east as well where the tunnel continues to get closer and closer to the surface.
r5020.description:
There are lots of foreign objects that have been strategically placed in and
around the walls around this part of the tunnel in an attempt to stop any
cave-ins that may occur.  There is a small stream of water running past your
feet downwards towards the northwest where the deepest part of the tunnel is
found.  You can head towards the southeast as well where the tunnel continues
to get closer and closer to the surface.

descKeys: here. you can feel a bit of water running past your feet towards the northwest.
r5021.description:
The dark tunnel continues to run towards the northwest and southeast.
Southeast of here there is an incline and you assume that if you keep heading
towards the southeast you will come to the surface.  There is a small lantern
that has been hung from the northern wall that sheds just enough light for
you to see.  The tunnel also slopes downwards northwest of here.  You can
feel a bit of water running past your feet towards the northwest.

descKeys: d towards the southeast where the tunnel heads upwards back towards the surface.
r5022.description:
You are standing in the small tunnel, and there are lots of strange noises
echoing all around you.  There isn't much light, and it's fairly hard to find
your way.  Southeast of here you can see a lantern on the northern wall that
is providing some dim light.  You can head downwards towards the northwest,
where it looks to be the deepest part of the tunnel.  You can also head
towards the southeast where the tunnel heads upwards back towards the
surface.

descKeys: owest point of the tunnel, because northwest and southeast of here it is uphill.
r5023.description:
It seems to be especially damp in here, and it seems as if your downhill
descent has ended.  The small stream that is running over your feet seems to
be gaining a bit of current here, but there isn't enough light to see where
the water is traveling.  You can see a small lantern northwest of here, that
provides you with enough light to maneuver through this meandering tunnel.
It seems as if you have reached the lowest point of the tunnel, because
northwest and southeast of here it is uphill.

descKeys: uns over your feet. the tunnel stretches on towards the northwest and southeast.
r5024.description:
You feel quite unsafe here, and sense that a cave-in is impending.  Many of
the boards that have been used to prevent the cave-in from happening look
very old and rotted.  There is a small bronze lantern that has been mounted
on the northern wall, which reveals the condition of the boards.  The small
lantern also provides enough light for you to see the ground, where there is
a small stream of water that runs over your feet.  The tunnel stretches on
towards the northwest and southeast.

descKeys: ering from the southeast. you can follow the dark tunnel northwest or southeast.
r5025.description:
This sloping tunnel heads further away from the surface if you continue to
follow it towards the southeast.  This is obviously a man-made tunnel,
because you can see all the strange objects that have been used to give the
surrounding walls support so they dont crash in on you.  As you walk through
the dark tunnel you feel a bit of water on your feet.  It is quite dark in
here, but you can see a small lantern flickering from the southeast.  You can
follow the dark tunnel northwest or southeast.

descKeys: or the northwest, southeast of here the tunnel begins to slope downwards a bit.
r5026.description:
You are standing amidst a dark and small tunnel.  The walls have boards,
rocks, and other kinds of man-made materials propped up against them for
support.  You feel quite constricted as you walk through the small tunnel.
The only apparent light is coming from a small lantern that is northwest of
here.  Northwest of here, you notice a small ladder leading back up to the
surface.  You can head towards the southeast or the northwest, southeast of
here the tunnel begins to slope downwards a bit.

descKeys: a minimal amount of light. you can follow the dark tunnel towards the southeast.
r5027.description:
You are standing in a rather large tunnel that is just below the tailor of
Kelton.  There are lots of boards, rocks, and other various materials keeping
the tunnel from crashing in around you.  There is a small ladder sitting in
the middle of the tunnel that leads up to some floorboards that are about ten
feet above your head.  On the northern wall of the tunnel, there is a small
bronze lantern providing a minimal amount of light.  You can follow the dark
tunnel towards the southeast.

descKeys: time, and that would make sense since this is the only tailor's shop in kelton.
r5028.description:
This is the shop of the town's tailor.  There are some small lines strung up
around the shop with clothes hanging off of them.  It looks to be very busy
here a lot of the time, and that would make sense since this is the only
tailor's shop in Kelton.

descKeys: weaponry. to the south is a large building. there is a wood door leading south .
r5029.description:
Everywhere you turn you find yourself face to face with a dwarf.  Dwarves are
running in to you every few seconds, and it looks like you will never be able
to get out of the crowd.  The dwarves coming out of the tailor are showing
off their new fine fur coats or other expensive garments.  Also the people
walking out of the small shop to the west are flashing big smiles and
pointing to their new weaponry.  To the south is a large building.
There is a wood door leading south ( OPENED ).

descKeys: in and out of the tailor seem pleased and are carrying finely crafted garments.
r5030.description:
Directly to the north is a busy intersection.  To the southwest is a small
shop.  Also to the southeast there is a tailor and a curious looking hut.  If
you head south you will definetly start to move slower, because of the huge
throngs of dwarves running around spending their money.  The dwarves going in
and out of the tailor seem pleased and are carrying finely crafted garments.

descKeys: ominous appearance. directly south of here the road splits into an intersection.
r5031.description:
Everywhere you look there are signs of an advanced civilization.  The
stonework is beautiful and is all made of the rarest stone, including the
street!  Towards the north is the more dangerous part of the city, it is
almost deserted giving it a more ominous appearance.  Directly south of here
the road splits into an intersection.

descKeys: at is ruled by gangs of merciless criminals. there is an alley to the northeast.
r5032.description:
You are on the cobbled streets of Kelton.  Although this area does sport a
few decently made houses, the majority of dwarves on the street are probably
more adept at snatching purses than they are at mining.  The houses are all
heavily locked, some even chained.  Towards the southeast there is the city's
square.  You are now walking in the section of the city that is ruled by
gangs of merciless criminals.  There is an alley to the northeast.

descKeys: train your eyes southwestward you can make out what seems to be the city square.
r5033.description:
There are hardly any dwarves on Pickpocket's Ally, if any.  The guards have
no control here, although they might post a guard only to keep watch and make
sure nothing sneaks into the main part of the city.  If you strain your eyes
southwestward you can make out what seems to be the City Square.

descKeys: you can see kelton's shop. to the south you can see the back of kelton's church.
r5034.description:
You are on the northern side of Kelton.  There seems to be more and more
cutpurses as you head east.  There is no law here, because there are no
guards.  You should leave as soon as possible.   Far to the west you can see
Kelton's shop.  To the south you can see the back of Kelton's church.

descKeys: use there no signs of cutpurses down there. heading west would be a good choice.
r5035.description:
You are on the northern side of Kelton.  You have definitely reached the area
with the most cutpurse activity.  This part of the city is where huge groups
of cutpurses usually mingle.  You could venture towards the southwestwest to
reach safety, because there no signs of cutpurses down there.  Heading west
would be a good choice.

descKeys: ible, obviously of the dwarves' doing. kelton's shop is far to the west of here.
r5036.description:
This part of the alley is gloomy, it would be the perfect place for an
ambush.  Supposedly this is the more dangerous part of town ruled by
cutpurses and thieves.  But other than the criminal problems this area has,
it's a nice place.  The streets are very well made, of the rarest stone
possible, obviously of the dwarves' doing.  Kelton's shop is far to the west
of here.

descKeys: to the northwest is kelton's shop. to the south you can see a busy intersection.
r5037.description:
You are on the northern side of Kelton.  Usually cutpurses inhabit this part
of the road.  This area of town didn't used to be like this, but it has been
going downhill.  The Guards have no authority here whatsoever, they have
tried to take control but their raids have all been unsuccessful.  You should
get out of here as soon as possible, or face the consequences.  To the
northwest is   Kelton's shop.  To the south you can see a busy intersection.

descKeys: ay out of any situation. along the wall are shelves filled with different items.
r5038.description:
You are in a large shop in Kelton, in fact the largest one in Kelton.  Here
they buy and sell all kinds of various equipment.  The owner of the shop is
well known, and he can supposedly haggle his way out of any situation. Along
the wall are shelves filled with different items.

descKeys: ce that is usually occupied by a recruiter. there is a wood door leading north .
r5039.description:
You are in the meeting room for the Merchant's Guild of Kelton.  The room has
several tables in it, used by the Merchants when they assemble in any numbers,
or just assemble to hang out and shoot the breeze.  A small corridor leads
south to a rather large office that is usually occupied by a Recruiter.
There is a wood door leading north ( OPENED ).

descKeys: y torches, bags, and other supplies for the travellers that come through kelton.
r5040.description:
You are in the Kelton's General supply store where you can buy all of your
basic needs.  This is a small shop, it only consists of a small one room
building with a counter on the southern wall of the building.  Albeit the
store's homely appearance it still looks like it makes a fine profit.  Behind
the counter are the shelves that carry torches, bags, and other supplies for
the travellers that come through Kelton.

descKeys: ad west. industry square is to the west. something is curiously odd in this hut.
r5041.description:
You are in a small hut.  There is a large stone chair with a stone desk in
front of it.  As you look around the room you don't see anything of great
interest.  The only way out is to head west. Industry square is to the west.
Something is curiously odd in this hut.

descKeys: urch is a missionary of kertaine. these dwarves sure know how to build churches!
r5042.description:
Entering the church you are dumbfounded.  It is beautiful.  With marble walls
and velvet curtains it looks more like a palace than a church.  There is an
amazing looking cross made of gold and silver resting on the wall behind the
altar.  The ceiling goes high into the air and ends in a dome.  The church is
a missionary of Kertaine.  These dwarves sure know how to build churches!

descKeys: of heights. towards the southeast you can faintly see the city's guard station.
r5043.description:
You are on the cobbled streets of Kelton.  The street's stones were mined and
layed by the dwarves residing here.  This part of the city is very busy with
dwarves because of the bar to the northeast.  All the buildings around here
are very low because of the dwarves fear of heights.  Towards the southeast
you can faintly see the city's guard station.

descKeys: tizens. if sherrif gabe ever heard about this they would be in a lot of trouble.
r5044.description:
You are in a small alleyway called Merry Way.  It was probably named so
because everyone who goes to the Mad CoW does indeed have a merry time.  The
ally's rare stones are all layed in exaclty the right spot.  To the north,
you can see a restaurant with a sign that says 'The Broken Axe'.  Though not
accessible from here you can see the Mad CoW to the east.  Walking or rather
stumbling through the bar's stone doors are many drunken guards and citizens.
 If Sherrif Gabe ever heard about this they would be in a lot of trouble.

descKeys: here are multiple tables scattered around the room where people can sit and eat.
r5045.description:
You are standing in Kelton's most prominent restaurant, the 'Broken Axe'.
The owner of this establishment used to be a fierce warrior who broke many
axes in his career.  These broken axes of legend line the walls of the
restaurant. There are multiple tables scattered around the room where people
can sit and eat.

descKeys: owner of the bar is well-known mainly because of his skill at preventing riots.
r5046.description:
You are in the Mad CoW, the local bar in Kelton.  This is where Kelton's
guards and citizens go to after duty, to get drunk.  The bar is basically
just a nice counter made of stone, it has stone shelves behind it that
contain all the alcoholic drinks.  Just in front of the counter are some
stone benches and tables.  The owner of the bar is well-known mainly because
of his skill at preventing riots.

descKeys: otion since all of the cooks are running back and forth between different tasks.
r5047.description:
You are in the east part of the castle kitchen.  Some boiling iron pots stand
on the stove to the right, some of them are almost boiling over.  You see
empty iron pots on the shelf hanging on the northern wall.  There is quite a
bit of commotion since all of the cooks are running back and forth between
different tasks.

descKeys: out the food plates and silverware, as it's soon diner time here at the castle.
r5048.description:
This is the northern part of the dining room.  The long dining table ends
here at the north wall, and there is a special chair reserved for Lord
Lorasin at the short side of the table.  Some servants are running around
putting out the food plates and silverware, as it's soon diner time here at
the castle.

descKeys: ng up. the torch that hangs on the northern wall appears to be almost burnt out.
r5049.description:
You are in the basement of Castle Lorasin.  You look to the west and there
seems to be an intersection between some paths, and a stairway in the middle
of the room leading up.  The torch that hangs on the northern wall appears to
be almost burnt out.

descKeys: e water drips from corner of the ceiling, probably coming from the moat outside.
r5050.description:
This is the northeast corner of the basement.  To the west you can see a
stairway leading up, and even further to the west you spot the castle jail,
you can also see a torture chamber to the south.  Some water drips from
corner of the ceiling, probably coming from the moat outside.

descKeys: west, probably leading back to the stairway. there is a iron door leading west .
r5051.description:
You are in the basement of Castle Lorasin, east of the torture chamber.  The
chamber is not used very often, because the elves here are too kind to do any
harm to anyone.  To the north the corridor takes a turn to the west, probably
leading back to the stairway.
There is a iron door leading west ( OPENED ).

descKeys: n't seen any of this elsewhere. the path heads in two directions, east and west.
r5052.description:
There are many trees around here still, which makes it very hard to see
anything around you.  The path is starting to widen here, allowing you to
walk freely upon it.  There is some kind of excrement left behind from
something on the side of the path, which seems rather strange since you
haven't seen any of this elsewhere.  The path heads in two directions, east
and west.

descKeys: ks darker as well, but the path looks like it has been walked on far more there.
r5053.description:
The path is quite wide here and starts to bend a bit towards the southeast.
The trees all around you are blocking most of the sun out of this area.  The
underbrush has almost completey overgrown the path.  You can head towards the
north where it looks darker, or you can head towards the southeast where it
looks darker as well, but the path looks like it has been walked on far more
there.

descKeys: difficult to follow the path. the path heads in two directions, north and south.
r5054.description:
The path has opened up significantly, and is quite large here.  The trees
around here have decreased significantly in numbers, which seems a bit
strange.  Although many of the trees have decreased the underbrush has
thickened a lot, and makes it difficult to follow the path.  The path heads
in two directions, north and south.

descKeys: outh. as you look far down the southern path you can see it open up quite a bit.
r5055.description:
When you walk through this part of the forest, a couple small furry creatures
run by you and scurry into the forest.  The trees are still scattered amongst
this part of the forest allowing quite a bit of light to enter.  The path
continues in two directions, north and south.  As you look far down the
southern path you can see it open up quite a bit.

descKeys: protruding up through the trees. the path heads towards the south and the east.
r5056.description:
The path here has widened a lot, and the trees have become much less dense.
As you look through the trees to the far west, you can see some kind of a
village.  There path starts to take a turn to the south here, where it
continues to get lighter.  Also far to the west you can see a mountain
protruding up through the trees.  The path heads towards the south and the
east.

descKeys: tip of the mountain rises into the clouds. it looks actually quite intimidating.
r5057.description:
As you enter the clearing you get your first view of the mountain.  It is
very large, and it sort of protrudes from the ground.  To the west more you
can see a village.  There are many clouds at the top of the mountain, and the
tip of the mountain rises into the clouds.  It looks actually quite
intimidating.

descKeys: oks to be pretty dense in forest, and the wall on that side is very straight up.
r5058.description:
As you get closer the mountain seems to get a lot larger.  You can see a path
leading around the mountain to the northwest, or so you think.  Though to the
north the mountain looks like it is pretty accessible and climbable.  The
path around looks to be pretty dense in forest, and the wall on that side is
very straight up.

descKeys: un challenge, and when you reached the top you could say you were in the clouds.
r5059.description:
When you come to the absolute bottom of the mountain, you think you have a
pretty good chance of climbing this monticle.  As you look up, it looks like
it would take a whole day to climb this thing.  Though it looks like it would
be a fun challenge, and when you reached the top you could say you were in
the clouds.

descKeys: around the mountain. whatever it does, it doesnt look very easy to get through.
r5060.description:
When you get to the path and start to pick through the briers, you don't
really think this is going to lead anywhere.  There is always a chance
though, that this path leads around the mountain.  Whatever it does, it
doesnt look very easy to get through.

descKeys: any further would be hard. the only obvious exit you see is where you came from.
r5061.description:
As you break through the briers into this tiny space, you realize that you
have had enough of this venturing through here.  You can see a small opening
in the wall here, and it looks like something has burrowed into it.  There is
a large thorn patch here, so going any further would be hard.  The only
obvious exit you see is where you came from.

descKeys: ds the east, it looks darker than here, and towards the west it looks a lighter.
r5062.description:
As you look around the trees have decreased some, and have allowed some more
light to enter.  On the path you see a small birds nest that has fallen from
one of the trees, and you can see a couple small blue eggs inside of it.
Towards the east, it looks darker than here, and towards the west it looks a
lighter.

descKeys: u look down the paths. you can take the paths towards the west or the southeast.
r5063.description:
There are lots of different plants that have grown up and around this path.
The trees still form a formidable wall on either sides of the path.  It is
extremely hard to see anything here, and you can't really tell which way is
which.  It begins to brighten a little towards the west otherwise there is no
real difference when you look down the paths.  You can take the paths towards
the west or the southeast.

descKeys: of movement too. the path continues in two directions, northwest and southeast.
r5064.description:
The underbrush here has grown up quite a bit on the path.  It has been
increasingly harder to see here, and you can't see more than ten feet into
the forest.  As you look up towards the northwest it looks darker than here,
and you see a little bit of movement too.  The path continues in two
directions, northwest and southeast.

descKeys: hs of the forest. the path continues in two directions, northwest and southeast.
r5065.description:
You arrive here, and quickly come to notice that it is dark.  The underbrush
here is quite thick, and doesn't allow you to leave the path.  As you look
around you see some small eyes peering at you from the depths of the forest.
The path continues in two directions, northwest and southeast.

descKeys: orthwest as well, where it continues to get darker, and further into the forest.
r5066.description:
This part of the path is quite dark, and has many trees all around it.  The
underbrush here is quite thick, and doesn't allow you to leave the path.
Towards the southeast it looks much lighter than it does here, and looks as
if it has been travelled on more than this path.  The path heads towards the
northwest as well, where it continues to get darker, and further into the
forest.

descKeys: the island of merevia to come and reflect. there is a wood door leading south .
r5067.description:
This small temple has been constructed by the followers of Aber.  The room
is used as a meditation point for those who look to Aber for guidance.  A
few straw mats are on the ground, and the walls are bare.  The Monks built
this retreat for travellers to the island of Merevia to come and reflect.
There is a wood door leading south ( OPENED ).

descKeys: a view of the water, but you can see the ships coming in, and the ones leaving.
r5068.description:
As you step on the dock, you hear the squeaks of weathered wood.  Looking
forward you see many clusters of ships.  Many sailors run around in what
seems to be a methodical mess.  You see no pattern in what they are doing,
but you are sure they are following the orders being barked at them by the
captains.  They seem to enjoy their work though.  You dont have much of a
view of the water, but you can see the ships coming in, and the ones leaving.

descKeys: too much. not only that, you feel a little out of place, as well as in the way.
r5069.description:
As you reach the end of the dock you are practically surrounded by ships.  Or
at least it feels that way, and you are being bumped into by sailors left and
right.  There are a lot of people in a very small space, and you don't like
it too much.  Not only that, you feel a little out of place, as well as in
the way.

descKeys: docks continue to the west. ships that are going to dunagin (celtia) dock here.

transit.label: Kendrite Passages ship
transit.howTo: buy a pass at the company office (`routes`, `purchase N`), then at this berth `board ship`, `ready`

board ship.note: Kendrite Passages ship to Dunagin: buy a pass at the company office (`routes`, `purchase N`), then at this berth `board ship`, `ready`

r5071.description:
The ships of the Kendrite Passages shipping company are berthed here.  The
three-masted schooners are very seaworthy and capable of attaining high
speeds in the open sea.  The main building for the company is a bit to the
east, through a small archway.  The company's private docks continue
to the west.  Ships that are going to Dunagin (Celtia) dock here.

descKeys: ports and such. the southwest exit leads to the company's private docking area.
r5072.description:
You are in the Merevia branch of the Kendrite Passages shipping company.
A large desk is in one corner, obviously used by an employee.  A few posters
are on the walls, showing distant ports and such.  The southwest exit
leads to the company's private docking area.

descKeys: east, through a small archway. the company's private docks continue to the west.
r5073.description:
The ships of the Kendrite Passages shipping company are berthed here.  The
three-masted schooners are very seaworthy and capable of attaining high
speeds in the open sea.  The main building for the company is a bit to the
northeast, through a small archway.  The company's private docks continue
to the west.

descKeys: the idea that not much goes into the decor furnishing by the local inhabitants.
r5074.description:
This building houses the Profession trainer for this region.  The building is
not much to look at, but what the trainers provide is merely awesome.  The
walls of this place are bare, as you get the idea that not much goes into the
decor furnishing by the local inhabitants.

descKeys: used by the caravans running the north-south routes from threshold to kalinport.
r5092.description:
The Great Forest totally envelopes you, almost cutting you off from any sort
of view out of the trees.  The area gives you a sense of awe, gazing at the
surrounding greenery.  You are on a large road, about twenty feet in width,
that is used by the caravans running the north-south routes from Threshold
to Kalinport.

descKeys: used by the caravans running the north-south routes from threshold to kalinport.

that is used by the caravans running the north-south routes from Threshold
to Kalinport.

descKeys: orest. to the south, you can see some mountains standing high against the trees.
r5150.description:
You have just entered a trail that seems to run deep into the forest.  You
cannot see off in the distance, because there are many trees in this part of
the forest.  To the south, you can see some mountains standing high against
the trees.
