descKeys: is the crest of house do'urtye, one of the more powerful houses in nal shaddar.
r6.description:
Upon entering this shop, you can see that behind the counter is a wide variety
of items, ranging from potions to weapons to armors.  Directly on both sides
of the doorway are two beautifully crafted statues resembling spiders.  On
the large counter along the eastern wall is the crest of House Do'Urtye, one
of the more powerful Houses in Nal Shaddar.

descKeys: a large window in the eastern wall affords a great view of the plains of nereka.
r5181.description:
You are standing in 'The Cliff House', an upscale eatery in the city of
Deepwater.  The restaurant was designed by an early prominent member of the
city's ruling council.  About ten tables are around the room, with comfortable
chairs having been set around them.  A large window in the eastern wall affords
a great view of the Plains of Nereka.

descKeys: dium-sized bookshelf is in another corner. there is a wooden door leading east .
r5182.description:
This small office is used by a clerk for the city.  It looks like his job
is mainly one of monotony.  He has to count all the taxes that are collected,
and then put those figures into pie graphs and other boring things.  A small
desk is in the corner, and a medium-sized bookshelf is in another corner.
There is a wooden door leading east ( OPENED ).

descKeys: ing. there is a wooden door leading east . there is a wooden door leading west .
r5183.description:
The hallway ends here, only heading to the north.  There are two offices at
this end of the city hall, and both look like they are used often.  The ceiling
in this part of the building is in need of slight repair.  The paint on the
walls is blue, but it is chipping.
There is a wooden door leading east ( OPENED ).
There is a wooden door leading west ( OPENED ).

descKeys: this office looks to be some sort of slob. there is a wooden door leading west .
r5184.description:
You are in a small office, located in Deepwater's City Hall.  There is a small
desk against the eastern wall, with a wooden chair in front of it.  A stack
of papers are on top of the desk.  The owner of this office looks to be some
sort of slob.
There is a wooden door leading west ( OPENED ).

descKeys: the idea that not much goes into the decor furnishing by the local inhabitants.
r5185.description:
This building houses the Profession trainer for this region.  The building is
not much to look at, but what the trainers provide is merely awesome.  The
walls of this place are bare, as you get the idea that not much goes into the
decor furnishing by the local inhabitants.

descKeys: s always well-stocked. an open door leads to the west, to the blacksmith's shop.
r5186.description:
This shop handles the resizing of all sorts of armor.  The armorer working here
is know throughout the land to be quite good at his craft.  The shop is full
of materials for the workings he does, and is always well-stocked.  An open
door leads to the west, to the Blacksmith's shop.

descKeys: ly piece of furniture is a an elaborate gilded cabinet meant to hold the relics.
r5187.description:
Avatar strikes you and rox the mud for a mind-bogglingly GARGANTUAN amount.
In this room, the priests of the Church store the most holy of relics of
Kertaine.  The room glows with an unnatural, albeit holy brilliance.
Aside from a large tapestry on one wall, the only piece of furniture is a
an elaborate gilded cabinet meant to hold the relics.

descKeys: is asleep. there is no movement anywhere but there is no lack of jungle noises.
r5190.description:
As you look around you realize everything in this area of the dark jungle looks
the same as the last.  However, the trees here are very dense and still.  It is
almost as if this part of the jungle is asleep.  There is no movement anywhere
but there is no lack of jungle noises.

descKeys: ny rocks in your time it is hard to say if this particular stone is one of them.
r5191.description:
As you look around you realize everything in this area of the dark jungle looks
the same as the last.  There is a rock here in the middle of the path that you
recognize.  Perhaps you have happend by this place before.  You have seen many
rocks in your time it is hard to say if this particular stone is one of them.

descKeys: a bit depressed. perhaps you should hurry out of this area while you still can.
r5192.description:
As you look around you realize everything in this area of the dark jungle looks
the same as the last.  You can feel some strange energies in the air.  These
energies permeate your very being making you lethargic and a bit depressed.
Perhaps you should hurry out of this area while you still can.

descKeys: alize the insects of this nest were the cause of the demise of these poor souls.
r5193.description:
As you look around you realize everything in this area of the dark jungle looks
the same as the last.  There is a huge insect nest here surrounded by a number
of skeletons.  The skeletons are of various sizes, shapes and types.  Somehow
you realize the insects of this nest were the cause of the demise of these
poor souls.

descKeys: utside, but any light even a little is a welcomed sight in a place such as this.
r5194.description:
As you look around you realize everything in this area of the dark jungle looks
the same as the last.  Yet there is a slight break in treetop canopy.  The
soft light coming through the break marks this spot as unique.  Not that the
light is enough to distinguish whether it is night or day outside, but any
light even a little is a welcomed sight in a place such as this.

descKeys: was here long ago. the sign is not readable but you could still give it a look.
r5195.description:
As you look around you realize everything in this area of the dark jungle looks
the same as the last.  There is a small, old, rickety, wooden sign here.  The
sign is very worn and looks as though it were carved from an old stump that was
here long ago.  The sign is not readable but you could still give it a look.

descKeys: hink you've seen them before. walking in this jungle is like walking in circles.
r5196.description:
As you look around you realize everything in this area of the dark jungle looks
the same as the last.  A few fallen trees smaller in size than the rest lay
across the path to the southeast completely blocking it off.  You know you've
seen these fallen trees before.  At least you think you've seen them before.
Walking in this jungle is like walking in circles.

descKeys: you still might take a closer look at it, might be something you could make out.
r5197.description:
As you look around you realize everything in this area of the dark jungle looks
the same as the last.  A sign carved on a stone slab is laying off to the side
of the road.  It is pretty worn out by the elements and most all the words have
faded.  You cannot read the sign but you still might take a closer look at it,
might be something you could make out.

descKeys: th no special or distinguishable features or markings encircling its atmosphere.
r5198.description:
As you look around you realize everything in this area of the dark jungle looks
the same as the last.  There is absolutely nothing of interest in this area.
This area is just a typical jungle area with no special or distinguishable
features or markings encircling its atmosphere.

descKeys: h of your arm wide, the length of your finger deep, and as long as you are tall.
r5199.description:
As you look around you realize everything in this area of the dark jungle looks
the same as the last.  A trickle of a stream bobbles up right at this juncture
and meanders a bit along the ground.  Until it comes to a tree root and then
the stream disappears back into the ground.  The whole thing couldn't be more
than the length of your arm wide, the length of your finger deep, and as long
as you are tall.

descKeys: in front of your face it is so dark. this must be the very heart of the jungle.
r5200.description:
As you look around you realize everything in this area of the dark jungle looks
the same as the last.  This is by far the darkest part of the jungle.  It is
amazing that you can see your hand in front of your face it is so dark.  This
must be the very heart of the jungle.

descKeys: ems very dark. there is a strange buzzing or humming sound coming from the west.
r5201.description:
As you look around you realize everything in this area of the dark jungle looks
the same as the last.  There isn't too much that catches your attention in this
part of the forest.  The path to the east seems very dark.  There is a strange
buzzing or humming sound coming from the west.

descKeys: o the northeast. the famous mountain is said to be home to many wondrous things.
r5202.description:
As you look around you realize everything in this area of the dark jungle looks
the same as the last.  The jungle opens up a bit here and you can see a bit of
the sky.  You can also see the massive mountain, Mount Arimis, rising up to the
northeast.  The famous mountain is said to be home to many wondrous things.

descKeys: is so great in fact that a cloud seems to be forming in this part of the jungle.
r5203.description:
As you look around you realize everything in this area of the dark jungle looks
the same as the last.  It is very humid here, more so than in most parts of this
jungle.  The humidity makes the jungle swelter as if everything were in a giant
cooking pot about to boil over.  The humidity is so great in fact that a cloud
seems to be forming in this part of the jungle.

descKeys: his is probably an indication of the great mountain said to be to the northeast.
r5204.description:
As you look around you realize everything in this area of the dark jungle looks
the same as the last.  In fact even the humidity has carried over from the
northeast.  The ground here is sloped slightly to the south and a little to the
west.  This is probably an indication of the great mountain said to be to the
northeast.

descKeys: the slope of the land bringing all the waters of the nearby jungle by this way.
r5205.description:
As you look around you realize everything in this area of the dark jungle looks
the same as the last.  The ground here feels to be soft.  It is not quite the
consistency of mud, but it is not solid ground either.  The softness is due
most likely to the humidity and the slope of the land bringing all the waters
of the nearby jungle by this way.

descKeys: e is readable. a closer examination may allow you to read some of the 'writing'.
r5206.description:
As you look around you realize everything in this area of the dark jungle looks
the same as the last.  Very prominently, there are small bones embedded in a
nearby tree that look like they spell out some words.  However the tree has
grown over most of the bones so that little is readable.  A closer examination
may allow you to read some of the 'writing'.

descKeys: ing too lost. the path only allows two directions from here, west and northwest.
r5207.description:
As you look around you realize everything in this area of the dark jungle looks
the same as the last.  This appears to be a dead end.  'Dead' being the key
word.  This is probably as far to the east as one can travel in this jungle
before getting too lost.  The path only allows two directions from here, west
and northwest.

descKeys: y there are makes one aware of danger that might be 'lurking' just out of sight.
r5208.description:
As you look around you realize everything in this area of the dark jungle looks
the same as the last.  There are many strange footprints all around on the
ground in this area.  The footprints seem to be humanoid in nature but slighty
disfigured.  This together with how many there are makes one aware of danger
that might be 'lurking' just out of sight.

descKeys: would seem that there are other turns that you simply cannot see in this light.
r5209.description:
As you look around you realize everything in this area of the dark jungle looks
the same as the last.  This seems to be a junction of sorts.  Even though you
can only distinguish two exits from this angle it would seem that there are
other turns that you simply cannot see in this light.

descKeys: robably come to drink from the small swampy pond to the immediate south of here.
r5210.description:
As you look around you realize everything in this area of the dark jungle looks
the same as the last.  There are footprints of every kind on the ground here.
All forms of life probably come to drink from the small swampy pond to the
immediate south of here.

descKeys: he jungle yet and many things could change before this place will let you leave!
r5211.description:
The jungle's dark veil lessens a bit releasing its death grip on you.  You are
probably nearing an exit to the jungle and that is the reason for the jungle's
powers to be waning.  However, you are not out of the jungle yet and many
things could change before this place will let you leave!

descKeys: of things. to the far northeast you can see mount arimis engulfing the horizion.
r5212.description:
You are near the opening to this dark jungle.  You can see much light to the
north.  To the south and southwest the jungle deepens getting much darker and
a lot more humid by the feel of things.  To the far northeast you can see Mount
Arimis engulfing the horizion.

descKeys: ge tree. behind all this to the northeast is the great and massive mount arimis.
r5213.description:
You are on the edge of an opening at the entrance to a dark jungle.  To your
south the jungle closes in becoming very dark and foreboding.  To your
immediate north there are two massive juts of land pushing straight up and
forming a rather unscaleable vertical walls.  There is however, a crack
between these two walls, but it is filled by a HUGE tree.  Behind all this to
the northeast is the great and massive Mount Arimis.

descKeys: be large enough to completely fill the space in between the two walls of stone.
r5214.description:
You are in an opening traveling along a simple path.  Ahead of you to the
north there is HUGE tree growing in between two walls of rock.  In a few years
this tree may be large enough to completely fill the space in between the two
walls of stone.

descKeys: of the tree where the tree seems to touch the western face of the eastern wall.
r5215.description:
The path ends here where the huge tree meets the wall.  The path also continues
back to the west.  There is not much you can see past the rock walls and giant
tree.  You notice a growth of numerous vines along the east side of the tree
where the tree seems to touch the western face of the eastern wall.

descKeys: this path. the path also continues to the east where it runs into a large tree.
r5220.description:
The path is well-worn running to the north.  It would seem that someone or
something uses this road very often.  The tracks are all similar but numerous.
If you didn't know any better you might think someone was pacing up and down
this path.  The path also continues to the east where it runs into a large
tree.

descKeys: someone who either knows something important or someone who is completely crazy.
r5221.description:
This road you are on runs north and south.  The road is well-worn with
multitude of tracks.  To the north the trail turns around a bend to the east.
Interestingly enough, the same is true of the southern portion of the road.
What person would make a road that goes around nothing?  The answer is probably
someone who either knows something important or someone who is completely
crazy.

descKeys: little to the east you can see the massive mountain, mount arimis is very close.
r5222.description:
This road is well-worn as it runs to the south.  Many tracks are embedded in
this road and they all look the same.  The path also goes east from here.  As
you look north and a little to the east you can see the massive mountain, Mount
Arimis is very close.

descKeys: the ravine surrounding the base of the mountain someone has constructed a wall.
r5223.description:
You are on the southwestern edge of a small grass field that borders a well
worn road.  To the north you can see a ravine between the grass field and the
mountain.  Across the ravine surrounding the base of the mountain someone has
constructed a wall.

descKeys: path spreads out to the west, north and northeast. to the north is mount arimis.
r5224.description:
You are standing in the middle of a green grass field.  There is a slight
breeze wafting across the field making everything feel very pleasant indeed.
There is a slight path of sorts on the ground.  The path spreads out to the
west, north and northeast.  To the north is Mount Arimis.

descKeys: it opens. you also notice a small make-shift shack off to the side of the gate.
r5225.description:
You are standing before a massive stone gate.  This gate is not typical in the
least.  It is covered in many interesting carvings and strange writings.  Its
size is at least fifty feet tall, if not higher, and a tremendous thirty feet
wide!  Strangely enough you do not see any hinges, keyholes, laches, or even
seams.  This gate doesn't look like it opens.  You also notice a small
make-shift shack off to the side of the gate.

descKeys: d climb to that ledge or head west along the ledge on which you currently stand.
r5227.description:
Hanging on tight to the mountainside you look up and see a much larger ledge
about twenty more feet above your current position.  You don't see a safe way
to climb down from here, just up.  You could perhaps try and climb to that
ledge or head west along the ledge on which you currently stand.

descKeys: reath away. you notice some hand holds that might let you climb up the mountain.
r5229.description:
You are standing on a wide mountainside ledge.  There is not much here on the
ledge itself except the rocks of the mountain.  Although the view from here
sweeps in a panoramic spectacular that takes one's breath away.  You notice
some hand holds that might let you climb up the mountain.

descKeys: ttle bit of vegetation growing. it also looks as though you could climb up here.
r5231.description:
You are on a mountain ledge.  There doesn't seem to be much of interest here
save the view and the shear size of the mountain itself.  You notice the
ledge continues to the south where there is a little bit of vegetation growing.
It also looks as though you could climb up here.

descKeys: is a small outcropping of rock that extends itself out to the southeast of here.
r5233.description:
You are in a small crevasse on the side of the mountain known as Mount Arimis.
The crevasse not much more than a niche in the rock of the mountain, however it
appears that the crevasse makes it easy to climb upward.  There is a small
outcropping of rock that extends itself out to the southeast of here.

descKeys: up but you could climb down to the bottom of the crevasse just below this ledge.
r5234.description:
You have found your way to the west end of yet another very small ledge of this
mountain.  This particular ledge runs east and west.  It looks like you are
very high up but you could climb down to the bottom of the crevasse just below
this ledge.

descKeys: ly around such hiding places where unknown assailing dangers could lurk in wait.
r5235.description:
The rock like formation on which you stand continues eastward to where it
becomes a very narrow ledge.  Many mountain rocks litter themselves all about
your surrounding making a multitude of unseen places.  One should proceed
cautiously around such hiding places where unknown assailing dangers could lurk
in wait.

descKeys: resting qualities but it is the only thing marking the undistinguished environs.
r5236.description:
A flat barren plateau stretches southwest.  This less than large plateau is
flat, smooth and featureless.  The only attention-grabbing item is a small
boulder in the center of the southwest trail.  Even this rock lacks interesting
qualities but it is the only thing marking the undistinguished environs.

descKeys: ess plateau encourages you a bit. you suddenly notice a very small tree growing.
r5237.description:
The southwest end of a bleak plateau ends here up against the mountain.
Although it looks like you could perhaps climb up the mountain.  A feeling of
gladness and eagerness to leave this featureless plateau encourages you a bit.
You suddenly notice a very small tree growing.

descKeys: e heights are certainly not for those who have any problems with high altitudes.
r5238.description:
You look over the slender edge and start to notice how far away the ground
truly is.  The view produced by this height is expansive and hard to take in
altogether.  These heights are certainly not for those who have any problems
with high altitudes.

descKeys: his mountain their home these holes are probably what passes as their dwellings.
r5239.description:
You are on a very slender edge up against the mountain.  There are a number of
decent sized holes in the side of the mountain right here.  From their size,
general appearance and the fact that a Trorc tribe calls this mountain their
home these holes are probably what passes as their dwellings.

descKeys: is in the back of the room, hanging open. the exit to the street is to the west.
r5241.description:
This newly-built shop is home to a travelling Smith who has finally decided to
settle down.  A large forge is on one side of the room, right beneath a metal
canopy.  A cooling trench is near the forge.  A small door is in the back of
the room, hanging open.  The exit to the street is to the west.

descKeys: fferent types of animals. there is a small sign on the wall that you could read.
r5242.description:
You are in a large shop set in the center of the huge merchant area of the
large desert city, Kalinport.  This particular shop caters to those people
who desire to own pets of all sorts.  Several cages are around the shop,
containing many different types of animals.  There is a small sign on the
wall that you could read.

descKeys: oking down you can see several fish byproducts, like eyes, entrails, and scales.
r5243.description:
This small shop specializes in the buying and selling of all types of marine
wildlife, mainly of the fish type.  A few crates are holding the salted-down
piles of fresh fish, ready for transport to other cities.  Looking down you
can see several fish byproducts, like eyes, entrails, and scales.

descKeys: ks upon them, as if some large and fearsome creature regularly visits this area.
r5286.description:
The tunnel branches off here, leading three separate ways.  The stagnant air
in this part of the mines causes you to gag slightly.  While gagging, you
notice that the walls have scratch marks upon them, as if some large and
fearsome creature regularly visits this area.

descKeys: doing some errand or other. the northern warrens continue to the east and south.
r5296.description:
You are near the north end of the Northern Warrens.  The houses around here
are large, with some being very grand indeed.  Here and there you can spot
servants of the rich Duergar running around doing some errand or other.  The
Northern Warrens continue to the east and south.

descKeys: een recently paved, and is in good shape. you do not see any noticable potholes.
r5297.description:
The Northern Warrens is home to many a rich Duergar, and the Duergar who do
not live in this section are usually poor or ordinary laborers.  The road
you are on has been recently paved, and is in good shape.  You do not see
any noticable potholes.

descKeys: rn corner leads up to the market plaza, as well as down to another meeting hall.
r5298.description:
This small area is used by the Duergar as a meeting hall of sorts.  A few stone
benches are around the room, and there is also a large table near the wall
to the north.  A set of stairs in the southwestern corner leads up to the
market plaza, as well as down to another meeting hall.

descKeys: one corner of the room. a small set of stairs leads up to another meeting hall.
r5299.description:
You are in a small meeting area, used by the Duergar when they need to gather
together to decide on specific measures.  A few stone benches have been put
here, as well as a large table that is in one corner of the room.  A small
set of stairs leads up to another meeting hall.

descKeys: rs that are leading up to some kind of floor owned by the merchants of dunkrist.
r5300.description:
You are standing inside of Dunkrist's main shop.  Several shelves line the
walls, full of both mundane and exotic goods.  The shop has been here for
many years, owned and operated by an old duergar who is past retirement age.
A large stone archway leads west towards the outside cavern.  A smaller and
newer-looking staircase leads down.  There is also a small flight of stairs
that are leading up to some kind of floor owned by the merchants of Dunkrist.

descKeys: s to get back to the shop below here. there is a small hallway that leads north.
r5301.description:
You are just above the shop in the city of Dunkrist.  This is a large room
with a thick elaborate carpet.  There are lanterns mounted on all the walls
around the room providing a steady bright light.  On the walls of the room
there are very elegant and beautiful paintings.  You can walk back down the
flight of stairs to get back to the shop below here.  There is a small
hallway that leads north.

descKeys: m. you can head north to get to a large open room where there is some furniture.
r5302.description:
There is a large fountain here in the middle of the room.  There is a statue
of a duergar in the middle of the fountain.  The statue has water coming out
of it's mouth filling the pool at the base of the fountain.  The paintings on
the wall are all intricate and beautiful.  The lanterns on the walls provide
plenty of light for you to see the paintings.  The carpet here is very soft
and has exquisite designs on it.  South of here there is a large open room.
You can head north to get to a large open room where there is some furniture.

descKeys: e south, where you can see a large fountain. there is a iron door leading east .
r5303.description:
You are standing amidst a very large room.  There are small paintings located
all around the room.  The carpet you're walking on is very soft and it feels
good on your feet.  Around the walls there are also some small lanterns that
are providing plenty of light.  Up against the eastern and western walls of
this large room, there are some large couches.  There is an open door in the
northern part of this room leading to some other part of the guild.  You can
also go towards the south, where you can see a large fountain.
There is a iron door leading east ( CLOSED ).

descKeys: for many of the duergar merchants to relax. there is a iron door leading east .
r5304.description:
You arrive just south of the quarters of the renowned duergar merchant,
Arcath.  There is a large open door north of here that is the entrance to his
quarters.  He is rumored to be the smartest duergar that has ever lived.  The
amount of time and money he must have put into this guild amazes you.  The
beautiful paintings are still all over the walls, the intricate lanterns
continue to burn around the room, and the soft carpet lines the entire floor
of the guild.  You can head north into Arcath's quarters or back down to the
south where there is a large room for many of the duergar merchants to relax.

There is a iron door leading east ( OPENED ).

descKeys: s. the door to the south is open allowing anyone to leave or enter his quarters.
r5305.description:
You are standing in a large room that belongs to Arcath.  Arcath is the most
successful duergar merchant that has ever lived.  There is a large bed in the
northern part of his room that looks very comfortable.  On the eastern side
of the room there is a large desk made out of a dark brown wood.  There are
small lanterns placed all around the room to give Arcath the necessary amount
of light.  There is a small archway on the western side of this room that
leads to another part of Arcath's quarters.  The door to the south is open
allowing anyone to leave or enter his quarters.

descKeys: eady stream of duergar is running to the west, heading for the merchant's plaza.
r5306.description:
You are in the northeastern part of Dunkrist, near a residential district.
A small, yet interesting, shop lies to the southeast, looking like some sort
of armoury.  A steady stream of Duergar is running to the west, heading for
the merchant's plaza.

descKeys: s section is in good shape, and looks like it has been repaired rather recently.
r5307.description:
You are in the eastern section of the Duergar city of Dunkrist.  Around this
area are medium-sized buildings that you presume are houses.  The road going
through this section is in good shape, and looks like it has been repaired
rather recently.

descKeys: the room, with a large anvil having been set directly in the middle of the shop.
r5308.description:
The small shop you are standing in has only been in Dunkrist for a short time.
The owner of this shop recently returned to his homeland after spending years
with an unknown smith, learning how to enhance armor.  After returning home,
the duergar opened this shop, ready for business.  A curious-looking device
is in one corner of the room, with a large anvil having been set directly in
the middle of the shop.

descKeys: counter in the middle of the shop. a small staircase leads up into another shop.
r5309.description:
This small shop was recently opened by a local duergar by the name of Grotuy
Hammerclaw.  The shop specializes in buying and selling iron ore and also
other raw materials.  Large stone shelves line the walls and there is a
long stone counter in the middle of the shop.  A small staircase leads up into
another shop.

notes: Aboard Kendrite Passages ship: not a place on the map. Arrival is recorded as a transit link from the boarding room.
r5319.title: Kendrite Passages ship
r5319.description: You are standing on the deck of a large seafaring vessel.

descKeys: e south. there is a wood door leading east . there is a wood door leading west .
r5320.description:
This is the castle staff's living quarters.  There is a sign saying 'Captains
Quarter's' on the door to the east, and one saying 'Castle Mage Quarter's' on
the west door.  There are flower baskets hanging above both doors, with
flowers from the castle garden.  The corridor continues to the south.
There is a wood door leading east ( OPENED ).
There is a wood door leading west ( CLOSED ).

descKeys: see the guard barracks starting to the west from the south end of the corridor.
r5321.description:
This is the castle staffs living quarters.  There is a window on the east
wall, looking out over the forest that surrounds the castle.  The corridor
continues to the south, and you can see the guard barracks starting to the
west from the south end of the corridor.

descKeys: rough the staff's living quarters ends here. there is a wood door leading west .
r5322.description:
You are in the south part of the castle staff's living quarters.  There is a
window on the east wall, outside the window you can see the forest that
surrounds this castle.  There is a sign hanging on the west door that says
'Guard Barracks'.  The corridor leading through the staff's living quarters
ends here.
There is a wood door leading west ( OPENED ).

descKeys: western one is a training and workout room. there is a wood door leading east .
r5323.description:
You are in the guard barracks.  In this room there are two tables with one
bench on each side, the guards usually sit here when they rest after their
shifts and when they eat.  There are two other rooms here, the southern one
is used for resting, and the western one is a training and workout room.
There is a wood door leading east ( OPENED ).

descKeys: unted weapons in a weapons rack for the guards to use when they practice combat.
r5324.description:
You are in the western part of the guard barracks.  The guards use this room
to practice and workout.  There are weights and strange workout machines
lying on the floor, and some dummies have been hung up from the ceiling so
the guards can practice their melee skills.  There are also blunted weapons
in a weapons rack for the guards to use when they practice combat.

descKeys: they have. next to the bunks are wooden lockers for personal items and clothes.
r5325.description:
You are in the southern room of the guard baracks.  This room contains bunks
on the west and east side for the guards to sleep in, they do not look
comfortable, but its all they have.  Next to the bunks are wooden lockers for
personal items and clothes.

descKeys: l light coming from anywhere. to the east is the castle staff's living quarters.
r5326.description:
This staircase leads to the upper levels of Castle Lorasin.  The staircase is
spiral-formed and made out of metal.  There are torches on the walls here to
provide with light, since there are no natural light coming from anywhere.
To the east is the castle staff's living quarters.

descKeys: ntersection of corridors leading in three different directions towards the east.
r5327.description:
This is the upper level of Castle Lorasin.  There is a staircase leading back
down to the first level.  It is spiral-formed and made out of metal.  There
is an eerie silence here, making a chill run down your spine.  You can see an
intersection of corridors leading in three different directions towards the
east.

descKeys: e this place seem more like home. to the east there is a corridor leading north.
r5328.description:
This is the upper level of Castle Lorasin.  To the south you see the entrance
to the southeast tower.  Someone has hung up a painting on the northern wall
to make this place seem more like home.  To the east there is a corridor
leading north.

descKeys: idor stops and heads west. there are several paintings and banners on each wall.
r5329.description:
You are in a corridor heading north, towards the living quarters of Lord
Lorasin himself.  There is a red carpet lying on the brick floor following
the corridor, until the corridor stops and heads west.  There are several
paintings and banners on each wall.

descKeys: su lane, or you can head back towards the west where there are more men working.
r5330.description:
Jitsu Lane is just southeast from here.  It is still quite dark, and there
are some men still digging into the ground and walls trying to make more
room.  There is quite a bit of light here that is coming from the southeast
where Jitsu Lane is.  Gaiden road heads towards the southeast where it leads
into Jitsu Lane, or you can head back towards the west where there are more
men working.

descKeys: ards the northeast. you can also leave the dojo here and get back on jitsu lane.
r5331.description:
This is the entrance room inside of the master samurai's dojo.  There are two
paths leading to different parts of the dojo.  Up towards the northwest you
can see some practice dummies, weapons, and large mats on the ground.  From
here it looks like it might be some kind of training area.  Up to the
northeast is where the master samurai is located.  There is a large intricate
red carpet leading towards the northeast.  You can also leave the dojo here
and get back on Jitsu Lane.

descKeys: so head back down towards the southwest to get back to the entrance of the dojo.
r5332.description:
You are walking on the red carpet here.  It continues to head up towards the
northeast and also back down towards the southwest.  This hallway leads to
the master samurai.  Up to the northeast you see some movement and it looks
as if there have been some guards stationed there to protect the samurai.
You can also head back down towards the southwest to get back to the entrance
of the dojo.

descKeys: the hallway leads back down to the southwest and it also leads up to the north.
r5333.description:
As you arrive here the red carpet has dissapeared.  Instead of the carpet
there are now large flower pots with huge red flowers lining either side of
the hallway.  You are now getting quite close to the master samurai.  He is
north of here somewhere.  This is a guard outpost where guards usually stay
here to protect their master.  The hallway leads back down to the southwest
and it also leads up to the north.

descKeys: fight. you can also head back down to the southeast to the entrance of the dojo.
r5334.description:
You have entered the training sect of the mighty samurai warriors.  There are
large dummies all around the room.  There are also some weapons that are
hanging from the wall.  Up towards the north is where the samurai teachers
instruct their students how to fight.  You can also head back down to the
southeast to the entrance of the dojo.

descKeys: ontinues on towards the west, and you can also head back down towards the south.
r5335.description:
There are huge mats all over the floor here.  Here is where the master
samurai teach their students the arts.  There are blood stains throughout the
room and it looks as if there have been many fights here.  There is a rack of
weapons for them to use to train their skills in other areas besides hand to
hand combat.  The sect continues on towards the west, and you can also head
back down towards the south.

descKeys: as taken place here in years past. the sect leads to the east and the southwest.
r5336.description:
You are in the training sect of the samurai.  Here all of the young samurai
will be tought how to be mighty warriors.  There are mats all around the room
for the trainers and youths to spar.  There are large amounts of blood that
have collected on the walls due to the immense amount of fighting that has
taken place here in years past.  The sect leads to the east and the
southwest.

descKeys: rai that wishes to serve for the master samurai has to pass in the testing room.
r5337.description:
You are just north of the samurai testing room now.  Here is the last part of
the training sect.  There aren't any mats here to protect the falls of the
upcoming samurai.  The sect continues towards the north where there is more
training of the samurai.  Down towards the south though, is the final testing
room.  Any samurai that wishes to serve for the master samurai has to pass in
the testing room.

descKeys: trainers and students. the only way to leave the testing room is to head north.
r5338.description:
You are in the testing room of the samurai sect.  This is the last step that
the students have to pass before becoming a part of the samurai arts.  There
are large collections of blood on each of the four walls.  There is intense
battle here between trainers and students.  The only way to leave the testing
room is to head north.

descKeys: lway in two directions north or south. up north you see quite a bit of movement.
r5339.description:
This hallway continues to head north and south.  There are large flower pots
that line both sides of the hallway.  There are usually some of the master
samurai's servants here to protect any intruders from coming any further into
the dojo.  You can follow the hallway in two directions north or south.  Up
north you see quite a bit of movement.

descKeys: llow the hallway towards the north, or you can head back down towards the south.
r5340.description:
The hallway continues on towards the north and south.  Up towards the north
you can't see any kind of movement.  The hallway is still lined on both sides
with beautiful flower pots full of red flowers.  You feel as if you are
getting mighty close to the master samurai.  You can continue to follow the
hallway towards the north, or you can head back down towards the south.

descKeys: here is a adamatite door leading east . there is a adamatite door leading west .
r5342.description:
You are in the main part of the House.  This sanctuary is used by the Nobles
of the House when they are plotting to destroy other Houses.  Several large
couches and chairs are here, with several tables having been placed against
one of the walls.  The main balcony is back to the east.
There is a adamatite door leading south ( LOCKED ).
There is a adamatite door leading east ( LOCKED ).
There is a adamatite door leading west ( LOCKED ).

descKeys: own the mountain. from here you could possibly go up a bit to another main path.
r5343.description:
You are standing next to a large rock.  To your north the Absinthe Mountains
stretch high up up into the sky.  To your south you see the Kendrite Sea in the
distance stretching out all the way to the horizon.  To your east you see what
just might be a small rocky path leading down the mountain.  From here you
could possibly go up a bit to another main path.

descKeys: edge of the path you can see the kendrite sea, which stretches far to the east.
r5344.description:
The path, which is very rough in some places, is running along the side of
a large mountain, which must belong to the Absinthe Mountain range.  Looking
down past the edge of the path you can see the Kendrite Sea, which stretches
far to the east.

descKeys: mountain that the path is running along rises way above you, shrouded in clouds.
r5345.description:
The path is very rocky here, as if there has not been very much traffic as
of late.  In some places you have to climb over small boulders just to
keep moving.  The mountain that the path is running along rises way above
you, shrouded in clouds.

descKeys: rite sea. the sea stretches out as far as the eye can see, way past the horizon.
r5346.description:
The path is coming precariously close to the edge, making you wonder if this
was such a good choice to travel it.  Looking down you can spot the large
and imposing Kendrite Sea.  The Sea stretches out as far as the eye can
see, way past the horizon.

descKeys: top of the mountain, high above you. the path continues southwest and northeast.
r5347.description:
The path is winding its way around the large mountain, switching back and
forth with regularity, dangerously close to the edge.  Looking up, you can
almost see the top of the mountain, high above you.  The path continues
southwest and northeast.

descKeys: e a small outcropping which ends suddenly, and you think you actually see smoke.
r5348.description:
The small path you are on continues to wind around and 'twords the base
of the mountain, and you are dangerously close to the edge.  To the north
you spy what looks to be a small outcropping which ends suddenly, and you
think you actually see smoke.

descKeys: hundred feet above the sea. a town has been built at the base of the mountain !
r5349.description:
You are standing at an outcropping that ends in a cliff here.  Down below you
it looks like the mountain itself has been cut away in a gigantic pie shape
and a base leveled out about one hundred feet above the sea.  A town has been
built at the base of the mountain !

descKeys: guardpost is situated at the border of the town, evidently screening travellers.
r5350.description:
You are standing near the bottom of a large cliff that stretches high above
you.  The cliff looks treacherous, but may be climbable.  The Minotaur town
of Minot is to the north a ways.  A guardpost is situated at the border of
the town, evidently screening travellers.

descKeys: ost of the population isn't too happy about it. the road continues to the north.
r5351.description:
You are standing at the southernmost entrance of town.  The population here
which is predominatly of the Minotaur race has just recently opened it's
doors to outsiders, though most of the population isn't too happy about it.
The road continues to the north.

descKeys: t's pier. the buildings in this area have been hastily and sloppily constructed.
r5352.description:
You are standing in the southernmost part of Minot.  The road leads south
to the outskirts of town, north towards the merchant section, and northeast
towards Minot's pier.  The buildings in this area have been hastily and
sloppily constructed.

descKeys: of the residents have moved to the far side of town where there is more privacy.
r5353.description:
You are traveling on Klopp Street in the southern part of town, you notice
that most of the buildings and homes on this side are all boarded up
and there are not many passers by.  Ever since Minot opened it's doors to
outsiders most of the residents have moved to the far side of town where
there is more privacy.

descKeys: ays to your north is minot's main square, which is the busiest part of the town.
r5354.description:
You are traveling on Klopp Street in the southern part of town.  You notice
the side of a tavern to your west and what looks like a temple of some
sort to the east.  A ways to your north is Minot's main square, which is
the busiest part of the town.

descKeys: , and to your west you spy a beautiful temple and an important looking building.
r5355.description:
Minot town square at Klopp and Main street.

You are standing in Minot's town square, the road forms a circle around a
gigantic statue.  The streets are busy here, many minotaurs push their way
past you without offering any sort of apology at all.  Two large streets
intersect paths here, Klopp Street going n-s, and Main Street heading e-w.
To your immediate east you spot a tavern and a store front, and to your west
you spy a beautiful temple and an important looking building.

descKeys: here is a temple to your south, and an important looking building to your north.
r5356.description:
You are standing just east of Minot's town square.  There are many minotaurs
traveling up and down this street, most pay you no attention while others
stare at you with either curiosity or disgust.  There is a temple to your
south, and an important looking building to your north.

descKeys: et stronger to the east. you spy the sheriff's office just to the north of here.
r5357.description:
You are traveling on Main street.  There are many minotaurs traveling up and
down this street.  The smell of the sea fills your lungs here and seems to
get stronger to the east.  You spy the sheriff's office just to the north
of here.

descKeys: er to the east. you spy a fish shop to the north, and a restaurant to the south.
r5358.description:
You are traveling on Main street, there are many minotaurs traveling up and
down this street.  The smell of the sea fills your lungs here and seems to
get stronger to the east.  You spy a fish shop to the north, and a restaurant
to the south.

descKeys: r of the sea seems to be calm at this time, which is rare for this time of year.
r5359.description:
You are at the intersection of Main Street and Seaside AVE.  There  is a
long pier extending out over the water with several ships at dock.  The smell
of the sea fills your lung here.  The water of the sea seems to be calm at
this time, which is rare for this time of year.

descKeys: ous fever. the kendrite sea stretches way out to the east as far as you can see.
r5360.description:
You are currently standing on Minot's main pier.  There are two decent-sized
ships docked nearby.  Flocks of seagulls are all over the place, squawking
and fighting with one another in ambiguous fever.  The Kendrite Sea stretches
way out to the east as far as you can see.

descKeys: a is rolling with large storms. a fair-weathered building is just south of here.
r5361.description:
The pier is running east towards a small intersection and west towards the
town of Minot, populated by Minotaurs.  The water around the base of the
pier is uncommonly placid.  Usually around this time of year the Sea is
rolling with large storms.  A fair-weathered building is just south of here.

descKeys: lone seagull seems to be following you, and it has a certain glint in its eyes.
r5362.description:
The pier runs into a small intersection here, running north, east, and also
west.  A large ship with the name 'Bonnie Moo' emblazed across the front of
boat is docked at this point.  A lone seagull seems to be following you, and
it has a certain glint in its eyes.

descKeys: op shape. the pier continues north and also south, towards a small intersection.
r5363.description:
You are standing on the Minot pier, just west of a large merchant ship that
is called 'Bonnie Moo'.  The ship is about one hundred feet long and looks
to be in top shape.  The pier continues north and also south, towards a
small intersection.

descKeys: tinues to the north towards a dead-end and to the south to a small intersection.
r5364.description:
You are on the main pier of Minot, the Minotaur coastal town.  A large ship
called 'Bonnie Moo' is to the east.  The ship's gangplank is lowered, so
you could easily board the vessel.  The pier continues to the north towards
a dead-end and to the south to a small intersection.

descKeys: d to the north you can see a new section of the pier, only recently constructed.
r5365.description:
You have reached the end of the pier, as there is only water to the north.
The water of the sea is relatively calm for this time of year, for some odd
reason.  A large ship called the 'Bonnie Moo' is to the east, with the
gangplank of the ship being to the south.  Up ahead to the north you can see
a new section of the pier, only recently constructed.

descKeys: ntimes treacherous kendrite sea. a small hatch leads down to a large cargo hold.
r5366.description:
This is the top deck of the merchant ship 'Bonnie Moo'.  The deck seems to
be immaculately swabbed, as evidence by its shiny wooden surface.  A railing
goes around the ship, preventing a land lubber like yourself from falling
in the oftentimes treacherous Kendrite Sea.  A small hatch leads down to a
large cargo hold.

descKeys: rigging are about the hold, no doubt used to secure the cargo during transport.
r5367.description:
You are standing in the cargo hold of the large merchant ship the 'Bonnie
Moo'.  The hold seems to be empty, as the ship has just recently docked and
must have offloaded its cargo.  A host of cables and rigging are about the
hold, no doubt used to secure the cargo during transport.

descKeys: the east you gaze out over the kendrite sea, which seems to stretch on forever.
r5368.description:
You are standing on the deck of the large merchant ship 'Bonnie Moo'.  High
above your head are three masts and a host of sails and riggings.  Looking
over the railing to the east you gaze out over the Kendrite Sea, which seems
to stretch on forever.

descKeys: tant ports and such. the north exit leads to the company's private docking area.
r5372.description:
You are in the Minot branch of the Kendrite Passages shipping company.
A large desk is in one corner, obviously used by an employee.  A few posters
are on the walls, showing distant ports and such.  The north exit leads
to the company's private docking area.

descKeys: g to deepwater dock here. the company's general dock continues to the northeast.
r5373.description:
The ships of the Kendrite Passages shipping company are berthed here.  The
three-masted schooners are very seaworthy and capable of attaining high
speeds in the open sea.  The main building for the company is a bit to the
south, through a small archway.  The company's private docks continue
to the east, but are closed from the general public.  Ships that are
heading to Deepwater dock here.  The company's general dock continues to
the northeast.

descKeys: fighting with each other. the kendrite sea stretches out before you to the east.
r5374.description:
You are now standing on Minot's main pier.  There are two large ships docked
nearby.  One of the ships, named the 'Bonnie Moo' is moored just to your
north.  Seagulls are flying overhead squawking and fighting with each other.
The Kendrite sea stretches out before you to the east.

descKeys: ood shape. the pier is made out of sturdy wood and is in no danger of capsizing.
r5375.description:
The pier is running east and west here, going past several large ships.  One
ship in particular to the north draws your attention.  That ship is about
one hundred feet long and looks to be in good shape.  The pier is made out
of sturdy wood and is in no danger of capsizing.

descKeys: e. a slightly smaller human merchant ship, called 'sweet betty' is to the south.
r5376.description:
The pier takes a turn here, heading west and also south towards a dead-end.
A large Minotaur ship is to the northwest, called 'Bonnie Moo'.  It seems
to be in good shape.  A slightly smaller Human merchant ship, called 'Sweet
Betty' is to the south.

descKeys: ed to the east, obviously a human-owned vessel. the pier continues to the north.
r5377.description:
The pier ends here, almost causing you to fall into the Kendrite Sea, which
would not be a pleasant experience.  A medium-sized ship called 'Sweet
Betty' is moored to the east, obviously a Human-owned vessel.  The pier
continues to the north.

descKeys: room, and a collection of sea charts is on it. the guild continues to the south.
r5378.description:
You are standing in the Mariner Guild, home of the fierce nefarious and
sea-faring minotaur.  This room of the building is surprisingly tame, with
little or no decoration.  A simple table is in the middle of the room, and
a collection of sea charts is on it.  The Guild continues to the south.

descKeys: art of the guild, southeast into a smaller room, and also south to a small dock.
r5379.description:
This is probably the Guild's 'trophy' room.  A long harpoon is on one of the
walls, taking up about the entire length of the room.  There is a large fish
of some kind mounted on another wall as well.  From here you can go north
to another part of the Guild, southeast into a smaller room, and also south
to a small dock.

descKeys: today, so be careful if you go out in it. the rest of the guild is to the north.
r5380.description:
You are on a small dock that is just outside of the Mariner Guild.  There are
several sailboats tied up here, evidently used by the members of the Guild.
To the southeast of the dock lies the Kendrite Sea.  The Sea looks a bit
choppy today, so be careful if you go out in it.  The rest of the Guild is
to the north.

descKeys: since this building is on a pier, it is swaying back and forth, ever so gently.
r5381.description:
This small room is home to the main Trainer of the Guild.  He spends his days
in here usually making charts of the Seas, or practicing his knot-tying.  A
few windows are set in the walls of the room, offering a good view of the
water outside.  Since this building is on a pier, it is swaying back and
forth, ever so gently.

descKeys: to the northwest is a smaller street that leads to the residential part of town.
r5382.description:
You are standing just west of Minot's town square.  There are many minotaurs
traveling up and down this street, most pay you no attention while others
stare at you with either curiosity or disgust.  There is a tavern to your
south, and a store to your north.  Also to the northwest is a smaller street
that leads to the residential part of town.

descKeys: r to stand. there is only a long shiny serving bar and a large mirror behind it.
r5383.description:
You are standing in the only tavern left in Minot.  The bartender and owner
of this tavern, Shrewd Max, ran all the other taverns out of business with
his unbeatable prices and the warm, friendly atmosphere in the tavern...
warm and friendly towards other minotaurs that is!  You notice that there
are no tables or chairs in the room, and realize that minotaurs prefer to stand.
There is only a long shiny serving bar and a large mirror behind it.

descKeys: s of joe posing with some famous people who shop at his store from time to time.
r5384.description:
You are standing inside of Crafty Joe's store. In front of you is a large glass
display case where Joe has all his wares for sale.  Behind the display case and
up on the wall are several pictures of Joe posing with some famous people who
shop at his store from time to time.

descKeys: raight, and is in good repair. you see that main street starts to the southeast.
r5385.description:
Barren Street is running north here, where it heads through the residential
section of Minot.  The street is lined with houses that are about fifteen
feet in height and variouse dimensions wide.  The street heads straight,
and is in good repair. You see that Main Street starts to the southeast.

descKeys: s it is repaired regularly. to the south you can see the road turns to the left.
r5386.description:
Barren Street is running north and south.  Lining the sides of the street are
lots of houses, evidently lived in by the residents of Minot.  There are
absolutely no problems with this road, as it is repaired regularly.  To the
south you can see the road turns to the left.

descKeys: e other houses in this area are nice as well, but not quite so grand in stature.
r5387.description:
You are on Barren Street, which is travelling both north and south.  On one
side of the street is a particularly large house, probably owned by a rather
rich individual.  The other houses in this area are nice as well, but not quite
so grand in stature.

descKeys: nge. many houses line the street, and from the looks of them they are well-kept.
r5388.description:
Barren Street stops here, only heading back to the south.  The northern part
of the road stops right before a large hill.  Beyond the hill you can easily
spot the Absinthe Mountain Range.  Many houses line the street, and from the
looks of them they are well-kept.

descKeys: re that lead down to a small beach that is about fifty feet below your position.
r5389.description:
Seaside AVE

You are standing in the southeast end of town, the wooden buildings rise up
to the northwest and the smell of the sea fills your lungs from the east.
There is a set of stairs here that lead down to a small beach that is about
fifty feet below your position.

descKeys: your mind. you can head south and continue on the beach. there are flowers here.
r5390.description:
You are standing on the southern beach in Minot.  A large staircase rises
its way back into the main part of town.  The smelly, though refreshing,
breeze hits you like a ton of bricks and you think of going for a swim.
Looking out over the deep waters, you quickly change your mind.  You can
head south and continue on the beach.  There are flowers here.

descKeys: al railing is running around the ship, protecting you from falling into the sea.
r5391.description:
You are upon the top deck of the merchant ship 'Bonnie Moo'.  The ship is
about one hundred feet long and is in top shape.  The decks have been nicely
swabbed thanks to the many deckhands.  A metal railing is running around the
ship, protecting you from falling into the sea.

descKeys: guardpost is situated at the border of the town, evidently screening travellers.
r5392.description:
You are standing near the bottom of a large cliff that stretches high above
you.  The cliff looks treacherous, but may be climbable.  The Minotaur town
of Minot is to the north a ways.  A guardpost is situated at the border of
the town, evidently screening travellers.

descKeys: ifts. it is extremely hard to move around here at all, due to the piles of snow.
r5393.description:
You are travelling through Cutland's Pass.  The mountain pass runs through
Mt. Kulajo and some of its surrounding and lesser know neighbors.  Snow
has piled up and formed permanent snow drifts.  It is extremely hard to move
around here at all, due to the piles of snow.

descKeys: and has been traversed by many the villager heading their way to kulajo plateau.
r5394.description:
The small mountain path winds its way around the rocky side of Mt. Kulajo,
twisting and turning until you find yourself slightly nauseated.  The path
is well-worn, and has been traversed by many the villager heading their way
to Kulajo Plateau.

descKeys: ks upon them, as if some large and fearsome creature regularly visits this area.
r5401.description:
The tunnel branches off here, leading three separate ways.  The stagnant air
in this part of the mines causes you to gag slightly.  While gagging, you
notice that the walls have scratch marks upon them, as if some large and
fearsome creature regularly visits this area.

descKeys: used by the caravans running the north-south routes from threshold to kalinport.
r5408.description:
The Great Forest totally envelopes you, almost cutting you off from any sort
of view out of the trees.  The area gives you a sense of awe, gazing at the
surrounding greenery.  You are on a large road, about twenty feet in width,
that is used by the caravans running the north-south routes from Threshold
to Kalinport.

Kalinport Professions Bulletin Board [ 4.name: Kalinport Professions Bulletin Board [ 47 messages, 47 new]

Deepwater Professions Bulletin Board [ 1.name: Deepwater Professions Bulletin Board [ 11 messages, 11 new]

r5468.description:
This area looks like it was set aside for meetings and the like.  In the center
of the room usually is a large bulletin board, which Professionals use when
discussing aspects of his or her Profession.  The exit, which leads back to the
west, passes through a small archway.

descKeys: ks upon them, as if some large and fearsome creature regularly visits this area.
r5475.description:
The tunnel branches off here, leading three separate ways.  The stagnant air
in this part of the mines causes you to gag slightly.  While gagging, you
notice that the walls have scratch marks upon them, as if some large and
fearsome creature regularly visits this area.

descKeys: cohol his guards are drinking. you can head back up to get to the main bar area.
r5477.description:
You are in a quiet small room.  It is very relaxing and quiet down here.
There are a couple small couches in the corner of the room.  It is rumored
that the barkeeper sends his drunks down here to pass out so Sheriff Gabe
never finds out about the alcohol his guards are drinking.  You can head back
up to get to the main bar area.

descKeys: eading to the southwest tower. you have heard rumors about a ghost living there.
r5478.description:
You are west of the southeast tower.  There is a cold feeling here, since
there is no natural heating in the castle.  To the north you can see a
painting hanging on the wall, and to the west there is a corridor leading to
the southwest tower.  You have heard rumors about a ghost living there.

descKeys: coming from the torch on the northern wall. to the east is the southeast tower.
r5479.description:
This is the southern part of the upper level of Castle Lorasin.  You are in a
corridor leading west to the southwest tower.  It is quite cold here, the
only heat appears to be coming from the torch on the northern wall.  To the
east is the southeast tower.

descKeys: he castle's ghost is true. this corridor also leads east to the southeast tower.
r5480.description:
You are in the southern corridor in the upper levels of the castle.  The
corridor leads east and west, with a tower on each side.  You spot a guard
post outside the tower entrance.  You wonder why the tower usually has guards
posted in front of it.  It seems quite strange since none of the other towers
have any kind of protection to keep intruders out.  You begin to ponder
wheter or not the rumor of the castle's ghost is true.  This corridor also
leads east to the southeast tower.

descKeys: fire is almost dead. this corridor also leads east towards the southeast tower.
r5481.description:
This is the southern part of the upper level of Castle Lorasin, you are just
east of a guard post outside the southwest tower.  The torch on the northern
wall glows slightly, the fire is almost dead.  This corridor also leads east
towards the southeast tower.

descKeys: oming from the tower. this corridor also leads east towards the southeast tower.
r5482.description:
You are just east of the southwest tower.  There are usually guards posted
here in front of the tower making sure no one can enter it.  It is unusually
cold here, you can feel a small breeze coming from the tower.  This corridor
also leads east towards the southeast tower.

descKeys: ad up to the top of the tower. to the west is a corridor leading west and north.
r5483.description:
You are in the southeast tower of Castle Lorasin.  There is no decoration
here, which makes this tower look quite sterile.  The only object here is the
stairs that lead up to the top of the tower.  To the west is a corridor
leading west and north.

descKeys: like some other sort of world. whether it is safe or not, it sure would be cool.
r5488.description:
When you move closer to the clouds, they look as though you could leap to
them.  Whether that is a good idea or not, is neither here nor there.  They
sure do look like they are solid, and they are making a hell of a formation.
You can sort of see through, and it looks like some other sort of world.
Whether it is safe or not, it sure would be cool.

descKeys: his is what heaven is like. you see walkable clouds to the east and west of you.
r5489.description:
You feel as though you are floating in the air, but there is a thin white
mist under you seemingly holding you up.  Through the clouds you see the
mountain below you.  The entire feeling is quite strange to you.  You wonder
if this is what heaven is like.  You see walkable clouds to the east and west
of you.

descKeys: resent distance. on one side of the staircase there is a path leading elsewhere.
r5490.description:
As you step onto the cloud you are amazed at it's formation.  You see a huge
staircase in front of you comprised of clouds.  In front of the staircase is
a huge golden gate that is lying open, with a sign reading something you
can't quite make out from your present distance.  On one side of the
staircase there is a path leading elsewhere.

descKeys: ere is a great fresco. it is very beautiful, and you see a path in front of you.
r5491.description:
When you get to the top of the stairs, the hallway is really foggy, and it
takes a minute for your eyes to get used to it.  The hall is a large dome of
clouds.  On the dome, or ceiling, there is a great fresco.  It is very
beautiful, and you see a path in front of you.

descKeys: a glow coming from the north. the ground you stand upon is comprised of clouds.
r5492.description:
When you enter this hall, you notice the mist is a lot thicker.  You can
still see the dome ceiling of the hall, but this is a golden ceiling.  Not
like the one before.  You see a glow coming from the north.  The ground you
stand upon is comprised of clouds.

descKeys: be big enough to even enter. it may not be such a good idea to enter it though.
r5493.description:
As you enter the hall you notice a slight glow about it.  There is a large
golden obelisk, and it is radiating light.  The shape is just sitting there,
suspended in air.  It just might be big enough to even enter.  It may not be
such a good idea to enter it though.

descKeys: ut you cant see very much due to the thick mist, and it is also quite cold here.
r5494.description:
You look around on this cloud and see many other clouds around you.  Most of
the clouds that are near by are just out of your reach, forcing you to stay
on this one.  You are in some sort of hall, but you cant see very much due to
the thick mist, and it is also quite cold here.

descKeys: esco painted on it. a heavy mist keeps you from seeing farther up the staircase.
r5495.description:
When you come to this room, you see a large staircase in front of you.  It
seems to be made of cloud, and by now you arent very suprised about that.
The ceiling in this hall is domed, and has a beautiful fresco painted on it.
A heavy mist keeps you from seeing farther up the staircase.

descKeys: s ahead. there is nothing hampering your view for the first time in a long time.
r5496.description:
When you reach the top of this set of stairs, you immediately see a path in
front of you.  The hall you are in has a large domed ceiling, and the ceiling
has a fresco painted on it.  You are very curious as to what lies ahead.
There is nothing hampering your view for the first time in a long time.

descKeys: g to the north of you, but you can't see very far due to the light in your eyes.
r5497.description:
Upon entering this area, you can't see too much due to a heavy fog.  The
ground which you are walking on is made of cloud, and is somehow keeping you
on it.  The mist is causing for a lot of humidity, and it is causing you to
drip in sweat and condensation.  There is a path leading to the north of you,
but you can't see very far due to the light in your eyes.

descKeys: the floor is made of some of the most beautiful green marble you have ever seen.
r5498.description:
When you enter this room, the room opens up a lot, and it makes your eyes
need to adjust.  When your eyes finally do, you see a large semi-circular
wall covered in a huge painting.  It looks very life-like, and it is very
beautifully done, and you are mesmerized by it.  The floor is made of some of
the most beautiful green marble you have ever seen.

descKeys: reath. there is a little hole behind you, which is probably where you came from.
r5499.description:
This large area seems to be some sort of warp zone.  It is all black, and
there seems to be nothing holding you up, though there is some unapparent
light source.  You seem to be in some sort of slip in time, a void.  The air
is chilly and brisk, but there is no mist erupting from your mouth at each
breath.  There is a little hole behind you, which is probably where you came
from.

descKeys: se it is covered by clouds that are a little lower than where you are right now.
r5501.description:
As you pull yourself up, you finally see the peak.  It is more of a plateau.
To the north you can see where the clouds actually come up and touch the
peak.  They almost look like a tunnel.  As you look over the edge you can't
see much of anything, because it is covered by clouds that are a little lower
than where you are right now.

descKeys: n you get a little woozy, because you have climbed a long way, and it is far up.
r5502.description:
When you reach the next ledge, you start to get used to all sorts of air
changes, and you notice that you are almost in the clouds, and probably the
next climb up would be straight to the peak.  As you look down you get a
little woozy, because you have climbed a long way, and it is far up.

descKeys: dging from what has happened, you dont think the air is going to get any better.
r5503.description:
As you reach the next ledge, you are dying for a breath of fresh air, but
instead the air is getting thinner.  You sort of gasp for air, and it is not
very comfortable.  The pain in your ears has not gotten better, but your only
concern is getting good air.  Though judging from what has happened, you dont
think the air is going to get any better.

descKeys: a slight pressure in your ears, and you aren't quite sure how to get rid of it.
r5504.description:
When you reach a ledge you sit and take a breath of the thin air which you
are not used to compared to the thick and stuffy air at sea level.  You feel
as though you have done a lot of climbing, but guessing from here you are
about a fifth of the way from the top.  There is also a slight pressure in
your ears, and you aren't quite sure how to get rid of it.

descKeys: everal different directions from here, but the grass looks rather high each way.
r5505.description:
There is five foot tall grass all around you, and all around this part of the
grasslands.  As you glance around the grasslands you realize how enormous
this place is, and it could be fairly easy to get lost.  As you stand here in
silence, you can hear the small waves lapping up on the coast from the Sea of
Honshale.  You can head in several different directions from here, but the
grass looks rather high each way.

descKeys: evil. above you there are lots of clouds that signal good weather is on the way.
r5506.description:
You can smell the aromas of the Sea of Honshale as an east to west wind
rushes through the grasslands.  The ground raises a bit here, and then slopes
back down towards the east.  There are mushrooms on the ground in front of
you, they are large and pretty but they don't look safe to eat.  There are
fresh animal prints on the soil, and as you look down at them closely, they
seem to have come from a fox.  To the west you can see a large dark forest
that seems to be filled with evil.  Above you there are lots of clouds that
signal good weather is on the way.

descKeys: plet of sweat from your brow and continue to walk through the plains of merevia.
r5507.description:
This part of the grasslands is sloping downwards towards the sea.  There are
lots of briars that are hard to see through the thick grass here.  As you
continue to walk through the grass the briars are poking you in the legs and
sticking in your clothes. You can east and continue to walk down the small
hill or west and continue to walk up the small hill.  You are standing under
some shade that a large cloud is providing for you.  You take the time to
wipe a droplet of sweat from your brow and continue to walk through the
plains of Merevia.

descKeys: see a small tree that really stands out compared to the mostly flat grasslands.
r5508.description:
The grasslands extend in all directions from here.  There is quite a bit of
grass here, but the amount of flowers here is what really draws your
attention.  They cover the entire ground in all colors of the rainbow.  These
natural wildflowers give so much character to the grasslands and really add
to the entire landscape around here.  There are many bees, butterflies, and
other small insects flying from one flower to the next and completely
disregarding your existance.  The grasslands continue to slope down to the
east from here to where the coast is located.  Down to the southeast you see
a small tree that really stands out compared to the mostly flat grasslands.
