descKeys: en knocked down. you can also follow the path up east, where the slope elevates.
r5645.description:
The small swamp path has become flooded by the waters that fill the swamp.
The underbrush is very thick on the northern and southern sides of the path,
as you try to venture off the path you are quickly caught up in the
vegetation and decide to stay on the path.  As you look down the path towards
the west it looks as if it might be some kind of haven for a larger beast
because lots of the vegetation and such have been knocked down.  You can also
follow the path up east, where the slope elevates.

descKeys: . it seems as if the only way you can head is back on the path towards the east.
r5646.description:
This part of the swamp doesn't look like any other part of the swamp you have
seen.  Most of the underbrush, trees, and other plants have been cleared out
or knocked down to make room for whatever beast that may loom here.  There
isn't really any type of path here, since all of the surrounding vegetation
has been knocked down.  It seems as if the only way you can head is back on
the path towards the east.

descKeys: to a black dragon. you had best vacate the area before you become its next meal.
r5652.description:
You are standing in a huge dragon's lair.  The marshy area has been almost
transformed into a house of treasure, as well as an abode of death.  Judging
from the lair's location in this swamp, it must be home to a Black dragon.
You had best vacate the area before you become its next meal.

descKeys: small window is in the northern wall which looks out over a few small buildings.
r5653.description:
You are standing in a small room in the Viper's Nest.  Sparse furnishings have
been put here, including a bed, chair, and footlocker.  A small window is in
the northern wall which looks out over a few small buildings.

descKeys: the eastern wall is a small window. in one corner of the room is a small alcove.
r5654.description:
This part of the Viper's Nest has been set aside for those people who have a
fondness for board games and such.  Several tables are around the room, with
each table having four chairs.  The exit to the room is west and leads to a
landing above the bar.  On the eastern wall is a small window.  In one corner
of the room is a small alcove.

descKeys: oking quite new. back to the left is a larger room that is used for other games.
r5655.description:
You are in a small alcove that has been set aside for Chess Games.  There is
a table in the middle of the room, with two chairs on either side of it.
There is a nice Chess board on the table, looking quite new.  Back to the left
is a larger room that is used for other games.

descKeys: ll window is set in the west wall and looks out over the threshold supply depot.
r5656.description:
This small and barely furnished room looks as if it is currently being rented.
The small bed's sheets are slightly rumpled and the footlocker at the end of
the bed is open, displaying its contents.  A small window is set in the west
wall and looks out over the Threshold Supply Depot.

descKeys: e pits. a small staircase in the corner runs up to the rest of the viper's nest.
r5657.description:
You are in a small kitchen, located beneath the Viper's Nest.  This area
was obviously a poor selection for a kitchen, but it seems that there was
no other place to put the cooking area.  A few vents in the ceiling run to
the outside, providing some ventilation.  Several large pots have been set
up over small fire pits.  A small staircase in the corner runs up to the
rest of the Viper's Nest.

descKeys: militia. a wooden staircase leads down to the rest of the miltia's headquarters.
r5658.description:
This large room has been set aside for storing all of the Militia's various
equipment.  Several shelves are on the walls, holding different items that
have been put here by other members of the Militia.  A wooden staircase
leads down to the rest of the Miltia's Headquarters.

descKeys: like skeleton and a beer mug large enough to drown in. wood stairs lead back up.
r5659.description:
This room holds the entrance to the Militia Jail.  The solid iron door
leading to it was constructed by gnomes so that only trained Militia
members can open it.  Underneath a torch, a simple wooden desk and chair
sit.  Along the walls, trophies from various battles of the Militia are
displayed.  Among them, you notice the giant, bird-like skeleton and a
beer mug large enough to drown in.  Wood stairs lead back up.

descKeys: lowly growing in height and majesty. the tunnel continues unabated to the north.
r5660.description:
You are standing at the beginning of a tunnel, or maybe it is the end of the
tunnel you are witnessing.  A large cavern starts here and extends to the
west, slowly growing in height and majesty.  The tunnel continues unabated
to the north.

descKeys: ded from years of exposure to determine to which race the rock's visage belongs.
r5661.description:
The tunnel starts to widen out here, gaining in size to the south.  Directly
in the middle of the tunnel lies a peculiar rock.  The rock is shaped like
a head, although the facial features have been rounded from years of exposure
to determine to which race the rock's visage belongs.

descKeys: tunnel continues west and even looks like it widens out a bit in that direction.
r5662.description:
The tunnel descends sharply downward here, going almost straight down into
the darkness.  You could easily lose your footing if you are not cautious.
A small opening in the wall to your north looks a bit out of the ordinary.
The dark tunnel continues west and even looks like it widens out a bit in
that direction.

descKeys: ough and rocky. you can see that to the northeast this tunnel hits a larger one.
r5664.description:
Something like that. touch depression may work without smelling first
This tunnel is fairly small, only coming to about five feet in height from the
ground to the ceiling.  The tunnel walls themselves are fairly smooth for some
odd reason, while the ground is rough and rocky.  You can see that to the
northeast this tunnel hits a larger one.

r5759.description:
The Viluten Mountains separate the harsh Kalamshite desert to the south and
the lush green forests to the north.  Judging from the rounded peaks and
mountain sides, the Vilutens are extremely ancient, having been around long
before any civilized race existed on the continent.  You are presently in a
deep ravine, used by the caravans from the north and south to pass through
the Vilutens.

r5835.description:
You are at the far northwest end of the mushroom grove.  The wall of the
cavern is mostly around you.  Exits from this part of the grove lead south and
southeast, through openings in a wall of tightly-packed mushrooms.  Near the
north side of the room is a large mushroom that has been carved to resemble
some sort of large chair, perhaps being a throne.

descKeys: it. a bubble rises to the surface, letting off a dastardly smell when it bursts.
r5837.description:
There appear to be a few footprints on this path.  Dark trees surround
both sides of the path, creaking quietly in the muddy bog.  On one side
of the path is a bubbling mud pit.  A bubble rises to the surface, letting
off a dastardly smell when it bursts.

descKeys: they ever managed to clear the swamps. a rock stands in the middle of the path.
r5838.description:
The swamps just get deeper and danker as you press on.  You are reminded
of tales of sinister evil lurking in the swamps.  The people of Threshold
formed the Militia to defend against such dangers.  You wonder if they
ever managed to clear the swamps.  A rock stands in the middle of the path.

descKeys: hink you see a series of stones crossing underneath the water to the other side.
r5839.description:
A large, putrid lake wallows before you to the south.  A few trees feed
off its life-giving waters, though you doubt that any wise creature drinks
from its dismal waters.  Looking in the water, you think you see a series
of stones crossing underneath the water to the other side.

descKeys: s stepping stones. to the south, you think you see the dim outline of a village.
r5840.description:
Stepping carefully, you drippingly wade across the lake using the stones.
South of the lake, you find signs that more activity has taken place here.
The ground is very muddy here, and you almost sink into it.  The lake is
back to the north with its stepping stones.  To the south, you think you
see the dim outline of a village.

descKeys: ly evil. you question the need to continue. brown lake is back to the northeast.
r5841.description:
The path here is well trod with footprints, obviously made by the
residents of the village to the south.  Whoever would live this far into
the swamps must be a primitive, perhaps enormously evil.  You question
the need to continue.  Brown Lake is back to the northeast.

descKeys: . several human-like footprints lead into a small gateway beside a gnarled tree.
r5842.description:
Standing on firmer ground, you find yourself before a tiny village of thatched
huts.  A wall of sharp stakes surrounds the town, and something you hope is not
blood is congealing on top of them. Several human-like footprints lead into
a small gateway beside a gnarled tree.

descKeys: ther to a rather pungent part of town. perhaps you should turn around and leave?
r5843.description:
Just inside the village, you find a primitive squallor of mud and filth
in this tiny town.  A few citizens muck about in behavior of interest
only to an anthropologist.  Two muddy paths lead into the village,
one leading to a mysterious tower and the other to a rather pungent
part of town.  Perhaps you should turn around and leave?

descKeys: hich still captures your fearful attention. a human bone sticks out of the muck.
r5844.description:
The huts seem bigger and better in this part of the village.  To the south a
ways off is a hut of immaculate construction.  Beyond that is that
dark tower which still captures your fearful attention.  A human
bone sticks out of the muck.

descKeys: outh, casting an eerie shadow over this hut. there is a wood door leading east .
r5845.description:
To the east is an impressive hut.  Lining the entrance is a doorway
of skulls, suggesting you might not like what it's inside.  Bellowing
and pounding drums echo from within.  The dark tower is quite close
to the south, casting an eerie shadow over this hut.
There is a wood door leading east ( OPENED ).

descKeys: y object of furniture is the chief's throne. there is a wood door leading west .
r5846.description:
The Village Chief's Hut is lit by a smoky firelight.  All village
matters are decided here, presumably by the Chief pounding on a
drum.  Flesh and blood still drop from the bones holding up the
hut, making you wonder if they were the chief's last meal.  The
only object of furniture is the Chief's throne.
There is a wood door leading west ( OPENED ).

descKeys: part of the village under the dismal shadow of the tower. the air here is still.
r5847.description:
To the southwest lies the ominous dark tower.  From here, you think
it might be an altar of some sorts.  What type of god these people
would worship frightens you.  There are no huts in this part of the
village under the dismal shadow of the tower.  The air here is still.

descKeys: e statue's beak gapes wide open, enough for any living creature to pass through.
notes: Serpico room. Banishes to the Abyss (teleport) — no walkable east exit to the Abyss.
r5848.description:
Two large pyres burn eternally beside a giant statue of a creature/god
these cannibals evidently worship.  Carved from obsidian, the statue is
of a birdlike, almost reptilian monster.  The floor beneath its immense
mouth is covered in blood.  The statue's beak gapes wide open, enough for
any living creature to pass through.

descKeys: ems further away now, but you see, to be getting closer to that dastardly smell.
r5849.description:
You are just north of the village center, but there is little bustle
of activity like there is in Threshold.  A few citizens muck about.
The dark tower seems further away now, but you see, to be getting
closer to that dastardly smell.

descKeys: o the east. still, the dark tower looms grimly on your situation from the south.

Cannibal Village Bulletin Board [ 16 mes.name: Cannibal Village Bulletin Board [ 16 messages, 16 new]

r5850.description:
Various cannibals roam around, doing various activities.  A shop of
sorts appears to be to the west and an impressive hut is to the east.
Still, the dark tower looms grimly on your situation from the south.

descKeys: onsidering this place, that old dark tower doesn't look too bad now, doesn't it?
r5851.description:
To the west is what you believe to be a food establishment, though
the smell makes you hope otherwise.  Various screams and squeals
(both animal and human) seem to come pounding from the hut.
Considering this place, that old dark tower doesn't look too bad
now, doesn't it?

descKeys: the south, perhaps to a kitchen. the village and fresh air is back to the east.
r5852.description:
Racks of various types of meat hang from the walls of this half-star
establishment.  Looking behind the counter, you see pictures of famous
customers who frequent this restaurant.  A small room leads off to the
south, perhaps to a kitchen.  The village and fresh air is back
to the east.

descKeys: utside. the restaurant is to the north. there is a wood door leading southwest .
r5853.description:
The kitchen surprises you because of its state of heavenly cleanliness.
Truth is, all the blood is carefully mopped up for the special sauce.
Several pots are cooking on a large stove.  Across the room stands a
large cabinet.  A door leads outside.  The restaurant is to the north.
There is a wood door leading southwest ( OPENED ).

descKeys: k the room to do more than just wallow. there is a wood door leading northeast .
r5854.description:
Fenced all around is a mud pit full of pigs.  The villagers must eat
these guys when other food supplies run low.  The restaurant kitchen
is back to the northeast.  The pen extends in several directions, but
the pigs still lack the room to do more than just wallow.
There is a wood door leading northeast ( OPENED ).

descKeys: seem content. still you think a yogurt stand would certainly liven up the place.
r5855.description:
The mud here is like most mud, except that in this case it is brown.
Oh wait, it's just like all the other mud you have seen in your life.
No wonder then that the pigs seem content.  Still you think a yogurt
stand would certainly liven up the place.

descKeys: y and it sunk into the mud. the pigs in this part of the pen are very depressed.
r5856.description:
You have uncovered the pigs' masterful plan of escape.  They have
rigged up a giant catapult to loft them safely away from here.
Unfortunately, it was too heavy and it sunk into the mud.  The pigs
in this part of the pen are very depressed.

descKeys: ce? should i join my fellow sticks in the fence? the pigs look at you strangely.
r5857.description:
You begin to wonder about the meaning of life.  Are we only just a
mere stick stuck deep in a grimy muck?  Do we only amount to anything
when we are joined with other sticks to form a fence?  Should I join
my fellow sticks in the fence?  The pigs look at you strangely.

descKeys: ced a welcome mat in front of the cage. there is a wood door leading southwest .
r5858.description:
From here, the dark tower to the southeast appears to be an altar of sorts.
A wooden cage is to the southwest, obviously meant to hold sacrifices or
lunch for the cannibals.  Out of a sense of irony, the cannibals have
placed a welcome mat in front of the cage.
There is a wood door leading southwest ( OPENED ).

descKeys: a dark palace of sorts has been erected in the middle of the swirling maelstrom.
notes: Serpico banishes here (teleport). Not connected by walking from the cannibal statue room.
r5859.description:
You are 'floating' around in what can only be described as a living nightmare.
Swirling mists and glancing winds are all around you, passing above you and
possibly even through you.  Dark shades of purple and black seem to be in a
much sordid existence, totally enveloping you.  A dark palace of sorts has
been erected in the middle of the swirling maelstrom.

descKeys: chamber is to the south, with a faint glimmer of light being seen to the north.
r5883.description:
The cave is at its widest here.  On one side of the lair is a large 'nest'
of sorts, having been cobbled together with small trees and branches.  Large
footprints are all around you, being about three feet wide.  A smaller and
darker chamber is to the south, with a faint glimmer of light being seen to
the north.

descKeys: ying around, collecting large amounts of rust. a larger chamber is to the north.
r5884.description:
This large chamber is being used as a treasury of sorts.  Piles of gold and
gems are all around you, gathering dust. Pieces of armor and an assortment
of weapons are laying around, collecting large amounts of rust.  A larger
chamber is to the north.

descKeys: the cave is to the north, ending on a small ledge. a small crack is in the wall.
r5885.description:
You are standing in a deep cavern that stretches back to the south.  The
rough-hewn rock around has been scorched a little bit, as if the occupant of
the cave has shaped the side to its liking.  The large opening to the cave
is to the north, ending on a small ledge.  A small crack is in the wall.

descKeys: you see no other exits. a large crack in the mountain side draws your attention.
r5886.description:
You are standing on the peak of Mt. Kulajo.  Judging from the rest of the
mountain range to the east, this mountain is the highest one standing.  You
can see the town of Threshold sitting at the base of the mountain.  Despite
the frigid air, you feel quite comfortable up here.  Aside from leaping
off of the peak, you see no other exits.  A large crack in the mountain
side draws your attention.

descKeys: . if you approach the southern cliff, you might be able to get a better glimpse.
r5887.description:
You are standing on Kulajo plateau, perched many hundreds of feet above the
town of Threshold, which you can barely see from here, what with the southern
portion of the plateau blocking your view and all.  If you approach the
southern cliff, you might be able to get a better glimpse.

descKeys: the picnic area. a cliff wall is to the north, which is the rest of mt. kulajo.
r5888.description:
You are standing atop Kulajo Plateau, aptly named after it's owner.  To the
south, the plateau extends out a ways, ending in a sheer drop of over one
hundred and fifty feet.  Small tables and benches have been brought up to this
point by the villagers of Threshold, to better enjoy the picnic area.  A
cliff wall is to the north, which is the rest of Mt. Kulajo.

descKeys: lace. looking up towards the mountain's peak, you wonder how you might reach it.
r5889.description:
The mountain path inclines sharply here, while heading to a downgrade to the
east.  By going farther up the trail, you should reach Kulajo Plateau.
Towards the east lies the path that leads down from this high place.  Looking
up towards the mountain's peak, you wonder how you might reach it.

descKeys: used by the caravans running the north-south routes from threshold to kalinport.
r5913.description:
The Great Forest totally envelopes you, almost cutting you off from any sort
of view out of the trees.  The area gives you a sense of awe, gazing at the
surrounding greenery.  You are on a large road, about twenty feet in width,
that is used by the caravans running the north-south routes from Threshold
to Kalinport.

that is used by the caravans running the north-south routes from Threshold
to Kalinport.  Directly southeast of here is a deep ravine that passes through
the Viluten Mountains.

descKeys: ine, used by the caravans from the north and south to pass through the vilutens.
r6042.description:
The Viluten Mountains separate the harsh Kalamshite desert to the south and
the lush green forests to the north.  Judging from the rounded peaks and
mountain sides, the Vilutens are extremely ancient, having been around long
before any civilized race existed on the continent.  You are presently in a
deep ravine, used by the caravans from the north and south to pass through
the Vilutens.

descKeys: . a large tapestry depicting a huge red dragon has been set on the western wall.
r6043.description:
You are in a small room near the back of the Assassin's Guild.  Several
wooden shelves are on the walls, holding various items that the Guild has
collected over the years.  A large tapestry depicting a huge Red Dragon
has been set on the western wall.

descKeys: through. looking at the high snow drifts with regret, you prepare to head back.
r6075.description:
The pass is getting extremely difficult to traverse this area.  The pass
is getting so full of snow it looks like an unending white blanket.  To
the east, it looks like the pass may be too difficult to travel through.
Looking at the high snow drifts with regret, you prepare to head back.

descKeys: velled mountain path, unless you can find some way to continue through the pass.
r6076.description:
The pass ends abruptly here, ending in a wall of thick ice and drifts of
packed snow.  It looks like you will have to turn back and go back west,
towards the more easily travelled mountain path, unless you can find some
way to continue through the pass.

descKeys: st, towards the arctic community of cerene. the path is covered in ice and snow.
r6077.description:
You are standing on Cutland's Pass, which cuts between some of the larger peaks
of the Absinthe Mountains.  The pass heads to the southwest towards the lower
lands and to the northeast, towards the arctic community of Cerene.  The path
is covered in ice and snow.

descKeys: of cerene. the snow is coming down really hard, and is making your travel hard.
r6078.description:
You are standing on Cutland's Pass, which cuts between the giant Mt. Kulajo
and the smaller Mt. Turkon.  The pass runs to the southeast towards the lower
land, and to the northeast towards the arctic settlement of Cerene.  The snow
is coming down really hard, and is making your travel hard.

descKeys: ty of yeti wandering around the mountainside, oftentimes blocking your progress.
r6079.description:
Cutland's Pass is becoming very steep here.  The path continues to the east
and to the southwest.  You can see that the pass cuts between Mt. Kulajo
and a much smaller Mt. Turkon.  There are plenty of Yeti wandering around the
mountainside, oftentimes blocking your progress.

descKeys: and threshold. you can climb up a small ledge here and continue towards cerene.
r6080.description:
You are on Cutland's Pass, the pass that cuts between many of the larger
peaks of the Absinthe Mountain range.  The path continues to the west heading
towards the lower land, and Threshold.  You can climb up a small ledge here
and continue towards Cerene.

descKeys: e. the wind is blowing snow in your face, you should probably find shelter soon.
r6081.description:
You are standing on Cutland's Pass, a path that leads through the Absinthe
Mountains.  This part of the pass cuts between the large Mt. Kulajo, and the
smaller peak, Mt. Turkon.  You can either head north, or down, down a small
ledge.  The wind is blowing snow in your face, you should probably find shelter
soon.

descKeys: on. the path has become the route for many northern creatures in search of food.
r6082.description:
This is the chilly Cutland's Pass.  The small and dangerous path leads from the
lower lands to the frozen north, and the town of Cerene.  The path slices
between the giant Mt. Kulajo, and the smaller Mt. Turkon.  The path has become
the route for many northern creatures in search of food.

descKeys: own of cerene, and to the southeast lies the warmer climates of the lower lands.
r6083.description:
You are making your way along the Cutland's Pass.  Through the falling snow
and blistering wind, you can make out two directions.  To the northeast lies
the frozen town of Cerene, and to the southeast lies the warmer climates of the
lower lands.

descKeys: e which direction that was. you had better just pick a direction and get moving.
r6084.description:
The snow is piling up, making travel along Cutland's Pass very difficult.
You could turn around, and head back in the direction from which you came, but
the falling snow is so blinding, you are not sure which direction that was.
You had better just pick a direction and get moving.

descKeys: ng to death isn't your idea of fun, then heading west would be more appropriate.
r6085.description:
You are here, but you are not sure where here is.  It is somewhere along the
path from the lower, and warmer lands, to the frozen north.  If you follow the
path to the northeast you are sure to find the town of Cerene, but if freezing
to death isn't your idea of fun, then heading west would be more appropriate.

descKeys: ut would then probably be buried in the massive amounts of snow that is falling.
r6086.description:
This part of the Cutland's Pass cuts between the large Mt. Kulajo, and the
smaller, but still impressive Mt. Turkon.  You could spend all day looking high
into the sky at the mountain peaks, but would then probably be buried in the
massive amounts of snow that is falling.

descKeys: your bones, turning your blood into ice. you had better seek some shelter soon.
r6087.description:
As you make your way along Cutland's Pass, cutting between Mt. Tarkon and
Mt. Kulajo, you begin to think that your nose is going to feeze off.  The
chilly wind is whipping through to your bones, turning your blood into ice.
You had better seek some shelter soon.

descKeys: to the northeast, lies the arctic town of cerene. you could seek shelter there.
r6088.description:
It looks as if the Cutland's Pass is going to be completely covered in falling
snow.  You had better get moving on before you get stuck here.  To the west
lies the lower lands, and Threshold, and to the northeast, lies the arctic town
of Cerene.  You could seek shelter there.

descKeys: rely a discernable path between the two, but you can not make it that direction.
r6089.description:
Cutland's Pass is very trecherous along the path here.  The path continues
to the northeast and the southwest.  Off to the northwest you can see the large
Mt. Kulajo rising into the sky.  Mt. Turkon is almost directly south of here,
and Mt. Amyln is to the east.  There is barely a discernable path between the
two, but you can not make it that direction.

descKeys: stop looking at the scenary and keep moving before you freeze to death out here.
r6090.description:
You are trying to make your way along Cutland's Pass.  The pass cuts between
Mt. Kulajo and Mt. Amlyn here.  The two peaks rise high above you into the
heavens.  You had better stop looking at the scenary and keep moving before you
freeze to death out here.

descKeys: sure because of the falling snow. the pass continues to the south and northeast.
r6091.description:
Very few make it along Cutland's Pass and you are beginning to understand
why.  As far as you can see in any direction is the white of the snow.  Although
you think you can see movement from time to time, it is hard to be sure because
of the falling snow.  The pass continues to the south and northeast.

descKeys: town of cerene. after being in this weather either would be a welcomed comfort.
r6092.description:
The Cutland's Pass ventures between the great Mt. Kulajo and the smaller Mt.
Amlyn.  You should be able to continue along this pass and reach either the
lower (and warmer) lands, or the town of Cerene.  After being in this weather
either would be a welcomed comfort.

descKeys: d that you believe that it might fall off. seeking shelter would be a good idea.
r6093.description:
You are standing along the Cutland's Pass, between Mt. Kulajo and Mt. Amlyn.
The path continues to the northeast and to the west.  Your nose has become so
frozen from the chilling wind that you believe that it might fall off.  Seeking
shelter would be a good idea.

descKeys: a comforting relief, but the snow is falling to thickly to give you any comfort.
r6094.description:
Cutland's Pass continues to the northeast and to the southwest from here.  The
warmer regions lie to the southwest, while Cerene lies to the northeast.  Any
sign of life out in this weather would be a comforting relief, but the snow is
falling to thickly to give you any comfort.

descKeys: . you can almost feel the warmth of the face, bringing you back to your reality.
r6095.description:
Thoughts of the warm desert sun sink into your head as you tredge through the
snow and ice along the Cutland's Pass.  You can almost feel the warmth of the
face, bringing you back to your reality.

descKeys: that futher to the northeast. you might want to consider seeking shelter there.
r6096.description:
Mt. Kulajo and Mt. Amlyn rise high above you into the sky.  The Cutland's Pass
which splits the two peaks runs both to the northeast and the south from here.
The town of Cerene should be not that futher to the northeast.  You might want
to consider seeking shelter there.

descKeys: reens. you are then brought back to this desolate land, and need to keep moving.
r6097.description:
You are making your way along Cutland's Pass.  Since you came to this
unforgiving land, the only color you have seen has been white.  You are
beginning to day dream of vibrant colors:  Reds, blues and greens.  You are
then brought back to this desolate land, and need to keep moving.

descKeys: d. you would not want to get stuck in this land, and should keep moving forward.
r6098.description:
This pass is known as Cutland's Pass.  The pass cuts between Mt. Kulajo and
Mt. Amlyn here.  The path continues to the northeast towards the town of Cerene
and to the southeast towards the warmer lands, and Threshold.  You would not
want to get stuck in this land, and should keep moving forward.

descKeys: your way to the north or the southwest. it would be a good idea to keep moving.
r6099.description:
You are making your way along Cutland's Pass, which cuts between the giant
Mt. Kulajo and the smaller Mt. Amlyn.  Although the pass is very slick with
ice, you can make your way to the north or the southwest.  It would be a good
idea to keep moving.

descKeys: s well. the pass also heads to the south, towards the lower lands of the region.
r6100.description:
This is the northern end of the Cutland's Pass.  There is an intersection of
this pass and the Yeti Pass just to the northeast.  The arctic town of Cerene
lies just to the northeast as well.  The pass also heads to the south, towards
the lower lands of the region.

descKeys: g to the arctic village of cerene. the path to the north becomes very dangerous.
r6101.description:
You are standing at an intersection.  The Cutland's Pass leads to the southwest
and the Yeti's Pass leads to the north.  There is also a well traveled path to
the northeast, leading to the arctic village of Cerene.  The path to the north
becomes very dangerous.

descKeys: and yeti passes. a path leading to the city of cerene is also just to the south.
r6102.description:
You standing at the beginning of the Yeti Pass.  The pass continues to the
northwest, trecking between the twin peaks Mt. Siikta and Mt. Soran.  There is
an intersection to the south of the Cutland's and Yeti passes.  A path leading
to the city of Cerene is also just to the south.

descKeys: snow has begun falling very heavily now, allowing you only a few feet of vision.
r6103.description:
You are standing on the Yeti Pass, which cuts between Mt. Soran and Mt. Siikta.
The pass becomes very dangerous to the northwest and also continues to the
south.  The snow has begun falling very heavily now, allowing you only a few
feet of vision.

descKeys: ee the peaks of mt. soran and mt. siika. a small path heads northwest from here.
r6104.description:
You are standing on the Yeti Pass, running northwest from the arctic town of
Cerene.  The pass becomes more dangerous the farther northwest one travels.
The snow is falling heavy here making travel difficult.  You can hardly see the
peaks of Mt. Soran and Mt. Siika.  A small path heads northwest from here.

descKeys: long the pass has never returned. you begin thinking you should get out of here.
r6105.description:
The dangerous Yeti Pass continues to the south and the northwest.  To the south
the pass leads to Cerene and the Cutland's Pass.  No one is sure what lies to
the northwest since anyone who have dared to travel along the pass has never
returned.  You begin thinking you should get out of here.

descKeys: snow. the arctic cold is very chilling making you think of the warm desert sun.
r6106.description:
The Yeti Pass cuts through the Absinthe Mountains here, passing between Mt.
Siikta to the east and Mt. Soran to the west.  The twin peaks rise high into
the sky but are not very visable through the falling snow.  The arctic cold is
very chilling making you think of the warm desert sun.

descKeys: tion. you could easily make your way to the southeast toward the town of cerene.
r6107.description:
You are making your way along the Yeti Pass, cutting between Mt. Soran and Mt.
Siikta.  The pass is very dangerous to the northwest, and only the most brave
should venture in that direction.  You could easily make your way to the
southeast toward the town of Cerene.

descKeys: d snow. you should probably head to the southwest back to the safer lower lands.
r6108.description:
The peaks of Mt. Soran and Mt. Siikta rise high above you into the sky.  The
Yeti Pass continues to the northwest and the southeast.  Travel has become
difficult here due to the ice and snow.  You should probably head to the
southwest back to the safer lower lands.

descKeys: imited vision makes you an easy target of suprise attacks from unseen creatures.
r6109.description:
The snow is beginning to fall very heavily, allowing you only a few feet of
vision.  You can tell that the Yeti Pass continues to the northwest and to
the southeast.  You limited vision makes you an easy target of suprise attacks
from unseen creatures.

descKeys: soup, but you are harshly brought back to this reality, surrounded by the cold.
r6110.description:
You begin to consider why you are here on the Yeti Pass, in the middle of the
freezing cold and falling snow.  With each step you take, your mind is filled
with thoughts of the warm sun and a hot bowl of soup, but you are harshly
brought back to this reality, surrounded by the cold.

descKeys: the cold is really starting to get to you, and you should probably seak shelter.
r6111.description:
You are standing along the Yeti Pass, between the giant mountain peaks of Mt.
Soran and Mt. Siikta.  You can barely see the tops of the peaks because of the
heavy snow fall.  The cold is really starting to get to you, and you should
probably seak shelter.

descKeys: the snow is falling heavily, blinding your vision. you should get moving before
r6112.description:
The Yeti Pass turns here, heading to the north and the southeast.  To the north
a bit you can see the opening to a large cave in the side of Mt. Siikta.  The
snow is falling heavily, blinding your vision.  You should get moving before

descKeys: north that you might be able to rest in, as long as the occupant does not mind.
r6113.description:
The Yeti Pass continues to the north and to the south.  Travel in either
direction will be difficult due to the falling snow, but you should be able to
make it.  You can see the opening to a large cave to the north that you might
be able to rest in, as long as the occupant does not mind.

descKeys: ee large prints of a bear heading into the cave, and you should beware the cave.
r6114.description:
The Yeti Pass turns here, heading both to the south and the northwest.  There
is also a large opening to a cave to the northeast in the side of Mt. Siikta.
You can see large prints of a bear heading into the cave, and you should
beware the cave.

descKeys: further from this point. the cold air is quite frigid, so you decide to move on.
r6115.description:
The Yeti Pass continues to the north and to the southeast from this location.
To the southeast you can spot a cave in the side of Mt. Siikta.  The pass to
the north does not look like it goes much further from this point.  The cold
air is quite frigid, so you decide to move on.

descKeys: ome sort of civilization (you hope). up above you is a ledge, perhaps reachable.
r6116.description:
You have come to a dead end of the Yeti pass.  The falling snow has piled up
too high here for you to travel to the north any farther.  The only direction
that you can move along now is back to the south, back towards some sort of
civilization (you hope).  Up above you is a ledge, perhaps reachable.

descKeys: to the west, but your senses are screaming out at you, something is over there.
r6117.description:
You are on a large ledge situated on the side of a mountain.  Looking over the
edge you see that the ground is some ways below you, it would not be an
easy climb down.  The ledge continues to the west, but your senses are
screaming out at you, something is over there.

descKeys: about. from this evidence, you surmise that this is indeed a lair of some sort.
r6118.description:
You are on a large ledge of the mountain.  The ledge is quite wide, and ends
with a very long drop to the ground.  Interestingly enough, there are piles
of frozen treasure all around you.  A few deer and yeti corpses, which are
also frozen, lay strewn about.  From this evidence, you surmise that this is
indeed a lair of some sort.

descKeys: muddier and more difficult to the southeast. strangely, it's sunny to the north.
r6154.description:
A cold damp wind blows from out of the south, freezing your marrow.  Few
elves travel to the Grey Hills, unless the Speaker or High Baron commands
them to.  You truly begin to understand why as the trail gets muddier and
more difficult to the southeast.  Strangely, it's sunny to the north.

descKeys: row under the warm sun. to the northeast, you spy what appear to be grape vines.
r6155.description:
There is a marked difference between the lands north and south of the trail.
The Grey Hills loom to the south under a heavy fog, while to the north, rich
farmlands grow under the warm sun.  To the northeast, you spy what appear to
be grape vines.

descKeys: es take many years to create each new generation. the trail is back to the east.
r6156.description:
The giant quartz walls form a sharp corner here, indicating you are at the
midpoint of Elinost's hourglass shape.  Behind the walls are shops, buildings,
and the homes of countless elves.  The city has grown only slightly over the
centuries, as the long-living elves take many years to create each new
generation.  The trail is back to the east.

descKeys: fallow and will be planted again next year. you can see elinost in the distance.
r6157.description:
The trail here runs northeast to southwest towards a large field of flax.
A large puddle reflects the sky, and lush grass grows to the north.
The fields surrounding you are being kept fallow and will be planted again
next year.  You can see Elinost in the distance.

descKeys: s. the mansion has a spiraled roof and has several gargoyles on top of its roof.
r6158.description:
The Mori is running through the richer sections of Elinost, passing by a few
large estates and mansions.  One mansion in particular catches your eye to
the south a few paces.  The mansion has a spiraled roof and has several
gargoyles on top of its roof.

descKeys: used by the caravans running the north-south routes from threshold to kalinport.
r6160.description:
The Great Forest totally envelopes you, almost cutting you off from any sort
of view out of the trees.  The area gives you a sense of awe, gazing at the
surrounding greenery.  You are on a large road, about twenty feet in width,
that is used by the caravans running the north-south routes from Threshold
to Kalinport.

descKeys: idently used for some sort of organization. there is a stone door leading east .
r6174.description:
The residential district you are in is called the Northern Warrens.  Home to
many Duergar, the Warrens holds about one-third of the city's populace, mostly
the more wealthy citizens.  A large building of sorts is right in front of
you, resembling a large boulder.  Another structure is to the east, evidently
used for some sort of organization.
There is a stone door leading east ( OPENED ).

descKeys: o put a knife in a being's back, if needed. there is a stone door leading west .

Dunkrist Homeguard Guild Board [ 30 mess.name: Dunkrist Homeguard Guild Board [ 30 messages, 30 new]

r6175.description:
You are in the headquarters of the Dunkrist Homeguard.  Established several
centuries ago, the Homeguard protects Dunkrist from marauders and also does
raids on the other cities of the Underdark.  To be a member of the Homeguard,
a Duergar must display cunning fighting skills, and also be able to put a
knife in a being's back, if needed.
There is a stone door leading west ( OPENED ).

descKeys: ast buffer from the evils of the underdark. there is a stone door leading east .
r6176.description:
You are near the east end of the great cavern that houses Granei, the city of
the Svirfneblin.  The city runs out to the west for a ways, stopping only
because the rock has proven unmanageable to mine.  Back to the east is a
large stone door that is usually kept closed, acting as one last buffer from
the evils of the UnderDark.
There is a stone door leading east ( OPENED ).

descKeys: to the residential section of the city, this area has no buildings or dwellings.
r6177.description:
You are in the eastern section of Granei, the Deep Gnome city.  This area of
Granei is used mainly by the workers, sorting through any findings that were
mined in the outside tunnels.  Conversly to the residential section of the
city, this area has no buildings or dwellings.

descKeys: ern is a weird symbol, one which is familar to you but you just cannot place it.
r6178.description:
You are in a the northwestern section of the 'working' area of the city.  The
spot you are in is not used often, and from the looks of it no one comes to
this spot.  Along the northern wall of the cavern is a weird symbol, one which
is familar to you but you just cannot place it.

descKeys: of the city, holding a few shops and also the large but seldom-used rock quarry.
r6179.description:
You are right between the working section of Granei and the merchant section.
To the east is that working section, with only a few buildings having been
constructed herein.  To the southwest is the merchant section of the city,
holding a few shops and also the large but seldom-used rock quarry.

descKeys: th, and there is another shop to the east. there is a stone door leading north .
r6180.description:
You are in the merchant section of the city.  Directly north is the main
shop of Granei, run by an older Svirfneblin who has been around forever.  The
merchant section continues to the west, where it runs by the old rock quarry.
Looking high above you, it seems that the cavern's ceiling is at least two
hundred feet from the ground.  A large building is to the south, and there is
another shop to the east.
There is a stone door leading north ( CLOSED ).

descKeys: all hole is set in the northern wall, about two and a half feet from the ground.
r6199.description:
You are near the dead-end of a medium-sized tunnel.  The tunnel ends against
a rock wall to the east, but continues back to the west, where it turns to the
southwest and also south.  A small hole is set in the northern wall, about two
and a half feet from the ground.

descKeys: only be described as a 'chute', as it slopes downward and a little to the right.
r6200.description:
This tunnel splits here, running in three different directions.  Heading east
will hit a dead-end, while going either south or southwest heads deeper into
the darkness.  There is a hole in the northern wall that can only be described
as a 'chute', as it slopes downward and a little to the right.

descKeys: are quite smooth. perhaps water has ran through here in the not so recent past.
r6201.description:
This tunnel is running north and south.  The height of the tunnel is only
about six feet, and it is shorter than that in several places.  The walls of
the tunnel are quite smooth.  Perhaps water has ran through here in the not so
recent past.

descKeys: e darkness. to the south, however, the tunnel ends right before a pool of water.
r6202.description:
You are in a dark tunnel, near a natural staircase that runs up the eastern
wall and looks to end up in another tunnel.  You could easily head up the
steps.  To the north and west, this tunnel continues off into the darkness.
To the south, however, the tunnel ends right before a pool of water.

descKeys: n underwater outlet for some of the pool's water, or this area would be flooded.
r6203.description:
You are standing in a small cavern that is housing a pool of water.  The pool
is not very big, being only about forty feet in diameter.  Looking to the
south you can see the source of the pool, a small stream of water trickling
in from another part of the Underdark.  There must be an underwater outlet for
some of the pool's water, or this area would be flooded.

descKeys: n is relatively clean and tidy, as if someone or something is taking care of it.
r6204.description:
You are in a small tunnel that is running east.  There is also a natural set
of stairs in one corner of the area, leading down to another set of tunnels.
You could easily go down the steps, if you so desire.  This region is
relatively clean and tidy, as if someone or something is taking care of it.

descKeys: the northeast, you come to the conclusion that something must live around here.
r6205.description:
The tunnel ends here, only heading back to the west.  To the northeast, a
decent-sized cavern opens up, with the ceiling being about twenty feet in
height.  Looking to the northeast, you come to the conclusion that something
must live around here.

descKeys: this point. the tunnel turns again to the north, heading slightly to the right.
r6206.description:
The tunnel turns sharply at this point, heading north and also east.  To the
east it looks like there is a sort of staircase carved from the rock of the
wall, but you cannot be certin from this point.  The tunnel turns again to
the north, heading slightly to the right.

descKeys: iddle of this part of the tunnel is a large rock, seemingly fixed to the ground.
r6207.description:
The tunnel is running northeast towards an intersection of another tunnel, and
also south where it turns abruptly to the east.  The ceiling of the tunnel
is quite smooth, as are the walls.  Directly in the middle of this part of the
tunnel is a large rock, seemingly fixed to the ground.

descKeys: back from you as if they are waiting on some signal ordering them to attack you.
r6210.description:
You have stumbled upon the bat enclave which contains, from what you can
quickly count, over a thousand bats hanging from the ceiling and walls.
The bats stir restlessly as you approach, but fall back from you as if they
are waiting on some signal ordering them to attack you.

descKeys: esembles a normal tunnel. a small cavern juts off through a tunnel to the north.
r6217.description:
The large cavern to the west has slowly dimished to about half of its height
and reached a steadying height of about forty-five feet at this juncture.
Off to the east, the cavern slopes down until it resembles a normal tunnel.
A small cavern juts off through a tunnel to the north.

descKeys: ks upon them, as if some large and fearsome creature regularly visits this area.

in this part of the mines causes you to gag slightly.  While gagging, you
notice that the walls have scratch marks upon them, as if some large and
fearsome creature regularly visits this area.

Gorthe Bey-Sandrax, the Archmage of Sorc.name: Gorthe Bey-Sandrax, the Archmage of Sorcere

r7036.description:
You find yourself in a room where you know that you are not supposed to be in.
The Archmage of Sorcere, Gorthe Bey-Sandrax, is not a nice Drow and would
definitely not enjoy the sight of you rummaging through his personal and
private belongings.  The room has a large desk set in the middle of a
beautiful red and purple carpet.  The chair behind the desk looks as if it
were made of the finest rothe hide.
npcs: Gorthe Bey-Sandrax, the Archmage of Sorcere

descKeys: a valuable asset to the academy. a small staircase leads up to the observatory.
r7037.description:
This is the Portal Room of Sorcere.  Long ago, the Archmage of Sorcere and his
many assistants created these portals in order to visit other realms.  At that
point in time, teleportation spells were not very reliable, so these portals
became a valuable asset to the academy.  A small staircase leads up to the
Observatory.

descKeys: by the archmagus of sorcere. a small staircase leads down into the portal room.
r7038.description:
You are in the topmost area of the Sorcere tower.  Large 'windows' are in each
of the four walls, looking out over Nal Shaddar.  These 'windows' are not
physical, but are magical.  They were a gift from a renegade Gnomish mage,
right before he was murdered by the Archmagus of Sorcere.  A small staircase
leads down into the Portal Room.

descKeys: must be gardening, too, for there are hundreds of potted plants around the room.
r7040.description:
Though elven economics is based more on bartering, the Bank of Elinost was
created to help facilitate commerce and business with non-elves.  You notice
that there are no other customers here, but the teller has kept himself
busy polishing and dusting the oak counters.  His hobby must be gardening,
too, for there are hundreds of potted plants around the room.

descKeys: leads down to the ground. you can also go west, where it seems to lead outside.
r7041.description:
You are in a small area above the floor of the hollow tree, on top of what
looks like to be the tree's trunk.  How it was formed this way, you will never
fully understand, as Eli can work in mysterious ways.  A small 'ladder' is
against one of the trunk's walls, and leads down to the ground.  You can
also go west, where it seems to lead outside.

descKeys: tree is to the east, and a small wooden ladder also leads up to another branch.
r7042.description:
You are standing on a large, but short, branch on the outside of the Life Tree.
The branch only goes out about fifteen feet where it stops suddenly, dropping
off in mid-air.  The branch seems stable enough to stand upon, however.  You
can see that an entrance into the Life Tree is to the east, and a small wooden
ladder also leads up to another branch.

descKeys: n the side of the tree to a lower branch, about twenty feet below your position.
r7043.description:
This branch outside of the Life Tree is quite magnificent.  The branch is about
twenty feet wide, and stretches out to the west about fifty feet.  Looking to
the north you can see the large city of Elinost, home of the Elves.  To your
immediate east is a small opening in the tree, allowing you to enter inside.
A small wooden ladder, overgrown with vines, leads down the side of the tree
to a lower branch, about twenty feet below your position.

descKeys: es are in the room, evidently used for sitting or just plain ornamental objects.

Priests of Eli Guild Board [ 92 messages.name: Priests of Eli Guild Board [ 92 messages, 92 new]

r7044.description:
You are standing inside of the Life Tree, named by the Priests of Eli in honor
of their life-giving Patron, Eli.  This part of the tree is fairly small, with
the only exit being to the west, where you would emerge outside of the tree
and onto a branch.  Mostly empty, this room must serve as a sort of meeting
room for the Priests.  A few large stones are in the room, evidently used for
sitting or just plain ornamental objects.

descKeys: along to the branch to the east, where it meets up with the tree's large trunk.
r7045.description:
You are standing near the end of a large branch that is extending outward
from the Life Tree, home of the Priests of Eli.  The branch tapers to about
five feet across right before the dropoff, but is about twenty feet wide near
the tree itself.  Looking down you can see the lush foliage of the Great
Forest, alive with woodland creatures and various forms of flora and fauna.
You can walk along to the branch to the east, where it meets up with the tree's
large trunk.

descKeys: ones are around as well, serving as stools. an exit to the room is to the north.
r7046.description:
This small 'room' inside of the Life Tree is evidently home to a Priest of Eli.
In one portion of the room is a small mat, obviously made from thatched weeds.
A few large stones are around as well, serving as stools.  An exit to the room
is to the north.

descKeys: ar you might be jeopardizing your own safety. there is a guard post to the east.
r7124.description:
You are just below the southwest tower of Castle Lorasin.  You hear loud
moaning noises and shrieks coming from above.  You are starting to believe
the rumors of the ghost that lives in the castle.  You have second thoughts
before heading up into the tower, for you fear you might be jeopardizing your
own safety.  There is a guard post to the east.

descKeys: ower's window. you get a feeling that the owner of the skeleton is still around.
r7125.description:
You are in the southwest tower of Castle Lorasin.  There are spider webs
hanging everywhere and insects crawling on the floor.  This place must have
been abandoned ages ago.  There is a skeleton lying on the ground, close to
the tower's window.  You get a feeling that the owner of the skeleton is
still around.

descKeys: can see the opening that is much lighter than any of the other areas around you.
r7126.description:
As you walk in, this area seems pretty developed. There is a rather
well-travelled road leading to the northwest.  While the small path leading
to the southwest does not look as travelled.  Also back to your east you can
see the opening that is much lighter than any of the other areas around you.

descKeys: o located. the boulders seem to line both sides of the path the entire way west.
r7127.description:
When you enter from the small path and look around, this place is quite
rocky.  There are mounds of boulders lining either side of the path.  The
path leads back towards an opening to the northeast where a road is also
located.  The boulders seem to line both sides of the path the entire way
west.

descKeys: ders, and another path continues south. a path also leads back towards the east.
r7128.description:
As you look around, this place looks just like all the others around it,
lined with large boulders, and there is nowhere to go except to follow one of
the paths.  The path continues west through a small crack in the boulders,
and another path continues south.  A path also leads back towards the east.

descKeys: n the boulders does not look normal compared to all the other stone around here.
r7129.description:
As you look around it looks no different from any other of the places around
here.  You see the small path to the north, and the boulders around you.
There is a small crack between two of the boulders.  The crack between the
boulders does not look normal compared to all the other stone around here.

descKeys: here the forest opens up more, or further into the forest in the by going north.
r7130.description:
There are many trees surrounding you.  On either side of you are very dense
woods that would be impossible to pass through.  The path you are walking on
is very hard to follow.  Further to the south you can see some kind of
strange rock formation that looks like it has some kind of opening in it.
You can head south into deeper woods to where the forest opens up more, or
further into the forest in the by going north.

descKeys: e it lightens up a bit more or you can attempt to enter the opening in the cave.
r7131.description:
Straight ahead is an opening to enter a dark cave.  It looks very spooky in
there.  You can't see any sign of light or life as you strain your eyes
trying to look in.  It is very strange that there is a cave in the middle of
the forest like this.  It looks as if no one has ever ventured here before,
and it would be a very good guess because of the protection the forest would
have given the cave.  The trees around here are very thick and overwhelming.
The path heads back towards the north where it lightens up a bit more or you
can attempt to enter the opening in the cave.

descKeys: in here. you can head further into the cave or also go back out into the forest.
r7132.description:
There is total darkness in here except for the opening.  You look around and
see the damp walls surrounding you.  The ground is nothing but packed dirt.
The ceiling is just above your head and you feel rather confined.  The cave
heads down towards the south where it looks to fork off in two different
directions.  It is tough to tell though since there is very little light in
here.  You can head further into the cave or also go back out into the
forest.

descKeys: you further into the cave. the opening up north seems to be the most appealing.
r7133.description:
You arrive here and feel very strange.  There is very little light, except
for the opening you can see up to the north which is providing a small amount
of light.  You can hear strange sounds all around you and you begin to wonder
whether or not you should go any deeper into the cave.  You come to a fork in
the two tunnels of the cave.  One of the tunnels heads off to the southwest
while the other heads to the southeast.  Both tunnels will take you further
into the cave.  The opening up north seems to be the most appealing.

descKeys: t it is some kind of bat guano. the tunnel heads towards the northeast and west.
r7134.description:
You follow the winding tunnel through the cave.  To the east you can hear a
small river running.  It still is extremely dark and it seems as if no one
has ever been in this cave before.  As you continue to follow the tunnel, you
step in something very soft which feels very strange in contrast to the hard
ground.  You look down and realize that it is some kind of bat guano.  The
tunnel heads towards the northeast and west.

descKeys: d it would be wise to keep heading south if you wish to get closer to the river.
r7135.description:
There are lots of different signs that lots of bats must live in this certain
part of the cave.  There is bat guano all over the floor.  You can also hear
them flying around up around the top of the cave.  Unfortunately it is too
dark and you can't see them clearly.  The tunnel leads in two directions,
towards the east and the south.  You can start to hear the river running a
little bit, and it would be wise to keep heading south if you wish to get
closer to the river.

descKeys: ies. the path also continues to lead down to the south and up towards the north.
r7136.description:
When you arrive and look around in the cave something seems very strange to
you.  It looks as if no one has been here in a very long time.  Next to you
is a small rope bridge that leads towards the southeast to another ledge off
in the darkness.  The sound of the river has now become very loud and if you
were to cross the rope bridge you would be much closer to it.  The bat guano
is laying around this part of the cave in great quantities.  The path also
continues to lead down to the south and up towards the north.

descKeys: he river from the easy across the ravine. the path leads to the north and south.
r7137.description:
The path here is very small, and it is extremely hard for you to maneuver
through.  The ceiling is very close to your head and you have about two feet
on either side of you.  If you were to take one to many steps on the eastern
side of the path you would fall down the ravine.  You can hear all kinds of
bats flurrying around this part of the cave and the odor of the bat guano has
overcome this whole area.  You can also hear the faint sounds of the river
from the easy across the ravine.  The path leads to the north and south.

descKeys: path gets smaller. down towards the south though the path begins to widen a bit.
r7138.description:
You arrive here and quickly come to notice the small rope bridge leading
towards the northeast.  Up towards the northeast you can hear the running
river.  Over across the ravine that the rope bridge clears you can see the
outline of another large bridge that may clear the river.  The path leads
towards the north and the south.  Up towards the north it looks as if the
path gets smaller.  Down towards the south though the path begins to widen a
bit.

descKeys: ere the path continues to grow larger and size and the downward slope increases.
r7139.description:
The path here is quite large and there isn't anything around this part of the
cave that grabs your attention.  You notice that this part of the cave begins
to slope downward a bit.  You can hear the sounds off towards the east of the
river, but you don't seem very close to it.  One of the paths heads back up
towards the north where the tunnels start to get thin and tight again.  The
other path heads towards the east where the path continues to grow larger and
size and the downward slope increases.

descKeys: ues to slope down towards the east and the path slopes back up towards the west.
r7140.description:
The path here is quite difficult to walk on.  There is a heavy downward slope
towards the south.  The path here looks as if there have been peope here
before.  You see a bit of light down towards the east.  It is much more damp
around this area.  There are lots of small insects that you can see on either
side of the cave lurking in the darkness.  The path continues to slope down
towards the east and the path slopes back up towards the west.

descKeys: own towards the southeast. you can also head back up the slope towards the west.
r7141.description:
You stand in the middle of a cold dark room.  You can see a narrow ridge
leading from this part of the cave through the middle of two ravines.  It
looks very dangerous to walk across the ledge.  As you walk up to the edge of
one of the ravines and look down you can't see the bottom of it, only
darkness.  Across the ridge towards the southeast you can see a small opening
to go deeper in the cave.  The ridge is about three feet wide and heads down
towards the southeast.  You can also head back up the slope towards the west.

descKeys: st. you would have to cross the ridges to go back to the other part of the cave.
r7142.description:
There are steps leading further down into the cave here.  It looks very dark
down the steps but something about it down there sparks your interest.  The
only light you have is from the small torch that is hanging from the side of
the wall.  This part of the cave is so cold that you start to shiver a bit.
You can head up towards the northwest or the northeast.  You would have to
cross the ridges to go back to the other part of the cave.

descKeys: et to the opening. you can also follow the dark tunnel up towards the northeast.
r7143.description:
It is very dark and you are quite hesitant to venture any further.  You can
see a narrow ridge leading from this part of the cave through the middle of
two ravines to another part of the cave.  As you walk up to the edge of one
of the ravines and look down you can't see the bottom of it.  Across the
ridge towards the southwest you can see a small torch lighting up another
opening to go deeper in the cave.  The ridge is about three feet wide and
heads down towards the southwest.  You must be very careful if you opt to
cross the ridge to get to the opening.  You can also follow the dark tunnel
up towards the northeast.

descKeys: t or the southwest. towards the southeast you can hear some of the ice cracking.
r7144.description:
You continue on through these dark caves and there still doesn't seem to be
any sign of life in this part of the cave.  The path curves some down towards
the southwest.  There are lots of noises coming from the southwest but you
can't see anything down there due to the darkness.  As you brush up against
one of the walls you feel how cold it is and it seems as if the further you
head into the cave the colder it gets.  You can head down towards the
southeast or the southwest.  Towards the southeast you can hear some of the
ice cracking.

descKeys: west seems very strange and there are some very odd noises coming from up there.
r7145.description:
You stand here overlooking the frozen lake.  Right out on the lake it doesn't
look very safe.  It is very cold here and the torch hanging on the wall is
the only thing providing any light.  The walls here look very dark but you
doubt anything is living around here due to the extreme cold.  The tunnel
here continues on towards the northwest.  It starts to get much darker up
towards the northwest.  The tunnel up towards the northwest seems very
strange and there are some very odd noises coming from up there.

descKeys: small torch that you can see to the south hanging off of one of the cave walls.
r7146.description:
The ice here doesn't feel safe at all.  It is cracking all around you and
whenever you step down you feel the ice cracking.  The ice looks much safer
towards the west and the north.  There doesn't seem to be any sign of life
around here and you can understand because of the extreme cold around this
part of the cave.  You are right on the bank of the lake and can get back on
to solid ground if you head further to the south.  There is another small
torch that you can see to the south hanging off of one of the cave walls.

descKeys: uthwest it looks much safer than this part of the lake or the part to the south.
r7147.description:
You look around and realize that this part of the lake doesn't feel very
solid.  Every step you take you hear some small cracks below your feet.  The
lake continues on towards the south and southwest.  You can also head back to
the north where you can see the bank of the lake along with a dim light.  As
you look down towards the south it looks as if the ice is becoming more thin
than this part of the lake and doesn't look too safe to walk on.  Down
towards the southwest it looks much safer than this part of the lake or the
part to the south.

descKeys: he south and the southwest. you can head back up the path towards the northwest.
r7148.description:
There is a small glowing torch here that grabs most of your attention as you
walk into the room.  You keep walking you step foot on something that feels
very strange and slippery.  You immediately look down and realize that you've
set foot on ice.  You are standing on the bank of a large frozen lake.  It is
very cold down here.  There is no way to understand how there is running
water so near by but you can still hear it.  The path stops here at the bank
of the frozen lake.  You can start walking out on the lake towards the south
and the southwest.  You can head back up the path towards the northwest.

descKeys: tion to the southeast. down towards the southeast you see a small glowing light.
r7149.description:
The path continues to slope down towards the southeast.  It is rather cold in
here and there are lots of cracking sounds coming down from the southeast.
You can't see any sign of movement or life around here, and it is probably
due to the very cold climate in this part of the cave.  The path slopes up
some towards the west and continues to slope down to a lower elevation to the
southeast.  Down towards the southeast you see a small glowing light.

descKeys: . the path also leads back towards the west where it looks a little bit ligther.
r7150.description:
As you look around it is very gloomy in here and it feels a litle humid.  You
can't hear anything and it starts to feel a little bit chilly in here.
Further into the caves you can hear something cracking.  There is no reason
why there isn't any kind of animals or insects that live around here.  The
path begins to slope down towards the east.  The path also leads back towards
the west where it looks a little bit ligther.

descKeys: nd you can see a little bit of the light coming through the opening of the cave.
r7151.description:
The small path that is winding through these dark caves starts to become much
darker towards the east.  You are not sure whether or not it is too smart to
go any further into the caves.  There is some small amounts of guano laying
on either side of the cave.  Towards the west you can hear some running
water.  It sounds as if you are pretty close to it but there is no way to
know.  Up towards the northwest it lightens up a little bit and you can see a
little bit of the light coming through the opening of the cave.

descKeys: y about walking any further because of all the cracking of the ice you can hear.
r7152.description:
You are standing on a frozen lake.  Towards the west you can see a river that
has led the water in to here, where it has frozen and formed the lake.
Coming off of the surface of the ice leading towards the west you can see a
wooden bridge that will take you across the running river.  The frozen lake
continues on towards the south and back up towards the northeast where you
can see the bank of the lake.  Up towards the northeast you can see a dim
light that is providing just enough light for you to see.  You feel a bit
uneasy about walking any further because of all the cracking of the ice you
can hear.

descKeys: as solid but still safe. the further you head into the cave the colder it gets.
r7153.description:
You are right next to the cave wall.  You are still standing on the frozen
lake and it feels quite sturdy.  There is no cracking in this part of the
lake.  The ice looks a little bit weaker to the east but you can see a
opening that could lead to solid ground.  You can head way up to the north
where the frozen lake extends and you can see the outline of a bridge.  You
can also head up towards the northeast where the ice doesn't look quite as
solid but still safe.  The further you head into the cave the colder it gets.

descKeys: . looking closer you see that these are actually the remains of a man-made fire!
r7154.description:
The tunnel gets a little wider. The tunnel does not seem completely natural,
the dirt is packed as hard as rock which doesn't seem right.  There are a few
scorch marks upon the floor of the tunnel.  Looking closer you see that these
are actually the remains of a man-made fire!

descKeys: s! and there are pieces of metal and other things that have not yet rotted away!
r7155.description:
Looking ahead the tunnel completely collapses.  You can go no further.
The only way to go is back.  There are still no traces of spider webs.  And
the foot prints are still not right.  Courageously you venture towards where the
cave-in occured.  There are human bones sticking out from under the pile of
dirt and rocks!  And there are pieces of metal and other things that have not
yet rotted away!

descKeys: used by the caravans running the north-south routes from threshold to kalinport.
r7156.description:
The Great Forest totally envelopes you, almost cutting you off from any sort
of view out of the trees.  The area gives you a sense of awe, gazing at the
surrounding greenery.  You are on a large road, about twenty feet in width,
that is used by the caravans running the north-south routes from Threshold
to Kalinport.

descKeys: ly southeast of here is a deep ravine that passes through the viluten mountains.
uth routes from threshold to kalinport. one small tree stands out in particular.
used by the caravans running the north-south routes from threshold to kalinport.

The Great Forest totally envelopes you, almost cutting you off from any sort

descKeys: tunnel continues west and even looks like it widens out a bit in that direction.
r7167.description:
The tunnel descends sharply downward here, going almost straight down into
the darkness.  You could easily lose your footing if you are not cautious.
A small opening in the wall to your north looks a bit out of the ordinary.
The dark tunnel continues west and even looks like it widens out a bit in
that direction.

descKeys: te nice, and are the main residence to many of the richer families of kalinport.
r7170.description:
You are standing somewhere in the Kalamshite Desert.  Huge sand dunes are
all around you, blocking yourThis is the middle- and upper-class section of Kalinport.  Most of the many
buildings and homes have been well-constructed using the finest of materials.
The homes to either side of Oasis Avenue are quite nice, and are the main
residence to many of the richer families of Kalinport.

descKeys: the south and the settled lands to the north. there is a plant in front of you.

path leading west through the desert.name: path leading west through the desert

r7181.description:
You are standing somewhere in the Kalamshite Desert.  Huge sand dunes are
all around you, blocking your view somewhat.  Looking around, you do not
see a speck of vegetation, only the rolling sands as far as you can see.
You are on the main caravan route between Kalinport to the south and the
settled lands to the north.  There is a plant in front of you.

descKeys: ademy, which all new players should go through. to leave the arena, type 'exit'.
r7230.description:
You go the easy route and hit the exit.  Your home town will be the default,
which is Nal Shaddar.

After a few seconds, you find yourself in a large Arena.

You are standing inside of a walled arena.  The ground is comprised of sand.
Above the walls lie many spectator stands, filled with cheering masses.  The
walls of the arena are too high for you to climb.  A small staircase leads down
into the arena floor.  Down those steps is a Donation room and also the famous
PowerMud Academy, which all new players should go through.

To leave the Arena, type 'exit'.

descKeys: lowly growing in height and majesty. the tunnel continues unabated to the north.
r7264.description:
You are standing at the beginning of a tunnel, or maybe it is the end of the
tunnel you are witnessing.  A large cavern starts here and extends to the
west, slowly growing in height and majesty.  The tunnel continues unabated
to the north.

descKeys: esembles a normal tunnel. a small cavern juts off through a tunnel to the north.
r7265.description:
The large cavern to the west has slowly dimished to about half of its height
and reached a steadying height of about forty-five feet at this juncture.
Off to the east, the cavern slopes down until it resembles a normal tunnel.
A small cavern juts off through a tunnel to the north.

descKeys: ks upon them, as if some large and fearsome creature regularly visits this area.
r7268.description:
The tunnel branches off here, leading three separate ways.  The stagnant air
in this part of the mines causes you to gag slightly.  While gagging, you
notice that the walls have scratch marks upon them, as if some large and
fearsome creature regularly visits this area.

descKeys: re is a small tunnel that is to the southwest, which leads away from the cavern.
r7278.description:
This cavern has a ceiling of perhaps twenty feet in height, and reaches back
to the east and northeast.  The area is free of debris, as if someone had
cleared it out.  There is a small tunnel that is to the southwest, which
leads away from the cavern.

descKeys: he eastern wall smells of fish, as that is probably where the garbage is buried.
r7279.description:
This part of the cavern is evidently used for a kitchen of sorts.  A small
pit is in the center of the area, surrounded by stones.  The pit is probably
used for a fire, but there are no ashes in the pit.  An area near the eastern
wall smells of fish, as that is probably where the garbage is buried.

descKeys: enty feet in height, and the width of the entire cavern is not over eighty feet.
r7280.description:
You are around the center of the cavern.  If you stop and listen, you will
probably hear faint echos from around the Underdark.  The cavern's ceiling
is about twenty feet in height, and the width of the entire cavern is not
over eighty feet.

descKeys: s like another passageway is being carved in the stone, but in the eastern wall.
r7320.description:
This part of the cavern has had a large cave-in.  What looks like a passageway
used to be in the northern wall, but the cave-in completely destroyed it.  Big
boulders that cannot be easily moved are around here, but there are no small
rocks laying around, interestingly enough.  It looks like another passageway
is being carved in the stone, but in the eastern wall.

descKeys: his area, you see that several 'benches' have been carved out of the solid rock.
r7321.description:
The cavern is not very large, only being about eighty feet at its widest point.
To the south you can see that a small tunnel starts, and pulls away from the
cavern, heading southwest.  In this area, you see that several 'benches' have
been carved out of the solid rock.

descKeys: for sure. off to the east you can see that there has been some sort of cave-in.
r7322.description:
This part of the cavern is evidently a sleeping quarters.  About fifteen
small beds have been 'carved' out of the rock.  The beds certainly do not

r7474.description:
The Plains stretch on and on, almost never ending.  Home to the nomadic
Plainsmen, the Plains provide game for the hunters and a much-needed sense
of openess that they so desire.  A tiny bush, trying to break through the
dirt to reach the sunlight, is at your feet, looking quite pitiful.

descKeys: ring nutrients from this dusty ground. the ground has been torn up in this area.
r7476.description:
The Plains seemingly run on forever, stretching out in every direction around
you.  Far off to the north you think you can spot where the Plains of Nereka
end and a vast body of water starts.  A small tree is trying to grow here but
is having a difficult time of gathering nutrients from this dusty ground.
The ground has been torn up in this area.

of view out of the trees.  The area gives you a sense of awe, gazing at the
surrounding greenery.  You are on a large road, about twenty feet in width,
that is used by the caravans running the north-south routes from Threshold
to Kalinport.
