descKeys: out of place. a small desk is in the center of the room, with a chair behind it.
r7709.description:
This room is used as the office of the Commander of the Homeguard.  The
stout Duergar who occupies this office is very military-like, so he keeps
the room in good order, nothing out of place.  A small desk is in the center
of the room, with a chair behind it.

descKeys: s a large space, the result of an explosion. there is a iron door leading west .
r7710.description:
You are standing in a large room filled with weird devices and instruments
that have been set around the area.  Large scorch marks and acid burns are
on the walls and tables, making the room look quite worse for the wear.  In
one of the walls is a large space, the result of an explosion.
There is a iron door leading west ( OPENED ).

descKeys: here is a small archway that leads towards the east where arcath's quarters are.
r7711.description:
This is a small meeting room that all of the Duergar merchants converse.  The
room is quite small and it lacks most of the inricate furnishings the rest of
the guild has.  There is a small fireplace inside the western wall.  There is
also a large round table in the middle of the room with comfortable chair
surrounding it.  The light is quite dim here, and there are aromas of pine
needles that fill your nose as you breathe in.  There is a small archway that
leads towards the east where Arcath's quarters are.

descKeys: small holes like his dot the plains, home to thousands of such varied varmants.
r7719.description:
A slight breeze is blowing around you, stirring up some dust, partially
obscurring your vision.  A small prairie dog pokes his head out of an
almost hidden hole, stares at you for a second, then pops back down into
the hole.  Small holes like his dot the plains, home to thousands of such
varied varmants.

descKeys: bush, startling you. the bunny then bounds away at top speed, running in terror.
r7720.description:
The Plains are running in every direction, going for miles and miles.  A
huge bush is right in front of you, looking quite out of place.  A small
rabbit bounds out from under the bush, startling you.  The bunny then bounds
away at top speed, running in terror.

descKeys: used by the caravans running the north-south routes from threshold to kalinport.

r7859.description:
You are standing at the entrance/exit to the Dwarven Mines, located beneath
the Dwarven Stronghold, which is in the Kal-Thax region.  The mines run deep
beneath the fortifications, stretching for many miles.  Few Dwarves know the
majority of the turns and twists of the tunnels, and none know all of them.
The mines stretch out in all directions from here, with a small stone stair-
case leading up to daylight.

The mine tunnels curve here a bit, heading south towards a large intersection
and northeast deeper into the darkness.  The floor of the mine tunnel is
well-worn around here, as if the traffic in these parts is quite heavy.  A
small crack is in the western wall.

descKeys: pen meeting area used by the merchants. there is a iron door leading southwest .
r7984.description:
This large office is used by the local Recruiter for the Merchant's Guild.
He is usually here, going through papers or looking over prospects.  A small
desk in one corner of the room must be used by the Recruiter.  Back to the
north is an open meeting area used by the Merchants.
There is a iron door leading southwest ( CLOSED ).

descKeys: ot. along the southern wall is an assortment of metallic items that need repair.
r7985.description:
You are in the city's smith, famous for it's repairing capabiltiy, rumored to
be the best in Merevia.  Along the wall there are hammers, pliers, wrenches,
and tons of other smithy equipment.   In the center of the room there is a
big furnace that is making the room way too hot.  Along the southern wall is
an assortment of metallic items that need repair.

descKeys: thick wood. two tunnels, one leading to the northeast, and one to the northwest.
r7986.description:
The walls here are built of stone piled upon stone.  The stone is nothing
fancy, but it serves its purpose well.  Mounted on the western wall, near the
ceiling is a large battle axe.  The axe has an inscription below it.  The
ceiling has a glass globe hanging from it on a chain.  Inside the globe there
is a lighted candle, it fills the room with a warm glow.  There are stairs
leading to the upper level of the guild, they are made of thick wood.
two tunnels, one leading to the northeast, and one to the northwest.

descKeys: s a few shields. the tunnel you are in leads to the southwest, and to the north.
r7987.description:
You are in the training room for the Merevian branch of the Stronghold guild.
The walls are made of stone, but have been covered with protective padded
mats.  On the western side of the room are six training dummies held aloft by
vertical wooden poles.  On the eastern side of the room is a large weapon
rack, it holds various kinds of slash weapons, as well as a few shields.  The
tunnel you are in leads to the southwest, and to the north.

descKeys: nt any serious damage. the tunnel leads to the northwest, and also to the south.
r7988.description:
This is the sparring room, where dwarves of this guild fight for the honor of
knowing that they are the stronger.  It is also used for teaching fighting
lessons to trainees.  The walls, as well as the floor are covered up by soft
mats.   There is a weapons rack on the eastern side of the tunnel, all the
weapons it carries have a leather cover on their blades to prevent any
serious damage.  The tunnel leads to the northwest, and also to the south.

descKeys: arious suits of armor. the only exit is the main hallway which is south of here.
r7989.description:
As you enter the room the atmosphere becomes a lot more serious and
business-like.  This is the office of the Merevian Honor Guard trainer,
Haffoy Rakclaw.  From here he can train members as well as attend to tasks
such as the important communication between he and his brother in Kal-thax.
Firmly planted in the middle of the room is a solid wooden desk littered with
letters and scrolls.  On the western side of the room there is a large
bookshelf made of the same material as the floor.  Along the eastern wall
lies what looks to be Haffoy's personal armory: a weapons rack, shields, and
various suits of armor.  The only exit is the main hallway which is south of
here.

descKeys: the ground here has turned completely to rock, as have all of the surroundings.
r7990.description:
When you walk into the room, you suddenly smell the stench of rotten bodies
and decomposing flesh.  The boulders around you are lined with human bones.
There is also a small tree growing out of one of the boulders, which is
extremely out of the ordinary.  The ground here has turned completely to
rock, as have all of the surroundings.

mountain sides, the Vilutens are extremely ancient, having been around long
before any civilized race existed on the continent.  You are presently in a
deep ravine, used by the caravans from the north and south to pass through
the Vilutens.

r8064.description:
Three milestones stand here in a crooked row, each tilted a different way,
as if drunk men had been set to count the miles to a place that no longer
wants visitors. The planks widen into a little island of firm peat, dotted
with black pools. To the north a trail of broken stepping stones wanders
off toward a still pond; west the causeway sinks into a wall of mist with
the shape of an arch inside it.

The Great Forest totally envelopes you, almost cutting you off from any sort
of view out of the trees.  The area gives you a sense of awe, gazing at the
surrounding greenery.  You are on a large road, about twenty feet in width,
that is used by the caravans running the north-south routes from Threshold
to Kalinport.

descKeys: leads into a small town. to the west is a trail that meanders through the trees.
r8219.description:
You are at an intersection in roads.  The road travelling north and south
is about twenty feet wide, and is known as the Caravan Route.  This Route
runs from Kalinport in the south all the way up to the northern towns and
villages.  To the southeast is a small road that leads into a small town.  To
the west is a trail that meanders through the trees.

descKeys: ur here. back to the west is the part of the city known as the northern warrens.
r8221.description:
You are wedged between two large houses, one to the north of you and one to
the south of here.  Looking around you see several blood stains on the ground.
It looks like unsavory activities occur here.  Back to the west is the part
of the city known as the Northern Warrens.

descKeys: g a mean streak in him a mile long. there is a stairwell on one wall leading up.
r8222.description:
You have entered a dark and smokey tavern, full of all those criminal types
that your mother warned you about.  Here and there scuffles break out and a
glint of steel catches your eye, right before it vanishes into warm flesh.
A few tables have been spread around, but they are mostly filled with scowling
Duergar, each having a mean streak in him a mile long.  There is a stairwell
on one wall leading up.

descKeys: have surrounded the graveyard look like they have been systematically poisoned.
r8246.description:
You are in an old graveyard, once used by the town of Threshold to bury
their dead within its boundaries.  Weeds and tall grass grow all over the
place, almost covering the graves and headstones.  The trees that have
surrounded the graveyard look like they have been systematically poisoned.

descKeys: iling with brute force. there seems to be an intersection of sorts to the south.
r8256.description:
The passageway runs into a dead end here, hitting a large wall of rubble
and debris.  The way to the north is totally blocked.  It looks like the
supports on the side of the passageway just gave way, collapsing the ceiling
with brute force.  There seems to be an intersection of sorts to the south.

descKeys: angely enough, no light shines in through the many holes that dot the two walls.
r8257.description:
The passageway is getting a little bit smaller here and to the south, but
widens out to the north, meeting an intersection.  The walls of the crypt
are in shambles, but strangely enough, no light shines in through the many
holes that dot the two walls.

descKeys: ard stone floor that has several rust-colored patches upon its corroded surface.
r8258.description:
The crypt's passageway takes a turn here, heading north and also heading to
the west, toward a dead end.  You suddenly have a bad feeling about going
west, and take an uneasy step towards the north.  Below your feet is a
cold and hard stone floor that has several rust-colored patches upon its
corroded surface.

descKeys: g about three feet in height. the stone floor beneath your feet is a rust-color.
r8259.description:
You are standing in a dead end of the crypt.  Several coffins are off to one
side, slightly open.  A pile of bones, some being fairly recent additions,
is in the middle of the room, reaching about three feet in height.  The stone
floor beneath your feet is a rust-color.

r8264.description:
A round hall of pale stone, wide as a market square, rises into a gloom where
the roof ought to be.  A great spiral stair climbs the centre of the room and
vanishes into the dark above.  Light-globes drift in the air like slow fish.
A brass plate on the first step reads: THE STAIR HAS NO TOP.  CLIMB AS FAR AS
YOU CAN.  THE GUARDIANS OF EACH FLOOR MUST FALL BEFORE THE NEXT STAIR OPENS.
YOU MAY ALWAYS GO DOWN.  Each group that climbs finds a tower of its own.
The door out stands to the south.

descKeys: . the stair winds back down. a corridor leads south into the heart of the floor.
r8265.description:
A brass numeral 9 is set into the floor, and runes crawl along the walls,
shifting whenever you stop looking at them.  The stair winds back down.  A
corridor leads south into the heart of the floor.

r8266.description:
A long corridor of green jade runs north, lit by floating lamps of pale fire.
 Doors line both walls, each sealed with a ward, and the runes on them spell
the number 4 over and over.  Behind you lies the landing, and ahead the
corridor opens into a great hall.

descKeys: u pass while the guardians of floor 1 live. the corridor lies back to the north.

r8285.description:
A causeway of black planks and rotted piles runs west out of the swamp, so
low that the brown water laps at its edge and sometimes over it. Reeds
crowd both sides as tall as a man, rattling though no wind moves. A mile
marker leans at the water's edge with its lettering long gone to moss. The
air is thick with the smell of peat, and from somewhere ahead comes the
slow, flat note of a bell that nobody is ringing.

descKeys: nder a low shroud of fog. a door stands ajar in a small timber hut to the north.
r8286.description:
A roofed lych-gate of blackened oak spans the path, its tiled roof sagging
under moss. This is where mourners once set down the coffin and waited for
the priest. A rusted bell hangs from the ridge on a rotted cord, and on
the beam under it someone has cut a row of tally marks, hundreds of them,
in short careful strokes. West, beyond the gate, the old burial ground
lies under a low shroud of fog. A door stands ajar in a small timber hut
to the north.

descKeys: plain wooden markers, and south into ground that looks softer, wetter and worse.
r8287.description:
Beyond the lych-gate the ground rises into a low hummock, and the dead
cover it in ranks. Headstones stand in rows too straight for the sinking
earth, their faces scoured blank by weather. Fog moves between them at
knee height as slowly as a tide. Paths of cracked flagstone lead west
toward a ruined chapel, north to a field of plain wooden markers, and
south into ground that looks softer, wetter and worse.

descKeys: leads west to the weeping statues, and a lean-to shed stands at the north edge.
r8288.description:
Here the burial ground gives up its pretensions. Plain wooden markers lean
at every angle over the shallow graves of people too poor for stone, each
one bearing a number and nothing else. The earth is the worst kind of wet,
and in places it has sunk into hollows where the coffins have collapsed.
Crows gather on the markers and watch you with an interest that is not at
all a bird's. A path leads west to the weeping statues, and a lean-to shed
stands at the north edge.

descKeys: arped into a curious square, and the lime has been scuffed away around its edge.
r8289.description:
A lean-to of warped planks propped against the north wall, crowded with
tools that have not seen use in years. Spades have rusted to lace and a
handcart lies on its side with a wheel gone. Under a tarpaulin there is a
long pit of lime, grey and bitter, still faintly steaming. Rats have made
nests in the sacking, and the wall bears a mural of charcoal tally marks
that someone has been adding to. The boards under the tarpaulin are warped
into a curious square, and the lime has been scuffed away around its edge.

descKeys: eads south to the main path, west toward the vestry, and north into a yew grove.
r8290.description:
A broad gravel walk runs through the northern half of the ground, edged
with the more expensive dead: marble angels with chipped wings, urns on
pedestals, a column broken off at the height of a man. Ivy has strangled
most of it. One angel has been turned to face the wall, perhaps by someone
who did not like her expression. The walk leads south to the main path,
west toward the vestry, and north into a yew grove.

descKeys: ng. to the north a gap in the old boundary wall shows a stretch of stone beyond.
r8291.description:
Seven great yews stand in a ring here, older than the village and perhaps
the swamp, their red-brown trunks fluted like the pillars of a cathedral.
The ground under them is a deep carpet of needles in which your steps make
no sound. Between the roots, small carved stones mark the graves of some
who were buried standing. To the north a gap in the old boundary wall
shows a stretch of stone beyond.

descKeys: . the yew grove lies south. even the mist seems reluctant to go through the gap.
r8292.description:
The old boundary wall of the cemetery has fallen in here, leaving a gap of
tumbled stone and stinging nettles. Through it a straight avenue of cut
stone runs north toward a row of tall grey tombs, and beyond them a drop
in the ground where something has been dug, and dug out again. The yew
grove lies south. Even the mist seems reluctant to go through the gap.

descKeys: or sure. a small set of stairs lead up towards a larger and more well-used room.
r8294.description:
This small room is used for a kitchen.  The cooking area is not very big,
and it is likely that only one individual works in here at a time.  A few
large pots are in here, full of something that is probably food, although
you cannot tell for sure.  A small set of stairs lead up towards a larger
and more well-used room.

descKeys: gar, but it subsides quickly. you can head down the stairwell to get to the pub.
r8295.description:
You are standing in a room apparently used for recreation.  The atmosphere is
dark and smokey and provides a great environment for bar fights.  Supposedly,
a few of the duergar merchants provided the finances to build this large room,
and you think you spot a few scattered about the room.  You notice a minor
scuffle ensue between two duergar, but it subsides quickly.  You can head down
the stairwell to get to the pub.

descKeys: mes are going. you almost feel tempted to start up a game with another opponent.
r8296.description:
This gaming room seems much quieter than the rest of the pub.  A few duergar
are around the room, hunched over tables.  Seemingly thinking very intently
on whatever is on the tables, you wonder how the Othello games are going.
You almost feel tempted to start up a game with another opponent.

descKeys: a tall grey tower of pale stone rises beside the road a short way to the north.

path leading north to the Wizard's Tower.name: path leading north to the Wizard's Tower

r8305.description:
You are near the town of Threshold, which is a little ways to the south.  All
along the road you are travelling upon, Gateway Road, there are small bushes
lining either side of it.  The funny thing is that they are all in great
shape, as if the town paid someone to take care of them.  A tall grey tower
of pale stone rises beside the road a short way to the north.

of view out of the trees.  The area gives you a sense of awe, gazing at the
surrounding greenery.  You are on a large road, about twenty feet in width,
that is used by the caravans running the north-south routes from Threshold
to Kalinport.

descKeys: leads into a small town. to the west is a trail that meanders through the trees.
r8417.description:
You are at an intersection in roads.  The road travelling north and south
is about twenty feet wide, and is known as the Caravan Route.  This Route
runs from Kalinport in the south all the way up to the northern towns and
villages.  To the southeast is a small road that leads into a small town.  To
the west is a trail that meanders through the trees.

descKeys: leasure. a mass of furs near the southern wall must serve as his sleeping place.
r8422.description:
This hut is used by the village's chief kobold.  The chief is not the chief
because of his intelligence, rather because of his brute strength.  He has
a small harem of about five kobold females that he keeps for his pleasure.
A mass of furs near the southern wall must serve as his sleeping place.

descKeys: ng trying to escape the confines of this hut. you have the sudden urge to leave.
r8423.description:
This small hut is extremely dirty and also smells tremendously bad.  The floor
of the hut is packed dirt.  Here and there are small holes, right against the
edges of the hut, evidently made by something trying to escape the confines
of this hut.  You have the sudden urge to leave.

descKeys: s hold a multitude of life. signs of large and small animals are all around you.
r8424.description:
You are standing on a small path that is meandering its way through a prairie
full of tall grass.  The valley you are in is not very large by most standards,
but it does hold a multitude of life.  Signs of large and small animals are
all around you.

descKeys: e valley up in flames. in the distance to the north you can see a small village.
r8425.description:
The path runs through a prairie that has large concentrations of high grasses.
Being about three feet high, the grasses are dry and brittle.  It would not
take much to send this whole valley up in flames.  In the distance to the north
you can see a small village.

descKeys: heast also, heading through the valley and then up to the surrounding mountains.
r8426.description:
You are just south of the halfling community of Lowhill.  The small village
has been in this valley for about eighty years, with the population of the
community staying relatively constant at about seventy individuals.  The path
you are on leads southeast also, heading through the valley and then up to the
surrounding mountains.

descKeys: the village is not visited very much by members of the other intelligent races.
r8427.description:
You are standing at the beginning of the halfling community of Lowhill.  The
small village has been here for about seventy years or so, and has stayed at
at a relatively constant population.  The community has few shops or trading
venues, and for that reason the village is not visited very much by members
of the other intelligent races.

descKeys: others. a few huts are here, looking like they are in desparate need of upkeep.
r8428.description:
The small and muddy path runs into an intersection of sorts here, with equally
grungy paths heading north, south, east, and southwest.  Any direction looks
about as sordid as the others.  A few huts are here, looking like they are in
desparate need of upkeep.

descKeys: the path, right under your left foot. there is a clearing of sorts to the north.
r8429.description:
The Narod's Bracelet is damaged by the sunlight!
You are near the northwest corner of Lowhill.  Looking around, you wonder why
any being would want to live in these conditions, as the huts that they live
in are quite sub-standard in appearance.  A small rivulet of water is running
down the path, right under your left foot.  There is a clearing of sorts
to the north.

descKeys: y, with its head and haft probably blighting out the sun. some flowers are here.
r8430.description:
The plateau is almost symmetrically flat and rhombus shaped.  It looks like
some great god smote Mt. Kulajo with a hammer, forming this spectacular area
you are now in.  The size of this hammer must have been extraordinary, with
its head and haft probably blighting out the sun.  Some flowers are here.

descKeys: creature frequents this area, feeding on the local villagers and their families.
r8431.description:
You are at the scene of a major disaster.  Small tables and benches have been
overturned and huge gouges of mountaintop have been ripped out of the ground.
It looks like some huge creature frequents this area, feeding on the local
villagers and their families.

descKeys: and looks to be used often. you can see the caravan route back to the northwest.
r8435.description:
This large road runs from the main Caravan Route all the way to Jaarmin Keep.
The Keep, which you can see off to the east, has walls that surround the city,
protecting it from any outside threat.  The road itself is well-made and
looks to be used often.  You can see the Caravan Route back to the northwest.

descKeys: e surfaced about the keep. speaking of the keep, you can see it off to the east.
r8436.description:
You are on the well-travelled road that runs between the medium-sized city
of Jaarmin Keep and the Caravan Route.  As of late the traffic using this
particular road has dwindled, as people that visit the Keep sometime never
leave.  Rumors of corrupt city officials and cruel guards have surfaced
about the Keep.  Speaking of the Keep, you can see it off to the east.

descKeys: g trees that almost touch the road, giving it a shady appearance during the day.
r8437.description:
The road is about twenty feet wide at its widest and is made out of packed
stone, a practice which you do not see much elsewhere.  On either side of
the road lies the Great Forest.  There are many branches from overhanging
trees that almost touch the road, giving it a shady appearance during the day.

descKeys: nlight during the early morning. the road is travelling both west and southeast.
r8438.description:
This road is running through the Great Forest, however you can see the large
mountains of the Viluten Mountain Range that is to the south.  Tall peaks
can be seen jutting into the sky, sometimes cutting off the sunlight during
the early morning.  The road is travelling both west and southeast.

descKeys: east. the road also travels back to the west, heading towards the caravan route.
r8439.description:
You have heard things about Jaarmin Keep, but who knows what is true or not.
Tales of rape, pillaging, and torture come out of the city.  Strange things
happen there.  Speaking of the Keep, it is rather close, only being a few
hudred feet to the east.  The road also travels back to the west, heading
towards the Caravan Route.

descKeys: age looks old and you are surprised that someone has not repaired it before now.
r8440.description:
This part of the road is in poor condition.  Parts of it are missing entirely.
Something must have happened here to cause it to be in disrepair.  However,
the damage looks old and you are surprised that someone has not repaired it
before now.

descKeys: k you can see a large body of water to the far east. it must be an ocean or sea.
r8441.description:
The road is travelling east towards a large walled city, and back to the west
it heads through the Great Forest, probably towards the Caravan Route.  All
sorts of trees, big and small, line the sides of the road.  If you strain
your eyes hard enough, you think you can see a large body of water to the
far east.  It must be an ocean or sea.

descKeys: to watch your step. the large gate is to the northeast that leads into the keep.
r8442.description:
You are directly outside of a large walled city named Jaarmin Keep.  The
organization that runs this city is called the Jaarmintrium, and they are
known to be very ruthless in their dealings with outsiders.  You may find
it wise to watch your step.  The large Gate is to the northeast that leads
into the Keep.

descKeys: out the gate to the west lies a large dirt road that travels through the forest.
r8443.description:
You are just east of a large iron gate.  The gate is about fifteen feet high
and looks incredibly solid.  Looking to you right and left you can see that
a large stone wall is surrounding this city, and it only has a few openings,
this being one of them.  To the southeast is the rest of the city, and out
the gate to the west lies a large dirt road that travels through the forest.

descKeys: r road. this part of the keep looks well-used, as you can see many people about.
r8444.description:
You are travelling upon Exterri Road.  The wide throughway is going in two
directions: northwest towards a large gate, and southeast towards an inter-
section with another road.  This part of the Keep looks well-used, as you can
see many people about.

descKeys: min way, leads east from here, heading towards the merchant section of the keep.
r8445.description:
You are at the intersection of Exterri Road and Jaarmin Way.  The larger
of the two throughways, Exterri Road, leads northwest towards the Western
Gate, and southeast towards the main Temple.  The other road, Jaarmin Way,
leads east from here, heading towards the merchant section of the Keep.

descKeys: this city. the city was named after him, as was this road you are on right now.
r8446.description:
This fortified city was founded many years ago by the followers of Xenei.
One of the first Diciples of Xenei was a young man named Helf Jaarmin.  He
became a leader of the Disciples, and helped found this city.  The city
was named after him, as was this road you are on right now.

descKeys: here, but most seem to be boarded up and probably closed to the general public.
r8447.description:
Jaarmin Way is running east and west here, east towards the mercantile section
of the Keep, and west towards the Western Gate.  You see several buildings
around here, but most seem to be boarded up and probably closed to the
general public.

descKeys: probably temple avenue. that road is a straight shoot south to the main temple.
r8448.description:
You are on Jaarmin Way, directly north of a large shop.  The shop, which
looks like it has been here forever, has a large sign out in front of it.
To the east you can see another road, which is probably Temple Avenue.  That
road is a straight shoot south to the main Temple.

descKeys: closed, however, and some of the buildings are almost falling in on themselves.
r8449.description:
Temple Avenue meets another road here, called Jaarmin Way, which is travelling
east and west.  The buildings in this area indicate that this is the mercantile
section of the Keep.  Most of the shops look to be closed, however, and some
of the buildings are almost falling in on themselves.

descKeys: stray dogs wander around aimlessly, sniffing here and there for anything edible.
r8450.description:
You are on Temple Avenue, directly south of a rather large intersection of
two main roads.  The buildings in this part of the Keep are quite shabby,
with all them needing a good facelift.  Stray dogs wander around aimlessly,
sniffing here and there for anything edible.

descKeys: f garbage that have piled up over the months. the stench is almost overwhelming.
r8451.description:
This part of the Keep must be the 'bad' part.  The buildings that line the
road are almost falling in on themselves.  The road itself is full of holes
and is not easily traversed.  Here and there are piles of garbage that have
piled up over the months.  The stench is almost overwhelming.

descKeys: , next to a small building, you notice a small pool of liquid, reddish in color.
r8452.description:
This is Temple Avenue.  Directly south of here is an intersection with another
large road, Exterri Road.  That part of the Keep is usually the busiest, as
it is in close proximity of the main Temple.  If you were to head in a northern
direction, you would pass through the mercantile section of the Keep.  Off to
the side of the road, next to a small building, you notice a small pool of
liquid, reddish in color.

descKeys: n throughway of the keep, is here as well, leading both northeast and northwest.
r8453.description:
You are travelling in the busiest location of the Keep.  People are milling
around, some in groups, and some just wandering around alone.  Directly to
the south of here is a large Gate that leads directly into the face of a
mountain.  Past that Gate is the main Temple of Xenei, where the Disciples
have their headquarters.  To the north of here is Temple Way, which leads
all the way to the North Gate, and also passes through the main mercantile
section of the Keep.  Exterri road, the main throughway of the Keep, is here
as well, leading both northeast and northwest.

descKeys: e, as some are forced into slavery, or worse. back to the north is exterri road.
r8454.description:
You are just inside of a large iron gate that is about fifteen feet tall.  The
Gate looks very sturdy, and is free of any blemishes.  Past the Gate to the
south lies the main Temple of Xenei.  Pilgrims from all over the world
travel here to worship the dark Xenei.  However, not all leave this place, as
some are forced into slavery, or worse.  Back to the north is Exterri Road.

descKeys: can see a large road, probably the caravan route. the path also continues east.
r8455.description:
This small path is meandering its way through a large forest full of an
expansive amount of trees, both large and small in stature.  Off to the
west you can see a large road, probably the Caravan Route.  The path also
continues east.

descKeys: r the lowest branch. a couple of bright blue birds are hovering around the nest.
r8456.description:
The path narrows a bit here, getting down to approximately three feet in
width, barely large enough for you to traverse.  Looking up through the
trees, you can see a small nest situated near the lowest branch.  A couple
of bright blue birds are hovering around the nest.

descKeys: ers using the caravan route, which is just a bit to the east from your position.
r8457.description:
You are just outside of the human town of Crossroads.  The town, which is to
the west, was founded by a few merchants seeing an opportunity to make some
good money off of the travelers using the Caravan Route, which is just a bit
to the east from your position.

descKeys: sell various goods. the 'main' part of the town is west and southwest from here.
r8458.description:
The small town of Crossroads does not have much to offer, only having a few
shops, but is quite popular with the travellers of the Caravan Route.  The
travellers can stop in for a bit to drink and buy/sell various goods.  The
'main' part of the town is west and southwest from here.

descKeys: the other way, the path leads toward a larger road. a small shop is to the west.
r8459.description:
The small path meanders right up to a small building to the north and stops
at the doorstep.  The building seems to be a tavern of sorts, judging by
the small sign hanging from the front.  Going the other way, the path leads
toward a larger road.  A small shop is to the west.

descKeys: service. a larger road is to the northeast. off to the south is a small stable.
r8460.description:
As you can probably see, Crossroads is not very large, only having one or
two shops or taverns.  One shop is to the west of here, buying and selling
various goods to travellers in need of this service.  A larger road is to
the northeast.  Off to the south is a small stable.

descKeys: must be cared for regularly. if you head to the north you will exit the stables.
r8461.description:
This is a small stable, which also continues to the south.  Several stalls
are here, housing many horses.  From the looks of the animals, they are in
good shape, and must be cared for regularly.  If you head to the north you
will exit the stables.

descKeys: l piles of hay are around here, used for food by the animals that are kept here.
r8462.description:
You are in a small stable that also continues to the north.  The walls of the
stable are made from a dark wood that has no visibile cracks or blemishes in
its surface.  Several piles of hay are around here, used for food by the
animals that are kept here.

descKeys: hrough. the owner of the shop, boglen shaddath, should be around here somewhere.
r8463.description:
You are standing in the only tailor's shop in Crossroads.  The shop has
only been here for a little while, so it has a limited stock of items for you
to browse through.  The owner of the shop, Boglen Shaddath, should be
around here somewhere.

descKeys: s are set in front of the bar, with a few chairs having been set up around them.
r8464.description:
You are standing in an extremely small tavern located in Crossroads, a small
human town that is right off the main caravan route.  A short bar is against
the northern wall, running for perhaps ten feet.  Two wooden tables are set
in front of the bar, with a few chairs having been set up around them.

descKeys: orest consist here of mostly pines and a few sprigs of bilberry and lingonberry.
r8465.description:
You are standing on a small path that continues in two directions, east, on to
the Caravan Route, and northwest, further away from it.  There are trees all
around you, preventing you from getting any view.  The forest consist here of
mostly pines and a few sprigs of bilberry and lingonberry.

descKeys: used by the caravans running the north-south routes from threshold to kalinport.
r8466.description:
The Great Forest totally envelopes you, almost cutting you off from any sort
of view out of the trees.  The area gives you a sense of awe, gazing at the
surrounding greenery.  You are on a large road, about twenty feet in width,
that is used by the caravans running the north-south routes from Threshold
to Kalinport.

the west is a trail that meanders through the trees.

surrounding greenery.  You are on a large road, about twenty feet in width,
that is used by the caravans running the north-south routes from Threshold
to Kalinport.

r8806.description:
You are standing somewhere in the Kalamshite Desert.  Huge sand dunes are
all around you, blocking your view somewhat.  Looking around, you do not
see a speck of vegetation, only the rolling sands as far as you can see.
You are on the main caravan route between Kalinport to the south and the
settled lands to the north.

descKeys: ssion in the western wall allows you to move in that direction, but only barely.
r8820.description:
This tunnel leads back to the east, that direction being shrouded in complete
and absolute darkness.  The walls in this area are smooth, as if something
regularly patrols around here, tending to its perfection.  The ground, though,
is rough and rocky.  A small depression in the western wall allows you to move
in that direction, but only barely.

descKeys: nd this area are smooth, oddly enough. a faint dripping sound reaches your ears.
r8821.description:
The tunnel is heading east and west at this point.  To the west it looks like
the tunnel ends, while to the east it appears that the tunnel turns to the right
a bit.  The walls around this area are smooth, oddly enough.  A faint dripping
sound reaches your ears.

descKeys: he underdark. a dark spot on one of the walls draws your attention for a moment.
r8822.description:
The tunnel that you are in takes a turn here, heading to the west and also to
the southeast.  the walls of the tunnel are quite smooth, making you wonder who
comes down to this section of the UnderDark.  A dark spot on one of the walls
draws your attention for a moment.

descKeys: he tunnel is quite rough, as if there is not a lot of traffic around this place.
r8823.description:
The tunnel narrows here, closing down to about eight feet in height and perhaps
ten feet in width.  Although that is not too cramped, you would rather it be a
a bit wider than it actually is.  The floor of the tunnel is quite rough, as if
there is not a lot of traffic around this place.

descKeys: o be found. a soft footfall is right behind you. was that just your imagination?
r8824.description:
You are in a tunnel in the UnderDark.  Off in the distance you think you can
hear a dripping sound, probably water nearby from a stream or river.  The walls
of the tunnel are smooth, with hardly a blemish to be found.  A soft footfall
is right behind you.  Was that just your imagination?

descKeys: in contrast to the walls. who knows what manner of creature inhabits this area.
r8825.description:
The tunnel turns sharply here.  it heads to the northeast and also back to the
northwest, where it appears to turn again.  The walls are smooth, but covered
with bat guano.  The floor of the tunnel is rough, in contrast to the walls.
Who knows what manner of creature inhabits this area.

descKeys: nbelievably smooth. you can travel either to the north or back to the southwest.
r8826.description:
This tunnel is quite dark, and a bit damp.  The walls of the tunnel are smooth,
with nary a crack to be found.  Here and there you can see patches of bat guano
on the walls, but for the most part it is unbelievably smooth.  You can travel
either to the north or back to the southwest.

descKeys: ell, it could be a trick of your overactive imagination. it is probably nothing.
r8827.description:
The tunnel turns here, heading into the darkness in two directions:  south and
east.  the ceiling of the tunnel looks a bit odd, as if there was something
moving up there.  Ah well, it could be a trick of your overactive imagination.
It is probably nothing.

descKeys: t mind would take up residence here in the vicious underdark? shaking your head,
r8828.description:
This part of the tunnel is quite wide.  You see a slight alcove in the southern
part of the tunnel.  It resembles a sleeping area of sorts!  Who in their right
mind would take up residence here in the vicious UnderDark?  Shaking your head,

descKeys: slip every now and then. back to the west you see the tunnel turns to the left.
r8829.description:
Just east of here you can see that the tunnel ends abruptly.  This part of the
tunnel is no different, you see that the walls are indeed quite smooth.  The
floor of the tunnel is rough, though, causing you to slip every now and then.
Back to the west you see the tunnel turns to the left.

descKeys: uano. it seems that you are not alone down here in the tunnels of the underdark.
r8830.description:
You are at a dead-end in the tunnels.  It seems you can only head back to the
west, through the darkness.  The walls here are smooth, but covered in a thick
layer of bat guano.  It seems that you are not alone down here in the tunnels
of the UnderDark.

descKeys: black and purple seem to be in a much sordid existence, totally enveloping you.
r8831.description:
You are 'floating' around in what can only be described as a living nightmare.
Swirling mists and glancing winds are all around you, passing above you and
possibly even through you.  Dark shades of black and purple seem to be in a
much sordid existence, totally enveloping you.

descKeys: hole leads downward. you wonder what becomes of the sacrifices tossed down here.
r8845.description:
After climbing a long way down the throat of the altar statue,
you find yourself in a dark pit.  The only light comes from the
statue's mouth high above.  The ground is soft and red.  A gaping
hole leads downward.  You wonder what becomes of the sacrifices
tossed down here.

descKeys: you think you are sinking, but find your footing three inches deep in the sand.
r8847.description:
The walls in this room are perfectly smooth, as if something had
sanded them down.  A large skin of some kind is nestled in the corner.
A fine sand makes walking a bit unsteady.  For a second you think you
are sinking, but find your footing three inches deep in the sand.

descKeys: some creature has been trying to claw its way through the massive stone column.
r8848.description:
A giant stalactite hangs down from the ceiling and crunches into the
floor below, perhaps supporting the entire world above.  There are
scratch marks all across the rocks.  Some creature has been trying to
claw its way through the massive stone column.

descKeys: chling's first meal: a dwarven skeleton. the tunnel leads back out to the south.
r8849.description:
Crawling through a tunnel of the main pit, you arrive in what looks
like a nest.  A large egg lies in a corner, already hatched.  Next to it
evidently is the leftovers of the hatchling's first meal: a dwarven
skeleton.  The tunnel leads back out to the south.

descKeys: t must live here to which all the shaman's sacrifices inevitably fall victim to.
r8850.description:
Your situation has not improved.  The floor is covered in bones, all of
which show signs of savagery.  Blood and rotting flesh form pools on
the floor.  A savage beast must live here to which all the shaman's
sacrifices inevitably fall victim to.

descKeys: orched and stained with blood. you feel as if no living soul has ever left here.
r8851.description:
No light reaches down to this, the dankest, deepest pit beneath the dark
altar.  You can barely make out the hole above you, but a series of
deep scratches will allow you to crawl out.  The walls hear are scorched
and stained with blood.  You feel as if no living soul has ever left here.

descKeys: ere is a adamatite door leading south . there is a adamatite door leading west .
r8891.description:
You are in the main part of the House.  This sanctuary is used by the Nobles
of the House when they are plotting to destroy other Houses.  Several large
couches and chairs are here, with several tables having been placed against
one of the walls.  The main balcony is back to the east.
There is a adamatite door leading east ( LOCKED ).
There is a adamatite door leading south ( LOCKED ).
There is a adamatite door leading west ( LOCKED ).

descKeys: the ocean. you can also head back to the opening in the trees to the southeast.
r8892.description:
As you walk on the road the ocean comes into existance.  From the road you
can see the water just as it is meeting the horizon.  There are still lots of
trees around you, but the road continues on towards the overall direction of
the ocean.  You can also head back to the opening in the trees to the
southeast.

descKeys: the road also continues west where you can hear a old sailor's tune being sung.
r8893.description:
When you arrive you immediately realize how close you are to the ocean.  The
breeze coming off the water feels extremely good, and beaches line the
waterfront as far as you can see.  There is a fairly large pier protruding
from the waterfront out into the ocean to the north.  The road also continues
west where you can hear a old sailor's tune being sung.

descKeys: ehind the west bench. the trail leads into a forest that is further to the west.
r8894.description:
As you arrive at the dead end of the road, this place looks as if it is where
all the bums hang out.  There are benches all around here, and there are lots
of pathetic attempts to give cover to the people that might stay here.  The
road leads back to the pier, which is not very far from this place.  On
closer inspection this might not be a dead end after all, there is a small
trail next to the bush that is behind the west bench.  The trail leads into a
forest that is further to the west.

descKeys: appears to have been well preserved over the centuries that they've stood here.
r8895.description:
You are in the outskirts of a forest.  If you head west from here the path
will take you deeper into the woods, while going east will take you out to
the road.  The trees here are quite thick and appears to have been well
preserved over the centuries that they've stood here.

descKeys: orates the sides of the path. the path seems to widen up a bit towards the west.
r8896.description:
As you enter this part of the forest you notice something different about the
trees.  They are smaller around here which indicates that they are younger
than the ones to your east.  Some small rocks decorates the sides of the
path.  The path seems to widen up a bit towards the west.

descKeys: on is rocky and uneven, making it easy to stumble if you don't watch your step.
r8897.description:
The trees around you sway gently as a slight gust of wind blows through the
area.  A lone bird can be seen flying in the air above you.  The bird seems
to be going to the east, away from this part of the forest.  The path you are
walking on is rocky and uneven, making it easy to stumble if you don't watch
your step.

descKeys: . looking at ground you notice some large, dragon-like tracks leading northwest.
r8898.description:
You have reached a fork in the forest path.  A stream of water flows from the
northwest, then crosses the southwest fork and continues towards the south.
Luckily there is a wooden bridge spanning over the stream.  Behind the bridge
you spot some tents that seems to have been set up recently.  Looking at
ground you notice some large, dragon-like tracks leading northwest.

descKeys: e flows from the northwest and then heads southward by the east side of he camp.
r8899.description:
You are in a camp located in an open part of the forest.  There is a lot of
activity here, several troops can be seen walking around in this area.  There
is also a guard post placed by the bridge to the northeast.  It's there to
prevent any dragonoids from crossing over it.  The stream that runs under the
bridge flows from the northwest and then heads southward by the east side of
he camp.

descKeys: . a tent south of you stands out in particular, as it is larger than the others.
r8900.description:
This is the center of the camp.  There are several tents surrounding you,
they have been set up to serve as temporary barracks for the troops that are
fighting againts the dragonoids.  A tent south of you stands out in
particular, as it is larger than the others.

descKeys: the left side of the path, evidently there has been a battle here not long ago.
r8901.description:
The path splits in four directions here.  To the west you can see a forest
starting, while the camp continues in all other directions.  Some remains
from a slain dragonoid lies in the grass on the left side of the path,
evidently there has been a battle here not long ago.

descKeys: , but not always, as the dragonoids tend to do random attacks on the encampment.
r8902.description:
This is the westernmost edge of a fighter encampment.  If you proceed
northwest from here you will enter unsafe territory, while heading towards
east will bring you into the encampment.  A guard post is here.  It's usually
manned, but not always, as the dragonoids tend to do random attacks on the
encampment.

descKeys: also notice an opening among the trees which will take you away from this path.
r8903.description:
Looking northwest you see that the path leads over an uphill slope.  To the
southeast however, the path will take you to an open area in the forest.
There is also a guard post placed there to prevent dragonoids from entering
that area.  Northeast of here you also notice an opening among the trees
which will take you away from this path.

descKeys: e slope. the path also branches off halfways through the slope, going northeast.
r8904.description:
You are standing in a slope that goes downhill towards the southeast where it
then evens out.  Looking to the northwest doesn't reaveal much as you can't
see over the upper edge of the slope.  The path also branches off halfways
through the slope, going northeast.

descKeys: ugh. the vegetation around here seem to consist mostly of moss and some heather.
r8905.description:
You are at the top of a path that travels to the southeast, where it goes
downhill, and to the west, where it levels out.  Looking down the slope you
see that it connects with another path halfway through.  The vegetation
around here seem to consist mostly of moss and some heather.

descKeys: kind. except for the sides there's also a few rocks embedded in the path itself.
r8906.description:
The pine trees grow widely apart here, and there is a large collection of
rocks providing some decoration on the north side of the path.  The rocks
vary in size, but most of them are of the larger kind.  Except for the sides
there's also a few rocks embedded in the path itself.

descKeys: . a minor obstacle in the form of a mossy log lies on the path to the northwest.
r8907.description:
The path travels around the base of a twenty feet high cliff.  There's a
plethora of thicket and moss growing along the sides of this path, and while
there barely are any trees here they increase in quantity to the northwest.
A minor obstacle in the form of a mossy log lies on the path to the
northwest.

descKeys: glimmering light reaches your eyes as it comes through the trees to your north.
r8908.description:
The forest path is winding it's way back and forth through the trees.  It's
hard to get through without getting a branch in the face, as they are packed
quite closely together in this area.  A ray of glimmering light reaches your
eyes as it comes through the trees to your north.

descKeys: immer a lot, either from the sunlight in the day, or the moonlight in the night.
r8909.description:
The lack of vegatation in this area suggests that the forest ends here.  The
area to the north is barren, and is apparently filled with crystals in
different formations.  The crystals shimmer a lot, either from the sunlight
in the day, or the moonlight in the night.

descKeys: into this field, while if you take the south path you will end up in the forest.
r8910.description:
As you travel on the rocky, barren path, you can't help looking at the
beautiful crystal formations that are sprouting up from the ground just like
plants.  There's something unnatural about these crystals, they are almost
too perfect.  The path continues in three directions from here.  Going west
or northeast will take you further into this field, while if you take the
south path you will end up in the forest.

descKeys: see anything without getting dazzled by the glimmering light that they produce.
r8911.description:
A single rock lies next to the path.  It looks a bit out of place, as it's
the only rock around here.  The amount of crystals here is almost absurd.
There's so many of them that it's hard to see anything without getting
dazzled by the glimmering light that they produce.

descKeys: limmer, almost by themselves, but there is also something very wrong about them.
r8912.description:
The crystals in this rocky and barren field seems to be spreading towards the
north, into the forest, taking over it by killing any plantlife that they get
close to.  These crystals may look beautiful as they glimmer, almost by
themselves, but there is also something very wrong about them.

descKeys: y a thick layer of trees to the east you can also spot the large aryndaris lake.
r8913.description:
The forest seems to end to the south, leading out into a field filled with
various crystal formations.  The light from the shimmering crystals doesn't
quite reach to this point, as there are too many trees obscuring the view.
Hidden by a thick layer of trees to the east you can also spot the large
Aryndaris lake.

descKeys: ot be so wise, as there are rumours about vicious creatures inhabiting the lake.
r8914.description:
A small side path leads of from here and down past a few spruce trees to the
southeast and then stops in front of Aryndaris lake.  This looks like a good
spot to enter the lake.  Although doing so might not be so wise, as there are
rumours about vicious creatures inhabiting the lake.

descKeys: a briar patch is to your south, looking quite unfriendly with it's long thorns.
r8915.description:
There is a ditch just beside the verge on the north side of the path.  The
ditch seems to be around two feet deep at the most, and travels southwest
alongside the path for as long as you can see from here.  A briar patch is to
your south, looking quite unfriendly with it's long thorns.

descKeys: ice that it's impossible to enter it from here, as the undergrowth is too thick.
r8916.description:
This path travels around the Aryndaris lake, but there is also a small branch
that heads off to the northeast, past a set of bushes and up on a ridge.
When looking at the lake to the south you notice that it's impossible to
enter it from here, as the undergrowth is too thick.

descKeys: r. the patch is just next to the verge of the path, and doesn't spread very far.
r8917.description:
There are a few holes in the ground here, so you have to watch your step to
avoid tripping over one.  On the east side of the path there is a nice patch
of heather.  The patch is just next to the verge of the path, and doesn't
spread very far.

descKeys: ge path will intersect with another path that circles around the aryndaris lake.
r8918.description:
You are on the west side of a ridge.  The path slopes a lot uphills towards
the east, and it's quite bumpy as well, so travelling east doesn't seem like
an easy task.  If you go southwest the ridge path will intersect with another
path that circles around the Aryndaris lake.

descKeys: ou can get a very good overlook of the aryndaris lake below the ridge from here.
r8919.description:
You are now at the top of the ridge.  From here the path goes downhill in
both directions, however the path on the west side of the ridge seems a lot
steeper than the one on the southeast side.  The view at this point is quite
exquisite, and you can get a very good overlook of the Aryndaris lake below
the ridge from here.

descKeys: most likely from a dragonoid, they travel both uphill and downhill on the ridge.
r8920.description:
When you look down to the southwest of the ridge you can see a lake
stretching out a bit to the south.  When looking at the path you can also see
some tracks, most likely from a dragonoid, they travel both uphill and
downhill on the ridge.

descKeys: of the forest, but a few of them can still be seen on the east side of the path.
r8921.description:
At this point the path will take you north, uphill a ridge, and south down to
a crossroads.  You notice that the amount of trees around here is a lot more
sparse than the rest of the forest, but a few of them can still be seen on
the east side of the path.

descKeys: to the east. two other paths branches off from this one, leading north and west.
r8922.description:
You are in a crossroads of several paths.  The main path leads east and
south, around an elevation in the ground.  The elevation has many trees
standing on it and is quite wide, reaching far to the east.  Two other paths
branches off from this one, leading north and west.

descKeys: ead carefully, in case you run into one of the dragonoids that occupy this area.
r8923.description:
If you head north you will end up in a crossing of several paths, while going
southeast will take you through a curve.  You can't see what's on the end of
the curve, as it bends too much.  So if you decide to head in that direction
you should tread carefully, in case you run into one of the dragonoids that
occupy this area.

descKeys: the north side of the path is quite thick and looks impossible to pass through.
r8924.description:
Tracks lead in both directions on the path here.  They seem to be recent and
are probably from some dragonoids.  There are several rocks scattered over the
ground here.  The underbrush on the north side of the path is quite thick and
looks impossible to pass through.

descKeys: the elevation is filled with trees, making it impossible to pass through there.
r8925.description:
You are on a straight stretch on a path heading east and west.  East of here
you see the path taking a turn towards the south.  On the south side of the
path the ground is elevated a few feet above the ground.  The elevation is
filled with trees, making it impossible to pass through there.

descKeys: east side of the path grabs your attention, as they look a little out of place.
r8926.description:
The path bends here, going south and west.  You notice that the path is a bit
uneven at this point, making it a little harder to travel on.  A few bushes
lying on the east side of the path grabs your attention, as they look a
little out of place.

descKeys: ess. a set of tracks near the base of the tree reveals the culprit, a dragonoid.
r8927.description:
At this point the path curves to the north and southwest.  One of the trees
standing on the elevated platform west of you has fallen to the ground and is
partly obstructing your progress.  A set of tracks near the base of the tree
reveals the culprit, a dragonoid.

descKeys: leads away from this one, heading up a slope behind some trees to the southeast.
r8928.description:
You are walking on a wide path circling around a platform of trees.  The
platform is elevated aproximately two feet above the ground and the trees
there seems newer than the rest.  Another path leads away from this one,
heading up a slope behind some trees to the southeast.

descKeys: breed, but quite common in this forest, and they are looking green and healthy.
r8929.description:
The path bends here, going northwest and east around a large elevation in the
ground.  The elevation is quite wide, spanning for several yards north from
here.  Looking around the area you spot a set of bushes to your west.  They
are of an unusual breed, but quite common in this forest, and they are
looking green and healthy.

descKeys: of here. you notice some tracks leading down the slope, and then they just stop.
r8930.description:
The path you are travelling on slopes steeply downhill towards the east.
Once the path evens out at the bottom of the slope it leads into a
crossroads, there is also another crossroads to the west of here.  You notice
some tracks leading down the slope, and then they just stop.

descKeys: e, unfortunately the underbrush is too thick to allow you to enter it from here.
r8931.description:
As you travel along this path you come across a spruce grove.  The grove is
on the east side of this path and there is a plethora of spruces in it that
are packed densely together, which in turn has prevented their growth
somewhat.  Looking at the west side you see Aryndaris lake, unfortunately the
underbrush is too thick to allow you to enter it from here.

descKeys: e to the southwest that will take you over a stream that emanates from the lake.
r8932.description:
You are in a crossroads of several paths.  When examining the paths you see
that the south path will take you through an alley, while the east path will
take you down through a steep slope.  The north and southwest path goes
around the large Aryndaris lake which is to the west of here.  You also spot
a bridge to the southwest that will take you over a stream that emanates from
the lake.

descKeys: enter the stream from this point, although it doesn't look to be very inviting.
r8933.description:
You are in the northern end of an alley.  While the trees are packed quite
closely together on both sides there is an opening among them to the south.
The opening takes you out into the stream, over a short landbridge.  It looks
like you can enter the stream from this point, although it doesn't look to be
very inviting.

descKeys: , flows a little faster at this point as it slopes a bit downwards to the south.
r8934.description:
You are halfway through the alley.  The trees that stand on both sides of the
alley are packed thight together and doesn't allow any movement on the
outside.  The stream which is located on the west side of the alley, behind
the trees, flows a little faster at this point as it slopes a bit downwards
to the south.

descKeys: s to splash some as it hits a set of rocks situated in the middle of the stream.
r8935.description:
As you travel through the alley you notice a few mud ponds on the ground.
They lie near the west side of the path and reflect the sky as you look at
them.  The mud ponds have most likely been created from the water of the
stream that flows on the west side of the path, as the water tends to splash
some as it hits a set of rocks situated in the middle of the stream.

descKeys: the daytime. if you head southeast you will find yourself in a fork in the path.
r8936.description:
You are infront of one of the ends of an alley.  The alley will take you
north and has many trees on both sides.  The trees have thick branches that
would give a good amount of shade during the daytime.  If you head southeast
you will find yourself in a fork in the path.

descKeys: nately the thick underbrush prevents you from entering the stream at this point.
r8937.description:
The main part of this path leads northwest, while a smaller path branches off
and heads northeast.  There is a stream of water on the west side of this
path and it's heading southeast.  Unfortunately the thick underbrush prevents
you from entering the stream at this point.

descKeys: on't run into one of them. southwest of here this path joins with a bigger path.
r8938.description:
Trees stand on both sides of the path here.  The path isn't very wide and is
starting to slope a bit downwards to the northeast.  This forest has been
claimed by the dragonoids, so you better watch out so you don't run into one
of them.  Southwest of here this path joins with a bigger path.

descKeys: the path as well, so you have to watch your step so you don't stumble over one.
r8939.description:
The narrow path is sloping a lot downwards to the northwest at this point.
And at the end of this slope it merges with a wider path.  Looking to the
southwest you see that this path isn't sloping as steeply though.  There are
several roots from the surrounding trees that runs over the path as well, so
you have to watch your step so you don't stumble over one.

descKeys: here for awhile, apparently reclaiming the forest was harder then they thought.
r8940.description:
A stream of water flows behind a group of trees to your north.  The stream
travels southeast, towards a wooden bridge.  There are several tents to your
south, they belong to an army that has set camp here.  They seem to have been
here for awhile, apparently reclaiming the forest was harder then they
thought.

descKeys: it seems that the army won this one, as there is now a guard post situated here.
r8941.description:
There is a large crater in the ground telling you that there has been a large
battle here between the dragonoids and the occupants of the camp.  Probably
not long ago, as there is still some fire burning inside it.  It seems that
the army won this one, as there is now a guard post situated here.

descKeys: t there. there is a vast birch grove spreading out on the west side of the path.
r8942.description:
At this point the path runs north and south.  There is also another path
leading away from this one, taking you to a guard post.  Behind the guard
post you see a set of tents leading you to the assumption that there is an
encampment there.  There is a vast birch grove spreading out on the west side
of the path.

descKeys: re is a large patch of briar spreading over the edge sloping down to the stream.
r8943.description:
This path travels southeast between a stream to the north and a birch grove
to the west.  The birch grove is quite large and while it's not particularly
thick, it's too overgrown with bushes and thicket to be entered.  There is a
large patch of briar spreading over the edge sloping down to the stream.

descKeys: attered over the ground. a large battle must have taken place here not long ago.
r8944.description:
The forest is thickening around the path while the path itself it getting
more narrow to the south.  Some corpses from both slain dragonoids and
dwarves and halflings lie scattered over the ground.  A large battle must
have taken place here not long ago.

descKeys: path. you notice that there is a lot of moss growing on the sides of this path.
r8945.description:
The narrow path is decreasing in width even more further down to the
southwest until it almost seems to come to an end.  However, there is an
opening in the trees down there which leads out to another path.  You notice
that there is a lot of moss growing on the sides of this path.

descKeys: a rather large birch grove which seems quite overgrown with bushes and thicket.
r8946.description:
At this point the path curves to the northwest and southwest.  If you head
southwest this path will take you to the middle of a long slope.  You can
also choose to go northwest, where the curve seems to straighten up.  To your
north you spot a rather large birch grove which seems quite overgrown with
bushes and thicket.

descKeys: e curve. a large set of rocks lie right in front of the birch grove to the east.
r8947.description:
If you head north from this point you will end up in one of the many
intersections of paths in this forest.  In the other direction the path
curves to the southeast and then goes behind a thick set of trees that
obscure the view, preventing you to see what's beyond the curve.  A large set
of rocks lie right in front of the birch grove to the east.

descKeys: in the birch grove cross over the northeast path and then go down near the lake.
r8948.description:
Three paths intersect at this point, coming from south, northeast and
northwest.  You can get a fairly good view of Aryndaris lake that is a bit to
the north of here.  A few roots from the trees in the birch grove cross over
the northeast path and then go down near the lake.

descKeys: f you decide to head down the southwest path it will take you into another fork.
r8949.description:
You have reached a point in the path where it forks, going southeast and
southwest around a birch grove and north across a stone bridge.  There is
also a stream that travels alongside with the southeast path.  If you decide
to head down the southwest path it will take you into another fork.

descKeys: ose to the north, but due to the thick undergrowth you can't enter it from here.
r8950.description:
This part of the forest path is a lot more rocky compared to the southeast.
Traveling here requires that you keep a little more attention on the road to
avoid tripping.  The trees down to the southwest seem to be more sparse as
well.  Aryndaris lake is quite close to the north, but due to the thick
undergrowth you can't enter it from here.

descKeys: he forest. the path slants somewhat upwards to the south, heading up to a cliff.
r8951.description:
As you travel along the winding forest path you notice a large anthill
standing on the east side of it.  It must be at least eight feet wide.
There's plenty of activity around the anthill, as the ants travel back
and forth with different building materials that they've collected from
the forest.  The path slants somewhat upwards to the south, heading up to
a cliff.

descKeys: th from here. you can also spot a field of crystal that is further to the north.
r8952.description:
The path stops abruptly to the south, right at the top of a cliff.  There are
no trees on the cliff, so you can get a good view of the surroundings from
here. That includes the path that runs below.  The cliff is quite steep, and
it's at least twenty feet down to the other path from here.  You can also spot
a field of crystal that is further to the north.

descKeys: ere as well. it seems that these crystals have killed away all of it now though.
r8953.description:
A lone, dead tree stands among the multitude of crystals.  This tree is the
last remnant of vegetation.  The tree indicates that once, long ago, there
must have been a forest here as well.  It seems that these crystals have
killed away all of it now though.

descKeys: of a large hill starting a bit to the south and spanning a long way to the west.
r8954.description:
This path is very rough and uneven, with plenty of rocks scattered all over
it.  Most of the crystal formations are on the north side of the path,
however there is an exceptionally large formation with the size of a large
hill starting a bit to the south and spanning a long way to the west.

descKeys: bruptly. a large rock stands next to this formation, looking a bit out of place.
r8955.description:
You are in a curve in the path, which will take you either east or northeast.
A large crystal formation is to the south, with a small side path that
travels towards it from the main path and then just stops abruptly.  A large
rock stands next to this formation, looking a bit out of place.

descKeys: nds in the high grass, which indicates that you may not be as alone as it seems.
r8956.description:
Some tents stand to your east, and behind them you can see the center of the
fighter encampment.  The outer parts of the camp doesn't seem to be very
populated, however you occasionally hear some deviating rustling sounds in
the high grass, which indicates that you may not be as alone as it seems.

descKeys: ects the sunlight right into your eyes, almost blinding you with its brilliance.
r8962.description:
Walking around in the Plains of Nereka, you sense a feeling of loneliness,
due to the open and vast region.  The grayish dirt beneath your feet is as
fine as any sand and just reflects the sunlight right into your eyes, almost
blinding you with its brilliance.

descKeys: through the dirt to reach the sunlight, is at your feet, looking quite pitiful.
r8965.description:
The Plains stretch on and on, almost never ending.  Home to the nomadic
Plainsmen, the Plains provide game for the hunters and a much-needed sense
of openess that they so desire.  A tiny bush, trying to break through the
dirt to reach the sunlight, is at your feet, looking quite pitiful.

descKeys: you can see the huge absinthe mountain range. a small plant is in front of you.
r8966.description:
The never ending Plains of Nereka are expansive as well as full of bounty.
Scores of roaming herds of pack animals cross the plains, leaving behind
wide swaths of footprints and destroyed vegetation.  To the east you can
see the huge Absinthe Mountain Range.  A small plant is in front of you.

descKeys: through the dirt to reach the sunlight, is at your feet, looking quite pitiful.
r8971.description:
The Plains stretch on and on, almost never ending.  Home to the nomadic
Plainsmen, the Plains provide game for the hunters and a much-needed sense
of openess that they so desire.  A tiny bush, trying to break through the
dirt to reach the sunlight, is at your feet, looking quite pitiful.

descKeys: caravan route between kalinport to the south and the settled lands to the north.
r8972.description:
You are standing somewhere in the Kalamshite Desert.  Huge sand dunes are
all around you, blocking your view somewhat.  Looking around, you do not
see a speck of vegetation, only the rolling sands as far as you can see.
You are on the main caravan route between Kalinport to the south and the
settled lands to the north.

The Great Forest totally envelopes you, almost cutting you off from any sort
of view out of the trees.  The area gives you a sense of awe, gazing at the
surrounding greenery.  You are on a large road, about twenty feet in width,
that is used by the caravans running the north-south routes from Threshold
