The Great Forest totally envelopes you, almost cutting you off from any sort
of view out of the trees.  The area gives you a sense of awe, gazing at the
surrounding greenery.  You are on a large road, about twenty feet in width,
that is used by the caravans running the north-south routes from Threshold
to Kalinport.

descKeys: through the dirt to reach the sunlight, is at your feet, looking quite pitiful.
r8993.description:
The Plains stretch on and on, almost never ending.  Home to the nomadic
Plainsmen, the Plains provide game for the hunters and a much-needed sense
of openess that they so desire.  A tiny bush, trying to break through the
dirt to reach the sunlight, is at your feet, looking quite pitiful.

descKeys: a huge and imposing castle, bristling with activity from the knights of nereka.
r8994.description:
You are standing in the Plains of Nereka.  The Plains stretch on for miles
with nary a tree or bush to be found, except near the bordering regions.
A ways to the west you can see a huge and imposing castle, bristling with
activity from the Knights of Nereka.

descKeys: ded from years of exposure to determine to which race the rock's visage belongs.
r8998.description:
The tunnel starts to widen out here, gaining in size to the south.  Directly
in the middle of the tunnel lies a peculiar rock.  The rock is shaped like
a head, although the facial features have been rounded from years of exposure
to determine to which race the rock's visage belongs.

descKeys: jected to many gases, and should not be breathed for prolonged portions of time.
r9002.description:
There is a large hole in the ceiling here, with several handholds along the
wall leading up into it.  The air down in the bottom part of the mines has
most likely been subjected to many gases, and should not be breathed for
prolonged portions of time.

descKeys: d and treasure have been heaped up all around you, looking like a king's ransom.
r9003.description:
You are standing in a huge cavern that has a ceiling that is open to the
sky.  Burn marks and deep gouges are in the cavern walls, presumably put
there by this lair's owner.  Speaking of the occupant of this lair, you
suddenly trip over a dragon scale that was laying upon the ground a few feet
in front of you as you entered the cavern.  Large piles of gold and treasure
have been heaped up all around you, looking like a king's ransom.

descKeys: esembles a normal tunnel. a small cavern juts off through a tunnel to the north.
r9005.description:
The large cavern to the west has slowly dimished to about half of its height
and reached a steadying height of about forty-five feet at this juncture.
Off to the east, the cavern slopes down until it resembles a normal tunnel.
A small cavern juts off through a tunnel to the north.

descKeys: ere is a adamatite door leading south . there is a adamatite door leading east .
notes: listen: You hear faint bits of conversation.
smell: You can smell a faint musty smell.

senses.listen: You hear faint bits of conversation.
senses.smell: You can smell a faint musty smell.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r9011.description:
You are in the main part of the House.  This sanctuary is used by the Nobles
of the House when they are plotting to destroy other Houses.  Several large
couches and chairs are here, with several tables having been placed against
one of the walls.  The main balcony is back to the east.
There is a adamatite door leading west ( LOCKED ).
There is a adamatite door leading south ( LOCKED ).
There is a adamatite door leading east ( LOCKED ).

descKeys: re is a adamatite door leading north . there is a adamantite door leading west .
notes: listen: You hear faint bits of conversation.
smell: You can smell a faint musty smell.

senses.listen: You hear faint bits of conversation.
senses.smell: You can smell a faint musty smell.
senses.search: You search around and find nothing.

r9012.description:
You are in hallway in the interior of the House.  The Nobles are just about the
only ones allowed in this area.  The walls of the hallway are a deep blue color,
something rarely seen in Nal Shaddar.  Decorations on the wall depict Loth in
all her glory.  Back to the south you can see a general gathering room.
There is a adamantite door leading east ( LOCKED ).
There is a adamatite door leading north ( LOCKED ).
There is a adamantite door leading west ( LOCKED ).

descKeys: ridor turns west. you see a chandelier hanging in the ceiling, shining brightly.
r9024.description:
This corridor leads to the living quarters of Lord Lorasin.  There are also
some more paintings on the walls here, and the red carpet goes on, stoping
ahead north where the corridor turns west.  You see a chandelier hanging in
the ceiling, shining brightly.

descKeys: the light here comes from the chandelier hanging in the center of the corridor.
r9025.description:
The corridor ends here, and as the corridor ends the lining of the red carpet
comes to an abrupt stop.  As you strain your eyes to look to the west it
looks as if there is a guard post there which usually has guards posted to
protect Lord Lorasin and keep people out of his quarters.  The only painting
here is hanging on the northern wall, it is a portrait made of Lord Lorasin
V, the current owner of the castle.  The light here comes from the chandelier
hanging in the center of the corridor.

descKeys: s a flower basket hanging on the southern wall, making the corridor look better.
r9026.description:
You can see Lord Lorasin's quarters to the west from here, and it's usually
heavily guarded.  To the north is a corridor leading west to the living
quarters of the residents of Castle Lorasin, and east to the northeast tower.
There is a flower basket hanging on the southern wall, making the corridor
look better.

descKeys: quarters. you can see lord lorasin's living quarters to the southwest from here.
r9027.description:
This is the north corridor of castle's upper level.  To your east is the
northeast tower, and to the west is a corridor leading to the castle
residents quarters.  You can see Lord Lorasin's living quarters to the
southwest from here.

descKeys: ral windows on the northern wall, starting from here to the end of the corridor.
r9028.description:
You are at the northern part of the upper levels of Castle Lorasin, in a
corridor leading to east and west.  You see towers on the west and east ends
of this corridor.  There are several windows on the northern wall, starting
from here to the end of the corridor.

descKeys: the window. this corridor is quite plain-looking, and has very few decorations.
r9029.description:
You are walking in a corridor heading east and west.  The sun shines brightly
from the window on the northern wall, casting a shadow on the southern wall
from the bars of the window.  This corridor is quite plain-looking, and has
very few decorations.

descKeys: wall, it tells about the history of this castle and the ones who have owned it.
r9030.description:
You are quite close to the resident's living quarters, which starts a step
west and then south from here.  A gold colored plaque has been set up on the
southern wall, it tells about the history of this castle and the ones who
have owned it.

descKeys: n you. a large statue of lord lorasin iv has been placed against the north wall.
r9031.description:
The resident's quarters starts directly south of here, and you can also spot
a library down there.  To the west is the nortwest tower.  It gets a little
colder here, as you head outside the reach of the windows and the sun is no
longer shining on you.  A large statue of Lord Lorasin IV has been placed
against the north wall.

descKeys: e is a stairway leading up to the top of the tower placed against the west wall.
r9032.description:
You are in the northwest tower of Castle Lorasin.  The only light source here
comes from the windows in the corridor to the east.  The windows provide
enough light for you to see in here, but they do not provide any warmth for
this part of the corridor making it very cold.  There is a stairway leading
up to the top of the tower placed against the west wall.

descKeys: view there is nothing else here to see, except the brick walls surrounding you.
r9033.description:
You are at the top of the northwest tower.  The view from the window is
excellent, you can see the forest that surrounds the castle, and also the Sea
of Honshale.  But apart from the nice view there is nothing else here to see,
except the brick walls surrounding you.

descKeys: here south down to the end of the corridor. there is a wood door leading west .
r9034.description:
This is the private living quarters for the resident's of Castle Lorasin.
This part of the castle is more decorated than the rest of the castle.  Nice
paintings with nature motives are lined up on the eastern wall.  A red carpet
stretches from here south down to the end of the corridor.
There is a wood door leading west ( OPENED ).

descKeys: ld be very pleased that you are in his room. there is a wood door leading east .
r9035.description:
You are in one of the private quarters belonging to one of the castle
resident's.  This room has a very personal decoration.  A working desk stands
in the northeast corner, and there is a bed next to it.  This room has a
window on the west wall, looking out over the surrounding forest, and you can
even spot the Sea of Honshale beyond it.  You doubt the resident would be
very pleased that you are in his room.
There is a wood door leading east ( OPENED ).

descKeys: here is a stairway in the middle of the room leading up to the top of the tower.
r9036.description:
This is the northeast tower of Castle Lorasin.  As you look to the west you
see a corridor leading to the residents living quarters and the northwest
tower.  There is a stairway in the middle of the room leading up to the top
of the tower.

descKeys: east with the wind. there is a stairway leading down to the bottom of the tower.
r9037.description:
You are at the top of the northeast tower of Castle Lorasin.  You can feel a
small breeze coming from the window on the northern wall.  When you look
outside it you can see some clouds floating in the sky, heading east with the
wind.  There is a stairway leading down to the bottom of the tower.

descKeys: ndow you can see a huge forest. the stair leads back down to the tower entrance.
r9038.description:
You are in the southeast tower of Castle Lorasin.  There is a window here
with much light coming from outside, making it very bright in here.  Outside
the window you can see a huge forest.  The stair leads back down to the tower
entrance.

descKeys: s castle are elves and will not harm anyone. there is a iron door leading east .
r9039.description:
You are inside the torture chamber.  There are several odd devices here,
probably used to torture captured prisoners to get information.  The devices
are a stretching bench, a chair with spikes on and a fire pit, used to fry
the victim.  The chamber is very dusty and appears not to have been used for
a long time, as the inhabitants of this castle are elves and will not
harm anyone.
There is a iron door leading east ( OPENED ).

descKeys: is chamber after the humans left the castle. there is a iron door leading west .
r9040.description:
You are in the castle's treasure room.  The room is huge and filled with
piles of gold, jewels, valuable weapons and armors that are scattered around
everywhere.  You could stand here for hours, just staring at the gold.  The
elves in this castle do not value treasure very much, but have still kept
this chamber after the humans left the castle.
There is a iron door leading west ( OPENED ).

descKeys: one. there is a glass door leading south . there is a wooden door leading east .
r9042.description:
You are between the bank to your south and the guard station to your east.
You can hear loud and angry shouts coming from the bank to the south,
probably some customer not too happy about their money balance.  The guard
station to the east is the headquarters of some of the best guards ever to be
trained.  The street is well made of very precious stone.
There is a glass door leading south ( OPENED ).
There is a wooden door leading east ( OPENED ).

descKeys: al of kelton's guards in uniform saluting. there is a wooden door leading west .
r9043.description:
You are standing in Kelton's guard station.  There is a desk with papers
cluttered all over it on the eastern side of the room.  On the southern side
of the room is a jail cell that looks to be well-worn.  On the northern side
of the room is what seems to be a mural of Kelton's guards in uniform
saluting.
There is a wooden door leading west ( OPENED ).

descKeys: ooth on the northwestern side of the bank. there is a glass door leading north .
r9044.description:
You are in Kelton's bank.  On the southern side of the room is a reception
desk cluttured with papers and bills.  This is where Kelton's citizens keep
their money.  On the eastern wall there is a painting of a woman throwing
coins out to the poor.  There is a guard booth on the northwestern side of
the bank.
There is a glass door leading north ( OPENED ).

descKeys: re is a adamatite door leading north . there is a adamantite door leading east .
r9053.description:
You are in hallway in the interior of the House.  The Nobles are just about the
only ones allowed in this area.  The walls of the hallway are a deep blue color,
something rarely seen in Nal Shaddar.  Decorations on the wall depict Loth in
all her glory.  Back to the south you can see a general gathering room.
There is a adamantite door leading west ( LOCKED ).
There is a adamatite door leading north ( LOCKED ).
There is a adamantite door leading east ( LOCKED ).

descKeys: n inhabits this lair, probably a green. it would be wise if you left right away.
r9057.description:
You are standing in a forest lair.  The trees have been trampled down over
a large area of approximately forty feet in diameter.  Judging from the
large piles of gems and gold stacked around, you can safely surmise that
a dragon inhabits this lair, probably a Green.  It would be wise if you
left right away.

descKeys: esembles a normal tunnel. a small cavern juts off through a tunnel to the north.
r9058.description:
The large cavern to the west has slowly dimished to about half of its height
and reached a steadying height of about forty-five feet at this juncture.
Off to the east, the cavern slopes down until it resembles a normal tunnel.
A small cavern juts off through a tunnel to the north.

descKeys: source of the glow. a small tunnel breaks off from the cavern to the northwest.
r9059.description:
The cavern grows in size to the south, and gently diminishes to the east.  The
point of the cavern you are now in glows faintly with a greenish hue.  Looking
at the walls, you notice a strange type of fungus attached to it.  The fungus
must be the source of the glow.  A small tunnel breaks off from the cavern
to the northwest.

reptiloid-village.label: Reptiloid Village
notes: Threshold newbie area, swamp south of Threshold (gates r1465). Male/Female reptiloid, Reptiloid child. Lizard men (aggressive) roam the swamp path.

newbie-arena.label: Newbie Arena
notes: Walled arena around PowerMud Pete (exp < 500); exits only by `exit` or the 500-exp boot to Elinost.

merevia.label: Merevia
notes: Island port reached by the Kendrite Passages ship from Deepwater (r2251).
